CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.catalog_rebind_violations(planned_basis jsonb, revision integer, declarations_bytes bytea)
 RETURNS bytea
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE property truss.prop_def%ROWTYPE;owner truss.type_def%ROWTYPE;object_row truss.object%ROWTYPE;affected bigint;missing bigint;violations jsonb;violation_buffer jsonb[]:=ARRAY[]::jsonb[];owner_index jsonb;paired_fields jsonb;paired_required boolean;
BEGIN
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_object_agg(t.value->>'type_id',t.value),'{}'::jsonb) INTO owner_index FROM jsonb_array_elements(planned_basis->'type_def') t;
 -- Original source/declaration correspondence and known DDD evolution were
 -- admitted by the caller. Keep the empty-only paired addition distinct from
 -- the existing independently qualified retained-value core rebind route.
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_object_agg(jsonb_build_array(r.value->>'documentId',r.value->>'moduleId',r.value->>'elementId')::text,
  r.value->'declaration'->'extensions'->'umf.ddd'->'fields'),'{}'::jsonb) INTO paired_fields
 FROM jsonb_array_elements(convert_from(declarations_bytes,'UTF8')::jsonb) d
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(d.value->'records') r
 WHERE jsonb_typeof(r.value->'declaration'->'extensions'->'umf.ddd'->'fields')='object';
 FOR property IN SELECT * FROM jsonb_populate_recordset(NULL::truss.prop_def,planned_basis->'prop_def') p WHERE p.since_rev=revision LOOP
  SELECT * INTO STRICT owner FROM jsonb_populate_record(NULL::truss.type_def,owner_index->property.type_id::text) t WHERE t.type_id=property.type_id;
  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM truss.type_def WHERE type_id=property.type_id) THEN CONTINUE;END IF;
  IF truss.runtime_can_read(owner.document_id,owner.module) IS NOT TRUE
   OR truss.runtime_can_read(owner.document_id,property.declaration_module) IS NOT TRUE
   OR property.cardinality IN ('array','map') AND truss.runtime_item_chain_readable(property.item) IS NOT TRUE THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'original candidate owner/property/item readers required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
  IF truss.valid_property_definition(property) IS NOT TRUE THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'supported planned rebind property required' USING ERRCODE='0A000';END IF;
  paired_required:=property.nullability='required' AND coalesce(
   (paired_fields->jsonb_build_array(owner.document_id,owner.module,owner.element)::text) ? property.element,false);
  FOR object_row IN SELECT o.* FROM truss.object o WHERE o.type_id=property.type_id
   AND (o.root_id IS NOT NULL OR o.root_type IS NOT NULL)
   AND (property.nullability='required' OR coalesce(o.retained ? property.name,false)) LOOP
  PERFORM truss.runtime_history_ownership(jsonb_build_object(
   'identity',jsonb_build_object('id',object_row.id::text,'typeId',object_row.type_id::text),
   'catalogRevision',object_row.rev,'ownership',truss.runtime_object_ownership_at(to_jsonb(object_row))));
  END LOOP;
  SELECT count(*) INTO missing FROM truss.object o WHERE o.type_id=property.type_id AND property.nullability='required'
   AND (paired_required OR coalesce(o.retained ? property.name,false) IS NOT TRUE OR o.retained->property.name='{"kind":"null"}'::jsonb);
  IF missing>0 THEN
   violation_buffer:=array_append(violation_buffer,jsonb_build_object('documentId',owner.document_id,'moduleId',owner.module,
    'recordId',owner.element,'fieldModuleId',property.declaration_module,'fieldId',property.element,
    'rule','property.required','affectedObjectCount',missing::text));
  END IF;
  SELECT count(*) INTO affected FROM truss.object o WHERE o.type_id=property.type_id AND coalesce(o.retained ? property.name,false)
   AND NOT (property.nullability='required' AND o.retained->property.name='{"kind":"null"}'::jsonb)
   AND (property.nullability NOT IN ('required','absent-allowed') OR o.props ? property.prop_id::text
    OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_populate_recordset(NULL::truss.key_def,planned_basis->'key_def') k WHERE k.type_id=property.type_id AND property.prop_id=ANY(k.prop_ids)
     AND (k.since_rev IS DISTINCT FROM revision OR k.is_primary IS DISTINCT FROM false
      OR property.nullability IS DISTINCT FROM 'required' OR property.cardinality IS DISTINCT FROM 'one'
      OR property.scalar_type NOT IN ('string','integer','decimal','boolean','binary')))
    OR truss.valid_property_value(o.retained->property.name,property) IS NOT TRUE);
  IF truss.runtime_can_read(owner.document_id,owner.module) IS NOT TRUE
   OR truss.runtime_can_read(owner.document_id,property.declaration_module) IS NOT TRUE
   OR property.cardinality IN ('array','map') AND truss.runtime_item_chain_readable(property.item) IS NOT TRUE THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'original candidate owner/property/item readers required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
  IF affected>0 THEN
   violation_buffer:=array_append(violation_buffer,jsonb_build_object('documentId',owner.document_id,'moduleId',owner.module,
    'recordId',owner.element,'fieldModuleId',property.declaration_module,'fieldId',property.element,
    'rule','property.rebind_value','affectedObjectCount',affected::text));
  END IF;
 END LOOP;
 FOR property IN SELECT * FROM jsonb_populate_recordset(NULL::truss.prop_def,planned_basis->'prop_def') p WHERE p.since_rev=revision AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM truss.type_def t WHERE t.type_id=p.type_id) LOOP
  SELECT * INTO STRICT owner FROM jsonb_populate_record(NULL::truss.type_def,owner_index->property.type_id::text) t WHERE t.type_id=property.type_id;
  IF truss.runtime_can_read(owner.document_id,owner.module) IS NOT TRUE
   OR truss.runtime_can_read(owner.document_id,property.declaration_module) IS NOT TRUE
   OR property.cardinality IN ('array','map') AND truss.runtime_item_chain_readable(property.item) IS NOT TRUE THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'original candidate owner/property/item readers required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
  FOR object_row IN SELECT o.* FROM truss.object o WHERE o.type_id=property.type_id
   AND (o.root_id IS NOT NULL OR o.root_type IS NOT NULL)
   AND (property.nullability='required' OR coalesce(o.retained ? property.name,false)) LOOP
  PERFORM truss.runtime_history_ownership(jsonb_build_object(
   'identity',jsonb_build_object('id',object_row.id::text,'typeId',object_row.type_id::text),
   'catalogRevision',object_row.rev,'ownership',truss.runtime_object_ownership_at(to_jsonb(object_row))));
  END LOOP;
 END LOOP;
 violations:=to_jsonb(violation_buffer);
 IF violations='[]'::jsonb THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 RETURN convert_to(violations::text,'UTF8');
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.query_seek_objects(binding jsonb, selected_type integer, selected_key text, after_value text, page_limit integer)
 RETURNS TABLE(id bigint, props jsonb)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
 SET row_security TO 'off'
AS $function$
DECLARE key_definition truss.key_def%ROWTYPE;component truss.prop_def%ROWTYPE;selected_ids bigint[];row record;
BEGIN
 PERFORM truss.query_scope(binding);
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(binding->'records') r WHERE (r.value->>'typeId')::int=selected_type) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'selected query record required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 IF page_limit IS NULL OR page_limit NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 1000 THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'bounded ordered page source required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 SELECT * INTO key_definition FROM truss.key_def k WHERE k.type_id=selected_type AND k.key_id=selected_key AND k.retired_rev IS NULL;
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'original authored page key required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 IF cardinality(key_definition.prop_ids)=1 THEN
  SELECT * INTO component FROM truss.prop_def p WHERE p.type_id=selected_type AND p.prop_id=key_definition.prop_ids[1] AND p.retired_rev IS NULL;
 END IF;
 IF component.scalar_type IS DISTINCT FROM 'string' OR component.nullability IS DISTINCT FROM 'required' OR component.cardinality IS DISTINCT FROM 'one'
  OR component.home IS DISTINCT FROM 'json' OR coalesce(component.facets,'{}')<>'{}'::jsonb
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM truss.object_key_bucket k WHERE k.type_id=selected_type AND k.key_num=key_definition.key_num
   AND truss.runtime_query_single_string_key(k.key_bytes) IS NULL) THEN
  RETURN QUERY SELECT q.* FROM truss.query_page_objects(binding,selected_type,selected_key) q;RETURN;
 END IF;
 -- Separate first/continuation statements retain directly indexable ordered predicates.
 IF after_value IS NULL THEN
  SELECT coalesce(array_agg(candidate.object_id),'{}'::bigint[]) INTO selected_ids FROM (
   SELECT k.object_id FROM truss.object_key_bucket k WHERE k.type_id=selected_type AND k.key_num=key_definition.key_num
    AND truss.runtime_query_single_string_key(k.key_bytes) IS NOT NULL
   ORDER BY truss.runtime_query_single_string_key(k.key_bytes) COLLATE "C"
   LIMIT least(page_limit,(binding->>'maximumScanRows')::int+1)) candidate;
 ELSE
  SELECT coalesce(array_agg(candidate.object_id),'{}'::bigint[]) INTO selected_ids FROM (
   SELECT k.object_id FROM truss.object_key_bucket k WHERE k.type_id=selected_type AND k.key_num=key_definition.key_num
    AND truss.runtime_query_single_string_key(k.key_bytes) IS NOT NULL
    AND (truss.runtime_query_single_string_key(k.key_bytes) COLLATE "C")>(after_value COLLATE "C")
   ORDER BY truss.runtime_query_single_string_key(k.key_bytes) COLLATE "C"
   LIMIT least(page_limit,(binding->>'maximumScanRows')::int+1)) candidate;
 END IF;
 FOR row IN SELECT q.* FROM truss.runtime_query_checked_ids(binding,selected_type,selected_ids) q LOOP
  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM truss.object_key_bucket k WHERE k.type_id=selected_type AND k.key_num=key_definition.key_num AND k.object_id=row.id
   AND truss.runtime_query_single_string_key(k.key_bytes) IS NOT DISTINCT FROM row.props->component.prop_id::text->>'text') THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'original canonical ordered key correspondence required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
  id:=row.id;props:=row.props;RETURN NEXT;
 END LOOP;
 PERFORM truss.query_scope(binding);
END;
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.query_selected_objects(binding jsonb, selected_type integer, selected_cells jsonb)
 RETURNS TABLE(id bigint, props jsonb)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
 SET row_security TO 'off'
AS $function$
DECLARE property_id text;cell jsonb;definition truss.prop_def%ROWTYPE;selected_ids bigint[];
BEGIN
 PERFORM truss.query_scope(binding);
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(binding->'records') r WHERE (r.value->>'typeId')::int=selected_type) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'selected query record required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 IF octet_length(selected_cells::text)>8388608 THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'bounded selected cell envelope required' USING ERRCODE='54000';END IF;
 IF jsonb_typeof(selected_cells) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
  OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(selected_cells))<>1 THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'one bounded exact selected cell required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 SELECT key,value INTO STRICT property_id,cell FROM jsonb_each(selected_cells);
 IF cell->>'kind'='string' AND octet_length(cell->>'text')>1048576 THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'bounded selected string operand required' USING ERRCODE='54000';END IF;
 SELECT * INTO definition FROM truss.prop_def p WHERE p.type_id=selected_type AND p.prop_id::text=property_id AND p.retired_rev IS NULL;
 IF NOT FOUND OR definition.home<>'json' OR definition.cardinality<>'one' OR definition.scalar_type NOT IN ('string','boolean')
  OR truss.valid_property_value(cell,definition) IS NOT TRUE OR cell->>'kind' IS DISTINCT FROM definition.scalar_type THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'admitted exact string or boolean selection required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 SELECT coalesce(array_agg(candidate.id),'{}'::bigint[]) INTO selected_ids
 FROM (SELECT o.id FROM truss.object o WHERE o.type_id=selected_type AND o.props @> selected_cells
  LIMIT (binding->>'maximumScanRows')::int+1) candidate;
 RETURN QUERY SELECT q.* FROM truss.runtime_query_checked_ids(binding,selected_type,selected_ids) q;
END;
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.recover_group_request(original_input bytea, original_documents bytea, original_request bytea, expected_release text, expected_digest text)
 RETURNS bytea
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
 SET row_security TO 'off'
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
 SET bytea_output TO 'hex'
AS $function$
DECLARE request jsonb;installation truss.catalog_runtime_installation%ROWTYPE;actor oid;ns bytea;rk bytea;
 receipt truss.request_receipt%ROWTYPE;attempt_id uuid;attempt truss.runtime_object_attempt%ROWTYPE;result jsonb;state text;code text;
BEGIN
 IF current_setting('transaction_read_only')<>'off' THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'selected read-write receipt observation profile required' USING ERRCODE='0A000';END IF;
 actor:=truss.runtime_person(false);
 IF original_input IS NULL OR octet_length(original_input) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 1048576
  OR original_documents IS NULL OR octet_length(original_documents) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 4194304 THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'bounded complete original recovery frame required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT installation FROM truss.runtime_current_installation();
 IF installation.release_id IS DISTINCT FROM expected_release OR installation.release_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM expected_digest THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'selected receipt observer runtime required' USING ERRCODE='0A000';END IF;
 IF original_request IS NULL OR octet_length(original_request) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 65536
  OR (convert_from(original_request,'UTF8') IS JSON OBJECT WITH UNIQUE KEYS) IS NOT TRUE THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'bounded original request frame required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 request:=convert_from(original_request,'UTF8')::jsonb;
 IF request->>'state' IS DISTINCT FROM 'present' THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'request-present frame required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 IF request->'identity'->>'authorizedScopeIdentity' IS DISTINCT FROM
  'truss-person:'||installation.installation_id::text||':'||actor::text THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'original person request scope required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
 ns:=convert_to(request->'identity'->>'authorizedScopeIdentity','UTF8');
 rk:=convert_to(request->'identity'->>'requestId','UTF8');
 SELECT * INTO receipt FROM truss.request_receipt WHERE namespace_sha256=sha256(ns) AND request_sha256=sha256(rk)
  AND namespace_identity_utf8=ns AND request_id_utf8=rk;
 IF FOUND THEN
  attempt_id:=truss.runtime_authorize_retained_request(receipt.storage_row_id);
  IF receipt.payload_state='complete' THEN
   SELECT * INTO STRICT attempt FROM truss.runtime_object_attempt WHERE id=attempt_id;
   -- Semantic input equality remains the original request-conflict rule.
   -- Separate source/request bytes establish the frozen frame's original custody.
   IF attempt.documents_bytes IS DISTINCT FROM original_documents OR attempt.request_bytes IS DISTINCT FROM original_request THEN
    PERFORM truss.runtime_authorize_retained_request(receipt.storage_row_id);
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'original frozen source and request frame required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
  END IF;
 END IF;
 result:=convert_from(truss.object_group_begin_prepared(original_input,original_documents,original_request,
  expected_release,expected_digest,convert_to('[]','UTF8'),true,NULL),'UTF8')::jsonb;
 IF result->>'outcome'='miss' THEN
  RETURN convert_to('{"outcome":"unavailable","reason":"request_not_observed"}','UTF8');END IF;
 IF result->>'outcome'='execute' THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'receipt-only observer cannot execute' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
 RETURN convert_to(result::text,'UTF8');
EXCEPTION WHEN SQLSTATE '22023' OR SQLSTATE 'P1001' OR SQLSTATE 'P1403'
 OR SQLSTATE '0A000' OR SQLSTATE '54000' OR SQLSTATE '55P03' THEN
 GET STACKED DIAGNOSTICS state=RETURNED_SQLSTATE;
 IF state IN ('0A000','54000','55P03') THEN
  RETURN convert_to(jsonb_build_object('outcome','unavailable','reason',CASE state
   WHEN '0A000' THEN 'profile' WHEN '54000' THEN 'resource' ELSE 'observation' END)::text,'UTF8');END IF;
 code:=CASE state WHEN '22023' THEN 'invalid_input' WHEN 'P1001' THEN 'request_conflict' ELSE 'unauthorized_person' END;
 RETURN convert_to(jsonb_build_object('outcome','failed','code',code,'nativeState',state)::text,'UTF8');
END;
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.require_person_invocation(original_function regprocedure, admission_kind text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE actor oid;enrolled boolean;installation truss.catalog_runtime_installation%ROWTYPE;original_owner oid;original_execute boolean;
BEGIN
 SELECT oid INTO STRICT actor FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname=session_user;
 IF admission_kind NOT IN ('read','write','catalog','registrar','audit','status') OR admission_kind IS NULL THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'selected invocation family required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 WITH RECURSIVE memberships(role_oid) AS (
  SELECT actor UNION SELECT m.roleid FROM pg_auth_members m JOIN memberships p ON m.member=p.role_oid)
 SELECT
  (admission_kind IN ('read','catalog','status') AND EXISTS(
    SELECT 1 FROM truss.module_access m JOIN memberships p
     ON p.role_oid IN (to_regrole(m.reader_role)::oid,to_regrole(m.writer_role)::oid)))
  OR (admission_kind='write' AND EXISTS(
    SELECT 1 FROM truss.module_access m JOIN memberships p ON p.role_oid=to_regrole(m.writer_role)::oid))
  OR (admission_kind IN ('catalog','registrar','status') AND EXISTS(
    SELECT 1 FROM truss.catalog_runtime_installation i JOIN memberships p ON p.role_oid=i.registrar_oid WHERE i.singleton))
  OR (admission_kind IN ('audit','status') AND EXISTS(
    SELECT 1 FROM truss.runtime_import_audit_access a JOIN memberships p ON p.role_oid=a.auditor_oid))
 INTO enrolled;
 -- No installation identity, role name, head or result is released on this path.
 IF enrolled IS DISTINCT FROM true THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'current person invocation admission required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT installation FROM truss.catalog_runtime_installation WHERE singleton;
 -- Replan this fixed catalog observation. A retained SPI plan after a contained
 -- source error otherwise reused an obsolete EXECUTE verdict on PostgreSQL18.6.
 -- Only these two typed OIDs vary; no caller SQL or identifier is interpolated.
 EXECUTE 'SELECT p.proowner,pg_catalog.has_function_privilege($1,p.oid,''EXECUTE'') FROM pg_catalog.pg_proc p WHERE p.oid=$2'
 INTO STRICT original_owner,original_execute USING actor,original_function::oid;
 IF original_owner IS DISTINCT FROM installation.owner_oid
  OR (SELECT oid FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname=current_user) IS DISTINCT FROM installation.owner_oid THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'original installed invocation owner required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
 IF original_execute IS DISTINCT FROM true THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'original invocation EXECUTE grant required' USING ERRCODE='42501';END IF;
 PERFORM truss.runtime_person(false);
END;
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.runtime_authorize_retained_request(selected_receipt bigint)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE receipt truss.request_receipt%ROWTYPE;writer jsonb;attempt truss.runtime_object_attempt%ROWTYPE;actor oid;owner record;
BEGIN
 actor:=truss.runtime_person(false);
 SELECT * INTO STRICT receipt FROM truss.request_receipt WHERE storage_row_id=selected_receipt;
 writer:=convert_from(receipt.original_writer_context_bytes,'UTF8')::jsonb;
 IF writer->>'profile' IS DISTINCT FROM 'truss-object-group-writer/0.1' THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'retained request writer profile required' USING ERRCODE='0A000';END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT attempt FROM truss.runtime_object_attempt WHERE id=(writer->>'attemptId')::uuid;
 IF NOT attempt.complete OR attempt.actor_oid IS DISTINCT FROM actor
  OR attempt.receipt_id IS DISTINCT FROM receipt.storage_row_id
  OR attempt.writer_xid IS DISTINCT FROM receipt.original_writer_xid
  OR writer->>'xid' IS DISTINCT FROM attempt.writer_xid::text
  OR writer->>'actorOid' IS DISTINCT FROM attempt.actor_oid::text THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'retained original request correspondence required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
 IF NOT truss.runtime_receipt_can_read(attempt.id) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'current retained request reader required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
 FOR owner IN SELECT DISTINCT r.value->'identity'->'owner'->>'documentId' document_id,
  r.value->'identity'->'owner'->>'moduleId' module FROM jsonb_array_elements(attempt.results) r LOOP
  PERFORM truss.runtime_module_writer_qualified(owner.document_id,owner.module,actor);
 END LOOP;
 PERFORM truss.runtime_edge_authorize(attempt.id);
 RETURN attempt.id;
END;
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.runtime_query_checked_ids(binding jsonb, selected_type integer, selected_ids bigint[])
 RETURNS TABLE(id bigint, props jsonb)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
 SET row_security TO 'off'
AS $function$
DECLARE owner truss.type_def%ROWTYPE;object_row truss.object%ROWTYPE;selected_row record;numeric_properties jsonb;
 row_count int:=0;byte_count bigint:=0;root_identity jsonb;roots jsonb:='{}';root_entry jsonb;
BEGIN
 PERFORM truss.query_scope(binding);
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(binding->'records') r WHERE (r.value->>'typeId')::int=selected_type)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'selected query record required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 IF selected_ids IS NULL OR cardinality(selected_ids)>(binding->>'maximumScanRows')::int THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'bounded selected query source required' USING ERRCODE='54000';END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT owner FROM truss.type_def t WHERE t.type_id=selected_type AND t.retired_rev IS NULL;
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('propertyId',p.prop_id::text,'scalarType',p.scalar_type) ORDER BY p.prop_id),'[]'::jsonb)
 INTO numeric_properties FROM truss.prop_def p WHERE p.type_id=selected_type AND p.retired_rev IS NULL AND p.scalar_type IN ('integer','decimal');
 FOR selected_row IN
  SELECT o AS object_row,NOT EXISTS(
   SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(numeric_properties) f
   CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT o.props->(f.value->>'propertyId') AS cell) selected_cell
   WHERE selected_cell.cell IS NOT NULL AND selected_cell.cell<>'{"kind":"null"}'::jsonb
    AND truss.query_numeric_value(selected_cell.cell->>'text',f.value->>'scalarType') IS NOT TRUE
  ) AS numeric_valid
  FROM truss.object o WHERE o.type_id=selected_type AND o.id=ANY(selected_ids) LOOP
  object_row:=selected_row.object_row;row_count:=row_count+1;
  byte_count:=byte_count+octet_length(object_row.props::text);
  IF byte_count>(binding->>'maximumBytes')::int THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'bounded selected query bytes required' USING ERRCODE='54000';END IF;
  root_identity:=truss.query_object_root(binding,object_row);
  IF root_identity IS NOT NULL THEN roots:=roots||jsonb_build_object((root_identity->>'typeId')||':'||(root_identity->>'id'),root_identity);END IF;
  IF byte_count+(CASE WHEN roots='{}'::jsonb THEN 0 ELSE octet_length(roots::text) END)>(binding->>'maximumBytes')::int THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'bounded selected query root witnesses required' USING ERRCODE='54000';END IF;
  IF object_row.ver<=0 OR object_row.rev>(binding->>'catalogRevision')::int THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'complete scalar source required' USING ERRCODE='0A000';END IF;
  IF NOT selected_row.numeric_valid THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'exact native numeric domain unavailable' USING ERRCODE='22003';END IF;
  id:=object_row.id;props:=object_row.props;RETURN NEXT;
 END LOOP;
 IF row_count<>cardinality(selected_ids) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'complete selected object identities required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
 FOR root_entry IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_each(roots) LOOP
  IF NOT truss.runtime_can_read(root_entry->'owner'->>'documentId',root_entry->'owner'->>'moduleId') THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'current buffered query aggregate root reader required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
 END LOOP;
 PERFORM truss.query_scope(binding);
END;
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.runtime_query_single_string_key(transport bytea)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE STRICT
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE token text;tuple bytea;payload_size int;second int;offset_bytes int;
BEGIN
 IF octet_length(transport) NOT BETWEEN 37 AND 2100 THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 token:=convert_from(transport,'UTF8');
 IF token !~ '^umf-key-tuple-v1:hex:[0-9a-f]+$' OR (length(token)-21)%2<>0 THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 tuple:=decode(substring(token FROM 22),'hex');
 IF octet_length(tuple)<8 OR substring(tuple FROM 1 FOR 7)<>decode('554d464b310104','hex') THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 payload_size:=get_byte(tuple,7);offset_bytes:=8;
 IF payload_size>=128 THEN
  IF octet_length(tuple)<9 THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
  second:=get_byte(tuple,8);
  IF second NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 8 THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
  payload_size:=payload_size-128+128*second;offset_bytes:=9;
 END IF;
 IF payload_size>1024 OR octet_length(tuple)<>offset_bytes+payload_size THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 RETURN convert_from(substring(tuple FROM offset_bytes+1),'UTF8');
EXCEPTION WHEN character_not_in_repertoire OR invalid_parameter_value THEN RETURN NULL;
END;
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.runtime_read_mutation_group_audit(selected_attempt uuid, maximum_events integer, expected_release text, expected_digest text, include_data boolean)
 RETURNS bytea
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
 SET row_security TO 'off'
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
 SET bytea_output TO 'hex'
AS $function$
DECLARE actor oid;installation truss.catalog_runtime_installation%ROWTYPE;
 attempt truss.runtime_object_attempt%ROWTYPE;owner_union jsonb:='[]'::jsonb;
 owner jsonb;transition_row record;physical truss.journal%ROWTYPE;resolved jsonb;
 entry jsonb;event jsonb;original bytea;image jsonb;member jsonb;schema_metadata jsonb;
 property_context jsonb;event_pin text;image_revision int;image_type int;operation_index int;
 event_count int:=0;byte_count int:=0;entries jsonb:='[]'::jsonb;operation_entries jsonb;
 edge_context jsonb;endpoint jsonb;operation_name text;actor_name text;group_action text;
 plan_row record;owner_candidate jsonb;owner_count int;scope_entry jsonb;image_map jsonb;projected_entries jsonb;projected_data jsonb;node jsonb;side text;key_entry record;key_values jsonb;key_rows jsonb;result_bytes bytea;
BEGIN
 actor:=truss.runtime_person(false);
 IF include_data IS NULL OR selected_attempt IS NULL OR maximum_events IS NULL OR maximum_events NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 4096 THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'bounded complete mutation group required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT installation FROM truss.runtime_current_installation();
 IF installation.release_id IS DISTINCT FROM expected_release OR installation.release_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM expected_digest
  OR pg_is_in_recovery() THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'selected retained mutation audit required' USING ERRCODE='0A000';END IF;
 SELECT * INTO attempt FROM truss.runtime_object_attempt a WHERE a.id=selected_attempt AND a.complete
  AND a.writer_xid<pg_catalog.pg_snapshot_xmin(pg_catalog.pg_current_snapshot());
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'committed complete mutation group required' USING ERRCODE='P0002';END IF;
 IF attempt.context->'mutationProfile' IS DISTINCT FROM truss.runtime_owned_profile() THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'retained mutation audit profile unsupported' USING ERRCODE='0A000';END IF;
 IF attempt.next_index<1 OR attempt.result_count<>attempt.next_index
  OR (SELECT count(*) FROM truss.runtime_owned_operation o WHERE o.attempt_id=attempt.id
      AND o.writer_xid=attempt.writer_xid AND o.result IS NOT NULL)<>attempt.next_index THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'complete retained operation census required' USING ERRCODE='P1010';END IF;
 IF octet_length(attempt.input_bytes)>1048576 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'retained mutation input too large' USING ERRCODE='54000';END IF;
 -- Preserve the actor captured by the native attempt even if its login role
 -- was later renamed or removed. No role-name lookup is part of audit identity.
 SELECT min(p.plan->>'actorName'),count(DISTINCT p.plan->>'actorName') INTO actor_name,owner_count
  FROM truss.runtime_owned_operation p WHERE p.attempt_id=attempt.id AND p.writer_xid=attempt.writer_xid;
 IF actor_name IS NULL OR owner_count<>1 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'retained native actor name unavailable' USING ERRCODE='P1010';END IF;
 IF jsonb_typeof(attempt.context->'originalAssertedOrigin'->'entries')='array'
  AND (SELECT count(*)=1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(attempt.context->'originalAssertedOrigin'->'entries') e
       WHERE e.value->>'key'='x-action')
  AND (SELECT count(*)=1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(attempt.context->'originalAssertedOrigin'->'entries') e
       WHERE e.value->>'key'='x-action' AND e.value->'value'->>'kind'='string'
        AND jsonb_typeof(e.value->'value'->'text')='string'
        AND octet_length(e.value->'value'->>'text') BETWEEN 1 AND 4096) THEN
  SELECT e.value->'value'->>'text' INTO group_action
   FROM jsonb_array_elements(attempt.context->'originalAssertedOrigin'->'entries') e WHERE e.value->>'key'='x-action';
 END IF;

 -- Retained plans cover unchanged operations that have no journal row. These
 -- plans are immutable witnesses; every owner-shaped item is conservatively
 -- included, and all exact property-reader dependencies are added from the
 -- image's own retained catalog revision.
 FOR plan_row IN SELECT p.operation_index,p.plan,p.result FROM truss.runtime_owned_operation p
  WHERE p.attempt_id=attempt.id AND p.writer_xid=attempt.writer_xid ORDER BY p.operation_index LOOP
  IF plan_row.operation_index<0 OR plan_row.operation_index>=attempt.next_index
   OR plan_row.plan->>'profile' IS DISTINCT FROM 'truss-owned-operation-plan/0.2'
   OR plan_row.plan->'operationIndex' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(plan_row.operation_index)
   OR plan_row.plan->'mutationProfile' IS DISTINCT FROM truss.runtime_owned_profile()
   OR plan_row.result IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'complete immutable operation plan required' USING ERRCODE='P1010';END IF;
  owner_count:=0;
  FOR owner_candidate IN SELECT jsonb_path_query(plan_row.plan,
   '$.** ? (@.documentId.type() == "string" && @.moduleId.type() == "string")') LOOP
   IF octet_length(owner_candidate->>'documentId') NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 4096
    OR octet_length(owner_candidate->>'moduleId') NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 4096 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'bounded operation-plan owner required' USING ERRCODE='P1010';END IF;
   owner_union:=owner_union||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
    'documentId',owner_candidate->>'documentId','moduleId',owner_candidate->>'moduleId'));
   owner_count:=owner_count+1;
  END LOOP;
  IF owner_count=0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'complete operation-plan owner scope required' USING ERRCODE='P1010';END IF;
  FOR image_map IN SELECT value FROM (VALUES(plan_row.plan->'beforeNodes'),(plan_row.plan->'afterNodes')) x(value)
   WHERE jsonb_typeof(value)='object' LOOP
   FOR image IN SELECT n.value->'image' FROM jsonb_each(image_map) n(key,value)
    WHERE jsonb_typeof(n.value->'image')='object' LOOP
    image_revision:=(image->>'rev')::int;image_type:=(image->>'type_id')::int;
    IF image_revision IS NULL OR image_type IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'retained image catalog coordinate required' USING ERRCODE='P1010';END IF;
    SELECT s.metadata INTO STRICT schema_metadata FROM truss.runtime_type_schema s
     WHERE s.rev=image_revision AND s.type_id=image_type;
    IF jsonb_typeof(schema_metadata->'propertyAccess') IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' THEN
     RAISE EXCEPTION 'retained type property scope unavailable' USING ERRCODE='P1010';END IF;
    FOR scope_entry IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_each(schema_metadata->'propertyAccess') LOOP
     IF (scope_entry->>'itemsValid')::boolean IS NOT TRUE OR jsonb_typeof(scope_entry->'readers') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'retained property readers unavailable' USING ERRCODE='P1010';END IF;
     FOR owner_candidate IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(scope_entry->'readers') LOOP
      IF jsonb_typeof(owner_candidate) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
       OR jsonb_typeof(owner_candidate->'documentId') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
       OR jsonb_typeof(owner_candidate->'moduleId') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string' THEN
       RAISE EXCEPTION 'retained property owner unavailable' USING ERRCODE='P1010';END IF;
      owner_union:=owner_union||jsonb_build_array(owner_candidate);
     END LOOP;
    END LOOP;
   END LOOP;
  END LOOP;
 END LOOP;

 FOR transition_row IN
  SELECT t.operation_index,t.writer_xid,'object'::text AS kind,t.object_id AS entity_id,
   t.type_id AS entity_type,t.journal
   FROM truss.runtime_object_transition t WHERE t.attempt_id=attempt.id AND t.writer_xid=attempt.writer_xid
  UNION ALL
  SELECT t.operation_index,t.writer_xid,'edge'::text,t.edge_id,t.rel_type_id,t.journal
   FROM truss.runtime_edge_transition t WHERE t.attempt_id=attempt.id AND t.writer_xid=attempt.writer_xid
  ORDER BY operation_index,kind,entity_id
 LOOP
  event_count:=event_count+1;
  IF event_count>maximum_events THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'whole mutation group exceeds audit event limit' USING ERRCODE='54000';END IF;
  IF transition_row.kind='edge' THEN
   SELECT t.endpoint_ownership INTO edge_context FROM truss.runtime_edge_transition t
    WHERE t.attempt_id=attempt.id AND t.operation_index=transition_row.operation_index
     AND t.writer_xid=attempt.writer_xid AND t.edge_id=transition_row.entity_id AND t.rel_type_id=transition_row.entity_type;
   IF edge_context IS NULL OR
    (jsonb_typeof(edge_context->'before') IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' AND jsonb_typeof(edge_context->'before') IS DISTINCT FROM 'null') OR
    (jsonb_typeof(edge_context->'after') IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' AND jsonb_typeof(edge_context->'after') IS DISTINCT FROM 'null') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'retained endpoint ownership unavailable' USING ERRCODE='P1010';END IF;
   FOR endpoint IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(jsonb_build_array(
     edge_context->'before'->'source',edge_context->'before'->'target',
     edge_context->'after'->'source',edge_context->'after'->'target')) WHERE value<>'null'::jsonb LOOP
    owner:=endpoint->'identity'->'owner';
    IF jsonb_typeof(owner) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' OR owner-ARRAY['documentId','moduleId']<>'{}'::jsonb THEN
     RAISE EXCEPTION 'retained endpoint identity owner unavailable' USING ERRCODE='P1010';END IF;
    owner_union:=owner_union||jsonb_build_array(owner);
    IF endpoint->'ownership'->>'state'='owned' THEN
     owner:=endpoint->'ownership'->'root'->'owner';
     IF jsonb_typeof(owner) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' OR owner-ARRAY['documentId','moduleId']<>'{}'::jsonb THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'retained endpoint root owner unavailable' USING ERRCODE='P1010';END IF;
     owner_union:=owner_union||jsonb_build_array(owner);
    ELSIF endpoint->'ownership'->>'state' IS DISTINCT FROM 'rootless' THEN
     RAISE EXCEPTION 'retained endpoint ownership state unavailable' USING ERRCODE='P1010';END IF;
   END LOOP;
  END IF;
  IF jsonb_typeof(transition_row.journal) IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'retained group journal unavailable' USING ERRCODE='P1010';END IF;
  resolved:=truss.runtime_owned_journal_materialize(transition_row.journal);
  FOR entry IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(resolved) LOOP
   IF jsonb_typeof(entry) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' OR entry-ARRAY['seq','at','xid','entity_kind','entity_id','entity_type','ver','op','prop_id','old_value','new_value','rev','origin']<>'{}'::jsonb THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'closed retained journal row required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
   physical:=jsonb_populate_record(NULL::truss.journal,entry);
   byte_count:=byte_count+octet_length(physical.new_value::text)+octet_length(physical.origin::text);
   IF byte_count>4194304 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'whole mutation group audit exceeds byte limit' USING ERRCODE='54000';END IF;
   IF physical.xid IS DISTINCT FROM attempt.writer_xid OR physical.entity_id IS DISTINCT FROM transition_row.entity_id
    OR physical.entity_type IS DISTINCT FROM transition_row.entity_type
    OR physical.entity_kind IS DISTINCT FROM (CASE WHEN transition_row.kind='object' THEN 'o'::char(1) ELSE 'e'::char(1) END)
    OR physical.new_value->>'component' IS DISTINCT FROM 'event' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'retained journal transition correspondence required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
   BEGIN
    original:=decode(physical.new_value->>'bytesBase64','base64');
    IF physical.new_value IS DISTINCT FROM truss.runtime_exact_wrapper('event',original)
     OR (convert_from(original,'UTF8') IS JSON OBJECT WITH UNIQUE KEYS) IS NOT TRUE THEN
     RAISE EXCEPTION 'exact retained event required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
    event:=convert_from(original,'UTF8')::jsonb;
   EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'retained event unavailable' USING ERRCODE='P1010';END;
   IF event->>'interfaceVersion' IS DISTINCT FROM 'truss-history-event/0.2.0-proposal'
   OR (event->>'historyProfile' IN ('truss-native-scalar-create/0.2','truss-native-owned-create/0.1',
     'truss-native-scalar-mutation/0.1','truss-native-owned-mutation/0.1',
     'truss-native-edge-mutation/0.1','truss-native-owned-edge-mutation/0.1')) IS NOT TRUE
    OR event->>'sourceEpoch' IS DISTINCT FROM installation.source_epoch::text
    OR event->>'xid' IS DISTINCT FROM physical.xid::text OR event->>'seq' IS DISTINCT FROM physical.seq::text
    OR event->>'eventVersion' IS DISTINCT FROM physical.ver::text
    OR event->>'eventCatalogRevision' IS DISTINCT FROM physical.rev::text
    OR event->'identity'->>'id' IS DISTINCT FROM physical.entity_id::text
    OR event->'identity'->>'typeId' IS DISTINCT FROM physical.entity_type::text
    OR physical.op IS DISTINCT FROM (CASE event->>'operation' WHEN 'property' THEN 'update' ELSE event->>'operation' END)
    OR physical.prop_id IS DISTINCT FROM (event->>'propertyId')::int
    OR physical.origin IS DISTINCT FROM truss.runtime_exact_wrapper('origin',convert_to((event->'origin')::text,'UTF8')) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'retained event provenance unavailable' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
   IF transition_row.kind='object' THEN
    SELECT s.metadata->>'typePin' INTO event_pin FROM truss.runtime_type_schema s
     WHERE s.rev=physical.rev AND s.type_id=physical.entity_type;
   ELSE event_pin:=truss.runtime_relationship_pin(physical.entity_type,physical.rev);END IF;
   IF event_pin IS NULL OR event->'identity'->>'definitionPin' IS DISTINCT FROM event_pin THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'retained event definition pin unavailable' USING ERRCODE='P1010';END IF;
   owner:=event->'identity'->'owner';
   IF jsonb_typeof(owner) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' OR owner-ARRAY['documentId','moduleId']<>'{}'::jsonb
    OR jsonb_typeof(owner->'documentId') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string' OR jsonb_typeof(owner->'moduleId') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'complete retained entity owner required' USING ERRCODE='P1010';END IF;
   owner_union:=owner_union||jsonb_build_array(owner);
   IF event->>'operation' IN ('create','metadata','delete') THEN
    FOR image IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(jsonb_build_array(event->'before',event->'after'))
     WHERE value IS NOT NULL AND value<>'null'::jsonb LOOP
     image_revision:=(image->>'catalogRevision')::int;image_type:=(image->'identity'->>'typeId')::int;
     owner:=image->'identity'->'owner';
     IF jsonb_typeof(owner) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'retained image owner unavailable' USING ERRCODE='P1010';END IF;
     owner_union:=owner_union||jsonb_build_array(owner);
     IF image->'ownership'->>'state'='owned' THEN
      owner:=image->'ownership'->'root'->'owner';
      IF jsonb_typeof(owner) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'retained root owner unavailable' USING ERRCODE='P1010';END IF;
      owner_union:=owner_union||jsonb_build_array(owner);
     END IF;
     IF transition_row.kind='edge' THEN
      FOR endpoint IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(jsonb_build_array(image->'source',image->'target')) LOOP
       owner:=endpoint->'owner';
       IF jsonb_typeof(owner) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'retained edge endpoint owner unavailable' USING ERRCODE='P1010';END IF;
       owner_union:=owner_union||jsonb_build_array(owner);
      END LOOP;
     END IF;
     FOR member IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(image->'properties') LOOP
      SELECT s.metadata INTO STRICT schema_metadata FROM truss.runtime_type_schema s WHERE s.rev=image_revision AND s.type_id=image_type;
      property_context:=schema_metadata->'propertyAccess'->(member->>'propertyId');
      event_pin:=schema_metadata->'propertyPins'->>(member->>'propertyId');
      IF event_pin IS DISTINCT FROM member->>'definitionPin' OR property_context IS NULL
       OR (property_context->>'itemsValid')::boolean IS NOT TRUE OR jsonb_typeof(property_context->'readers') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' THEN
       RAISE EXCEPTION 'retained property scope unavailable' USING ERRCODE='P1010';END IF;
      FOR owner IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(property_context->'readers') LOOP
       owner_union:=owner_union||jsonb_build_array(owner);
      END LOOP;
     END LOOP;
    END LOOP;
   ELSIF event->>'operation' IN ('property','rebind') THEN
    SELECT s.metadata INTO STRICT schema_metadata FROM truss.runtime_type_schema s
     WHERE s.rev=physical.rev AND s.type_id=physical.entity_type;
    event_pin:=CASE WHEN event->>'operation'='rebind' THEN event->>'afterDefinitionPin' ELSE event->>'definitionPin' END;
    property_context:=schema_metadata->'propertyAccess'->physical.prop_id::text;
    IF schema_metadata->'propertyPins'->>physical.prop_id::text IS DISTINCT FROM event_pin OR property_context IS NULL
     OR (property_context->>'itemsValid')::boolean IS NOT TRUE OR jsonb_typeof(property_context->'readers') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' THEN
     RAISE EXCEPTION 'retained property delta scope unavailable' USING ERRCODE='P1010';END IF;
    FOR owner IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(property_context->'readers') LOOP owner_union:=owner_union||jsonb_build_array(owner);END LOOP;
   ELSE RAISE EXCEPTION 'retained operation profile unsupported' USING ERRCODE='0A000';END IF;
   entries:=entries||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('operationIndex',transition_row.operation_index::text,
    'entityKind',transition_row.kind,'entityId',transition_row.entity_id::text,'entityType',transition_row.entity_type::text,
    'operation',event->>'operation','observedAt',to_char(physical.at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"')));
  END LOOP;
 END LOOP;
 -- A completed unchanged operation has no event row. Its sealed plan/result
 -- is still a retained native observation, with a timestamp captured when the
 -- attempt row was created. Never manufacture an audit time at read time.
 FOR plan_row IN SELECT p.operation_index,p.plan,p.result FROM truss.runtime_owned_operation p
  WHERE p.attempt_id=attempt.id AND p.writer_xid=attempt.writer_xid ORDER BY p.operation_index LOOP
  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(entries) e
   WHERE e.value->>'operationIndex'=plan_row.operation_index::text) THEN
   IF attempt.audit_observed_at IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'no-op attempt observation unavailable' USING ERRCODE='P1010';END IF;
   operation_name:=plan_row.result->>'operation';
   image:=plan_row.result->'identity';
   IF operation_name NOT IN ('create_object','update_object','delete_object','create_edge','update_edge','delete_edge')
    OR jsonb_typeof(image) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
    OR jsonb_typeof(image->'id') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
    OR jsonb_typeof(image->'typeId') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'no-op retained identity unavailable' USING ERRCODE='P1010';END IF;
   entries:=entries||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('operationIndex',plan_row.operation_index::text,
    'entityKind',CASE WHEN operation_name LIKE '%_edge' THEN 'edge' ELSE 'object' END,
    'entityId',image->>'id','entityType',image->>'typeId','operation',operation_name,
    'observedAt',to_char(attempt.audit_observed_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"')));
  END IF;
 END LOOP;
 IF jsonb_array_length(entries)=0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'retained group has no supported operation evidence' USING ERRCODE='P1010';END IF;
 IF jsonb_array_length(entries)>maximum_events THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'whole group exceeds audit page limit' USING ERRCODE='54000';END IF;
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(value ORDER BY value->>'documentId',value->>'moduleId'),'[]'::jsonb) INTO owner_union
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(owner_union)) owners;
 IF jsonb_array_length(owner_union)>4096 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'complete audit owner union exceeds limit' USING ERRCODE='54000';END IF;
 FOR owner IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(owner_union) LOOP
  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM truss.runtime_import_audit_access a WHERE a.document_id=owner->>'documentId'
   AND a.module=owner->>'moduleId' AND truss.runtime_audit_role_member(actor,a.auditor_oid)) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'complete mutation group audit membership required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
 END LOOP;
 IF include_data THEN
  FOR owner IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(owner_union) LOOP
   IF truss.runtime_can_read(owner->>'documentId',owner->>'moduleId') IS NOT TRUE THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'separate complete retained data readership required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
  END LOOP;
  projected_entries:='[]'::jsonb;
  FOR entry IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(entries) LOOP
   image_map:=truss.runtime_owned_plan(attempt.id,(entry->>'operationIndex')::int);
   projected_data:=jsonb_build_object('basis','retained-operation','before',NULL,'after',NULL);
   FOREACH side IN ARRAY ARRAY['before','after'] LOOP
    SELECT n.value INTO node FROM jsonb_each(image_map->(side||CASE WHEN entry->>'entityKind'='edge' THEN 'Edges' ELSE 'Nodes' END)) n
     WHERE truss.runtime_owned_identity(attempt.id,(entry->>'operationIndex')::int,n.key,entry->>'entityKind',image_map,attempt)->>'id'=entry->>'entityId'
      AND n.value->'identity'->>'typeId'=entry->>'entityType';
    image:=node->'image';key_rows:='[]'::jsonb;
    IF image IS NOT NULL AND image<>'null'::jsonb THEN
     IF entry->>'entityKind'='object' THEN
      FOR key_entry IN SELECT k.key_id,k.key_num,k.prop_ids,d.definition_pin
       FROM jsonb_populate_recordset(NULL::truss.key_def,truss.catalog_all_expected_records((image->>'rev')::int)->'key_def') k JOIN truss.type_def t ON t.type_id=k.type_id
       JOIN truss.runtime_definition_source d ON d.rev=k.definition_rev AND d.ord=k.definition_doc_ord
        AND d.doc_id=k.definition_document_id AND d.module_id=t.module AND d.element_id=t.element AND d.kind='key' AND d.key_id=k.key_id
       WHERE k.type_id=(entry->>'entityType')::int AND k.since_rev<=(image->>'rev')::int
        AND (k.retired_rev IS NULL OR k.retired_rev>(image->>'rev')::int) ORDER BY k.key_num LOOP
       SELECT jsonb_agg(image->'props'->p.id::text ORDER BY p.ordinality) INTO key_values
        FROM unnest(key_entry.prop_ids) WITH ORDINALITY p(id,ordinality);
       IF key_values IS NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(key_values) v WHERE v.value='null'::jsonb) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'complete retained key values unavailable' USING ERRCODE='P1010';END IF;
       key_rows:=key_rows||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('keyId',key_entry.key_id,'keyNumber',key_entry.key_num::text,
        'definitionPin',key_entry.definition_pin,'values',key_values));
      END LOOP;
     END IF;
     projected_data:=jsonb_set(projected_data,ARRAY[side],jsonb_build_object('version',image->>'ver','keys',key_rows));
    END IF;
   END LOOP;
   IF projected_data->'before'='null'::jsonb AND projected_data->'after'='null'::jsonb THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'retained operation images unavailable' USING ERRCODE='P1010';END IF;
   projected_entries:=projected_entries||jsonb_build_array(entry||jsonb_build_object('data',projected_data));
  END LOOP;
  entries:=projected_entries;
  IF octet_length(entries::text)>1048576 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'projected audit byte bound exceeded' USING ERRCODE='54000';END IF;
 END IF;
 -- Recheck every original owner after constructing the whole-group projection.
 FOR owner IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(owner_union) LOOP
  IF include_data AND truss.runtime_can_read(owner->>'documentId',owner->>'moduleId') IS NOT TRUE THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'retained data readership changed' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM truss.runtime_import_audit_access a WHERE a.document_id=owner->>'documentId'
   AND a.module=owner->>'moduleId' AND truss.runtime_audit_role_member(actor,a.auditor_oid)) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'mutation group audit authority changed before release' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
 END LOOP;
 PERFORM truss.runtime_person(false);
 result_bytes:=convert_to(jsonb_build_object('outcome','page','attemptId',attempt.id::text,
  'nativeActorOid',attempt.actor_oid::text,'nativeActorName',actor_name,'assertedAction',group_action,'writerXid',attempt.writer_xid::text,
  'observedAt',to_char(attempt.audit_observed_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"'),'ownerScopes',owner_union,
  'operationCount',attempt.next_index::text,'eventCount',jsonb_array_length(entries)::text,'entries',entries)::text,'UTF8');
 IF octet_length(result_bytes)>1048576 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'complete audit response exceeds byte bound' USING ERRCODE='54000';END IF;
 RETURN result_bytes;
END;
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.accepted_document(selected_document text, maximum_bytes integer, expected_release text, expected_digest text)
 RETURNS bytea
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
 SET row_security TO 'off'
AS $function$
DECLARE installation truss.catalog_runtime_installation%ROWTYPE;captured_revision int;archive truss.schema_doc%ROWTYPE;module jsonb;source jsonb;request truss.catalog_registration_request%ROWTYPE;encoded bytea;
BEGIN
 PERFORM truss.runtime_person(false);
 IF selected_document IS NULL OR octet_length(selected_document) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 4096 OR maximum_bytes IS NULL OR maximum_bytes NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 16777216 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'bounded document selection required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT installation FROM truss.runtime_current_installation();
 IF installation.release_id IS DISTINCT FROM expected_release OR installation.release_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM expected_digest THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'selected runtime required' USING ERRCODE='0A000';END IF;
 IF current_setting('transaction_read_only')='on' THEN
 SELECT rev INTO STRICT captured_revision FROM truss.schema_head WHERE id=1;
 ELSE
 SELECT rev INTO STRICT captured_revision FROM truss.schema_head WHERE id=1 FOR SHARE NOWAIT;
 END IF;
 IF captured_revision<1 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'accepted catalog required' USING ERRCODE='0A000';END IF;
 SELECT * INTO archive FROM truss.schema_doc WHERE rev<=captured_revision AND doc_id=selected_document ORDER BY rev DESC LIMIT 1;
 IF NOT FOUND OR jsonb_array_length(archive.document::jsonb->'modules')=0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'authorized document required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
 FOR module IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(archive.document::jsonb->'modules') LOOP
  IF NOT truss.runtime_can_read(selected_document,module->>'id') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'authorized document required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
 END LOOP;
 IF octet_length(archive.document)>maximum_bytes THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'document byte limit' USING ERRCODE='54000';END IF;
 IF encode(sha256(convert_to(archive.document,'UTF8')),'hex') IS DISTINCT FROM archive.content_sha256 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'exact accepted source required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT request FROM truss.catalog_registration_request WHERE catalog_registration_request.revision=archive.rev;
 SELECT value INTO STRICT source FROM jsonb_array_elements(convert_from(request.input_bytes,'UTF8')::jsonb->'documents') WHERE value->>'documentId'=selected_document;
 IF source->>'documentRevision' IS DISTINCT FROM archive.doc_revision OR source->'artifact'->>'sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM archive.content_sha256 OR (CASE WHEN (convert_from(request.input_bytes,'UTF8')::jsonb)->>'interfaceVersion'='truss-acceptance-input/0.2.0' THEN source->'artifact' ? 'bytesBase64'
  ELSE decode(source->'artifact'->>'bytesBase64','base64') IS DISTINCT FROM convert_to(archive.document,'UTF8') END) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'original accepted source required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
 encoded:=convert_to((jsonb_build_object('documentId',selected_document,'documentRevision',archive.doc_revision,'artifactIdentity',source->'artifact'->>'identity','contentBase64',encode(convert_to(archive.document,'UTF8'),'base64'),'sha256',archive.content_sha256,'catalogRevision',captured_revision,'sourceCatalogRevision',archive.rev,'registrationId',request.registration_id::text,'validation',archive.validation->'sourceValidation')
  ||CASE WHEN archive.validation ? 'dddValidation' THEN jsonb_build_object('dddProfile',archive.validation->'dddProfile','dddValidation',archive.validation->'dddValidation') ELSE '{}'::jsonb END)::text,'UTF8');
 IF octet_length(encoded)>maximum_bytes THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'encoded document byte limit' USING ERRCODE='54000';END IF;
 FOR module IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(archive.document::jsonb->'modules') LOOP
  IF NOT truss.runtime_can_read(selected_document,module->>'id') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'current reader required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
 END LOOP;
 PERFORM truss.runtime_person(false);
 IF (SELECT rev FROM truss.schema_head WHERE id=1) IS DISTINCT FROM captured_revision THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'catalog changed during document observation' USING ERRCODE='55P03';END IF;
 RETURN encoded;
END;
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.admin_install_recovery()
 RETURNS bytea
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
 SET row_security TO 'off'
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
AS $function$
DECLARE actor record;installation truss.catalog_runtime_installation%ROWTYPE;
 owner_name text;registrar_name text;has_owner boolean;
BEGIN
 SELECT oid,rolname::text,rolcanlogin,rolsuper,rolcreatedb,rolcreaterole,rolreplication,rolbypassrls,rolinherit,
  current_setting('role')='none' AS original_role INTO STRICT actor
 FROM pg_catalog.pg_roles WHERE rolname=session_user;
 IF actor.rolcanlogin IS NOT TRUE OR actor.original_role IS NOT TRUE
  OR NOT (actor.rolsuper OR actor.rolcreaterole) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'direct installation administrator required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT installation FROM truss.catalog_runtime_installation WHERE singleton;
 IF NOT actor.rolsuper THEN
  WITH RECURSIVE inherited(role_oid) AS (
   SELECT actor.oid UNION SELECT m.roleid FROM pg_catalog.pg_auth_members m
    JOIN inherited i ON m.member=i.role_oid WHERE m.inherit_option)
  SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM inherited WHERE role_oid=installation.owner_oid) INTO has_owner;
  IF has_owner IS NOT TRUE THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'installation owner administration required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
 END IF;
 SELECT rolname::text INTO owner_name FROM pg_catalog.pg_roles WHERE oid=installation.owner_oid
  AND NOT rolcanlogin AND NOT rolsuper AND NOT rolcreatedb AND NOT rolcreaterole
  AND NOT rolreplication AND NOT rolbypassrls AND NOT rolinherit;
 IF owner_name IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'installation owner profile is incompatible' USING ERRCODE='0A000';END IF;
 SELECT rolname::text INTO registrar_name FROM pg_catalog.pg_roles WHERE oid=installation.registrar_oid
  AND NOT rolcanlogin AND NOT rolsuper AND NOT rolcreatedb AND NOT rolcreaterole
  AND NOT rolreplication AND NOT rolbypassrls AND NOT rolinherit;
 IF registrar_name IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'installation registrar profile is incompatible' USING ERRCODE='0A000';END IF;
 IF installation.owner_oid=installation.registrar_oid OR owner_name IS NULL OR registrar_name IS NULL THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'installation role profile is incompatible' USING ERRCODE='0A000';END IF;
 RETURN convert_to(jsonb_build_object('outcome','recovered','ownerRole',owner_name,
  'registrarRole',registrar_name)::text,'UTF8');
END;
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.apply_create_group_qualified(original_input bytea, original_documents bytea, original_keys bytea, original_request bytea, expected_release text, expected_digest text, qualified_actor oid, selected_attempt uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, selected_original bytea DEFAULT NULL::bytea, selected_input jsonb DEFAULT NULL::jsonb)
 RETURNS bytea
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
 SET row_security TO 'off'
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
 SET bytea_output TO 'hex'
AS $function$
<<creation_leaf>>
DECLARE selected_owned boolean;changed_rows bigint;
 planned_items jsonb[]:='{}';planned_key_items jsonb[]:='{}';component_cells jsonb[];member_key_items jsonb[];prior_generations bigint[]:='{}';
 input jsonb;request jsonb;key_inputs jsonb;metadata jsonb;context jsonb;installation truss.catalog_runtime_installation%ROWTYPE;
 source_pin record;actor_oid oid;writer xid8;group_uuid uuid:=gen_random_uuid();current_index int:=0;operation jsonb;operation_meta jsonb;
 selected_type truss.type_def%ROWTYPE;property truss.prop_def%ROWTYPE;key_definition truss.key_def%ROWTYPE;
 supplied_value jsonb;props jsonb;retained jsonb;planned jsonb:='[]';planned_keys jsonb:='[]';key_plan jsonb;key_input jsonb;
 values_text text[];values_cells jsonb;key_facets jsonb;component record;namespace bytea;transport bytea;tuple_bytes bytea;owner_receipt jsonb;
 route record;observed record;planned_row jsonb;actual_row jsonb;object_row truss.object%ROWTYPE;
 object_identity jsonb;properties_json jsonb;retained_json jsonb;after_record jsonb;event jsonb;event_bytes bytea;origin_bytes bytea;
 journal_row truss.journal%ROWTYPE;expected_journal jsonb;actual_journal jsonb;event_digest text;
 expected_transition jsonb;actual_transition jsonb;actual_progress record;physical_journal jsonb;stored_result jsonb;
 results jsonb:='[]';aliases jsonb:='[]';members jsonb:='[]';member_keys jsonb;
 membership truss.object_key_bucket%ROWTYPE;reservation truss.object_key_reservation_bucket%ROWTYPE;
 semantic jsonb;semantic_bytes bytea;new_generation bigint;
 captured_revision int;outcome jsonb;outer_attempt record;
 type_metadata jsonb;key_codec jsonb;owned_plan jsonb;owned_state jsonb;root_reference text;root_identity jsonb;root_object truss.object%ROWTYPE;selected_history text;
BEGIN
 selected_owned:=coalesce(selected_attempt IS NOT NULL AND selected_input->'mutationProfile'=truss.runtime_owned_profile(),false);
 -- Private create execution: request admission, replay and rollback belong to
 -- the outer group. Keep its one public exception boundary around all operations.
 IF original_input IS NULL OR octet_length(original_input) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 1048576
  OR original_documents IS NULL OR octet_length(original_documents) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 4194304 THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'bounded original create source required' USING ERRCODE='54000';END IF;
 -- The selected owned caller supplies engine-built operation bytes and the
 -- immutable begin-admitted documents. Standalone calls retain admission.
 IF NOT selected_owned AND ((convert_from(original_input,'UTF8') IS JSON OBJECT WITH UNIQUE KEYS) IS NOT TRUE
  OR (selected_attempt IS NULL AND
   (convert_from(original_documents,'UTF8') IS JSON ARRAY WITH UNIQUE KEYS) IS NOT TRUE)) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'unique original create source required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 context:=convert_from(truss.group_context_qualified(expected_release,expected_digest,qualified_actor),'UTF8')::jsonb;
 actor_oid:=qualified_actor;writer:=pg_current_xact_id();
 SELECT rev INTO STRICT captured_revision FROM truss.schema_head WHERE id=1 FOR SHARE NOWAIT;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT installation FROM truss.runtime_current_installation();
 IF original_keys IS NULL OR octet_length(original_keys) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 8388608
 OR original_request IS NULL OR octet_length(original_request) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 65536 THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'bounded group keys and request required' USING ERRCODE='54000'; END IF;
 IF (convert_from(original_keys,'UTF8') IS JSON ARRAY WITH UNIQUE KEYS) IS NOT TRUE OR (convert_from(original_request,'UTF8') IS JSON OBJECT WITH UNIQUE KEYS) IS NOT TRUE THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'unique key/request JSON members required' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
 input:=convert_from(original_input,'UTF8')::jsonb;request:=convert_from(original_request,'UTF8')::jsonb;
 key_inputs:=convert_from(original_keys,'UTF8')::jsonb;
 IF key_inputs<>'[]'::jsonb THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'client key encoding is no longer accepted' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 IF input-ARRAY['interfaceVersion','layoutProfile','mutationProfile','valueProfile','catalog','operations','assertedOrigin']<>'{}'::jsonb
 OR input->'assertedOrigin'->>'kind' IS DISTINCT FROM 'map' OR jsonb_typeof(input->'assertedOrigin'->'entries') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
 OR (input->'assertedOrigin')-ARRAY['kind','entries']<>'{}'::jsonb THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'closed selected group and origin required' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(input->'assertedOrigin'->'entries') e
  WHERE jsonb_typeof(e.value->'key') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string' OR e.value-ARRAY['key','value']<>'{}'::jsonb
  OR (e.value->'value'='{"kind":"null"}'::jsonb OR (e.value->'value'->>'kind'='string'
   AND jsonb_typeof(e.value->'value'->'text')='string' AND (e.value->'value')-ARRAY['kind','text']='{}'::jsonb)) IS NOT TRUE)
 OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_array_elements(input->'assertedOrigin'->'entries'))
  <>(SELECT count(DISTINCT e.value->>'key') FROM jsonb_array_elements(input->'assertedOrigin'->'entries') e) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'exact unique scalar asserted origin required' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
 IF request IS DISTINCT FROM '{"state":"none"}'::jsonb THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'outer group owns request identity and replay' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 IF selected_owned THEN
  SELECT a.id,a.next_index,a.actor_oid,a.writer_xid INTO STRICT outer_attempt FROM truss.runtime_object_attempt a
   WHERE a.id=selected_attempt AND a.writer_xid=writer AND a.actor_oid=creation_leaf.actor_oid AND NOT a.complete
    AND a.context->'creationTransitionProfile'=creation_leaf.context->'creationTransitionProfile'
   FOR UPDATE NOWAIT;
  owned_plan:=truss.runtime_owned_plan(outer_attempt.id,outer_attempt.next_index);
  owned_state:=owned_plan->'afterNodes'->(owned_plan->>'primary');
  SELECT * INTO STRICT selected_type FROM truss.type_def WHERE type_id=(owned_state->'identity'->>'typeId')::int;
  SELECT t.metadata INTO STRICT type_metadata FROM truss.runtime_type_schema t
   WHERE t.rev=captured_revision AND t.type_id=selected_type.type_id;
  PERFORM truss.runtime_module_writer_qualified(selected_type.document_id,selected_type.module,qualified_actor);
  IF NOT truss.runtime_object_values_readable_qualified(selected_type.type_id,qualified_actor) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'current property and item interpretation reader required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
  metadata:=jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('typeId',selected_type.type_id::text,
   'documentId',selected_type.document_id,'moduleId',selected_type.module));
 ELSE
  metadata:=convert_from(truss.group_create_metadata_qualified(original_input,original_documents,expected_release,expected_digest,qualified_actor),'UTF8')::jsonb;
 SELECT a.id,a.next_index,a.actor_oid,a.writer_xid,a.results,a.aliases INTO STRICT outer_attempt FROM truss.runtime_object_attempt a
 WHERE a.writer_xid=writer AND a.actor_oid=creation_leaf.actor_oid AND NOT a.complete
  AND a.context->'creationTransitionProfile'=creation_leaf.context->'creationTransitionProfile'
  AND a.documents_bytes=original_documents
  AND CASE WHEN input->'mutationProfile'=truss.runtime_owned_profile() THEN
   a.results='[]'::jsonb AND a.aliases='[]'::jsonb AND
   (SELECT count(*) FROM truss.runtime_owned_operation p WHERE p.attempt_id=a.id AND p.result IS NOT NULL)=a.next_index
   ELSE jsonb_array_length(a.results)=a.next_index END
  AND ((selected_attempt IS NULL AND

    AND p.writer_xid=writer AND (selected_owned OR p.plan->'operation'=input->'operations'->0) AND p.result IS NULL;
  GET DIAGNOSTICS changed_rows=ROW_COUNT;
  IF changed_rows<>1 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'one original create result slot required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
  IF NOT selected_owned THEN
  SELECT p.result INTO STRICT stored_result FROM truss.runtime_owned_operation p
   WHERE p.attempt_id=outer_attempt.id AND p.operation_index=outer_attempt.next_index;
  IF stored_result IS DISTINCT FROM semantic->'results'->0 THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'exact sealed create result required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
  END IF;
  UPDATE truss.runtime_object_attempt a SET next_index=a.next_index+1
   WHERE a.id=outer_attempt.id AND a.next_index=outer_attempt.next_index AND NOT a.complete
    AND a.actor_oid=creation_leaf.actor_oid AND a.writer_xid=writer AND a.results='[]'::jsonb AND a.aliases='[]'::jsonb;
 ELSE
 UPDATE truss.runtime_object_attempt a SET next_index=a.next_index+1,
  results=a.results||jsonb_build_array(results_of_create.value),aliases=a.aliases||(semantic->'aliases')
 FROM (SELECT semantic->'results'->0 AS value) results_of_create
 WHERE a.id=outer_attempt.id AND a.next_index=outer_attempt.next_index AND NOT a.complete;
 -- Read the stored row once below; an UPDATE RETURNING image here would be
 -- immediately overwritten and repeatedly copy the growing complete result.
 END IF;
 GET DIAGNOSTICS changed_rows=ROW_COUNT;
 IF changed_rows<>1 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'one atomic outer create progress required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
 IF NOT selected_owned THEN
 SELECT a.actor_oid,a.writer_xid,a.next_index,a.results,a.aliases,a.complete INTO actual_progress
 FROM truss.runtime_object_attempt a WHERE a.id=outer_attempt.id;
 SELECT to_jsonb(t)-'transition_id' INTO STRICT actual_transition FROM truss.runtime_object_transition t
 WHERE t.attempt_id=outer_attempt.id AND t.operation_index=outer_attempt.next_index;
 IF actual_transition IS DISTINCT FROM expected_transition THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'exact stored atomic create transition required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
 IF ROW(actual_progress.actor_oid,actual_progress.writer_xid,actual_progress.next_index,
  actual_progress.results,actual_progress.aliases,actual_progress.complete) IS DISTINCT FROM
  ROW(outer_attempt.actor_oid,outer_attempt.writer_xid,outer_attempt.next_index+1,
   CASE WHEN input->'mutationProfile'=truss.runtime_owned_profile() THEN '[]'::jsonb
    ELSE outer_attempt.results||jsonb_build_array(semantic->'results'->0) END,
   CASE WHEN input->'mutationProfile'=truss.runtime_owned_profile() THEN '[]'::jsonb
    ELSE outer_attempt.aliases||(semantic->'aliases') END,false) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'exact atomic outer create progress required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(j.row ORDER BY j.seq),'[]'::jsonb) INTO physical_journal FROM
  (SELECT to_jsonb(j) AS row,j.seq FROM truss.journal j WHERE j.entity_kind='o'
   AND j.entity_id=object_row.id AND j.entity_type=object_row.type_id AND j.xid=writer AND j.ver=1
   ORDER BY j.seq LIMIT 2) j;
 IF jsonb_array_length(physical_journal)>1 THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'whole history group exceeds event limit' USING ERRCODE='54000';END IF;
 IF physical_journal IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_array(expected_journal) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'exact physical atomic create journal required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
 FOR key_plan IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(member_keys) LOOP
  SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(r.row),'[]'::jsonb) INTO actual_row FROM
   (SELECT to_jsonb(r) AS row FROM truss.object_key_reservation_bucket r
    WHERE r.namespace_sha256=decode(substring(key_plan->'membership'->>'namespace_sha256' FROM 3),'hex')
     AND r.key_sha256=decode(substring(key_plan->'membership'->>'key_sha256' FROM 3),'hex')
     AND r.namespace_bytes=decode(substring(key_plan->'membership'->>'namespace_bytes' FROM 3),'hex')
     AND r.key_bytes=decode(substring(key_plan->'membership'->>'key_bytes' FROM 3),'hex') LIMIT 2) r;
  IF actual_row IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_array(key_plan->'reservation') THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'exact retained create key reservation required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
 END LOOP;
 END IF;
 -- The selected owned leaf retains constraints, actual write counts and one
 -- result slot. Mandatory attempt settlement checks completion and authority.
 -- The compatibility creation path retains its original leaf check.
 IF input->'mutationProfile' IS DISTINCT FROM truss.runtime_owned_profile() THEN
  PERFORM truss.runtime_create_transition_validate_qualified((SELECT transition_id FROM truss.runtime_object_transition WHERE attempt_id=outer_attempt.id AND operation_index=outer_attempt.next_index AND before_object IS NULL),qualified_actor);
 END IF;
 FOR operation_meta IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(metadata) LOOP
  IF truss.runtime_module_writer_qualified(operation_meta->>'documentId',operation_meta->>'moduleId',qualified_actor) IS DISTINCT FROM outer_attempt.actor_oid THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'original current create actor required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
  IF NOT truss.runtime_object_values_readable_qualified((operation_meta->>'typeId')::int,qualified_actor) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'current property and item interpretation reader required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
 END LOOP;
 IF root_identity IS NOT NULL AND NOT truss.runtime_can_read_qualified(root_identity->'owner'->>'documentId',root_identity->'owner'->>'moduleId',qualified_actor) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'current create root reader required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
 RETURN convert_to(jsonb_build_object('outcome','success','disposition','applied','durability','pending','semantic',semantic)::text,'UTF8');
END;
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.apply_group_prepared(original_input bytea, original_documents bytea, original_request bytea, expected_release text, expected_digest text, app_prepared jsonb)
 RETURNS bytea
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
 SET row_security TO 'off'
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
 SET bytea_output TO 'hex'
AS $function$
DECLARE opened jsonb;attempt_id uuid;operation_index int:=0;operation_count int;result jsonb;failure_result jsonb;input_text text;
 failure_operation_index int;operation_local_failure boolean:=false;
 native_state text;native_detail text;native_detail_json jsonb;failure_code text;unavailable_reason text;parsed_input jsonb;
BEGIN
 -- Read only a guarded count hint before admission so a trusted conflict
 -- ordinal raised during group-begin can be bounded. The original bytes still
 -- enter the normal admission function unchanged; malformed input leaves the
 -- hint unset and receives its established admission outcome.
 BEGIN
  IF original_input IS NOT NULL AND octet_length(original_input) BETWEEN 1 AND 1048576 THEN
   input_text:=convert_from(original_input,'UTF8');
   IF input_text IS JSON OBJECT WITH UNIQUE KEYS THEN
    parsed_input:=input_text::jsonb;
    IF jsonb_typeof(parsed_input->'operations')='array'
     AND jsonb_array_length(parsed_input->'operations') BETWEEN 1 AND 1024 THEN
     operation_count:=jsonb_array_length(parsed_input->'operations');
    END IF;
   END IF;
  END IF;
 EXCEPTION WHEN others THEN
  parsed_input:=NULL;operation_count:=NULL;
 END;
 opened:=convert_from(truss.object_group_begin_prepared(original_input,original_documents,original_request,expected_release,expected_digest,convert_to('[]','UTF8'),false,app_prepared),'UTF8')::jsonb;
 IF opened->>'outcome'<>'execute' THEN RETURN convert_to(opened::text,'UTF8');END IF;
 attempt_id:=(opened->>'attemptId')::uuid;
 parsed_input:=convert_from(original_input,'UTF8')::jsonb;
 operation_count:=jsonb_array_length(parsed_input->'operations');
 IF parsed_input->'mutationProfile'=truss.runtime_owned_profile() AND NOT EXISTS(
  SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(parsed_input->'operations') o
  WHERE o.value->>'operation' IS DISTINCT FROM 'create_object'
   OR o.value->'ownership' IS DISTINCT FROM '{"state":"rootless"}'::jsonb) THEN
  PERFORM truss.runtime_owned_create_batch(attempt_id);
 ELSIF parsed_input->'mutationProfile'=truss.runtime_owned_profile() AND NOT EXISTS(
  SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(parsed_input->'operations') o
  WHERE o.value->>'operation' IS DISTINCT FROM 'create_edge'
   OR o.value->'source'->>'state' IS DISTINCT FROM 'stored'
   OR o.value->'target'->>'state' IS DISTINCT FROM 'stored') AND NOT EXISTS(
  SELECT 1 FROM truss.runtime_owned_operation p JOIN truss.rel_def r
   ON r.rel_type_id=(p.plan->'afterEdges'->(p.plan->>'primary')->'identity'->>'typeId')::int
  WHERE p.attempt_id=(opened->>'attemptId')::uuid AND r.lifecycle<>'independent') THEN
  PERFORM truss.runtime_owned_edge_create_batch(attempt_id);
 ELSIF parsed_input->'mutationProfile'=truss.runtime_owned_profile() AND NOT EXISTS(
  SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(parsed_input->'operations') o
  WHERE o.value->>'operation' IS DISTINCT FROM 'update_object'
   OR o.value->'target'->>'state' IS DISTINCT FROM 'stored' OR o.value ? 'ownershipChange')
  AND (SELECT count(DISTINCT plan->>'primary') FROM truss.runtime_owned_operation p WHERE p.attempt_id=(opened->>'attemptId')::uuid)=operation_count THEN
  PERFORM truss.runtime_owned_update_batch(attempt_id);
 ELSE
 FOR step_index IN 0..operation_count-1 LOOP
  operation_index:=step_index;
  operation_local_failure:=true;
  PERFORM truss.runtime_owned_group_step_in_input(attempt_id,operation_index,convert_to('[]','UTF8'),original_input,parsed_input);
  operation_local_failure:=false;
 END LOOP;
 END IF;
 operation_local_failure:=false;
 operation_index:=operation_count-1;
 result:=convert_from(truss.object_group_finish(attempt_id),'UTF8')::jsonb;
 -- Internal import provenance attaches to the same completed attempt. This field
 -- is outside the public semantic result and does not alter receipt bytes.
 RETURN convert_to((result||jsonb_build_object('attemptId',attempt_id::text))::text,'UTF8');
EXCEPTION WHEN SQLSTATE '22023' OR SQLSTATE '23505' OR SQLSTATE 'P1001' OR SQLSTATE 'P1003'
 OR SQLSTATE 'P1004' OR SQLSTATE 'P1005' OR SQLSTATE 'P1405' OR SQLSTATE 'P1403' OR SQLSTATE '0A000'
 OR SQLSTATE '54000' OR SQLSTATE '55P03' THEN
 GET STACKED DIAGNOSTICS native_state=RETURNED_SQLSTATE,native_detail=PG_EXCEPTION_DETAIL;
 IF operation_local_failure THEN failure_operation_index:=operation_index;END IF;
 -- Batched key preflight reports the original colliding operation in the
 -- exception raised while the graph writer gate is still held. Keep this
 -- mapping in the same native decision; never guess by rereading catalog rows.
 IF native_state='23505' AND native_detail IS NOT NULL
  AND native_detail IS JSON OBJECT WITH UNIQUE KEYS THEN
  native_detail_json:=native_detail::jsonb;
  IF native_detail_json-ARRAY['operationIndex']='{}'::jsonb
   AND jsonb_typeof(native_detail_json->'operationIndex')='number' THEN
   IF (native_detail_json->>'operationIndex') ~ '^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,3})$' THEN
    IF (native_detail_json->>'operationIndex')::int<operation_count THEN
     failure_operation_index:=(native_detail_json->>'operationIndex')::int;
    END IF;
   END IF;
  END IF;
 END IF;
 -- This exception block has rolled back admission, every step and finalization.
 -- Cancellation, deadlock and serialization errors propagate to host settlement.
 unavailable_reason:=CASE native_state WHEN '0A000' THEN 'profile' WHEN '54000' THEN 'resource' WHEN '55P03' THEN 'observation' END;
 IF unavailable_reason IS NOT NULL THEN
  RETURN convert_to(jsonb_build_object('outcome','unavailable','reason',unavailable_reason)::text,'UTF8');END IF;
 failure_code:=CASE native_state WHEN '22023' THEN 'invalid_input' WHEN '23505' THEN 'key_conflict'
  WHEN 'P1001' THEN 'request_conflict' WHEN 'P1003' THEN 'expected_version' WHEN 'P1004' THEN 'not_found'
  WHEN 'P1005' THEN 'dependencies' WHEN 'P1405' THEN 'multiplicity' WHEN 'P1403' THEN 'unauthorized_person' END;
 failure_result:=jsonb_build_object('outcome','failed','code',failure_code,'nativeState',native_state);
 IF native_state='P1405' THEN
  failure_operation_index:=NULL;
  IF native_detail IS NULL OR (native_detail IS JSON OBJECT WITH UNIQUE KEYS) IS NOT TRUE THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'original native multiplicity diagnostic required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
  native_detail_json:=native_detail::jsonb;
  IF native_detail_json-ARRAY['rule','entity','relationship']<>'{}'::jsonb
   OR NOT native_detail_json ?& ARRAY['rule','entity','relationship'] THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'closed native multiplicity diagnostic required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
  failure_result:=failure_result||jsonb_build_object('phase','final_state')||native_detail_json;
 END IF;
 IF failure_operation_index IS NOT NULL THEN
  failure_result:=failure_result||jsonb_build_object('operationIndex',failure_operation_index::text);
 END IF;
 RETURN convert_to(failure_result::text,'UTF8');
END;
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.build_import_records(original_drafts bytea, expected_release text, expected_digest text)
 RETURNS bytea
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
 SET row_security TO 'off'
AS $function$
 DECLARE drafts jsonb;draft jsonb;context jsonb;metadata jsonb;cache jsonb:='{}';cache_key text;
 identity jsonb;component jsonb;components jsonb;matches int;cell jsonb;payload jsonb;payload_bytes bytea;
 records jsonb[]:='{}';item jsonb;selected_type int;definition truss.prop_def%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
 context:=convert_from(truss.batched_import_context(expected_release,expected_digest),'UTF8')::jsonb;
 IF original_drafts IS NULL OR octet_length(original_drafts)>8388608 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'bounded import drafts required' USING ERRCODE='54000';END IF;
 IF (convert_from(original_drafts,'UTF8') IS JSON ARRAY WITH UNIQUE KEYS) IS NOT TRUE THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'unique original import drafts required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 drafts:=convert_from(original_drafts,'UTF8')::jsonb;
 IF jsonb_array_length(drafts)>1024 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'bounded import drafts required' USING ERRCODE='54000';END IF;
 FOR draft IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(drafts) LOOP
  IF (draft->>'kind' IN ('object','edge')) IS NOT TRUE OR jsonb_typeof(draft->'values') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM unnest(ARRAY['documentId','moduleId']) k WHERE jsonb_typeof(draft->k) IS DISTINCT FROM 'string' OR octet_length(draft->>k) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 4096)
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'closed exact import draft required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
  PERFORM truss.runtime_module_writer(draft->>'documentId',draft->>'moduleId');
  cache_key:=jsonb_build_array(draft->>'kind',draft->>'documentId',draft->>'moduleId',draft->>'recordId',draft->>'relationshipId')::text;
  metadata:=cache->cache_key;
  IF draft->>'kind'='object' THEN
   IF draft-ARRAY['kind','documentId','moduleId','recordId','values','source']<>'{}'::jsonb THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'closed object import draft required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
   IF metadata IS NULL THEN
    metadata:=convert_from(truss.import_key_selection(draft->>'documentId',draft->>'moduleId',draft->>'recordId',expected_release,expected_digest),'UTF8')::jsonb;
    cache:=cache||jsonb_build_object(cache_key,metadata);
   END IF;
   selected_type:=(metadata->'type'->>'typeId')::int;components:='[]';
   FOR component IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(metadata->'components') LOOP
