    SELECT count(*),jsonb_agg(v.value->'value')->0 INTO matches,cell FROM jsonb_array_elements(draft->'values') v WHERE v.value->>'name'=component->>'name';
    IF matches<>1 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'complete original primary values required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
    SELECT * INTO STRICT definition FROM truss.prop_def WHERE type_id=selected_type AND prop_id=(component->>'propertyId')::int AND retired_rev IS NULL;
    IF NOT truss.runtime_can_read(draft->>'documentId',definition.declaration_module) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'current primary reader required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
    components:=components||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('propertyId',component->>'propertyId','definitionPin',component->>'definitionPin','value',cell));
   END LOOP;
   identity:=jsonb_build_object('operation','object_key','type',metadata->'type','keyNumber',metadata->>'keyNumber',
    'keyDefinitionPin',metadata->>'keyDefinitionPin','keyEncodingProfile',metadata->'keyEncodingProfile','components',components);
   payload:=jsonb_build_object('interfaceVersion','truss-import-payload/0.1.0','kind','object','values',draft->'values','ownership',jsonb_build_object('state','rootless'));
  ELSE
   IF draft-ARRAY['kind','documentId','moduleId','relationshipId','sourceEndpoint','targetEndpoint','values','orderKey','source']<>'{}'::jsonb THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'closed edge import draft required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
   IF metadata IS NULL THEN
    metadata:=convert_from(truss.group_relationship_reference(draft->>'documentId',draft->>'moduleId',draft->>'relationshipId',expected_release,expected_digest),'UTF8')::jsonb;
    IF metadata IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'accepted relationship required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
    cache:=cache||jsonb_build_object(cache_key,metadata);
   END IF;
   identity:=jsonb_build_object('relationshipDefinitionPin',metadata->>'definitionPin','source',draft->'sourceEndpoint','target',draft->'targetEndpoint');
   payload:=jsonb_build_object('interfaceVersion','truss-import-payload/0.1.0','kind','edge','values',draft->'values','orderKey',draft->'orderKey');
  END IF;
  IF draft->'source' IS NOT NULL AND draft->'source'<>'null'::jsonb THEN payload:=payload||jsonb_build_object('source',draft->'source');END IF;
  payload_bytes:=convert_to(payload::text,'UTF8');
  IF octet_length(payload_bytes)>1048576 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'bounded record payload required' USING ERRCODE='54000';END IF;
  records:=array_append(records,jsonb_build_object('kind',draft->>'kind','identity',identity,'payloadProfile',context->'importPayloadProfile',
   'payload',jsonb_build_object('identity',encode(sha256(payload_bytes),'hex'),'bytesBase64',replace(encode(payload_bytes,'base64'),E'\n',''),'sha256',encode(sha256(payload_bytes),'hex'))));
 END LOOP;
 -- Repeat each cached definition's original authority proof before publishing.
 FOR draft IN SELECT DISTINCT ON (value->>'kind',value->>'documentId',value->>'moduleId',value->>'recordId',value->>'relationshipId') value FROM jsonb_array_elements(drafts) LOOP
  cache_key:=jsonb_build_array(draft->>'kind',draft->>'documentId',draft->>'moduleId',draft->>'recordId',draft->>'relationshipId')::text;
  IF draft->>'kind'='object' THEN
   IF convert_from(truss.import_key_selection(draft->>'documentId',draft->>'moduleId',draft->>'recordId',expected_release,expected_digest),'UTF8')::jsonb IS DISTINCT FROM cache->cache_key THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'original builder definition changed' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
  ELSE
   IF convert_from(truss.group_relationship_reference(draft->>'documentId',draft->>'moduleId',draft->>'relationshipId',expected_release,expected_digest),'UTF8')::jsonb IS DISTINCT FROM cache->cache_key THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'original relationship authority changed' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
  END IF;
 END LOOP;
 RETURN convert_to(jsonb_build_object('context',context,'records',to_jsonb(records))::text,'UTF8');
END;
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.catalog_accept_with_keys(input_bytes bytea, documents_bytes bytea, declarations_bytes bytea, source_bytes bytea, origin_bytes bytea, request_key text, key_receipts bytea, preview_mode boolean, expected_revision integer, expected_documents bytea)
 RETURNS TABLE(revision text, registration_id text, report_bytes bytea, replayed boolean, unchanged boolean, actor_name text, violations_bytes bytea)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
 SET bytea_output TO 'hex'
AS $function$
DECLARE actor oid; installation truss.catalog_runtime_installation%ROWTYPE;
 request truss.catalog_registration_request%ROWTYPE; existing truss.catalog_registration_request%ROWTYPE;
 alias_request truss.catalog_unchanged_request%ROWTYPE;
 expected jsonb; prior_expected jsonb; origin bytea; original_report bytea; table_name text; columns text; assignments text;identity_column text;conflict_columns text; rows jsonb; raw bytea; total bigint:=0; request_count bigint;
 expected_docs jsonb; expected_doc jsonb;
 prior_revision int;new_revision int;type_start int;property_start int;relationship_start int;component_index int:=0;component_limit int;compact boolean;violations bytea;key_candidates jsonb;verified_keys jsonb;
BEGIN
 IF preview_mode IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'explicit catalog mode required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 compact:=(convert_from(input_bytes,'UTF8')::jsonb)->>'interfaceVersion'='truss-acceptance-input/0.2.0';
 IF compact AND declarations_bytes<>''::bytea THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'source-only catalog request required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 actor:=truss.catalog_actor();
 SELECT * INTO STRICT installation FROM truss.runtime_current_installation();
 IF installation.release_id<>'truss-catalog-runtime/0.74-candidate' OR request_key IS NULL OR octet_length(request_key) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 1024 THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'selected catalog release and request key required' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
 FOREACH raw IN ARRAY ARRAY[input_bytes,documents_bytes,declarations_bytes,source_bytes,origin_bytes] LOOP
  component_index:=component_index+1;
  component_limit:=CASE WHEN component_index=5 THEN 1048576 WHEN component_index=4 THEN 4194304 ELSE 16777216 END;
  IF raw IS NULL OR NOT (compact AND component_index=3 AND octet_length(raw)=0) AND octet_length(raw) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND component_limit THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'catalog input byte limit exceeded' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
  total:=total+octet_length(raw);
 END LOOP;
 IF total>16777216 OR jsonb_typeof(convert_from(origin_bytes,'UTF8')::jsonb) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'bounded catalog request required' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
 IF expected_revision IS NOT NULL AND expected_revision NOT BETWEEN -1 AND 2147483647
  OR expected_documents IS NULL OR octet_length(expected_documents) NOT BETWEEN 2 AND 1048576 THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'bounded catalog source expectations required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 -- The private host's immutable semantic-parameter lane excludes SQL NULL.
 -- Normalize its -1 sentinel immediately so custody and replay remain byte-for-byte
 -- identical to historical no-CAS requests.
 IF expected_revision=-1 THEN expected_revision:=NULL;END IF;
 expected_docs:=convert_from(expected_documents,'UTF8')::jsonb;
 IF jsonb_typeof(expected_docs) IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' OR jsonb_array_length(expected_docs)>512 THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'catalog source expectations required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 IF jsonb_array_length(expected_docs)>0 THEN
  IF jsonb_array_length(expected_docs)<>jsonb_array_length(convert_from(documents_bytes,'UTF8')::jsonb)
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(expected_docs) e
    WHERE jsonb_typeof(e.value) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
     OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(e.value))<>2
     OR jsonb_typeof(e.value->'documentId') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
     OR octet_length(e.value->>'documentId') NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 4096
     OR jsonb_typeof(e.value->'sourceCatalogRevision') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number'
     OR (e.value->>'sourceCatalogRevision') !~ '^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$'
     OR (e.value->>'sourceCatalogRevision')::numeric>2147483647)
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(expected_docs) e GROUP BY e.value->>'documentId' HAVING count(*)<>1)
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(convert_from(documents_bytes,'UTF8')::jsonb) d GROUP BY d.value->>'documentId' HAVING count(*)<>1)
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(convert_from(documents_bytes,'UTF8')::jsonb) d
    WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(expected_docs) e WHERE e.value->>'documentId'=d.value->>'documentId')) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'exact submitted document expectation set required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 END IF;
 IF compact THEN declarations_bytes:=truss.runtime_owned_catalog_declarations(documents_bytes);END IF;
 -- Bound concurrency without an automatic retry loop.
 SELECT rev INTO STRICT prior_revision FROM truss.schema_head WHERE id=1 FOR UPDATE NOWAIT;
 prior_expected:=truss.catalog_all_expected_records();
 SELECT count(*) INTO request_count FROM (
  SELECT 1 FROM truss.catalog_registration_request r WHERE r.installation_id=installation.installation_id AND r.actor_oid=actor AND r.request_key=catalog_accept_with_keys.request_key
  UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM truss.catalog_unchanged_request r WHERE r.installation_id=installation.installation_id AND r.actor_oid=actor AND r.request_key=catalog_accept_with_keys.request_key) requests;
 IF request_count>1 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'unambiguous catalog request required' USING ERRCODE='55000'; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO existing FROM truss.catalog_registration_request r WHERE r.installation_id=installation.installation_id AND r.actor_oid=actor AND r.request_key=catalog_accept_with_keys.request_key;
 IF FOUND THEN
  IF existing.input_bytes IS DISTINCT FROM input_bytes OR existing.expected_revision IS DISTINCT FROM expected_revision OR existing.expected_documents IS DISTINCT FROM expected_documents OR (CASE WHEN octet_length(existing.document_bytes)=0 THEN
    convert_from(truss.runtime_owned_request_documents(existing),'UTF8')::jsonb IS DISTINCT FROM convert_from(documents_bytes,'UTF8')::jsonb
   ELSE existing.document_bytes IS DISTINCT FROM documents_bytes OR existing.declaration_bytes IS DISTINCT FROM declarations_bytes END) OR existing.origin_bytes IS DISTINCT FROM origin_bytes THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'request key reused with different registration input' USING ERRCODE='P1001'; END IF;
  PERFORM truss.catalog_actor();
  PERFORM truss.catalog_rebind_report_reader(existing.registration_id);
  RETURN QUERY SELECT existing.revision::text,existing.registration_id::text,r.report_bytes,true,false,existing.actor_name,NULL::bytea FROM truss.catalog_acceptance_report r WHERE r.rev=existing.revision;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'original registration report missing' USING ERRCODE='55000'; END IF;
  PERFORM truss.catalog_actor();
  PERFORM truss.catalog_rebind_report_reader(existing.registration_id);
  RETURN;
 END IF;
 SELECT * INTO alias_request FROM truss.catalog_unchanged_request r
  WHERE r.installation_id=installation.installation_id AND r.actor_oid=actor AND r.request_key=catalog_accept_with_keys.request_key;
 IF FOUND THEN
  SELECT * INTO STRICT existing FROM truss.catalog_registration_request r WHERE r.registration_id=alias_request.registration_id;
  IF existing.input_bytes IS DISTINCT FROM input_bytes OR (CASE WHEN octet_length(existing.document_bytes)=0 THEN
    convert_from(truss.runtime_owned_request_documents(existing),'UTF8')::jsonb IS DISTINCT FROM convert_from(documents_bytes,'UTF8')::jsonb
   ELSE existing.document_bytes IS DISTINCT FROM documents_bytes OR existing.declaration_bytes IS DISTINCT FROM declarations_bytes END)
   OR alias_request.origin_bytes IS DISTINCT FROM origin_bytes OR alias_request.expected_revision IS DISTINCT FROM expected_revision
   OR alias_request.expected_documents IS DISTINCT FROM expected_documents THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'request key reused with different registration input' USING ERRCODE='P1001'; END IF;
  PERFORM truss.catalog_actor();
  PERFORM truss.catalog_rebind_report_reader(existing.registration_id);
  RETURN QUERY SELECT existing.revision::text,existing.registration_id::text,r.report_bytes,true,true,alias_request.actor_name,NULL::bytea
   FROM truss.catalog_acceptance_report r WHERE r.rev=existing.revision;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'original registration report missing' USING ERRCODE='55000'; END IF;
  PERFORM truss.catalog_actor();
  PERFORM truss.catalog_rebind_report_reader(existing.registration_id);
  RETURN;
 END IF;
 -- Source and optional global CAS checks happen only after exact authorized
 -- replay resolution, under the same schema-head serialization lock.
 IF expected_revision IS NOT NULL AND prior_revision IS DISTINCT FROM expected_revision THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'expected catalog revision changed' USING ERRCODE='P1011';END IF;
 IF jsonb_array_length(expected_docs)>0 THEN
  FOR expected_doc IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(expected_docs) LOOP
   IF coalesce((SELECT max(rev) FROM truss.schema_doc WHERE doc_id=expected_doc->>'documentId'),0)
     IS DISTINCT FROM (expected_doc->>'sourceCatalogRevision')::int THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'expected document source revision changed' USING ERRCODE='P1011';END IF;
  END LOOP;
 END IF;
 -- Ordinary registration keeps one validation summary per original document.
 -- Semantic source/declaration checks and atomic publication remain native.
 IF (convert_from(source_bytes,'UTF8')::jsonb)->>'sourceFormat' ='truss-registration-summary/2.0' THEN
  DECLARE
   summary jsonb:=convert_from(source_bytes,'UTF8')::jsonb;
   original_input jsonb:=convert_from(input_bytes,'UTF8')::jsonb;
   original_docs jsonb:=convert_from(documents_bytes,'UTF8')::jsonb;
   doc jsonb; validation jsonb; selected_doc jsonb; ddd_profile jsonb; ddd_validation jsonb; ddd_known boolean; doc_index int:=0;
  BEGIN
   IF (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(summary))<>3
    OR jsonb_typeof(summary->'umf') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
    OR jsonb_typeof(summary->'documentValidations') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
    OR jsonb_array_length(summary->'documentValidations')<>jsonb_array_length(original_docs)
    OR original_input->'binding' IS DISTINCT FROM '{"state":"absent"}'::jsonb
    OR original_input->'transforms' IS DISTINCT FROM '[]'::jsonb THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'original native registration summary required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
   FOR doc IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(original_docs) LOOP
    validation:=summary->'documentValidations'->doc_index;
    selected_doc:=original_input->'documents'->doc_index;
    ddd_known:=((doc->>'originalText')::jsonb->'vocabularies'->'umf.ddd'->>'version')='0.1.0';
    ddd_profile:=validation->'dddProfile';ddd_validation:=validation->'dddValidation';
    IF (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(validation))<>
      (CASE WHEN ddd_known THEN 5 ELSE 3 END)
      OR validation->>'documentId' IS DISTINCT FROM doc->>'documentId'
      OR validation->>'contentSha256' IS DISTINCT FROM selected_doc->'artifact'->>'sha256'
      OR selected_doc->'ingress' IS DISTINCT FROM '{"kind":"native"}'::jsonb
      OR validation->'validation' IS DISTINCT FROM doc->'validation'->'sourceValidation'
      OR validation->'validation'->'valid' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'::jsonb
      OR jsonb_typeof(validation->'validation'->'complete') IS DISTINCT FROM 'boolean'
      OR jsonb_typeof(validation->'validation'->'diagnostics') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
      OR ddd_known AND (ddd_profile IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object('identity','umf-ddd-document-validation',
       'version',original_input->'validatorProfile'->>'version','sha256',original_input->'validatorProfile'->>'sha256')
       OR ddd_profile IS DISTINCT FROM doc->'validation'->'dddProfile'
       OR ddd_validation IS DISTINCT FROM doc->'validation'->'dddValidation'
       OR ddd_validation->'valid' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'::jsonb
       OR jsonb_typeof(ddd_validation->'complete') IS DISTINCT FROM 'boolean'
       OR jsonb_typeof(ddd_validation->'diagnostics') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array')
      OR NOT ddd_known AND (validation ? 'dddProfile' OR validation ? 'dddValidation'
       OR doc->'validation' ? 'dddProfile' OR doc->'validation' ? 'dddValidation') THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'original document validation summary required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
    doc_index:=doc_index+1;
   END LOOP;
  END;
 ELSE
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Current registration summary required' USING ERRCODE='22023';
 END IF;

 SELECT r.* INTO existing FROM truss.catalog_registration_request r
  WHERE pg_catalog.sha256(r.input_bytes)=pg_catalog.sha256(catalog_accept_with_keys.input_bytes)
  AND r.input_bytes=catalog_accept_with_keys.input_bytes AND CASE WHEN octet_length(r.document_bytes)=0 THEN
   convert_from(truss.runtime_owned_request_documents(r),'UTF8')::jsonb=convert_from(catalog_accept_with_keys.documents_bytes,'UTF8')::jsonb
  ELSE r.document_bytes=catalog_accept_with_keys.documents_bytes AND r.declaration_bytes=catalog_accept_with_keys.declarations_bytes END
  AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(convert_from(catalog_accept_with_keys.documents_bytes,'UTF8')::jsonb) d
   WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM truss.schema_doc current_doc WHERE current_doc.doc_id=d.value->>'documentId'
    AND current_doc.rev=(SELECT max(latest.rev) FROM truss.schema_doc latest WHERE latest.doc_id=current_doc.doc_id)
    AND current_doc.document=d.value->>'originalText' AND current_doc.doc_revision=d.value->>'revision'));
 IF FOUND THEN
  PERFORM truss.catalog_require_sources(input_bytes,documents_bytes,declarations_bytes);
  IF NOT preview_mode THEN
  INSERT INTO truss.catalog_unchanged_request(installation_id,actor_oid,actor_name,request_key,registration_id,origin_bytes,expected_revision,expected_documents)
   VALUES(installation.installation_id,actor,session_user::text,request_key,existing.registration_id,origin_bytes,expected_revision,expected_documents);
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'unchanged request not stored' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
  END IF;
  alias_request.actor_name:=session_user::text;
  PERFORM truss.catalog_actor();
  PERFORM truss.catalog_rebind_report_reader(existing.registration_id);
  RETURN QUERY SELECT existing.revision::text,existing.registration_id::text,r.report_bytes,false,true,alias_request.actor_name,NULL::bytea
   FROM truss.catalog_acceptance_report r WHERE r.rev=existing.revision;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'original registration report missing' USING ERRCODE='55000'; END IF;
  PERFORM truss.catalog_actor();
  PERFORM truss.catalog_rebind_report_reader(existing.registration_id);
  RETURN;
 END IF;
 PERFORM truss.catalog_require_sources(input_bytes,documents_bytes,declarations_bytes);
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(convert_from(documents_bytes,'UTF8')::jsonb) d
  JOIN truss.schema_doc s ON s.doc_id=d.value->>'documentId') THEN
  IF NOT truss.catalog_ddd_optional_evolution_supported(documents_bytes) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'known DDD source evolution is outside selected additive-member compatibility' USING ERRCODE='0A000';END IF;
  violations:=truss.catalog_scalar_violations_with_sources(declarations_bytes,documents_bytes);
  IF violations IS NOT NULL THEN
   PERFORM truss.catalog_actor();
   RETURN QUERY SELECT prior_revision::text,NULL::text,NULL::bytea,false,false,session_user::text,violations;
   RETURN;
  END IF;
 END IF;
 IF prior_revision<> (SELECT coalesce(max(r.revision),0) FROM truss.catalog_registration_request r) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'complete current catalog head required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
 IF prior_revision=2147483647 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'catalog revision exhausted' USING ERRCODE='54000';END IF;
 new_revision:=prior_revision+1;
 SELECT coalesce(max(type_id),0) INTO type_start FROM truss.type_def;
 SELECT coalesce(max(prop_id),0) INTO property_start FROM truss.prop_def;
 SELECT coalesce(max(rel_type_id),0) INTO relationship_start FROM truss.rel_def;
 IF type_start>2147418111 OR property_start>2147418111 OR relationship_start>2147418111 THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'catalog identity range exhausted' USING ERRCODE='54000';END IF;
 origin:=convert_to((convert_from(origin_bytes,'UTF8')::jsonb||jsonb_build_object('actor',session_user::text,'db_role',session_user::text))::text,'UTF8');
 expected:=truss.catalog_revision_plan(prior_expected,truss.catalog_expected_records(declarations_bytes,documents_bytes,origin,transaction_timestamp(),installation.genesis_at,new_revision,0,0,0));
 -- Input and public-view wire budgets apply to their actual carriers. Source
 -- archives and immutable history are not another request or a rendered view.
 IF jsonb_array_length(expected->'type_def')+jsonb_array_length(expected->'prop_def')+jsonb_array_length(expected->'key_def')+jsonb_array_length(expected->'rel_def')>65536
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'complete catalog resource limit' USING ERRCODE='54000';END IF;
 violations:=truss.catalog_rebind_violations(expected,new_revision,declarations_bytes);
 IF violations IS NOT NULL THEN
  PERFORM truss.catalog_actor();
  RETURN QUERY SELECT prior_revision::text,NULL::text,NULL::bytea,false,false,session_user::text,violations;RETURN;
 END IF;
 key_candidates:=truss.catalog_key_backfill_candidates(expected,new_revision);
 IF preview_mode THEN
  RETURN QUERY SELECT prior_revision::text,NULL::text,
   convert_to(jsonb_build_object('interfaceVersion','truss-catalog-key-candidates/0.1','candidates',key_candidates)::text,'UTF8'),
   false,false,session_user::text,NULL::bytea;RETURN;
 END IF;
 verified_keys:=truss.catalog_key_backfill_verify(expected,new_revision,coalesce(key_receipts,convert_to('[]','UTF8')));
 violations:=truss.catalog_key_backfill_violations(verified_keys);
 IF violations IS NOT NULL THEN
  PERFORM truss.catalog_actor();
  RETURN QUERY SELECT prior_revision::text,NULL::text,NULL::bytea,false,false,session_user::text,violations;RETURN;
 END IF;
 FOREACH table_name IN ARRAY ARRAY['schema_rev','schema_doc','type_def','prop_def','key_def','rel_def','relationship_lineage','rel_endpoint','schema_change'] LOOP
  rows:=expected->table_name;
  SELECT string_agg(format('%I',a.attname),',' ORDER BY a.attnum),string_agg(format('%I=EXCLUDED.%I',a.attname,a.attname),',' ORDER BY a.attnum) INTO columns,assignments FROM pg_attribute a
   WHERE a.attrelid=to_regclass('truss.'||table_name) AND a.attnum>0 AND NOT a.attisdropped AND a.attgenerated='';
  IF table_name='schema_change' THEN
   -- The planner supplies only this new revision's changes.
   INSERT INTO truss.schema_change SELECT p.* FROM truss.catalog_planned_changes(rows) p;
  ELSIF table_name IN ('type_def','prop_def','rel_def') THEN
   identity_column:=CASE table_name WHEN 'type_def' THEN 'type_id' WHEN 'prop_def' THEN 'prop_id' ELSE 'rel_type_id' END;
   EXECUTE format('INSERT INTO truss.%I AS stored(%s) SELECT %s FROM jsonb_populate_recordset(NULL::truss.%I,$1) ON CONFLICT(%I) DO UPDATE SET %s WHERE stored IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED',table_name,columns,columns,table_name,identity_column,assignments) USING rows;
  ELSE
   conflict_columns:=CASE table_name WHEN 'schema_rev' THEN 'rev' WHEN 'schema_doc' THEN 'rev,ord'
    WHEN 'key_def' THEN 'type_id,key_id' WHEN 'relationship_lineage' THEN 'rel_type_id'
    WHEN 'rel_endpoint' THEN 'rel_type_id,source_type,target_type' END;
   EXECUTE format('INSERT INTO truss.%I(%s) SELECT %s FROM jsonb_populate_recordset(NULL::truss.%I,$1) ON CONFLICT(%s) DO NOTHING',table_name,columns,columns,table_name,conflict_columns) USING rows;
  END IF;
 END LOOP;
 request.registration_id:=gen_random_uuid();request.installation_id:=installation.installation_id;
 request.actor_oid:=actor;request.actor_name:=session_user::text;request.request_key:=request_key;
 request.writer_xid:=pg_current_xact_id();request.accepted_at:=transaction_timestamp();request.revision:=new_revision;
 request.expected_revision:=expected_revision;request.expected_documents:=expected_documents;
 request.type_offset:=type_start;request.property_offset:=property_start;request.relationship_offset:=relationship_start;
 request.input_bytes:=input_bytes;request.document_bytes:=CASE WHEN compact THEN ''::bytea ELSE documents_bytes END;
 request.declaration_bytes:=CASE WHEN compact THEN ''::bytea ELSE declarations_bytes END;
 IF compact THEN
  request.source_bytes:=convert_to(jsonb_build_object('sourceFormat','truss-registration-summary/2.0',
   'umf',(convert_from(source_bytes,'UTF8')::jsonb)->'umf',
   'runtimeRelease',jsonb_build_object('id',installation.release_id,'sha256',installation.release_sha256),
   'validationLocation','schema_doc.validation',
   'documentValidations',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('documentId',v.value->>'documentId',
    'contentSha256',v.value->>'contentSha256','valid',v.value->'validation'->'valid','complete',v.value->'validation'->'complete') ORDER BY v.ordinality)
    FROM jsonb_array_elements((convert_from(source_bytes,'UTF8')::jsonb)->'documentValidations') WITH ORDINALITY v))::text,'UTF8');
 ELSE request.source_bytes:=source_bytes;END IF;
 request.origin_bytes:=origin_bytes;
 PERFORM truss.catalog_rebind_objects(request,expected);
 PERFORM truss.catalog_key_backfill_apply(request,verified_keys);
 PERFORM truss.catalog_rebind_report_reader(request.registration_id,expected);
 original_report:=truss.catalog_make_report(request,expected);request.report_sha256:=sha256(original_report);
 IF octet_length(original_report)>16777216 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'bounded original registration report required' USING ERRCODE='54000';END IF;
 INSERT INTO truss.catalog_acceptance_report VALUES(new_revision,original_report);
 INSERT INTO truss.catalog_registration_request SELECT request.*;
 PERFORM truss.catalog_actor();
 UPDATE truss.schema_head SET rev=new_revision WHERE id=1 AND rev=prior_revision;
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'complete head transition required' USING ERRCODE='55000'; END IF;
 -- Property and key rebinds do not change the graph. Only changed bounded
 -- relationships need a census; a removed max-one bound also needs marker cleanup.
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM truss.rel_def r LEFT JOIN truss.schema_change c
   ON c.rev=new_revision AND c.kind='rel' AND c.def_id=r.rel_type_id
   WHERE (r.since_rev=new_revision OR c.def_id IS NOT NULL)
    AND (r.source_min>0 OR r.target_min>0 OR r.source_max IS NOT NULL OR r.target_max IS NOT NULL
     OR (c.before->>'source_max')::int=1 OR (c.before->>'target_max')::int=1)) THEN
  PERFORM truss.runtime_graph_validate(true);
 END IF;
 PERFORM truss.catalog_rebind_report_reader(request.registration_id);
 RETURN QUERY SELECT request.revision::text,request.registration_id::text,original_report,false,false,request.actor_name,NULL::bytea;
END;
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.catalog_ddd_optional_evolution_supported(documents_bytes bytea)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE candidate jsonb;candidate_source jsonb;original jsonb;old_module jsonb;new_module jsonb;old_record jsonb;new_record jsonb;
 old_ddd jsonb;new_ddd jsonb;old_fields jsonb;new_fields jsonb;appended_member jsonb;added_name text;
 field_module text;field_id text;field_element jsonb;core_scalar text;ddd_scalar text;old_count int;member_index int;
BEGIN
 FOR candidate IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(convert_from(documents_bytes,'UTF8')::jsonb) LOOP
  SELECT document::jsonb INTO original FROM truss.schema_doc
   WHERE doc_id=candidate->>'documentId' ORDER BY rev DESC LIMIT 1;
  IF NOT FOUND OR original IS NULL THEN CONTINUE;END IF;
  candidate_source:=(candidate->>'originalText')::jsonb;
  IF original->'vocabularies'->'umf.ddd' IS DISTINCT FROM candidate_source->'vocabularies'->'umf.ddd'
    OR original->'extensions'->'umf.ddd' IS DISTINCT FROM candidate_source->'extensions'->'umf.ddd' THEN RETURN false;END IF;
  FOR old_module IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(original->'modules','[]'::jsonb)) LOOP
   SELECT value INTO new_module FROM jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(candidate_source->'modules','[]'::jsonb)) WHERE value->>'id'=old_module->>'id';
   IF NOT FOUND THEN
    IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(old_module->'elements','[]'::jsonb)) e
      WHERE e.value->>'kind'='record' AND e.value->'extensions' ? 'umf.ddd') THEN RETURN false;END IF;
    CONTINUE;
   END IF;
   IF old_module->'extensions'->'umf.ddd' IS DISTINCT FROM new_module->'extensions'->'umf.ddd' THEN RETURN false;END IF;
   FOR old_record IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(old_module->'elements','[]'::jsonb))
    WHERE value->>'kind'='record' LOOP
    SELECT value INTO new_record FROM jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(new_module->'elements','[]'::jsonb))
     WHERE value->>'id'=old_record->>'id' AND value->>'kind'='record';
    old_ddd:=old_record->'extensions'->'umf.ddd';
    IF NOT FOUND THEN IF old_ddd IS NOT NULL THEN RETURN false;END IF;CONTINUE;END IF;
    new_ddd:=new_record->'extensions'->'umf.ddd';
    IF old_ddd IS NOT DISTINCT FROM new_ddd THEN
     IF old_ddd IS NOT NULL AND (original->'vocabularies'->'umf.ddd'->>'version' IS DISTINCT FROM candidate_source->'vocabularies'->'umf.ddd'->>'version'
       OR original->'vocabularies'->'umf.ddd'->>'version' IS DISTINCT FROM '0.1.0') THEN RETURN false;END IF;
     IF old_ddd ? 'fields' AND old_record->'members' IS DISTINCT FROM new_record->'members' THEN RETURN false;END IF;
     CONTINUE;
    END IF;
    old_fields:=old_ddd->'fields';new_fields:=new_ddd->'fields';
    IF original->>'umf' IS DISTINCT FROM '0.10.0'
      OR candidate_source->>'umf' IS DISTINCT FROM '0.10.0'
      OR original->'vocabularies'->'umf.ddd'->>'version' IS DISTINCT FROM '0.1.0'
      OR candidate_source->'vocabularies'->'umf.ddd'->>'version' IS DISTINCT FROM '0.1.0'
      OR jsonb_typeof(old_fields) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' OR jsonb_typeof(new_fields) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' THEN
      RETURN false;
    END IF;
    IF (new_record-ARRAY['members','extensions']) IS DISTINCT FROM (old_record-ARRAY['members','extensions'])
      OR ((new_record->'extensions')-'umf.ddd'::text) IS DISTINCT FROM ((old_record->'extensions')-'umf.ddd'::text)
      OR (new_ddd-'fields'::text) IS DISTINCT FROM (old_ddd-'fields'::text)
      OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(new_fields))<>(SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(old_fields))+1
      OR jsonb_array_length(coalesce(new_record->'members','[]'::jsonb))<>jsonb_array_length(coalesce(old_record->'members','[]'::jsonb))+1
      OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_object_keys(old_fields) AS k(key) WHERE new_fields->(k.key) IS DISTINCT FROM old_fields->(k.key)) THEN
      RETURN false;
    END IF;
    old_count:=jsonb_array_length(old_record->'members');
    IF old_count>0 THEN
     FOR member_index IN 0..old_count-1 LOOP
      IF old_record->'members'->member_index IS DISTINCT FROM new_record->'members'->member_index THEN RETURN false;END IF;
     END LOOP;
    END IF;
    appended_member:=new_record->'members'->old_count;
    IF jsonb_typeof(appended_member) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
      OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(appended_member))<>2
      OR jsonb_typeof(appended_member->'module') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
      OR jsonb_typeof(appended_member->'element') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string' THEN RETURN false;END IF;
    added_name:=NULL;
    SELECT k.key INTO added_name FROM jsonb_object_keys(new_fields) AS k(key) WHERE NOT (old_fields ? k.key);
    IF added_name IS NULL OR old_fields ? added_name THEN RETURN false;END IF;
    field_module:=appended_member->>'module';field_id:=appended_member->>'element';
    SELECT element.value INTO field_element
     FROM jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(candidate_source->'modules','[]'::jsonb)) module(value)
     CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(module.value->'elements','[]'::jsonb)) element(value)
     WHERE module.value->>'id'=field_module AND element.value->>'id'=field_id;
    IF NOT FOUND OR field_element->>'kind' IS DISTINCT FROM 'field'
      OR field_element->>'name' IS DISTINCT FROM added_name
      OR field_element->>'nullability' NOT IN ('absent-allowed','required')
      OR field_element->>'cardinality' IS DISTINCT FROM 'one' THEN RETURN false;END IF;
    core_scalar:=field_element->>'scalarType';
    ddd_scalar:=CASE core_scalar WHEN 'string' THEN 'string' WHEN 'boolean' THEN 'boolean'
      WHEN 'integer' THEN 'integer' WHEN 'decimal' THEN 'decimal' WHEN 'timestamp' THEN 'date-time' WHEN 'binary' THEN 'bytes' END;
    IF ddd_scalar IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(new_fields->added_name) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
      OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(new_fields->added_name)) NOT BETWEEN 2 AND 3
      OR ((new_fields->added_name)-ARRAY['type','cardinality','description']) IS DISTINCT FROM '{}'::jsonb
      OR jsonb_typeof(new_fields->added_name->'cardinality') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
      OR new_fields->added_name->>'cardinality' IS DISTINCT FROM (CASE field_element->>'nullability' WHEN 'required' THEN 'one' ELSE 'optional' END)
      OR jsonb_typeof(new_fields->added_name->'type') IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
      OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(new_fields->added_name->'type'))<>2
      OR new_fields->added_name->'type'->>'kind' IS DISTINCT FROM 'scalar'
      OR new_fields->added_name->'type'->>'name' IS DISTINCT FROM ddd_scalar
      OR new_fields->added_name ? 'description' AND jsonb_typeof(new_fields->added_name->'description') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string' THEN
      RETURN false;
    END IF;
   END LOOP;
  END LOOP;
 END LOOP;
 RETURN true;
END;
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.catalog_ddd_optional_record_addition(old_document jsonb, new_document jsonb, selected_module text, old_record jsonb, new_record jsonb)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE old_module jsonb;new_module jsonb;old_ddd jsonb;new_ddd jsonb;old_source_document jsonb;new_source_document jsonb;
 old_fields jsonb;new_fields jsonb;added_name text;member jsonb;field jsonb;
BEGIN
 old_source_document:=(old_document->>'document')::jsonb;new_source_document:=(new_document->>'document')::jsonb;
 IF old_source_document IS NULL OR new_source_document IS NULL
  OR old_source_document->>'umf' IS DISTINCT FROM '0.10.0' OR new_source_document->>'umf' IS DISTINCT FROM '0.10.0'
  OR old_source_document->'vocabularies'->'umf.ddd'->>'version' IS DISTINCT FROM '0.1.0'
  OR new_source_document->'vocabularies'->'umf.ddd'->>'version' IS DISTINCT FROM '0.1.0'
  OR old_document->'validation'->'dddProfile' IS DISTINCT FROM new_document->'validation'->'dddProfile'
  OR old_document->'validation'->'dddProfile'->>'identity' IS DISTINCT FROM 'umf-ddd-document-validation'
  OR old_document->'validation'->'dddValidation'->'valid' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'::jsonb
  OR new_document->'validation'->'dddValidation'->'valid' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'::jsonb THEN RETURN false;END IF;
 SELECT value INTO old_module FROM jsonb_array_elements(old_source_document->'modules') WHERE value->>'id'=selected_module;
 SELECT value INTO new_module FROM jsonb_array_elements(new_source_document->'modules') WHERE value->>'id'=selected_module;
 IF old_module IS NULL OR new_module IS NULL
  OR old_module->'extensions'->'umf.ddd' IS DISTINCT FROM new_module->'extensions'->'umf.ddd' THEN RETURN false;END IF;
 old_ddd:=old_record->'extensions'->'umf.ddd';new_ddd:=new_record->'extensions'->'umf.ddd';
 old_fields:=old_ddd->'fields';new_fields:=new_ddd->'fields';
 IF jsonb_typeof(old_fields) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' OR jsonb_typeof(new_fields) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
  OR (new_record-ARRAY['members','extensions']) IS DISTINCT FROM (old_record-ARRAY['members','extensions'])
  OR ((new_record->'extensions')-'umf.ddd'::text) IS DISTINCT FROM ((old_record->'extensions')-'umf.ddd'::text)
  OR (new_ddd-'fields'::text) IS DISTINCT FROM (old_ddd-'fields'::text)
  OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(new_fields))<>(SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(old_fields))+1
  OR jsonb_array_length(coalesce(new_record->'members','[]'::jsonb))<>jsonb_array_length(coalesce(old_record->'members','[]'::jsonb))+1
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_object_keys(old_fields) AS k(key) WHERE new_fields->(k.key) IS DISTINCT FROM old_fields->(k.key)) THEN
  RETURN false;
 END IF;
 IF jsonb_array_length(coalesce(old_record->'members','[]'::jsonb))>0 AND EXISTS(
   SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(old_record->'members') WITH ORDINALITY old_member(value,ordinality)
   JOIN jsonb_array_elements(new_record->'members') WITH ORDINALITY new_member(value,ordinality) USING(ordinality)
   WHERE old_member.value IS DISTINCT FROM new_member.value) THEN RETURN false;END IF;
 member:=new_record->'members'->jsonb_array_length(coalesce(old_record->'members','[]'::jsonb));
 IF jsonb_typeof(member) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(member))<>2
  OR member->>'module' IS DISTINCT FROM selected_module THEN RETURN false;END IF;
 added_name:=NULL;
 SELECT k.key INTO added_name FROM jsonb_object_keys(new_fields) AS k(key) WHERE NOT (old_fields ? k.key);
 IF added_name IS NULL OR old_fields ? added_name THEN RETURN false;END IF;
 SELECT element.value INTO field FROM jsonb_array_elements(new_module->'elements') element(value)
  WHERE element.value->>'id'=member->>'element';
 IF NOT FOUND OR field->>'kind' IS DISTINCT FROM 'field' OR field->>'name' IS DISTINCT FROM added_name
  OR field->>'nullability' NOT IN ('absent-allowed','required') OR field->>'cardinality' IS DISTINCT FROM 'one' THEN RETURN false;END IF;
 IF jsonb_typeof(new_fields->added_name) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
  OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(new_fields->added_name)) NOT BETWEEN 2 AND 3
  OR ((new_fields->added_name)-ARRAY['type','cardinality','description']) IS DISTINCT FROM '{}'::jsonb
  OR new_fields->added_name->>'cardinality' IS DISTINCT FROM (CASE field->>'nullability' WHEN 'required' THEN 'one' ELSE 'optional' END)
  OR new_fields->added_name->'type'->>'kind' IS DISTINCT FROM 'scalar' THEN RETURN false;END IF;
 RETURN CASE field->>'scalarType' WHEN 'string' THEN new_fields->added_name->'type'->>'name'='string'
  WHEN 'boolean' THEN new_fields->added_name->'type'->>'name'='boolean'
  WHEN 'integer' THEN new_fields->added_name->'type'->>'name'='integer'
  WHEN 'decimal' THEN new_fields->added_name->'type'->>'name'='decimal'
  WHEN 'timestamp' THEN new_fields->added_name->'type'->>'name'='date-time'
  WHEN 'binary' THEN new_fields->added_name->'type'->>'name'='bytes' ELSE false END;
END;
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.catalog_key_backfill_apply(request truss.catalog_registration_request, verified_receipts jsonb)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
 SET bytea_output TO 'hex'
AS $function$
DECLARE selected record;entry jsonb;owner truss.type_def%ROWTYPE;object_row truss.object%ROWTYPE;
 definition truss.key_def%ROWTYPE;installation truss.catalog_runtime_installation%ROWTYPE;pin record;observed record;
 original_image jsonb;keys jsonb;effects jsonb;values_cells jsonb;facets jsonb;property truss.prop_def%ROWTYPE;component int;
 ns bytea;transport bytea;context_bytes bytea;reservation_bytes bytea;member_id bigint;reservation_id bigint;prior_generation bigint;membership truss.object_key_bucket%ROWTYPE;reservation truss.object_key_reservation_bucket%ROWTYPE;actual_row jsonb;
BEGIN
 IF request.actor_oid IS DISTINCT FROM truss.catalog_actor() OR request.actor_name IS DISTINCT FROM session_user::text
  OR request.writer_xid IS DISTINCT FROM pg_current_xact_id() OR request.registration_id IS NULL THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'current original catalog key registration required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT installation FROM truss.runtime_current_installation();
 IF truss.catalog_key_backfill_violations(verified_receipts) IS NOT NULL THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'unique complete backfill tuples required' USING ERRCODE='23505';END IF;
 FOR selected IN SELECT DISTINCT (r.value->>'typeId')::int type_id,(r.value->>'objectId')::bigint object_id
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(verified_receipts) r ORDER BY 1,2 LOOP
  SELECT * INTO STRICT owner FROM truss.type_def WHERE type_id=selected.type_id AND retired_rev IS NULL;
  PERFORM truss.runtime_module_writer(owner.document_id,owner.module);
  IF truss.runtime_object_values_readable(owner.type_id) IS NOT TRUE THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'current key backfill reader required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
  SELECT * INTO STRICT object_row FROM truss.object WHERE id=selected.object_id AND type_id=selected.type_id FOR UPDATE;
  original_image:=to_jsonb(object_row);effects:='[]';
  FOR entry IN SELECT r.value FROM jsonb_array_elements(verified_receipts) r
   WHERE r.value->>'typeId'=selected.type_id::text AND r.value->>'objectId'=selected.object_id::text
   ORDER BY (r.value->>'keyNumber')::smallint LOOP
   IF encode(sha256(convert_to(original_image::text,'UTF8')),'hex') IS DISTINCT FROM entry->>'objectImageSha256'
    AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM truss.runtime_catalog_rebind_transition t WHERE t.registration_id=request.registration_id
     AND t.object_id=selected.object_id AND t.type_id=selected.type_id AND t.after_object=original_image
     AND encode(sha256(convert_to(t.before_object::text,'UTF8')),'hex')=entry->>'objectImageSha256') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'original locked backfill object image required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
   SELECT * INTO STRICT definition FROM truss.key_def WHERE type_id=selected.type_id AND key_num=(entry->>'keyNumber')::smallint
    AND key_id=entry->>'keyId' AND since_rev=request.revision AND retired_rev IS NULL AND NOT is_primary;
   values_cells:='[]';facets:='[]';
   FOREACH component IN ARRAY definition.prop_ids LOOP
    SELECT * INTO STRICT property FROM truss.prop_def WHERE type_id=selected.type_id AND prop_id=component AND retired_rev IS NULL;
    values_cells:=values_cells||jsonb_build_array(object_row.props->component::text);facets:=facets||jsonb_build_array(coalesce(property.facets,'{}'));
   END LOOP;
   IF values_cells IS DISTINCT FROM entry->'values' OR truss.verify_umf_scalar_key_tuple(decode(entry->>'tupleHex','hex'),values_cells,facets) IS NOT TRUE THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'unchanged exact final key values required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
   SELECT * INTO STRICT pin FROM truss.runtime_owned_definition_metadata('key',selected.type_id,definition.key_num);
   ns:=convert_to(jsonb_build_object('profile','truss-string-key-namespace/0.2','installationId',installation.installation_id::text,
    'sourceEpoch',installation.source_epoch::text,'typeId',selected.type_id::text,'keyNumber',definition.key_num::text,
    'definitionPin',pin.definition_pin,'encoding','umf-key-tuple-v1')::text,'UTF8');
   transport:=convert_to('umf-key-tuple-v1:hex:'||(entry->>'tupleHex'),'UTF8');
   SELECT * INTO STRICT observed FROM truss.lock_string_key_bucket(ns,transport);prior_generation:=observed.generation;
   IF cardinality(observed.member_ids)>0 OR cardinality(observed.reservation_ids)>0 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'new key already allocated or reserved' USING ERRCODE='23505';END IF;
   context_bytes:=convert_to(jsonb_build_object('profile','truss-catalog-key-backfill-context/0.2','registrationId',request.registration_id::text,
    'objectId',selected.object_id::text,'xid',request.writer_xid::text,'derivation','postgresql-umf-key-tuple-v1')::text,'UTF8');
   reservation_bytes:=convert_to(jsonb_build_object('profile','truss-catalog-key-backfill-reservation/0.1','registrationId',request.registration_id::text,
    'objectId',selected.object_id::text,'typeId',selected.type_id::text,'keyNumber',definition.key_num::text,'xid',request.writer_xid::text)::text,'UTF8');
   membership.storage_row_id:=nextval('truss.key_storage_row_seq');membership.type_id:=selected.type_id;
   membership.key_num:=definition.key_num;membership.object_id:=selected.object_id;membership.namespace_bytes:=ns;
   membership.key_bytes:=transport;membership.original_context_bytes:=context_bytes;
   membership.namespace_sha256:=sha256(ns);membership.key_sha256:=sha256(transport);member_id:=membership.storage_row_id;
   INSERT INTO truss.object_key_bucket(storage_row_id,type_id,key_num,object_id,namespace_bytes,key_bytes,original_context_bytes)
    VALUES(member_id,selected.type_id,definition.key_num,selected.object_id,ns,transport,context_bytes) RETURNING to_jsonb(object_key_bucket) INTO actual_row;
   IF actual_row IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(membership) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'exact backfill membership insert required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
   reservation.storage_row_id:=nextval('truss.key_storage_row_seq');reservation.namespace_bytes:=ns;reservation.key_bytes:=transport;
   reservation.original_reservation_bytes:=reservation_bytes;reservation.namespace_sha256:=sha256(ns);reservation.key_sha256:=sha256(transport);reservation_id:=reservation.storage_row_id;
   INSERT INTO truss.object_key_reservation_bucket(storage_row_id,namespace_bytes,key_bytes,original_reservation_bytes)
    VALUES(reservation_id,ns,transport,reservation_bytes) RETURNING to_jsonb(object_key_reservation_bucket) INTO actual_row;
   IF actual_row IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(reservation) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'exact backfill reservation insert required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
   UPDATE truss.key_bucket_guard SET generation=generation+1 WHERE namespace_sha256=sha256(ns) AND key_sha256=sha256(transport);
   SELECT * INTO STRICT observed FROM truss.lock_string_key_bucket(ns,transport);
   IF observed.generation IS DISTINCT FROM prior_generation+1 OR observed.member_ids IS DISTINCT FROM ARRAY[member_id]
    OR observed.reservation_ids IS DISTINCT FROM ARRAY[reservation_id] THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'exact applied backfill key bucket required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
   effects:=effects||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('keyId',definition.key_id,'keyNumber',definition.key_num::text,
    'definitionPin',pin.definition_pin,'namespaceBase64',replace(encode(ns,'base64'),chr(10),''),'tupleHex',entry->>'tupleHex',
    'derivation','postgresql-umf-key-tuple-v1','memberId',member_id::text,'reservationId',reservation_id::text,
    'priorGeneration',prior_generation::text,'generation',observed.generation::text,
    'contextBase64',replace(encode(context_bytes,'base64'),chr(10),''),'reservationBase64',replace(encode(reservation_bytes,'base64'),chr(10),'')));
  END LOOP;
  IF (SELECT to_jsonb(o) FROM truss.object o WHERE o.id=selected.object_id AND o.type_id=selected.type_id) IS DISTINCT FROM original_image THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'key-only backfill preserves exact object image' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
  SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(k) ORDER BY k.key_num),'[]') INTO keys FROM truss.object_key_bucket k
   WHERE k.object_id=selected.object_id AND k.type_id=selected.type_id;
  INSERT INTO truss.runtime_catalog_key_backfill(registration_id,writer_xid,actor_oid,revision,object_id,type_id,object_image,after_keys,effects)
   VALUES(request.registration_id,request.writer_xid,request.actor_oid,request.revision,selected.object_id,selected.type_id,original_image,keys,effects);
 END LOOP;
 PERFORM truss.catalog_actor();
END;
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.catalog_key_backfill_candidates(planned_basis jsonb, selected_revision integer)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
 SET bytea_output TO 'hex'
AS $function$
DECLARE definition truss.key_def%ROWTYPE;owner truss.type_def%ROWTYPE;property truss.prop_def%ROWTYPE;
 object_row truss.object%ROWTYPE;component int;values_cells jsonb;archive truss.schema_doc%ROWTYPE;result jsonb:='[]';candidate_count int:=0;head int;selected_cell jsonb;
BEGIN
 PERFORM truss.catalog_actor();
 SELECT rev INTO STRICT head FROM truss.schema_head WHERE id=1 FOR UPDATE NOWAIT;
 IF selected_revision IS DISTINCT FROM head+1 OR planned_basis IS NULL THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'original locked next catalog basis required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
 FOR definition IN SELECT k.* FROM jsonb_populate_recordset(NULL::truss.key_def,planned_basis->'key_def') k
  WHERE k.since_rev=selected_revision AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM truss.type_def t WHERE t.type_id=k.type_id)
  AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM truss.key_def old WHERE old.type_id=k.type_id AND old.key_id=k.key_id)
  ORDER BY k.type_id,k.key_num LOOP
  IF definition.is_primary OR cardinality(definition.prop_ids) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 127 THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'new bounded alternate key required' USING ERRCODE='0A000';END IF;
  SELECT * INTO STRICT owner FROM truss.type_def WHERE type_id=definition.type_id AND retired_rev IS NULL;
  PERFORM truss.runtime_module_writer(owner.document_id,owner.module);
  IF truss.runtime_object_values_readable(owner.type_id) IS NOT TRUE THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'current key backfill reader required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
  FOREACH component IN ARRAY definition.prop_ids LOOP
   SELECT * INTO STRICT property FROM jsonb_populate_recordset(NULL::truss.prop_def,planned_basis->'prop_def') p WHERE p.prop_id=component AND p.type_id=owner.type_id AND p.retired_rev IS NULL;
   IF property.nullability IS DISTINCT FROM 'required' OR property.cardinality IS DISTINCT FROM 'one'
    OR property.scalar_type NOT IN ('string','integer','decimal','boolean','binary') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'required scalar key components required' USING ERRCODE='0A000';END IF;
   IF truss.runtime_can_read(owner.document_id,property.declaration_module) IS NOT TRUE THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'current planned key component reader required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
  END LOOP;
  SELECT * INTO STRICT archive FROM jsonb_populate_recordset(NULL::truss.schema_doc,planned_basis->'schema_doc') d
   WHERE d.rev=definition.definition_rev AND d.ord=definition.definition_doc_ord AND d.doc_id=definition.definition_document_id;
  IF archive.content_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM encode(sha256(convert_to(archive.document,'UTF8')),'hex') THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'original planned document bytes required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
  FOR object_row IN SELECT o.* FROM truss.object o WHERE o.type_id=owner.type_id ORDER BY o.id FOR UPDATE LOOP
   candidate_count:=candidate_count+1;values_cells:='[]';
   PERFORM truss.runtime_history_ownership(jsonb_build_object(
    'identity',jsonb_build_object('id',object_row.id::text,'typeId',object_row.type_id::text),
    'catalogRevision',object_row.rev,'ownership',truss.runtime_object_ownership_at(to_jsonb(object_row))));
   IF candidate_count>10000 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'bounded key backfill inventory required' USING ERRCODE='54000';END IF;
   FOREACH component IN ARRAY definition.prop_ids LOOP
    SELECT * INTO STRICT property FROM jsonb_populate_recordset(NULL::truss.prop_def,planned_basis->'prop_def') p WHERE p.prop_id=component AND p.type_id=owner.type_id;
    IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM truss.prop_def p WHERE p.prop_id=component AND p.type_id=owner.type_id) THEN
     selected_cell:=object_row.props->component::text;
    ELSE
     IF property.since_rev IS DISTINCT FROM selected_revision OR object_row.props ? component::text THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'genuinely new absent key destination required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
     selected_cell:=object_row.retained->property.name;
    END IF;
    IF truss.valid_scalar_property(selected_cell,property.scalar_type,false,property.facets) IS NOT TRUE THEN
     RAISE EXCEPTION 'valid complete key candidate values required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
    values_cells:=values_cells||jsonb_build_array(selected_cell);
   END LOOP;
   result:=result||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('documentId',owner.document_id,'moduleId',owner.module,
    'recordId',owner.element,'keyId',definition.key_id,'keyNumber',definition.key_num::text,'typeId',owner.type_id::text,
    'objectId',object_row.id::text,'objectVersion',object_row.ver::text,'sourceRevision',archive.rev::text,'sourceOrdinal',archive.ord::text,
    'sourceDocumentId',archive.doc_id,'sourceSha256',archive.content_sha256,
    'objectImageSha256',encode(sha256(convert_to(to_jsonb(object_row)::text,'UTF8')),'hex'),'values',values_cells));
   IF octet_length(convert_to(result::text,'UTF8'))>8388608 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'bounded original key candidate bytes required' USING ERRCODE='54000';END IF;
  END LOOP;
 END LOOP;
 PERFORM truss.catalog_actor();
 FOR owner IN SELECT t.* FROM truss.type_def t WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(result) c WHERE c.value->>'typeId'=t.type_id::text) ORDER BY t.type_id LOOP
  PERFORM truss.runtime_module_writer(owner.document_id,owner.module);
  IF truss.runtime_object_values_readable(owner.type_id) IS NOT TRUE THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'current key backfill disclosure reader required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
  FOR object_row IN SELECT o.* FROM truss.object o WHERE o.type_id=owner.type_id AND o.root_id IS NOT NULL LOOP
   PERFORM truss.runtime_history_ownership(jsonb_build_object(
    'identity',jsonb_build_object('id',object_row.id::text,'typeId',object_row.type_id::text),
    'catalogRevision',object_row.rev,'ownership',truss.runtime_object_ownership_at(to_jsonb(object_row))));
  END LOOP;
 END LOOP;
 FOR property IN SELECT p.* FROM jsonb_populate_recordset(NULL::truss.prop_def,planned_basis->'prop_def') p
  WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_populate_recordset(NULL::truss.key_def,planned_basis->'key_def') k
   WHERE k.since_rev=selected_revision AND k.type_id=p.type_id AND p.prop_id=ANY(k.prop_ids)
    AND NOT k.is_primary
    AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM truss.type_def t WHERE t.type_id=k.type_id)
    AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM truss.key_def old WHERE old.type_id=k.type_id AND old.key_id=k.key_id)) LOOP
  SELECT * INTO STRICT owner FROM truss.type_def WHERE type_id=property.type_id;
  IF truss.runtime_can_read(owner.document_id,property.declaration_module) IS NOT TRUE THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'current planned key component disclosure reader required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
 END LOOP;
 RETURN result;
END;
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.catalog_key_backfill_transition_reader(transition truss.runtime_catalog_key_backfill, planned_basis jsonb DEFAULT NULL::jsonb)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE basis jsonb;owner truss.type_def%ROWTYPE;definition truss.key_def%ROWTYPE;property truss.prop_def%ROWTYPE;
 effect jsonb;component int;pin record;
BEGIN
 basis:=coalesce(planned_basis,truss.catalog_all_expected_records(transition.revision));
 SELECT * INTO STRICT owner FROM jsonb_populate_recordset(NULL::truss.type_def,basis->'type_def') t WHERE t.type_id=transition.type_id;
 IF truss.runtime_can_read(owner.document_id,owner.module) IS NOT TRUE THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'current original backfill owner reader required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
 PERFORM truss.runtime_history_ownership(jsonb_build_object(
  'identity',jsonb_build_object('id',transition.object_image->>'id','typeId',transition.object_image->>'type_id'),
  'catalogRevision',transition.object_image->'rev',
  'ownership',truss.runtime_object_ownership_at(transition.object_image)));
 FOR effect IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(transition.effects) LOOP
  SELECT * INTO STRICT definition FROM jsonb_populate_recordset(NULL::truss.key_def,basis->'key_def') k
   WHERE k.type_id=transition.type_id AND k.key_num=(effect->>'keyNumber')::smallint AND k.key_id=effect->>'keyId';
  SELECT * INTO STRICT pin FROM truss.catalog_rebind_definition('key',transition.type_id,definition.key_num,basis);
  IF pin.definition_pin IS DISTINCT FROM effect->>'definitionPin' THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'original backfill key definition required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
  FOREACH component IN ARRAY definition.prop_ids LOOP
   SELECT * INTO STRICT property FROM jsonb_populate_recordset(NULL::truss.prop_def,basis->'prop_def') p WHERE p.prop_id=component AND p.type_id=transition.type_id;
   IF truss.runtime_can_read(owner.document_id,property.declaration_module) IS NOT TRUE THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'current original key component reader required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
  END LOOP;
 END LOOP;
END;
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.catalog_rebind_objects(request truss.catalog_registration_request, planned_basis jsonb)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
 SET bytea_output TO 'hex'
AS $function$
DECLARE object_row truss.object%ROWTYPE;original jsonb;after_image jsonb;identity jsonb;before_record jsonb;after_record jsonb;
 owner truss.type_def%ROWTYPE;property truss.prop_def%ROWTYPE;pin record;installation truss.catalog_runtime_installation%ROWTYPE;
 observed_after jsonb;effects jsonb;effects_buffer jsonb[];events jsonb;event jsonb;event_buffer jsonb[];decorated_events jsonb[];journals jsonb;journal_buffer jsonb[];journal truss.journal%ROWTYPE;keys jsonb;group_digest text;property_count int;object_count int:=0;selected_profile text;
BEGIN
 IF request.actor_oid IS DISTINCT FROM truss.catalog_actor() OR request.actor_name IS DISTINCT FROM session_user::text
  OR request.writer_xid IS DISTINCT FROM pg_current_xact_id() OR request.registration_id IS NULL THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'current original catalog registration required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT installation FROM truss.runtime_current_installation();
 selected_profile:=CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM truss.prop_def p WHERE p.since_rev=request.revision AND p.cardinality IN ('array','map') AND p.item ? 'descendants')
  THEN 'truss-native-catalog-rebind/0.4' WHEN EXISTS(
  SELECT 1 FROM truss.key_def k CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(k.prop_ids) member(prop_id)
  JOIN truss.prop_def p ON p.type_id=k.type_id AND p.prop_id=member.prop_id
  WHERE k.since_rev=request.revision AND NOT k.is_primary AND p.since_rev=request.revision)
  THEN 'truss-native-catalog-rebind/0.3' ELSE 'truss-native-catalog-rebind/0.2' END;
 FOR object_row IN SELECT o.* FROM truss.object o WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM truss.prop_def p
  WHERE p.type_id=o.type_id AND p.since_rev=request.revision AND o.retained ? p.name) ORDER BY o.type_id,o.id FOR UPDATE LOOP
  object_count:=object_count+1;
  IF object_count>10000 OR object_row.ver=9223372036854775807 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'bounded catalog rebinding required' USING ERRCODE='54000';END IF;
  SELECT * INTO STRICT owner FROM truss.type_def WHERE type_id=object_row.type_id;
  PERFORM truss.runtime_module_writer(owner.document_id,owner.module);
  IF truss.runtime_object_values_readable(object_row.type_id) IS NOT TRUE THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'current rebind interpretation reader required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
  PERFORM truss.runtime_history_ownership(jsonb_build_object(
   'identity',jsonb_build_object('id',object_row.id::text,'typeId',object_row.type_id::text),
   'catalogRevision',object_row.rev,'ownership',truss.runtime_object_ownership_at(to_jsonb(object_row))));
  original:=to_jsonb(object_row);effects_buffer:=ARRAY[]::jsonb[];event_buffer:=ARRAY[]::jsonb[];decorated_events:=ARRAY[]::jsonb[];journal_buffer:=ARRAY[]::jsonb[];property_count:=0;
  SELECT definition_pin INTO STRICT pin FROM truss.catalog_rebind_definition('type',object_row.type_id,NULL,planned_basis);
  identity:=jsonb_build_object('id',object_row.id::text,'typeId',object_row.type_id::text,
   'definitionPin',pin.definition_pin,'owner',jsonb_build_object('documentId',owner.document_id,'moduleId',owner.module));
  before_record:=truss.runtime_object_history(original,identity);
  FOR property IN SELECT * FROM truss.prop_def p WHERE p.type_id=object_row.type_id AND p.since_rev=request.revision
   AND object_row.retained ? p.name ORDER BY p.prop_id LOOP
   property_count:=property_count+1;
   IF property_count>127 OR property.nullability NOT IN ('required','absent-allowed') OR object_row.props ? property.prop_id::text
    OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM truss.key_def k WHERE k.type_id=property.type_id AND property.prop_id=ANY(k.prop_ids)
     AND (k.since_rev IS DISTINCT FROM request.revision OR k.is_primary IS DISTINCT FROM false
      OR property.nullability IS DISTINCT FROM 'required' OR property.cardinality IS DISTINCT FROM 'one'
      OR property.scalar_type NOT IN ('string','integer','decimal','boolean','binary')))
    OR truss.valid_property_definition(property) IS NOT TRUE OR truss.valid_property_value(object_row.retained->property.name,property) IS NOT TRUE THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'valid absent catalog rebind destination required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
   SELECT definition_pin INTO STRICT pin FROM truss.catalog_rebind_definition('property',property.type_id,property.prop_id,planned_basis);
   effects_buffer:=array_append(effects_buffer,jsonb_build_object('propertyId',property.prop_id::text,'originalName',property.name,
    'definitionPin',pin.definition_pin,'value',object_row.retained->property.name));
   event_buffer:=array_append(event_buffer,jsonb_build_object('operation','rebind','propertyId',property.prop_id::text,
    'retainedName',property.name,'beforeDefinitionContext',before_record->'identity'->>'definitionPin','afterDefinitionPin',pin.definition_pin,
    'retainedBefore',jsonb_build_object('present',true,'value',object_row.retained->property.name),
    'retainedAfter',jsonb_build_object('present',false),'propertyBefore',jsonb_build_object('present',false),
    'propertyAfter',jsonb_build_object('present',true,'value',object_row.retained->property.name)));
   object_row.props:=object_row.props||jsonb_build_object(property.prop_id::text,object_row.retained->property.name);
   object_row.retained:=object_row.retained-property.name;
  END LOOP;
  IF octet_length(convert_to(jsonb_build_object('props',object_row.props,'retained',object_row.retained)::text,'UTF8'))>1048576 THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'bounded rebound object values required' USING ERRCODE='54000';END IF;
  object_row.retained:=nullif(object_row.retained,'{}'::jsonb);object_row.ver:=object_row.ver+1;
  object_row.rev:=request.revision;object_row.updated_at:=clock_timestamp();after_image:=to_jsonb(object_row);
  after_record:=truss.catalog_rebind_history(after_image,identity,planned_basis);
  event_buffer:=array_append(event_buffer,jsonb_build_object('operation','metadata','before',before_record,'after',after_record));
  FOR event_index IN 1..cardinality(event_buffer) LOOP
   event:=event_buffer[event_index]||jsonb_build_object('interfaceVersion','truss-history-event/0.2.0-proposal',
    'historyProfile',selected_profile,'sourceEpoch',installation.source_epoch::text,
    'xid',request.writer_xid::text,'seq',nextval('truss.journal_seq')::text,
    'identity',identity,'eventVersion',object_row.ver::text,'eventCatalogRevision',request.revision::text,
    'origin',jsonb_build_object('asserted',convert_from(request.origin_bytes,'UTF8')::jsonb,'databaseRole',session_user::text));
   decorated_events:=array_append(decorated_events,event);
  END LOOP;
  events:=to_jsonb(decorated_events);effects:=to_jsonb(effects_buffer);
  group_digest:=encode(sha256(convert_to(events::text,'UTF8')),'hex');
  FOR event IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(events) LOOP
   event:=event||jsonb_build_object('mutationGroup',jsonb_build_object('profile','truss-history-group/0.1.0',
    'eventCount',jsonb_array_length(events)::text,'orderedEventDigest',group_digest));
   journal.seq:=(event->>'seq')::bigint;journal.at:=clock_timestamp();journal.xid:=request.writer_xid;
   journal.entity_kind:='o';journal.entity_id:=object_row.id;journal.entity_type:=object_row.type_id;journal.ver:=object_row.ver;
   journal.op:=event->>'operation';journal.prop_id:=(event->>'propertyId')::int;journal.old_value:=NULL;
   journal.new_value:=truss.runtime_exact_wrapper('event',convert_to(event::text,'UTF8'));journal.rev:=request.revision;
   journal.origin:=truss.runtime_exact_wrapper('origin',convert_to((event->'origin')::text,'UTF8'));
   INSERT INTO truss.journal SELECT (jsonb_populate_record(NULL::truss.journal,to_jsonb(journal))).*;
   journal_buffer:=array_append(journal_buffer,to_jsonb(journal));
  END LOOP;
  journals:=to_jsonb(journal_buffer);
  SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(k) ORDER BY k.key_num),'[]'::jsonb) INTO keys FROM truss.object_key_bucket k
   WHERE k.object_id=object_row.id AND k.type_id=object_row.type_id;
  UPDATE truss.object o SET props=object_row.props,retained=object_row.retained,ver=object_row.ver,rev=object_row.rev,updated_at=object_row.updated_at
   WHERE id=object_row.id AND type_id=object_row.type_id RETURNING to_jsonb(o) INTO observed_after;
  IF NOT FOUND OR observed_after IS DISTINCT FROM after_image THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'exact applied catalog rebind image required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
  INSERT INTO truss.runtime_catalog_rebind_transition(registration_id,writer_xid,actor_oid,revision,object_id,type_id,before_object,after_object,after_keys,journal,effects)
   VALUES(request.registration_id,request.writer_xid,request.actor_oid,request.revision,object_row.id,object_row.type_id,original,after_image,keys,journals,effects);
 END LOOP;
END;
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.catalog_rebind_transition_reader(transition truss.runtime_catalog_rebind_transition, planned_basis jsonb DEFAULT NULL::jsonb)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE owner truss.type_def%ROWTYPE;property truss.prop_def%ROWTYPE;basis jsonb;property_id text;image jsonb;
BEGIN
  basis:=coalesce(planned_basis,truss.catalog_all_expected_records(transition.revision));
  SELECT * INTO STRICT owner FROM jsonb_populate_recordset(NULL::truss.type_def,basis->'type_def') t WHERE t.type_id=transition.type_id;
  IF truss.runtime_can_read(owner.document_id,owner.module) IS NOT TRUE THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'current original rebind owner reader required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
  FOR image IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(jsonb_build_array(transition.before_object,transition.after_object)) LOOP
   PERFORM truss.runtime_history_ownership(jsonb_build_object(
    'identity',jsonb_build_object('id',image->>'id','typeId',image->>'type_id'),
    'catalogRevision',image->'rev','ownership',truss.runtime_object_ownership_at(image)));
  END LOOP;
  FOR property_id IN SELECT jsonb_object_keys(transition.before_object->'props') LOOP
   PERFORM truss.runtime_history_property(transition.type_id,property_id::int,(transition.before_object->>'rev')::int,
    (SELECT definition_pin FROM truss.runtime_owned_definition_metadata('property',transition.type_id,property_id::int,(transition.before_object->>'rev')::int)));
  END LOOP;
  FOR property_id IN SELECT jsonb_object_keys(transition.after_object->'props') LOOP
   SELECT * INTO STRICT property FROM jsonb_populate_recordset(NULL::truss.prop_def,basis->'prop_def') p WHERE p.type_id=transition.type_id AND p.prop_id=property_id::int;
   IF truss.runtime_can_read(owner.document_id,property.declaration_module) IS NOT TRUE
    OR property.cardinality IN ('array','map') AND truss.runtime_item_chain_readable(property.item) IS NOT TRUE THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'current original rebind property/item reader required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
  END LOOP;
END;
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.catalog_revision(expected_release text, expected_digest text, selected_document text)
 RETURNS bytea
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
 SET row_security TO 'off'
AS $function$
DECLARE installation truss.catalog_runtime_installation%ROWTYPE;revision int;archive truss.schema_doc%ROWTYPE;module jsonb;
BEGIN
 PERFORM truss.runtime_person(false);
 SELECT * INTO STRICT installation FROM truss.runtime_current_installation();
 IF installation.release_id IS DISTINCT FROM expected_release OR installation.release_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM expected_digest THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'selected runtime required' USING ERRCODE='0A000';END IF;
 -- No share lock: this is a cache key, not admission of a write.
 SELECT rev INTO STRICT revision FROM truss.schema_head WHERE id=1;
 IF revision<1 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'accepted catalog required' USING ERRCODE='0A000';END IF;
 IF selected_document IS NULL THEN RETURN convert_to(jsonb_build_object('catalogRevision',revision::text)::text,'UTF8');END IF;
 IF octet_length(selected_document) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 4096 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'bounded document selection required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 SELECT * INTO archive FROM truss.schema_doc WHERE rev<=revision AND doc_id=selected_document ORDER BY rev DESC LIMIT 1;
 IF NOT FOUND OR jsonb_array_length(archive.document::jsonb->'modules')=0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'authorized document required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
 FOR module IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(archive.document::jsonb->'modules') LOOP
  IF NOT truss.runtime_can_read(selected_document,module->>'id') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'authorized document required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
 END LOOP;
 RETURN convert_to(jsonb_build_object('catalogRevision',revision::text,'documentId',selected_document,'documentRevision',archive.doc_revision,'sourceCatalogRevision',archive.rev::text)::text,'UTF8');
END;
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.catalog_scalar_violations(declarations_bytes bytea)
 RETURNS bytea
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE rec jsonb;field jsonb;node jsonb;selected_type int;property_id int;missing_count bigint;family_count bigint;retained_count bigint;facet_count bigint;
 rel jsonb;old_relation jsonb;tightening boolean;selected_relation truss.rel_def%ROWTYPE;side text;minimum int;maximum int;low_count bigint;high_count bigint;
 violations jsonb[]:=ARRAY[]::jsonb[];scope jsonb;scopes jsonb[]:=ARRAY[]::jsonb[];owner record;original_item jsonb;property_meta record;result bytea;
 field_checks jsonb[];field_ordinal int;candidate_name text;check_required boolean;check_family boolean;check_facets boolean;check_name boolean;counts record;
 stored_values_bytes bigint:=0;remaining_stored_values_bytes bigint;
BEGIN
 -- The caller holds the exclusive head lock, excluding supported graph writers.
 FOR rec IN SELECT r.value FROM jsonb_array_elements(convert_from(declarations_bytes,'UTF8')::jsonb) d
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(d.value->'records') r LOOP
  SELECT type_id INTO selected_type FROM truss.type_def t WHERE t.document_id=rec->>'documentId'
   AND t.module=rec->>'moduleId' AND t.element=rec->>'elementId' AND t.retired_rev IS NULL;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN CONTINUE;END IF;
  IF NOT truss.runtime_can_read(rec->>'documentId',rec->>'moduleId') THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'current module read authority required for compatibility counts' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
  scopes:=array_append(scopes,jsonb_build_object('documentId',rec->>'documentId','moduleId',rec->>'moduleId'));
  field_checks:=ARRAY[]::jsonb[];field_ordinal:=0;
  FOR field IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(rec->'fields') LOOP
   field_ordinal:=field_ordinal+1;
   IF NOT truss.runtime_can_read(rec->>'documentId',field->>'fieldModule') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'current field module read authority required for compatibility counts' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
   scopes:=array_append(scopes,jsonb_build_object('documentId',rec->>'documentId','moduleId',field->>'fieldModule'));
   IF field->'declaration'->>'cardinality' IN ('array','map') THEN
    IF truss.runtime_can_read(rec->>'documentId',field->'declaration'->'itemType'->>'module') IS NOT TRUE THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'current item module read authority required for compatibility counts' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
    scopes:=array_append(scopes,jsonb_build_object('documentId',rec->>'documentId','moduleId',field->'declaration'->'itemType'->>'module'));
   END IF;
   property_id:=NULL;original_item:=NULL;
   SELECT p.prop_id,p.item,p.name,p.nullability,p.cardinality,p.scalar_type,p.facets
    INTO property_meta FROM truss.prop_def p WHERE p.type_id=selected_type
    AND p.declaration_module=field->>'fieldModule' AND p.element=field->>'fieldId' AND p.retired_rev IS NULL;
   IF FOUND THEN property_id:=property_meta.prop_id;IF property_meta.cardinality IN ('array','map') THEN original_item:=property_meta.item;END IF;END IF;
   IF original_item IS NOT NULL THEN
    IF truss.runtime_item_chain_readable(original_item) IS NOT TRUE THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'complete current item readers required for compatibility counts' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
    FOR node IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(jsonb_build_array(original_item)||coalesce(original_item->'descendants','[]'::jsonb)) LOOP
     scopes:=array_append(scopes,jsonb_build_object('documentId',node->>'documentId','moduleId',node->'reference'->>'module'));
    END LOOP;
   END IF;
   candidate_name:=coalesce(field->'declaration'->>'name',field->'declaration'->>'id');
   -- Existing-property tightening counts canonical cells here. New-property
   -- requiredness is checked once by catalog_rebind_violations against the
   -- admitted retained-value destination under the same exclusive head gate.
   check_required:=property_id IS NOT NULL AND field->'declaration'->>'nullability'='required' AND property_meta.nullability IS DISTINCT FROM 'required';
   check_family:=property_id IS NOT NULL AND field->'declaration'->>'cardinality'='one'
    AND (property_meta.cardinality IS DISTINCT FROM 'one' OR property_meta.scalar_type IS DISTINCT FROM field->'declaration'->>'scalarType');
   check_facets:=property_id IS NOT NULL AND field->'declaration'->>'cardinality'='one'
    AND property_meta.facets IS DISTINCT FROM field->'declaration'->'facets';
   check_name:=property_id IS NOT NULL AND property_meta.name IS DISTINCT FROM candidate_name;
   -- Unchanged native constraints and names cannot invalidate existing rows;
   -- only changed fields enter the one per-type data census below.
   IF check_required OR check_family OR check_facets OR check_name THEN
    field_checks:=array_append(field_checks,jsonb_build_object('ordinal',field_ordinal,'propertyId',property_id,
     'name',candidate_name,'scalarType',field->'declaration'->>'scalarType','facets',field->'declaration'->'facets',
     'fieldModule',field->>'fieldModule','fieldId',field->>'fieldId','checkRequired',check_required,
     'checkFamily',check_family,'checkFacets',check_facets,'checkName',check_name));
   END IF;
  END LOOP;
  IF cardinality(field_checks)>0 THEN
   remaining_stored_values_bytes:=16777216-stored_values_bytes;
   FOR counts IN
    WITH checks AS MATERIALIZED (
     SELECT (c.value->>'ordinal')::int AS ordinal,(c.value->>'propertyId')::int AS property_id,
      c.value->>'name' AS property_name,c.value->>'scalarType' AS scalar_type,
      NULLIF(c.value->'facets','null'::jsonb) AS facets,
      (c.value->>'checkRequired')::boolean AS check_required,(c.value->>'checkFamily')::boolean AS check_family,
      (c.value->>'checkFacets')::boolean AS check_facets,(c.value->>'checkName')::boolean AS check_name,
      c.value->>'fieldModule' AS field_module,c.value->>'fieldId' AS field_id
     FROM jsonb_array_elements(to_jsonb(field_checks)) c(value)),
    objects AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT o.id,o.props,o.retained FROM truss.object o WHERE o.type_id=selected_type),
    cells AS MATERIALIZED (
     SELECT f.ordinal,o.id,c.value AS cell,f.scalar_type,f.facets,f.check_family,f.check_facets
     FROM objects o CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(o.props) c
      JOIN checks f ON c.key=f.property_id::text AND (f.check_required OR f.check_family OR f.check_facets)),
    cell_validity AS MATERIALIZED (
     SELECT c.*,
      CASE WHEN c.cell IS NOT NULL AND c.cell<>'{"kind":"null"}'::jsonb AND (c.check_family OR c.check_facets)
       THEN truss.valid_scalar_cell(c.cell,c.scalar_type,true) IS TRUE ELSE false END AS valid_cell
     FROM cells c),
    cell_flags AS MATERIALIZED (
     SELECT c.*,
      c.cell IS NOT NULL AND c.cell<>'{"kind":"null"}'::jsonb AND c.check_family AND c.valid_cell IS NOT TRUE AS invalid_family,
      c.cell IS NOT NULL AND c.cell<>'{"kind":"null"}'::jsonb AND c.check_facets AND c.valid_cell
       AND truss.checked_scalar_facets(c.scalar_type,c.facets) IS TRUE
       AND truss.valid_scalar_property(c.cell,c.scalar_type,true,c.facets) IS NOT TRUE AS invalid_facets,
      c.cell IS NOT NULL AND c.cell<>'{"kind":"null"}'::jsonb AS present_nonnull
     FROM cell_validity c),
    retained_names AS MATERIALIZED (
     SELECT o.id,n.value AS property_name FROM objects o
      CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_object_keys(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(o.retained)='object' THEN o.retained ELSE '{}'::jsonb END) n(value)),
    object_count AS (SELECT count(*) AS total FROM objects),
    property_stats AS (
     SELECT f.ordinal,
      count(*) FILTER(WHERE c.invalid_family) AS invalid_family,
      count(*) FILTER(WHERE c.invalid_facets) AS invalid_facets,
      coalesce(sum(octet_length(jsonb_build_object('objectId',c.id::text,'text',c.cell->>'text')::text)::bigint)
       FILTER(WHERE c.invalid_facets AND f.scalar_type IN ('string','binary')),0)::bigint AS stored_entry_bytes,
      count(*) FILTER(WHERE c.invalid_facets AND f.scalar_type IN ('string','binary'))::bigint AS stored_entry_count,
      count(*) FILTER(WHERE c.present_nonnull) AS present_nonnull
     FROM checks f LEFT JOIN cell_flags c ON c.ordinal=f.ordinal GROUP BY f.ordinal),
    budgeted_stats AS MATERIALIZED (
     SELECT s.*,
      CASE WHEN s.stored_entry_count=0 THEN 0 ELSE s.stored_entry_bytes+2*s.stored_entry_count END::bigint AS stored_value_bytes,
      sum(CASE WHEN s.stored_entry_count=0 THEN 0 ELSE s.stored_entry_bytes+2*s.stored_entry_count END)
       OVER(ORDER BY s.ordinal ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_stored_value_bytes
     FROM property_stats s),
    stored_arrays AS (
     SELECT b.ordinal,coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('objectId',c.id::text,'text',c.cell->>'text') ORDER BY c.id)
       FILTER(WHERE c.invalid_facets AND c.scalar_type IN ('string','binary')
        AND b.cumulative_stored_value_bytes<=remaining_stored_values_bytes),'[]'::jsonb) AS stored_values
     FROM budgeted_stats b LEFT JOIN cell_flags c ON c.ordinal=b.ordinal
     GROUP BY b.ordinal,b.cumulative_stored_value_bytes),
    retained_counts AS (
     SELECT f.ordinal,count(*) AS collisions FROM checks f JOIN retained_names n ON n.property_name=f.property_name
      WHERE f.check_name GROUP BY f.ordinal)
   SELECT f.ordinal,f.field_module,f.field_id,
    CASE WHEN f.check_required THEN greatest(o.total-coalesce(p.present_nonnull,0),0) ELSE 0 END AS missing,
    coalesce(p.invalid_family,0) AS family,coalesce(p.invalid_facets,0) AS facets,
    coalesce(p.stored_value_bytes,0) AS stored_value_bytes,coalesce(a.stored_values,'[]'::jsonb) AS stored_values,
    coalesce(r.collisions,0) AS retained
   FROM checks f CROSS JOIN object_count o LEFT JOIN budgeted_stats p ON p.ordinal=f.ordinal
    LEFT JOIN stored_arrays a ON a.ordinal=f.ordinal
    LEFT JOIN retained_counts r ON r.ordinal=f.ordinal ORDER BY f.ordinal
   LOOP
    IF counts.stored_value_bytes>remaining_stored_values_bytes THEN
     RAISE EXCEPTION 'complete compatibility violation result exceeds byte limit' USING ERRCODE='54000';END IF;
    stored_values_bytes:=stored_values_bytes+counts.stored_value_bytes;
    remaining_stored_values_bytes:=remaining_stored_values_bytes-counts.stored_value_bytes;
    scope:=jsonb_build_object('documentId',rec->>'documentId','moduleId',rec->>'moduleId',
     'recordId',rec->>'elementId','fieldModuleId',counts.field_module,'fieldId',counts.field_id);
    IF counts.missing>0 THEN violations:=array_append(violations,scope||jsonb_build_object('rule','property.required','affectedObjectCount',counts.missing::text));END IF;
