    IF counts.family>0 THEN violations:=array_append(violations,scope||jsonb_build_object('rule','property.scalar_type','affectedObjectCount',counts.family::text));END IF;
    IF counts.facets>0 THEN violations:=array_append(violations,scope||jsonb_build_object('rule','property.facets','affectedObjectCount',counts.facets::text)
     ||CASE WHEN counts.stored_values='[]'::jsonb THEN '{}'::jsonb ELSE jsonb_build_object('storedValues',counts.stored_values) END);END IF;
    IF counts.retained>0 THEN violations:=array_append(violations,scope||jsonb_build_object('rule','property.retained_name_collision','affectedObjectCount',counts.retained::text));END IF;
   END LOOP;
  END IF;
 END LOOP;
 -- Existing independent relationship bounds are checked before publication.
 FOR rel IN SELECT r.value FROM jsonb_array_elements(convert_from(declarations_bytes,'UTF8')::jsonb) d
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(d.value->'relationships') r LOOP
  SELECT * INTO selected_relation FROM truss.rel_def WHERE document_id=rel->>'documentId' AND module=rel->>'moduleId'
   AND rel_id=rel->'declaration'->>'id' AND retired_rev IS NULL;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN CONTINUE;END IF;
  tightening:=(rel->'declaration'->'sourceMultiplicity'->>'min')::int>selected_relation.source_min
   OR (rel->'declaration'->'targetMultiplicity'->>'min')::int>selected_relation.target_min
   OR rel->'declaration'->'sourceMultiplicity'->>'max'<>'*' AND (selected_relation.source_max IS NULL OR (rel->'declaration'->'sourceMultiplicity'->>'max')::int<selected_relation.source_max)
   OR rel->'declaration'->'targetMultiplicity'->>'max'<>'*' AND (selected_relation.target_max IS NULL OR (rel->'declaration'->'targetMultiplicity'->>'max')::int<selected_relation.target_max);
  IF tightening THEN
   SELECT r.value INTO STRICT old_relation FROM truss.schema_doc d CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(d.document::jsonb->'modules') m
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(m.value->'relationships') r WHERE d.rev=selected_relation.definition_rev AND d.ord=selected_relation.definition_doc_ord
    AND d.doc_id=selected_relation.definition_document_id AND m.value->>'id'=selected_relation.module AND r.value->>'id'=selected_relation.rel_id;
   IF old_relation->'source' IS DISTINCT FROM rel->'declaration'->'source' OR old_relation->'target' IS DISTINCT FROM rel->'declaration'->'target' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'tightening requires unchanged endpoint declarations' USING ERRCODE='0A000';END IF;
  END IF;
  IF truss.runtime_can_read(selected_relation.document_id,selected_relation.module) IS NOT TRUE THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'relationship reader required for compatibility counts' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
  scopes:=array_append(scopes,jsonb_build_object('documentId',selected_relation.document_id,'moduleId',selected_relation.module));
  FOR owner IN SELECT DISTINCT t.document_id,t.module FROM truss.rel_endpoint e JOIN truss.type_def t ON t.type_id IN(e.source_type,e.target_type) WHERE e.rel_type_id=selected_relation.rel_type_id LOOP
   IF truss.runtime_can_read(owner.document_id,owner.module) IS NOT TRUE THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'complete endpoint reader required for compatibility counts' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
   scopes:=array_append(scopes,jsonb_build_object('documentId',owner.document_id,'moduleId',owner.module));
  END LOOP;
  IF NOT tightening THEN CONTINUE;END IF;
  FOREACH side IN ARRAY ARRAY['source','target'] LOOP
   minimum:=(rel->'declaration'->CASE WHEN side='source' THEN 'targetMultiplicity' ELSE 'sourceMultiplicity' END->>'min')::int;
   maximum:=CASE WHEN rel->'declaration'->CASE WHEN side='source' THEN 'targetMultiplicity' ELSE 'sourceMultiplicity' END->>'max'='*' THEN NULL ELSE (rel->'declaration'->CASE WHEN side='source' THEN 'targetMultiplicity' ELSE 'sourceMultiplicity' END->>'max')::int END;
   IF side='source' AND minimum<=selected_relation.target_min
      AND (maximum IS NULL OR selected_relation.target_max IS NOT NULL AND maximum>=selected_relation.target_max)
    OR side='target' AND minimum<=selected_relation.source_min
      AND (maximum IS NULL OR selected_relation.source_max IS NOT NULL AND maximum>=selected_relation.source_max) THEN CONTINUE;END IF;
   -- Bound each degree probe while retaining exact violation totals.
   IF side='source' THEN
    SELECT count(*) FILTER(WHERE degree<minimum),count(*) FILTER(WHERE maximum IS NOT NULL AND degree>maximum) INTO low_count,high_count FROM (
     SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM (
      SELECT 1 FROM truss.edge e WHERE e.rel_type_id=selected_relation.rel_type_id AND e.source_id=o.id AND e.source_type=o.type_id
      LIMIT CASE WHEN maximum IS NULL THEN minimum::bigint ELSE maximum::bigint+1 END
     ) matching_edges) AS degree
     FROM truss.object o WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM truss.rel_endpoint e WHERE e.rel_type_id=selected_relation.rel_type_id AND e.source_type=o.type_id)) anchors;
   ELSE
    SELECT count(*) FILTER(WHERE degree<minimum),count(*) FILTER(WHERE maximum IS NOT NULL AND degree>maximum) INTO low_count,high_count FROM (
     SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM (
      SELECT 1 FROM truss.edge e WHERE e.rel_type_id=selected_relation.rel_type_id AND e.target_id=o.id AND e.target_type=o.type_id
      LIMIT CASE WHEN maximum IS NULL THEN minimum::bigint ELSE maximum::bigint+1 END
     ) matching_edges) AS degree
     FROM truss.object o WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM truss.rel_endpoint e WHERE e.rel_type_id=selected_relation.rel_type_id AND e.target_type=o.type_id)) anchors;
   END IF;
   scope:=jsonb_build_object('documentId',selected_relation.document_id,'moduleId',selected_relation.module,'relationshipId',selected_relation.rel_id,'side',side);
   IF low_count>0 THEN violations:=array_append(violations,scope||jsonb_build_object('rule','relationship.min','affectedObjectCount',low_count::text));END IF;
   IF high_count>0 THEN violations:=array_append(violations,scope||jsonb_build_object('rule','relationship.max','affectedObjectCount',high_count::text));END IF;
  END LOOP;
 END LOOP;
 FOR owner IN SELECT DISTINCT item.value->>'documentId' AS document_id,item.value->>'moduleId' AS module_id FROM unnest(scopes) AS item(value) LOOP
  IF NOT truss.runtime_can_read(owner.document_id,owner.module_id) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'current module authority changed during compatibility validation' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
 END LOOP;
 IF cardinality(violations)=0 THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 result:=convert_to(to_jsonb(violations)::text,'UTF8');
 IF octet_length(result)>16777216 THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'complete compatibility violation result exceeds byte limit' USING ERRCODE='54000';END IF;
 RETURN result;
END;
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.catalog_scalar_violations_with_sources(declarations_bytes bytea, documents_bytes bytea)
 RETURNS bytea
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE rec jsonb;field jsonb;item jsonb;node jsonb;source_indexes jsonb;
 parsed_declarations jsonb;parsed_documents jsonb;scopes jsonb[]:=ARRAY[]::jsonb[];result bytea;
BEGIN
 parsed_declarations:=convert_from(declarations_bytes,'UTF8')::jsonb;
 parsed_documents:=convert_from(documents_bytes,'UTF8')::jsonb;
 WITH needed_documents AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT (r.value->>'documentId') COLLATE "C" document_id
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(parsed_declarations) d
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(d.value->'records') r
  WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(r.value->'fields') f
   WHERE f.value->'declaration'->>'cardinality' IN ('array','map'))
 )
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_object_agg(d.value->>'documentId',
   truss.catalog_item_source_index(d.value->>'originalText')),'{}'::jsonb)
 INTO source_indexes
 FROM jsonb_array_elements(parsed_documents) d
 JOIN needed_documents n ON n.document_id=d.value->>'documentId' COLLATE "C";
 FOR rec IN SELECT r.value FROM jsonb_array_elements(parsed_declarations) d CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(d.value->'records') r LOOP
  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM truss.type_def t WHERE t.document_id=rec->>'documentId' AND t.module=rec->>'moduleId' AND t.element=rec->>'elementId' AND t.retired_rev IS NULL) THEN CONTINUE;END IF;
  FOR field IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(rec->'fields') LOOP
   IF field->'declaration'->>'cardinality' NOT IN ('array','map') THEN CONTINUE;END IF;
   item:=truss.catalog_item_definition_indexed(source_indexes->(rec->>'documentId'),rec->>'documentId',1,0,field->'declaration'->'itemType');
   IF truss.runtime_item_chain_readable(item) IS NOT TRUE THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'complete candidate item readers required for compatibility counts' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
   FOR node IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(jsonb_build_array(item)||coalesce(item->'descendants','[]'::jsonb)) LOOP
    scopes:=array_append(scopes,jsonb_build_object('documentId',node->>'documentId','moduleId',node->'reference'->>'module'));
   END LOOP;
  END LOOP;
 END LOOP;
 result:=truss.catalog_scalar_violations(declarations_bytes);
 FOR node IN SELECT value FROM unnest(scopes) AS item(value) LOOP
  IF truss.runtime_can_read(node->>'documentId',node->>'moduleId') IS NOT TRUE THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'candidate item authority changed during compatibility counts' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
 END LOOP;
 RETURN result;
END;
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.catalog_validate_completion()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE request truss.catalog_registration_request%ROWTYPE; installation truss.catalog_runtime_installation%ROWTYPE;
 expected jsonb; origin bytea; original_report bytea;
BEGIN
 IF TG_TABLE_SCHEMA<>'truss' OR TG_TABLE_NAME<>'schema_head' OR NEW.id<>1 OR NEW.rev<1 THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'selected catalog completion required' USING ERRCODE='55000'; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT installation FROM truss.runtime_current_installation();
 SELECT * INTO STRICT request FROM truss.catalog_registration_request WHERE revision=NEW.rev;
 IF request.actor_oid IS DISTINCT FROM truss.catalog_actor() THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'current original registration authority required' USING ERRCODE='P1403'; END IF;
 IF request.installation_id<>installation.installation_id OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM truss.schema_head WHERE id=1 AND rev>=request.revision) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'complete catalog publication required' USING ERRCODE='55000'; END IF;
 origin:=convert_to((convert_from(request.origin_bytes,'UTF8')::jsonb||jsonb_build_object('actor',request.actor_name,'db_role',request.actor_name))::text,'UTF8');
 SELECT report_bytes INTO STRICT original_report FROM truss.catalog_acceptance_report WHERE rev=request.revision;
 RETURN NULL;
END;
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.catalog_validate_unchanged()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE original truss.catalog_registration_request%ROWTYPE; stored truss.catalog_unchanged_request%ROWTYPE;
 expected jsonb; original_origin bytea; report bytea; request_count bigint;
BEGIN
 IF TG_TABLE_SCHEMA<>'truss' OR TG_TABLE_NAME<>'catalog_unchanged_request'
  OR NEW.actor_oid IS DISTINCT FROM truss.catalog_actor() OR NEW.actor_name IS DISTINCT FROM session_user::text THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'current unchanged request authority required' USING ERRCODE='P1403'; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT stored FROM truss.catalog_unchanged_request r
  WHERE r.installation_id=NEW.installation_id AND r.actor_oid=NEW.actor_oid AND r.request_key=NEW.request_key;
 IF stored IS DISTINCT FROM NEW THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'original unchanged request required' USING ERRCODE='55000'; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT original FROM truss.catalog_registration_request r WHERE r.registration_id=NEW.registration_id;
 IF original.installation_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.installation_id
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM truss.runtime_current_installation() i WHERE i.installation_id=NEW.installation_id)
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM truss.schema_head h WHERE h.id=1 AND h.rev>=original.revision)
  OR jsonb_typeof(convert_from(NEW.origin_bytes,'UTF8')::jsonb) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'original current registration required' USING ERRCODE='55000'; END IF;
 SELECT count(*) INTO request_count FROM (
  SELECT 1 FROM truss.catalog_registration_request r WHERE r.installation_id=NEW.installation_id AND r.actor_oid=NEW.actor_oid AND r.request_key=NEW.request_key
  UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM truss.catalog_unchanged_request r WHERE r.installation_id=NEW.installation_id AND r.actor_oid=NEW.actor_oid AND r.request_key=NEW.request_key) requests;
 IF request_count<>1 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'unambiguous catalog request required' USING ERRCODE='55000'; END IF;
 original_origin:=convert_to((convert_from(original.origin_bytes,'UTF8')::jsonb||jsonb_build_object('actor',original.actor_name,'db_role',original.actor_name))::text,'UTF8');
 SELECT report_bytes INTO STRICT report FROM truss.catalog_acceptance_report WHERE rev=original.revision;
 RETURN NULL;
END;
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.get_object(selected_document text, selected_module text, selected_record text, selected_id bigint, maximum_bytes integer, expected_release text, expected_digest text)
 RETURNS bytea
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
 SET row_security TO 'off'
AS $function$
DECLARE actor_oid oid; selected_type truss.type_def%ROWTYPE; current_object truss.object%ROWTYPE;
 property truss.prop_def%ROWTYPE; cell jsonb; values_json jsonb:='[]'; retained_json jsonb:='[]';
 properties truss.prop_def[];has_row_home boolean;definition_pin text;dependency record;frozen record;
 root_object truss.object;root_definition truss.type_def;root_identity jsonb;
 captured_revision int; result bytea; policy truss.module_access%ROWTYPE; installation truss.catalog_runtime_installation%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
 actor_oid:=truss.runtime_person(false);
 IF selected_document IS NULL OR selected_module IS NULL OR selected_record IS NULL
 OR octet_length(selected_document) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 4096 OR octet_length(selected_module) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 4096
 OR octet_length(selected_record) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 4096 OR selected_id IS NULL OR selected_id<=0
 OR maximum_bytes IS NULL OR maximum_bytes NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 16777216 THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'bounded object selection required' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
 IF current_setting('transaction_read_only')='on' THEN
 SELECT rev INTO STRICT captured_revision FROM truss.schema_head WHERE id=1;
 ELSE
 SELECT rev INTO STRICT captured_revision FROM truss.schema_head WHERE id=1 FOR SHARE NOWAIT;
 END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT installation FROM truss.runtime_current_installation();
 IF expected_release IS DISTINCT FROM installation.release_id OR expected_digest IS DISTINCT FROM installation.release_sha256
 OR installation.release_id<>'truss-catalog-runtime/0.74-candidate' THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'selected installed object runtime required' USING ERRCODE='0A000'; END IF;
 IF captured_revision<1 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'accepted read catalog required' USING ERRCODE='0A000'; END IF;
 -- No object observation until exact document/module membership is established.
 IF current_setting('transaction_read_only')='on' THEN
 SELECT * INTO policy FROM truss.module_access WHERE document_id=selected_document AND module=selected_module;
 ELSE
 SELECT * INTO policy FROM truss.module_access WHERE document_id=selected_document AND module=selected_module FOR SHARE NOWAIT;
 END IF;
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
 IF NOT EXISTS(WITH RECURSIVE memberships(role_oid) AS (
   SELECT actor_oid UNION SELECT m.roleid FROM pg_auth_members m JOIN memberships p ON m.member=p.role_oid)
   SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles r JOIN memberships m ON m.role_oid=r.oid
   WHERE r.rolname::text IN (policy.reader_role,policy.writer_role)) THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO selected_type FROM truss.type_def WHERE document_id=selected_document AND module=selected_module
   AND element=selected_record AND retired_rev IS NULL AND kind='record' AND NOT provisional AND since_rev<=captured_revision;
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
 -- Require every declaration owner before any object observation.
 IF NOT truss.runtime_object_values_readable(selected_type.type_id) THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 SELECT coalesce(array_agg(p ORDER BY p.prop_id),ARRAY[]::truss.prop_def[]) INTO properties FROM truss.prop_def p WHERE p.type_id=selected_type.type_id AND p.retired_rev IS NULL;
 SELECT d.definition_pin INTO STRICT definition_pin FROM truss.runtime_owned_definition_metadata('type',selected_type.type_id) d;
 SELECT o AS object,ro AS root_object,rt AS root_definition,
 false AS row_home
 INTO frozen FROM truss.object o
 LEFT JOIN truss.object ro ON ro.id=o.root_id AND ro.type_id=o.root_type
 LEFT JOIN truss.type_def rt ON rt.type_id=ro.type_id AND rt.retired_rev IS NULL AND NOT rt.provisional AND rt.kind='record'
 WHERE o.id=selected_id AND o.type_id=selected_type.type_id;
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
 current_object:=frozen.object;has_row_home:=frozen.row_home;
 root_object:=frozen.root_object;root_definition:=frozen.root_definition;
 IF current_object.root_id IS NOT NULL OR current_object.root_type IS NOT NULL THEN
  IF current_object.root_id IS NULL OR current_object.root_type IS NULL OR root_object.id IS NULL OR root_definition.type_id IS NULL
   OR root_object.root_id IS NOT NULL OR root_object.root_type IS NOT NULL OR root_object.id=current_object.id AND root_object.type_id=current_object.type_id
   THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'current aggregate root required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
  IF root_object.rev>captured_revision OR root_definition.since_rev>captured_revision THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'catalog changed during ownership observation' USING ERRCODE='55P03';END IF;
  IF NOT truss.runtime_can_read(root_definition.document_id,root_definition.module) THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
  root_identity:=jsonb_build_object('id',root_object.id::text,'typeId',root_object.type_id::text,
   'definitionPin',(SELECT d.definition_pin FROM truss.runtime_owned_definition_metadata('type',root_object.type_id) d),
   'owner',jsonb_build_object('documentId',root_definition.document_id,'moduleId',root_definition.module));
 END IF;
 result:=truss.render_logical_object(current_object,selected_type,properties,has_row_home,definition_pin,captured_revision,maximum_bytes,installation.release_id,installation.release_sha256,root_identity);
 actor_oid:=truss.runtime_person(false);
 IF current_setting('transaction_read_only')='on' THEN
  SELECT * INTO policy FROM truss.module_access WHERE document_id=selected_document AND module=selected_module;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
 END IF;
 IF NOT EXISTS(WITH RECURSIVE memberships(role_oid) AS (
   SELECT actor_oid UNION SELECT m.roleid FROM pg_auth_members m JOIN memberships p ON m.member=p.role_oid)
   SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles r JOIN memberships m ON m.role_oid=r.oid
   WHERE r.rolname::text IN (policy.reader_role,policy.writer_role)) THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
 IF NOT truss.runtime_object_values_readable(selected_type.type_id) THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 IF root_identity IS NOT NULL AND NOT truss.runtime_can_read(root_definition.document_id,root_definition.module) THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 IF (SELECT rev FROM truss.schema_head WHERE id=1) IS DISTINCT FROM captured_revision THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'catalog changed during object observation' USING ERRCODE='55P03';END IF;
 RETURN result;
END;
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.grant_import_audit_access(selected_document text, selected_module text, selected_auditor_role text)
 RETURNS bytea
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
 SET row_security TO 'off'
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
AS $function$
DECLARE actor record;installation truss.catalog_runtime_installation%ROWTYPE;auditor oid;has_owner boolean;
BEGIN
 SELECT r.oid,r.rolcanlogin,r.rolsuper,r.rolcreaterole,r.rolcreatedb,r.rolreplication,r.rolbypassrls,
  current_setting('role')='none' AS original_role INTO STRICT actor
  FROM pg_catalog.pg_roles r WHERE r.rolname=session_user;
 IF selected_document IS NULL OR selected_module IS NULL OR selected_auditor_role IS NULL
  OR octet_length(selected_document) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 65536
  OR octet_length(selected_module) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 65536
  OR octet_length(selected_auditor_role) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 256
  OR actor.rolcanlogin IS NOT TRUE OR actor.original_role IS NOT TRUE
  OR NOT actor.rolsuper AND (NOT actor.rolcreaterole OR actor.rolcreatedb
   OR actor.rolreplication OR actor.rolbypassrls) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'qualified direct installation administrator and audit role required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT installation FROM truss.catalog_runtime_installation WHERE singleton;
 IF NOT actor.rolsuper THEN
  WITH RECURSIVE inherited(role_oid) AS (
   SELECT actor.oid UNION SELECT m.roleid FROM pg_catalog.pg_auth_members m
    JOIN inherited i ON m.member=i.role_oid WHERE m.inherit_option)
  SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM inherited WHERE role_oid=installation.owner_oid) INTO has_owner;
  IF has_owner IS NOT TRUE THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'installation owner administration required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
 END IF;
 SELECT r.oid INTO auditor FROM pg_catalog.pg_roles r WHERE r.rolname=selected_auditor_role
  AND NOT r.rolcanlogin AND NOT r.rolsuper AND NOT r.rolcreatedb AND NOT r.rolcreaterole
  AND NOT r.rolreplication AND NOT r.rolbypassrls AND NOT r.rolinherit;
 IF auditor IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM truss.module_access m
  WHERE m.document_id=selected_document AND m.module=selected_module
   AND m.reader_role IS DISTINCT FROM selected_auditor_role
   AND m.writer_role IS DISTINCT FROM selected_auditor_role) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'configured module audit role required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 INSERT INTO truss.runtime_import_audit_access(document_id,module,auditor_oid,granted_by)
  VALUES(selected_document,selected_module,auditor,actor.oid)
  ON CONFLICT(document_id,module) DO UPDATE SET auditor_oid=EXCLUDED.auditor_oid,granted_by=EXCLUDED.granted_by;
 RETURN convert_to('{"outcome":"granted"}','UTF8');
END;
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.group_context_qualified(expected_release text, expected_digest text, qualified_actor oid)
 RETURNS bytea
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
 SET row_security TO 'off'
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
 SET bytea_output TO 'hex'
AS $function$
DECLARE person oid;installation truss.catalog_runtime_installation%ROWTYPE;revision int;
BEGIN
 person:=qualified_actor;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT installation FROM truss.runtime_current_installation();
 IF installation.release_id IS DISTINCT FROM expected_release OR installation.release_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM expected_digest THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'selected installed group runtime required' USING ERRCODE='0A000'; END IF;
 SELECT rev INTO STRICT revision FROM truss.schema_head WHERE id=1 FOR SHARE NOWAIT;
 IF revision<1 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'accepted catalog required' USING ERRCODE='0A000'; END IF;
 RETURN convert_to((truss.runtime_group_profiles()||jsonb_build_object('layoutProfile',installation.layout_profile,
  'authorizedScopeIdentity','truss-person:'||installation.installation_id||':'||person::text,
  'catalogRevision',revision::text,'installationId',installation.installation_id::text,'sourceEpoch',installation.source_epoch::text,'historyProfile',
   CASE WHEN truss.runtime_group_profiles()->'mutationProfile'=truss.runtime_owned_profile() THEN 'truss-native-owned-create/0.1' ELSE 'truss-native-scalar-create/0.2' END))::text,'UTF8');
END;
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.group_create_metadata_qualified(original_input bytea, original_documents bytea, expected_release text, expected_digest text, qualified_actor oid)
 RETURNS bytea
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
 SET row_security TO 'off'
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
 SET bytea_output TO 'hex'
AS $function$
DECLARE input jsonb;documents jsonb;operation jsonb;context jsonb;selected_type truss.type_def%ROWTYPE;
 source_pin record;archive truss.schema_doc%ROWTYPE;metadata jsonb;metadata_items jsonb[]:='{}';counted int:=0;source_text text;
 source_slots jsonb;source_slot_list jsonb;source_slot int;source_texts text[];source_verified boolean[];
BEGIN
 context:=convert_from(truss.group_context_qualified(expected_release,expected_digest,qualified_actor),'UTF8')::jsonb;
 IF original_input IS NULL OR octet_length(original_input) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 1048576
 OR original_documents IS NULL OR octet_length(original_documents) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 4194304 THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'bounded group source required' USING ERRCODE='54000'; END IF;
 IF (convert_from(original_input,'UTF8') IS JSON OBJECT WITH UNIQUE KEYS) IS NOT TRUE OR (convert_from(original_documents,'UTF8') IS JSON ARRAY WITH UNIQUE KEYS) IS NOT TRUE THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'unique original JSON members required' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
 input:=convert_from(original_input,'UTF8')::jsonb;documents:=convert_from(original_documents,'UTF8')::jsonb;
 IF input->>'interfaceVersion' IS DISTINCT FROM 'truss-group-input/0.1.0'
 OR input->'layoutProfile' IS DISTINCT FROM context->'layoutProfile'
 OR input->'mutationProfile' IS DISTINCT FROM context->'mutationProfile'
 OR input->'valueProfile' IS DISTINCT FROM context->'valueProfile'
 OR input->'catalog' IS DISTINCT FROM '{"selection":"current"}'::jsonb
 OR jsonb_typeof(input->'operations') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' OR jsonb_array_length(input->'operations') NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 128
 OR jsonb_typeof(documents) IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' OR jsonb_array_length(documents) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 512 THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'selected create group profile required' USING ERRCODE='0A000'; END IF;
 WITH docs AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT value,ordinality::int slot,value->>'documentId' document_id
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(documents) WITH ORDINALITY d(value,ordinality)),
 slots AS (
  SELECT document_id COLLATE pg_catalog."C" document_id,jsonb_agg(slot ORDER BY slot) slots
  FROM docs WHERE document_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY document_id COLLATE pg_catalog."C")
 SELECT coalesce((SELECT jsonb_object_agg(document_id,slots) FROM slots),'{}'::jsonb),
  coalesce(array_agg(value->>'sourceText' ORDER BY slot),'{}'::text[]),
  coalesce(array_agg(false ORDER BY slot),'{}'::boolean[])
 INTO source_slots,source_texts,source_verified FROM docs;
 FOR operation IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(input->'operations') LOOP
  IF operation->>'operation' IS DISTINCT FROM 'create_object' OR
   (operation->'ownership' IS DISTINCT FROM '{"state":"rootless"}'::jsonb AND
    (input->'mutationProfile'=truss.runtime_owned_profile() AND operation->'ownership'->>'state'='owned'
     AND (operation->'ownership')-ARRAY['state','root']='{}'::jsonb) IS NOT TRUE) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'explicit selected create ownership required' USING ERRCODE='0A000'; END IF;
  WITH pinned AS MATERIALIZED (
   SELECT rev,ord,doc_id,module_id,element_id FROM truss.runtime_definition_source
   WHERE definition_pin=operation->>'typeDefinitionPin' AND kind='element' AND key_id='')
  SELECT t.* INTO STRICT selected_type FROM pinned p JOIN truss.type_def t
   ON t.definition_rev=p.rev AND t.definition_doc_ord=p.ord AND t.definition_document_id=p.doc_id
    AND t.module=p.module_id AND t.element=p.element_id
   WHERE t.kind='record' AND NOT t.provisional AND t.retired_rev IS NULL;
  PERFORM truss.runtime_module_writer_qualified(selected_type.document_id,selected_type.module,qualified_actor);
  IF NOT truss.runtime_object_values_readable_qualified(selected_type.type_id,qualified_actor) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'current property and item interpretation reader required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
  source_slot_list:=source_slots->selected_type.document_id;
  IF source_slot_list IS NULL THEN RAISE NO_DATA_FOUND;END IF;
  IF jsonb_array_length(source_slot_list)<>1 THEN RAISE TOO_MANY_ROWS;END IF;
  source_slot:=(source_slot_list->>0)::int;
  IF NOT source_verified[source_slot] THEN
   SELECT * INTO STRICT archive FROM truss.schema_doc d WHERE d.doc_id=selected_type.document_id ORDER BY d.rev DESC LIMIT 1;
   source_text:=source_texts[source_slot];
   IF convert_to(source_text,'UTF8') IS DISTINCT FROM convert_to(archive.document,'UTF8') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'complete original accepted source required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
   source_verified[source_slot]:=true;
  END IF;
  counted:=counted+1;
  metadata_items[counted]:=jsonb_build_object('operationIndex',counted-1,'typeId',selected_type.type_id::text,
   'documentId',selected_type.document_id,'moduleId',selected_type.module,'recordId',selected_type.element,
   'keys',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('keyNumber',k.key_num::text,'keyId',k.key_id,
    'names',(SELECT jsonb_agg(p.name ORDER BY i.ord) FROM unnest(k.prop_ids) WITH ORDINALITY i(prop_id,ord)
      JOIN truss.prop_def p ON p.prop_id=i.prop_id AND p.type_id=k.type_id)) ORDER BY k.key_num),'[]'::jsonb)
    FROM truss.key_def k WHERE k.type_id=selected_type.type_id AND k.retired_rev IS NULL));
 END LOOP;
 metadata:=to_jsonb(metadata_items);
 RETURN convert_to(metadata::text,'UTF8');
END;
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.import_edge_identity(original_identity bytea, expected_release text, expected_digest text)
 RETURNS bytea
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
 SET row_security TO 'off'
AS $function$
DECLARE context jsonb;identity jsonb;relation truss.rel_def%ROWTYPE;source_definition truss.type_def%ROWTYPE;target_definition truss.type_def%ROWTYPE;key text;edge_row truss.edge%ROWTYPE;result jsonb;matches int;owned_selection boolean:=false;endpoint record;
BEGIN
 -- Selection needs current custody/configuration and the key profile, not a
 -- reconstruction/hash of the complete catalog bundle for every record.
 PERFORM truss.group_context(expected_release,expected_digest);
 IF (SELECT selected_setting.value FROM truss.setting selected_setting WHERE selected_setting.key='key_reuse') IS DISTINCT FROM '"forbid"'::jsonb OR (SELECT selected_setting.value FROM truss.setting selected_setting WHERE selected_setting.key='journal_mode') IS DISTINCT FROM '"engine"'::jsonb THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'installed engine/forbid import policy required' USING ERRCODE='0A000';END IF;
 context:=truss.runtime_import_profiles();
 IF original_identity IS NULL OR octet_length(original_identity) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 65536 OR (convert_from(original_identity,'UTF8') IS JSON OBJECT WITH UNIQUE KEYS) IS NOT TRUE THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'bounded exact edge import identity required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 identity:=convert_from(original_identity,'UTF8')::jsonb;
 IF identity->'profile'=truss.runtime_import_profiles()->'ownedImportProfile'
  AND identity-ARRAY['profile','identity']='{}'::jsonb THEN
  owned_selection:=true;identity:=identity->'identity';
 END IF;

 IF identity-ARRAY['relationshipDefinitionPin','source','target']<>'{}'::jsonb THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'closed edge import identity required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 relation:=truss.runtime_operation_relationship(jsonb_build_object('operation','create_edge','relationshipDefinitionPin',identity->>'relationshipDefinitionPin'),'[]',0);
 PERFORM truss.runtime_module_writer(relation.document_id,relation.module);source_definition:=truss.runtime_condition_type(identity->'source');target_definition:=truss.runtime_condition_type(identity->'target');
 IF NOT truss.runtime_can_read(source_definition.document_id,source_definition.module) OR NOT truss.runtime_can_read(target_definition.document_id,target_definition.module) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'edge endpoint readers required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM truss.rel_endpoint WHERE rel_type_id=relation.rel_type_id AND source_type=source_definition.type_id AND target_type=target_definition.type_id) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'admitted edge endpoint pair required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 LOCK TABLE truss.object IN SHARE ROW EXCLUSIVE MODE NOWAIT;
 LOCK TABLE truss.edge IN SHARE ROW EXCLUSIVE MODE NOWAIT;
 IF NOT owned_selection AND (relation.lifecycle IS DISTINCT FROM 'independent' OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM truss.object o WHERE
  (o.id=(identity->'source'->>'id')::bigint AND o.type_id=source_definition.type_id OR o.id=(identity->'target'->>'id')::bigint AND o.type_id=target_definition.type_id)
  AND (o.root_id IS NOT NULL OR o.root_type IS NOT NULL))) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'rootless independent edge import profile required' USING ERRCODE='0A000';END IF;
 IF owned_selection THEN
  IF relation.lifecycle NOT IN ('owned','independent') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'supported owned import relationship required' USING ERRCODE='0A000';END IF;
  FOR endpoint IN SELECT DISTINCT t.document_id,t.module FROM truss.object o JOIN truss.type_def t ON t.type_id=o.root_type
   WHERE (o.id=(identity->'source'->>'id')::bigint AND o.type_id=source_definition.type_id
     OR o.id=(identity->'target'->>'id')::bigint AND o.type_id=target_definition.type_id) LOOP
   IF NOT truss.runtime_can_read(endpoint.document_id,endpoint.module) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'current imported endpoint root reader required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
  END LOOP;
 END IF;
 PERFORM 1 FROM truss.object WHERE id=(identity->'source'->>'id')::bigint AND type_id=source_definition.type_id FOR UPDATE NOWAIT;
 PERFORM 1 FROM truss.object WHERE id=(identity->'target'->>'id')::bigint AND type_id=target_definition.type_id FOR UPDATE NOWAIT;
 key:=truss.runtime_edge_business_key(relation.rel_type_id,identity->'source',identity->'target');PERFORM truss.runtime_lock_edge_business_key(key);
 SELECT count(*) INTO matches FROM (SELECT 1 FROM truss.edge WHERE rel_type_id=relation.rel_type_id
  AND source_id=(identity->'source'->>'id')::bigint AND source_type=source_definition.type_id
  AND target_id=(identity->'target'->>'id')::bigint AND target_type=target_definition.type_id LIMIT 2) candidates;
 IF matches>1 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'ambiguous endpoint-only edge import identity' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 SELECT * INTO edge_row FROM truss.edge WHERE rel_type_id=relation.rel_type_id AND source_id=(identity->'source'->>'id')::bigint AND source_type=source_definition.type_id AND target_id=(identity->'target'->>'id')::bigint AND target_type=target_definition.type_id FOR UPDATE NOWAIT;
 IF FOUND THEN result:=jsonb_build_object('state','skipped','reason','live_identity','identity',jsonb_build_object('id',edge_row.id::text,'typeId',relation.rel_type_id::text,'definitionPin',identity->>'relationshipDefinitionPin','owner',jsonb_build_object('documentId',relation.document_id,'moduleId',relation.module)));
 ELSIF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM truss.key_tombstone WHERE entity_kind='e' AND type_id=relation.rel_type_id AND key_num=0 AND k=key) THEN result:=jsonb_build_object('state','skipped','reason','reserved_identity');
 ELSE result:=jsonb_build_object('state','eligible','documentId',relation.document_id,'moduleId',relation.module,'relationshipDefinitionPin',identity->>'relationshipDefinitionPin');END IF;
 PERFORM truss.runtime_module_writer(relation.document_id,relation.module);
 IF NOT truss.runtime_can_read(source_definition.document_id,source_definition.module) OR NOT truss.runtime_can_read(target_definition.document_id,target_definition.module) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'current endpoint readers required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
 RETURN convert_to(result::text,'UTF8');
END;
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.import_key_selection(selected_document text, selected_module text, selected_record text, expected_release text, expected_digest text)
 RETURNS bytea
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
 SET row_security TO 'off'
AS $function$
DECLARE context jsonb;selected truss.type_def%ROWTYPE;key_row truss.key_def%ROWTYPE;pin record;property truss.prop_def%ROWTYPE;components jsonb;component_buffer jsonb[]:=ARRAY[]::jsonb[];type_pin text;key_pin text;
BEGIN
 -- Selection needs current custody/configuration and the key profile, not a
 -- reconstruction/hash of the complete catalog bundle for every record.
 PERFORM truss.group_context(expected_release,expected_digest);
 IF (SELECT selected_setting.value FROM truss.setting selected_setting WHERE selected_setting.key='key_reuse') IS DISTINCT FROM '"forbid"'::jsonb OR (SELECT selected_setting.value FROM truss.setting selected_setting WHERE selected_setting.key='journal_mode') IS DISTINCT FROM '"engine"'::jsonb THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'installed engine/forbid import policy required' USING ERRCODE='0A000';END IF;
 context:=truss.runtime_import_profiles();
 PERFORM truss.runtime_module_writer(selected_document,selected_module);
 SELECT * INTO selected FROM truss.type_def WHERE document_id=selected_document AND module=selected_module AND element=selected_record AND kind='record' AND NOT provisional AND retired_rev IS NULL;
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'accepted import record type required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 SELECT * INTO key_row FROM truss.key_def WHERE type_id=selected.type_id AND is_primary AND retired_rev IS NULL;
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'import primary key required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT pin FROM truss.runtime_owned_definition_metadata('type',selected.type_id);type_pin:=pin.definition_pin;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT pin FROM truss.runtime_owned_definition_metadata('key',selected.type_id,key_row.key_num);key_pin:=pin.definition_pin;
 FOR property IN SELECT p.* FROM unnest(key_row.prop_ids) WITH ORDINALITY i(prop_id,ord) JOIN truss.prop_def p ON p.type_id=selected.type_id AND p.prop_id=i.prop_id ORDER BY i.ord LOOP
  IF property.scalar_type NOT IN ('string','integer','decimal','boolean','binary') OR property.scalar_type IS NULL OR property.cardinality<>'one' OR property.nullability<>'required' OR property.home<>'json' OR property.retired_rev IS NOT NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'selected string primary key required' USING ERRCODE='0A000';END IF;
  IF NOT truss.runtime_can_read(selected_document,property.declaration_module) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'primary property reader required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
  SELECT * INTO STRICT pin FROM truss.runtime_owned_definition_metadata('property',selected.type_id,property.prop_id);
  component_buffer:=array_append(component_buffer,jsonb_build_object('name',property.name,'propertyId',property.prop_id::text,'definitionPin',pin.definition_pin,'scalarType',property.scalar_type,'facets',coalesce(property.facets,'{}'::jsonb)));
 END LOOP;
 FOR property IN SELECT p.* FROM unnest(key_row.prop_ids) i(prop_id) JOIN truss.prop_def p ON p.type_id=selected.type_id AND p.prop_id=i.prop_id LOOP
  IF NOT truss.runtime_can_read(selected_document,property.declaration_module) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'current primary declaration reader required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
 END LOOP;
 PERFORM truss.runtime_module_writer(selected_document,selected_module);
 components:=to_jsonb(component_buffer);
 RETURN convert_to(jsonb_build_object('recordId',selected.element,'type',jsonb_build_object('typeId',selected.type_id::text,'definitionPin',type_pin,'owner',jsonb_build_object('documentId',selected.document_id,'moduleId',selected.module)),
  'keyNumber',key_row.key_num::text,'keyId',key_row.key_id,'keyDefinitionPin',key_pin,'keyEncodingProfile',context->'importKeyProfile','components',components)::text,'UTF8');
END;
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.import_object_identity(original_identity bytea, original_document bytea, tuple_bytes bytea, expected_release text, expected_digest text)
 RETURNS bytea
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
 SET row_security TO 'off'
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
AS $function$
DECLARE identity jsonb;selected truss.type_def%ROWTYPE;metadata jsonb;key_row truss.key_def%ROWTYPE;installation truss.catalog_runtime_installation%ROWTYPE;
 archive truss.schema_doc%ROWTYPE;component jsonb;values_text text[]:=ARRAY[]::text[];values_cells jsonb;values_buffer jsonb[]:=ARRAY[]::jsonb[];key_facets jsonb;facets_buffer jsonb[]:=ARRAY[]::jsonb[];fields jsonb;fields_buffer jsonb[]:=ARRAY[]::jsonb[];component_index int:=0;pin record;namespace bytea;transport bytea;observed record;member truss.object_key_bucket%ROWTYPE;object_row truss.object%ROWTYPE;result jsonb;owned_selection boolean:=false;root_owner record;
BEGIN
 IF original_identity IS NULL OR octet_length(original_identity) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 1048576 OR (convert_from(original_identity,'UTF8') IS JSON OBJECT WITH UNIQUE KEYS) IS NOT TRUE THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'bounded unique import identity required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 identity:=convert_from(original_identity,'UTF8')::jsonb;
 IF identity->'profile'=truss.runtime_import_profiles()->'ownedImportProfile'
  AND identity-ARRAY['profile','identity']='{}'::jsonb THEN
  owned_selection:=true;identity:=identity->'identity';
 END IF;

 IF identity-ARRAY['operation','type','keyNumber','keyDefinitionPin','keyEncodingProfile','components']<>'{}'::jsonb OR identity->>'operation' IS DISTINCT FROM 'object_key'
  OR (identity->'type')-ARRAY['typeId','definitionPin','owner']<>'{}'::jsonb OR jsonb_typeof(identity->'type'->'typeId') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
  OR identity->'type'->>'typeId' !~ '^[1-9][0-9]{0,9}$' OR length(identity->'type'->>'typeId')=10 AND (identity->'type'->>'typeId') COLLATE "C">'2147483647'
  OR jsonb_typeof(identity->'components') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'closed exact primary identity required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 SELECT * INTO selected FROM truss.type_def WHERE type_id=(identity->'type'->>'typeId')::int AND kind='record' AND NOT provisional AND retired_rev IS NULL;
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'known import type required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 metadata:=convert_from(truss.import_key_selection(selected.document_id,selected.module,selected.element,expected_release,expected_digest),'UTF8')::jsonb;
 IF jsonb_typeof(identity->'keyNumber') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string' OR jsonb_typeof(identity->'keyDefinitionPin') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string' OR identity->'type' IS DISTINCT FROM metadata->'type' OR identity->>'keyNumber' IS DISTINCT FROM metadata->>'keyNumber'
  OR identity->>'keyDefinitionPin' IS DISTINCT FROM metadata->>'keyDefinitionPin' OR (identity->'keyEncodingProfile' IS DISTINCT FROM metadata->'keyEncodingProfile' AND NOT ((identity->'keyEncodingProfile'='{"identity":"truss-selected-umf-string-key","version":"0.1","sha256":"07e1b99b22803e55a378f8068a6b80454b7581129c66eabcb117545746a16625"}'::jsonb AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(identity->'components') c WHERE c.value->'value'->>'kind' IS DISTINCT FROM 'string')) IS TRUE))
  OR jsonb_array_length(identity->'components')<>jsonb_array_length(metadata->'components') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'actual complete primary definition required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 IF NOT owned_selection THEN
  SELECT * INTO STRICT archive FROM truss.schema_doc WHERE doc_id=selected.document_id ORDER BY rev DESC LIMIT 1;
  IF original_document IS DISTINCT FROM convert_to(archive.document,'UTF8') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'caller-known original document required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 END IF;
 FOR component IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(identity->'components') LOOP
  IF jsonb_typeof(component->'propertyId') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string' OR jsonb_typeof(component->'definitionPin') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string' OR component-ARRAY['propertyId','definitionPin','value']<>'{}'::jsonb OR component->>'propertyId' IS DISTINCT FROM metadata->'components'->component_index->>'propertyId'
   OR component->>'definitionPin' IS DISTINCT FROM metadata->'components'->component_index->>'definitionPin' OR truss.valid_scalar_property(component->'value',metadata->'components'->component_index->>'scalarType',false,metadata->'components'->component_index->'facets') IS NOT TRUE THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'exact ordered primary component required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
  values_buffer:=array_append(values_buffer,component->'value');
  facets_buffer:=array_append(facets_buffer,metadata->'components'->component_index->'facets');
  fields_buffer:=array_append(fields_buffer,jsonb_build_object('name',metadata->'components'->component_index->>'name','value',component->'value'));
  component_index:=component_index+1;
 END LOOP;
 values_cells:=to_jsonb(values_buffer);key_facets:=to_jsonb(facets_buffer);fields:=to_jsonb(fields_buffer);
 IF tuple_bytes IS NOT NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'client key encoding is no longer accepted' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 tuple_bytes:=truss.derive_catalog_key_tuple(selected.type_id,(metadata->>'keyNumber')::smallint,values_cells);
 SELECT * INTO STRICT installation FROM truss.runtime_current_installation();
 namespace:=convert_to(jsonb_build_object('profile','truss-string-key-namespace/0.2','installationId',installation.installation_id::text,'sourceEpoch',installation.source_epoch::text,
  'typeId',metadata->'type'->>'typeId','keyNumber',metadata->>'keyNumber','definitionPin',metadata->>'keyDefinitionPin','encoding','umf-key-tuple-v1')::text,'UTF8');
 LOCK TABLE truss.object IN SHARE ROW EXCLUSIVE MODE NOWAIT;
 LOCK TABLE truss.edge IN SHARE ROW EXCLUSIVE MODE NOWAIT;
 transport:=convert_to('umf-key-tuple-v1:hex:'||encode(tuple_bytes,'hex'),'UTF8');SELECT * INTO STRICT observed FROM truss.lock_string_key_bucket(namespace,transport);
 IF cardinality(observed.member_ids)>1 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'unique live primary identity required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
 IF cardinality(observed.member_ids)=1 THEN
  SELECT * INTO STRICT member FROM truss.object_key_bucket WHERE storage_row_id=observed.member_ids[1];
  SELECT * INTO STRICT object_row FROM truss.object WHERE id=member.object_id AND type_id=selected.type_id FOR UPDATE NOWAIT;
  IF object_row.root_id IS NOT NULL OR object_row.root_type IS NOT NULL THEN
   IF NOT owned_selection THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'owned object import requires an explicit supported ownership import profile' USING ERRCODE='0A000';END IF;
   SELECT t.document_id,t.module INTO STRICT root_owner FROM truss.type_def t WHERE t.type_id=object_row.root_type;
   IF NOT truss.runtime_can_read(root_owner.document_id,root_owner.module) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'current imported root reader required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
  END IF;
  result:=jsonb_build_object('state','skipped','reason','live_identity','identity',jsonb_build_object('id',object_row.id::text,'typeId',selected.type_id::text,'definitionPin',metadata->'type'->>'definitionPin','owner',metadata->'type'->'owner'));
 ELSIF cardinality(observed.reservation_ids)>0 THEN result:=jsonb_build_object('state','skipped','reason','reserved_identity');
 ELSE result:=jsonb_build_object('state','eligible','documentId',selected.document_id,'moduleId',selected.module,'recordId',selected.element,'definitionPin',metadata->'type'->>'definitionPin','primaryFields',fields);END IF;
 PERFORM truss.import_key_selection(selected.document_id,selected.module,selected.element,expected_release,expected_digest);
 PERFORM truss.runtime_module_writer(selected.document_id,selected.module);
 RETURN convert_to(result::text,'UTF8');
END;
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.import_report_record_authority(original_identity bytea, kind text, expected_release text, expected_digest text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
 SET row_security TO 'off'
AS $function$
DECLARE envelope jsonb;outcome_identity jsonb;object_row truss.object;edge_row truss.edge;endpoint record;identity jsonb;relation truss.rel_def%ROWTYPE;source_definition truss.type_def%ROWTYPE;target_definition truss.type_def%ROWTYPE;owned_selection boolean:=false;root_owner record;
BEGIN
 IF original_identity IS NULL OR octet_length(original_identity) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 2097152
  OR (convert_from(original_identity,'UTF8') IS JSON OBJECT WITH UNIQUE KEYS) IS NOT TRUE THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'bounded original report selection and outcome required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 envelope:=convert_from(original_identity,'UTF8')::jsonb;
 IF envelope-ARRAY['originalIdentity','outcomeIdentity']<>'{}'::jsonb OR NOT envelope ?& ARRAY['originalIdentity','outcomeIdentity']
  OR jsonb_typeof(envelope->'originalIdentity') IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
  OR jsonb_typeof(envelope->'outcomeIdentity') NOT IN ('object','null') THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'exact original report outcome envelope required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 outcome_identity:=nullif(envelope->'outcomeIdentity','null'::jsonb);
 IF outcome_identity IS NOT NULL AND (outcome_identity-ARRAY['id','typeId','definitionPin','owner']<>'{}'::jsonb
  OR jsonb_typeof(outcome_identity->'id') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string' OR outcome_identity->>'id' !~ '^[1-9][0-9]{0,18}$') THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'retained typed report outcome required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 original_identity:=convert_to((envelope->'originalIdentity')::text,'UTF8');
 IF envelope->'originalIdentity'->'profile'=truss.runtime_import_profiles()->'ownedImportProfile'
  AND (envelope->'originalIdentity')-ARRAY['profile','identity']='{}'::jsonb THEN
  owned_selection:=true;original_identity:=convert_to((envelope->'originalIdentity'->'identity')::text,'UTF8');
 END IF;

 IF kind='object' THEN
  IF original_identity IS NULL OR octet_length(original_identity) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 1048576 OR (convert_from(original_identity,'UTF8') IS JSON OBJECT WITH UNIQUE KEYS) IS NOT TRUE THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'bounded unique report identity required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
  identity:=convert_from(original_identity,'UTF8')::jsonb;
  IF jsonb_typeof(identity->'type'->'typeId') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string' OR identity->'type'->>'typeId' !~ '^[1-9][0-9]{0,9}$'
   OR length(identity->'type'->>'typeId')=10 AND (identity->'type'->>'typeId') COLLATE "C">'2147483647' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'exact report type ID required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
  SELECT t.* INTO source_definition FROM truss.type_def t WHERE t.type_id=(identity->'type'->>'typeId')::int AND t.kind='record' AND NOT t.provisional AND t.retired_rev IS NULL;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'known report type required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
  IF identity->'type' IS DISTINCT FROM convert_from(truss.import_key_selection(source_definition.document_id,source_definition.module,source_definition.element,expected_release,expected_digest),'UTF8')::jsonb->'type' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'original report type identity required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
  IF outcome_identity IS NOT NULL THEN
   IF outcome_identity-'id' IS DISTINCT FROM identity->'type' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'original object report outcome type required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
   SELECT * INTO object_row FROM truss.object WHERE id=(outcome_identity->>'id')::bigint AND type_id=source_definition.type_id;
   IF FOUND AND (object_row.root_id IS NOT NULL OR object_row.root_type IS NOT NULL) THEN
    IF NOT owned_selection THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'rootless object import report profile required' USING ERRCODE='0A000';END IF;
    SELECT t.document_id,t.module INTO STRICT root_owner FROM truss.type_def t WHERE t.type_id=object_row.root_type;
    IF NOT truss.runtime_can_read(root_owner.document_id,root_owner.module) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'current imported root report reader required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
   END IF;
  END IF;
  RETURN;
 END IF;
 IF kind<>'edge' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'selected report record required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 identity:=convert_from(original_identity,'UTF8')::jsonb;
 relation:=truss.runtime_operation_relationship(jsonb_build_object('operation','create_edge','relationshipDefinitionPin',identity->>'relationshipDefinitionPin'),'[]',0);
 PERFORM truss.runtime_module_writer(relation.document_id,relation.module);
 IF owned_selection THEN
  PERFORM truss.runtime_owned_import_reference(convert_to((identity->'source')::text,'UTF8'),expected_release,expected_digest);
  PERFORM truss.runtime_owned_import_reference(convert_to((identity->'target')::text,'UTF8'),expected_release,expected_digest);
  SELECT * INTO STRICT source_definition FROM truss.type_def WHERE type_id=(identity->'source'->'type'->>'typeId')::int;
  SELECT * INTO STRICT target_definition FROM truss.type_def WHERE type_id=(identity->'target'->'type'->>'typeId')::int;
  IF relation.lifecycle NOT IN ('owned','independent') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'supported owned import report relationship required' USING ERRCODE='0A000';END IF;
 ELSE
  source_definition:=truss.runtime_condition_type(identity->'source');target_definition:=truss.runtime_condition_type(identity->'target');
  IF relation.lifecycle IS DISTINCT FROM 'independent' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'independent import report profile required' USING ERRCODE='0A000';END IF;
 END IF;
 IF outcome_identity IS NOT NULL THEN
  IF outcome_identity->>'typeId' IS DISTINCT FROM relation.rel_type_id::text
   OR outcome_identity->>'definitionPin' IS DISTINCT FROM identity->>'relationshipDefinitionPin'
   OR outcome_identity->'owner' IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object('documentId',relation.document_id,'moduleId',relation.module) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'original edge report outcome type required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
  SELECT * INTO edge_row FROM truss.edge WHERE id=(outcome_identity->>'id')::bigint AND rel_type_id=relation.rel_type_id;
  IF FOUND THEN
   FOR endpoint IN SELECT o.*,t.document_id,t.module FROM truss.object o JOIN truss.type_def t ON t.type_id=o.type_id
    WHERE (o.id=edge_row.source_id AND o.type_id=edge_row.source_type OR o.id=edge_row.target_id AND o.type_id=edge_row.target_type) LOOP
    IF NOT truss.runtime_can_read(endpoint.document_id,endpoint.module) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'current retained report endpoint reader required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
    IF endpoint.root_id IS NOT NULL OR endpoint.root_type IS NOT NULL THEN
     IF NOT owned_selection THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'rootless endpoint import report profile required' USING ERRCODE='0A000';END IF;
     SELECT t.document_id,t.module INTO STRICT root_owner FROM truss.type_def t WHERE t.type_id=endpoint.root_type;
     IF NOT truss.runtime_can_read(root_owner.document_id,root_owner.module) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'current imported endpoint root report reader required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
    END IF;
   END LOOP;
  END IF;
 END IF;
 IF NOT truss.runtime_can_read(source_definition.document_id,source_definition.module) OR NOT truss.runtime_can_read(target_definition.document_id,target_definition.module) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'current report endpoint readers required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
END;
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.lookup_import_source(selection jsonb, maximum_bytes integer, expected_release text, expected_digest text)
 RETURNS bytea
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
 SET row_security TO 'off'
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
AS $function$
DECLARE entity jsonb;kind char(1);ledger truss.runtime_import_source%ROWTYPE;attempt truss.runtime_object_attempt%ROWTYPE;
 identity jsonb;actual jsonb;content bytea;result bytea;creation jsonb;captured_revision int;frontier xid8;
 source_operation jsonb;source_result jsonb;legacy_input jsonb;
BEGIN
 entity:=truss.runtime_history_entity(selection,expected_release,expected_digest);
 captured_revision:=(SELECT rev FROM truss.schema_head WHERE id=1);frontier:=pg_snapshot_xmin(pg_current_snapshot());
 IF maximum_bytes IS NULL OR maximum_bytes NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 16777216 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'bounded provenance output required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 kind:=CASE entity->>'kind' WHEN 'object' THEN 'o' ELSE 'e' END;
 SELECT * INTO ledger FROM truss.runtime_import_source WHERE entity_kind=kind AND entity_id=(entity->>'id')::bigint;
 IF NOT FOUND THEN
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM truss.record_source WHERE entity_kind=kind AND entity_id=(entity->>'id')::bigint) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'original source ledger required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
  -- Absence is meaningful only for an authorized original committed creation.
  creation:=convert_from(truss.read_history(selection,NULL,1,4096,maximum_bytes,expected_release,expected_digest),'UTF8')::jsonb;
  IF creation->>'outcome' IS DISTINCT FROM 'record' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'original committed creation required' USING ERRCODE='P1010';END IF;
  IF creation->'event'->>'writerXid' IS NULL OR (creation->'event'->>'writerXid')::xid8>=frontier THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'creation outside fixed source observation' USING ERRCODE='P1010';END IF;
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM truss.runtime_import_source WHERE entity_kind=kind AND entity_id=(entity->>'id')::bigint)
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM truss.record_source WHERE entity_kind=kind AND entity_id=(entity->>'id')::bigint) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'source absence observation changed' USING ERRCODE='55P03';END IF;
  result:=convert_to('{"outcome":"absent"}','UTF8');
 ELSE
  IF ledger.writer_xid>=frontier THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'committed provenance unavailable' USING ERRCODE='P1010';END IF;
  SELECT * INTO STRICT attempt FROM truss.runtime_object_attempt WHERE id=ledger.group_attempt_id;
  IF attempt.context->'mutationProfile'=truss.runtime_owned_profile() THEN
   SELECT p.plan->'operation',p.result INTO STRICT source_operation,source_result
   FROM truss.runtime_owned_operation p
   WHERE p.attempt_id=attempt.id AND p.operation_index=ledger.operation_index AND p.writer_xid=ledger.writer_xid;
  ELSE
   legacy_input:=convert_from(attempt.input_bytes,'UTF8')::jsonb;
   source_operation:=legacy_input->'operations'->ledger.operation_index;
   source_result:=attempt.results->ledger.operation_index;
   IF convert_from(ledger.original_record,'UTF8')::jsonb->'payloadProfile' IS DISTINCT FROM truss.runtime_import_profiles()->'ownedImportPayloadProfile'
    AND attempt.next_index<>1 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'legacy singleton import creation required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
  END IF;
  identity:=source_result->'identity';
  IF NOT attempt.complete OR ledger.operation_index<0 OR ledger.operation_index>=attempt.next_index
   OR attempt.writer_xid IS DISTINCT FROM ledger.writer_xid
   OR source_result->>'outcome' IS DISTINCT FROM 'created' OR identity->>'id' IS DISTINCT FROM entity->>'id'
   OR identity->>'typeId' IS DISTINCT FROM entity->>'typeId'
   OR identity->'owner' IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object('documentId',entity->>'documentId','moduleId',entity->>'moduleId')
   OR source_operation->>'operation' IS DISTINCT FROM
      (CASE kind WHEN 'o' THEN 'create_object' ELSE 'create_edge' END) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'original qualified import creation required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
  IF NOT truss.runtime_receipt_can_read(attempt.id) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'original creation dependency reader required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
  SELECT to_jsonb(s) INTO actual FROM truss.record_source s WHERE entity_kind=kind AND entity_id=(entity->>'id')::bigint;
  IF actual IS NULL OR actual->>'entity_kind' IS DISTINCT FROM kind::text
   OR actual->>'entity_id' IS DISTINCT FROM entity->>'id' THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'retained native source correspondence required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
  content:=convert_to(actual::text,'UTF8');
  result:=convert_to(jsonb_build_object('outcome','found','loadId',actual->>'load_id','writerXid',ledger.writer_xid::text,
   'contentBase64',replace(encode(content,'base64'),chr(10),''),'sha256',encode(sha256(content),'hex'))::text,'UTF8');
  IF NOT truss.runtime_receipt_can_read(attempt.id) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'current creation dependency reader required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
 END IF;
 PERFORM truss.runtime_history_entity(selection,expected_release,expected_digest);
 IF captured_revision IS DISTINCT FROM (SELECT rev FROM truss.schema_head WHERE id=1) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'provenance context changed' USING ERRCODE='55P03';END IF;
 IF octet_length(result)>maximum_bytes THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'provenance exceeds byte limit' USING ERRCODE='54000';END IF;
 RETURN result;
END;
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.object_group_begin_prepared(original_input bytea, original_documents bytea, original_request bytea, expected_release text, expected_digest text, original_condition_keys bytea, replay_only boolean, app_prepared jsonb)
 RETURNS bytea
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
 SET row_security TO 'off'
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
 SET bytea_output TO 'hex'
AS $function$
DECLARE input_operations jsonb;
 input jsonb;documents jsonb;request jsonb;context jsonb;selected record;archive truss.schema_doc%ROWTYPE;installation truss.catalog_runtime_installation%ROWTYPE;head_revision int;head_registration uuid;
 operation jsonb;admission record;source_slots jsonb;source_slot_list jsonb;source_slot int;source_bytes_by_slot bytea[];source_verified boolean[];person oid;writer xid8;ns bytea;rk bytea;route bigint;prior_generation bigint;receipt truss.request_receipt%ROWTYPE;
 raw jsonb;observation bytea;attempt truss.runtime_object_attempt%ROWTYPE;index int:=0;failure_detail text;retained_basis jsonb;retained_count int;
 admission_aliases jsonb;
BEGIN
 IF replay_only IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'explicit replay probe required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 context:=convert_from(truss.group_context(expected_release,expected_digest),'UTF8')::jsonb;person:=truss.runtime_person(false);writer:=pg_current_xact_id();
 IF original_input IS NULL OR octet_length(original_input) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 1048576 OR original_documents IS NULL OR octet_length(original_documents) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 4194304
  OR original_request IS NULL OR octet_length(original_request) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 65536 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'bounded group required' USING ERRCODE='54000';END IF;
 IF (convert_from(original_input,'UTF8') IS JSON OBJECT WITH UNIQUE KEYS) IS NOT TRUE
 OR (convert_from(original_documents,'UTF8') IS JSON ARRAY WITH UNIQUE KEYS) IS NOT TRUE
 OR (convert_from(original_request,'UTF8') IS JSON OBJECT WITH UNIQUE KEYS) IS NOT TRUE THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'unique original JSON members required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 input:=convert_from(original_input,'UTF8')::jsonb;documents:=convert_from(original_documents,'UTF8')::jsonb;request:=convert_from(original_request,'UTF8')::jsonb;
 input_operations:=input->'operations';
 IF replay_only AND request->>'state' IS DISTINCT FROM 'present' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'request-present replay probe required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 IF input-ARRAY['interfaceVersion','layoutProfile','mutationProfile','valueProfile','catalog','operations','assertedOrigin','preconditions']<>'{}'::jsonb
 OR input->>'interfaceVersion' IS DISTINCT FROM 'truss-group-input/0.1.0' OR input->'catalog' IS DISTINCT FROM '{"selection":"current"}'::jsonb
 OR jsonb_typeof(input_operations) IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
 OR jsonb_array_length(input_operations) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND (CASE WHEN input->'mutationProfile'=truss.runtime_owned_profile() THEN 1024 ELSE 128 END) OR jsonb_typeof(documents) IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
 OR jsonb_array_length(documents) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 512 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'selected bounded object group required' USING ERRCODE='0A000';END IF;
 IF input->'assertedOrigin'->>'kind' IS DISTINCT FROM 'map' OR (input->'assertedOrigin')-ARRAY['kind','entries']<>'{}'::jsonb
 OR jsonb_typeof(input->'assertedOrigin'->'entries') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(input->'assertedOrigin'->'entries') e WHERE jsonb_typeof(e.value->'key') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
 OR e.value-ARRAY['key','value']<>'{}'::jsonb OR (e.value->'value'='{"kind":"null"}'::jsonb OR (e.value->'value'->>'kind'='string'
 AND jsonb_typeof(e.value->'value'->'text')='string' AND (e.value->'value')-ARRAY['kind','text']='{}'::jsonb)) IS NOT TRUE)
 OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_array_elements(input->'assertedOrigin'->'entries'))<>(SELECT count(DISTINCT e.value->>'key') FROM jsonb_array_elements(input->'assertedOrigin'->'entries') e)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'closed scalar asserted origin required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 IF (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_array_elements(input_operations) o WHERE o.value ? 'alias')
 <>(SELECT count(DISTINCT o.value->>'alias') FROM jsonb_array_elements(input_operations) o WHERE o.value ? 'alias') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'unique aliases required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 IF request<>'{"state":"none"}'::jsonb THEN
  IF request->>'state' IS DISTINCT FROM 'present' OR request-ARRAY['state','identity']<>'{}'::jsonb
   OR request->'identity'->>'inputProfile' IS DISTINCT FROM 'truss-group-input/0.1.0'
   OR request->'identity'->>'interfaceVersion' IS DISTINCT FROM 'truss-request-identity/0.1.0'
   OR request->'identity'->>'authorizedScopeIdentity' IS DISTINCT FROM context->>'authorizedScopeIdentity'
   OR jsonb_typeof(request->'identity'->'requestId') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string' OR octet_length(request->'identity'->>'requestId') NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 1024
   OR (request->'identity')-ARRAY['authorizedScopeIdentity','requestId','claimedSha256','inputProfile','interfaceVersion']<>'{}'::jsonb
   OR (request->'identity' ? 'claimedSha256' AND request->'identity'->>'claimedSha256' IS DISTINCT FROM encode(sha256(original_input),'hex')) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'original request identity required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
  ns:=convert_to(context->>'authorizedScopeIdentity','UTF8');rk:=convert_to(request->'identity'->>'requestId','UTF8');
  route:=('x'||substr(encode(sha256(convert_to('group-request','UTF8')||sha256(ns)||sha256(rk)),'hex'),1,16))::bit(64)::bigint;
  IF NOT pg_try_advisory_xact_lock(route) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'request in flight' USING ERRCODE='55P03';END IF;
  SELECT generation INTO prior_generation FROM truss.request_receipt_route_guard WHERE namespace_sha256=sha256(ns) AND request_sha256=sha256(rk) FOR UPDATE NOWAIT;
  IF NOT FOUND AND NOT replay_only THEN INSERT INTO truss.request_receipt_route_guard VALUES(sha256(ns),sha256(rk),0);END IF;
  IF (SELECT count(*) FROM truss.request_receipt WHERE namespace_sha256=sha256(ns) AND request_sha256=sha256(rk))>10000 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'bounded receipt route required' USING ERRCODE='54000';END IF;
  IF (SELECT count(*) FROM truss.request_receipt WHERE namespace_sha256=sha256(ns) AND request_sha256=sha256(rk) AND namespace_identity_utf8=ns AND request_id_utf8=rk)>1 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'unique exact receipt required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM truss.runtime_object_attempt a WHERE a.writer_xid=writer AND NOT a.complete AND a.context->>'authorizedScopeIdentity'=convert_from(ns,'UTF8')
   AND convert_from(a.request_bytes,'UTF8')::jsonb->'identity'->>'requestId'=request->'identity'->>'requestId') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'request already unfinished' USING ERRCODE='55P03';END IF;
  SELECT * INTO receipt FROM truss.request_receipt WHERE namespace_sha256=sha256(ns) AND request_sha256=sha256(rk) AND namespace_identity_utf8=ns AND request_id_utf8=rk;
  IF FOUND THEN
   PERFORM truss.runtime_authorize_retained_request(receipt.storage_row_id);
   IF receipt.payload_state<>'complete' THEN
    PERFORM truss.runtime_authorize_retained_request(receipt.storage_row_id);
    RETURN convert_to('{"outcome":"unavailable","reason":"receipt_expired"}','UTF8');END IF;
   raw:=convert_from(receipt.original_receipt_bytes,'UTF8')::jsonb;
   IF raw->>'profile' IS DISTINCT FROM 'truss-object-group-receipt/0.1' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'selected receipt required' USING ERRCODE='0A000';END IF;
   IF decode(raw->>'inputBase64','base64') IS DISTINCT FROM original_input THEN
    PERFORM truss.runtime_authorize_retained_request(receipt.storage_row_id);
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'request input changed' USING ERRCODE='P1001';END IF;
   SELECT * INTO STRICT attempt FROM truss.runtime_object_attempt WHERE id=(raw->>'attemptId')::uuid;
   IF NOT attempt.complete OR attempt.receipt_id IS DISTINCT FROM receipt.storage_row_id OR attempt.writer_xid IS DISTINCT FROM receipt.original_writer_xid
    OR (attempt.expected_receipt IS NOT NULL AND to_jsonb(receipt) IS DISTINCT FROM attempt.expected_receipt) OR attempt.input_bytes IS DISTINCT FROM original_input
    OR attempt.position_bytes IS DISTINCT FROM truss.runtime_receipt_position(attempt.context,receipt.storage_row_id,receipt.original_writer_xid)
    OR raw->'semantic' IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object('interfaceVersion','truss-group-result/0.1.0','executedCatalogRevision',raw->'semantic'->>'executedCatalogRevision',
     'layoutProfile',input->'layoutProfile','mutationProfile',input->'mutationProfile','results',attempt.results,'aliases',attempt.aliases) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'original receipt position correspondence required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
   IF attempt.context->'mutationProfile'=truss.runtime_owned_profile() THEN
    IF NOT truss.runtime_receipt_can_read(attempt.id) THEN
     RAISE EXCEPTION 'current retained dependency reader required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
    FOR selected IN SELECT DISTINCT r.value->'identity'->'owner'->>'documentId' document_id,
     r.value->'identity'->'owner'->>'moduleId' module FROM jsonb_array_elements(attempt.results) r LOOP
     PERFORM truss.runtime_module_writer_qualified(selected.document_id,selected.module,person);
    END LOOP;
   ELSE
   retained_count:=jsonb_array_length(attempt.results);
   index:=0;FOR operation IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(input_operations) LOOP
    IF NOT attempt.complete OR index<0 OR index>=attempt.next_index OR retained_count<>attempt.next_index THEN
     RAISE EXCEPTION 'complete retained operation required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
    SELECT * INTO STRICT selected FROM truss.runtime_owned_retained_operation_frame(operation,attempt.results->index,
     raw->'semantic'->>'executedCatalogRevision',retained_basis,person);
    retained_basis:=selected.historical_basis;
    PERFORM truss.runtime_module_writer(selected.document_id,selected.module);index:=index+1;
   END LOOP;
   END IF;
   PERFORM truss.runtime_edge_authorize((raw->>'attemptId')::uuid);
   observation:=convert_to(jsonb_build_object('profile','truss-native-create-replay-observation/0.1','sourceEpoch',context->>'sourceEpoch',
    'observingXid',writer::text,'originalWriterXid',receipt.original_writer_xid::text,'receiptStorageId',receipt.storage_row_id::text,
    'receiptGeneration',receipt.lifecycle_generation::text,'receiptSha256',encode(sha256(receipt.original_receipt_bytes),'hex'),
    'actorOid',person::text,'actor',session_user::text,'scopeIdentity',context->>'authorizedScopeIdentity',
    'releaseId',expected_release,'releaseSha256',expected_digest,'basis',CASE WHEN writer=receipt.original_writer_xid THEN 'same_transaction' ELSE 'committed_receipt' END)::text,'UTF8');
   RETURN convert_to(jsonb_build_object('outcome','success','disposition','replayed','durability',CASE WHEN writer=receipt.original_writer_xid THEN 'pending' ELSE 'committed' END,
    'attemptId',attempt.id::text,'semantic',raw->'semantic','receiptToken',truss.runtime_receipt_token(attempt.position_bytes),'observationBase64',replace(encode(observation,'base64'),chr(10),''),'observationSha256',encode(sha256(observation),'hex'))::text,'UTF8');
  END IF;
 END IF;
 IF input->'layoutProfile' IS DISTINCT FROM context->'layoutProfile' OR input->'mutationProfile' IS DISTINCT FROM context->'mutationProfile' OR input->'valueProfile' IS DISTINCT FROM context->'valueProfile' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'current group profile required on receipt miss' USING ERRCODE='0A000';END IF;
 IF replay_only THEN RETURN convert_to('{"outcome":"miss"}','UTF8');END IF;
 -- Build one exact document-ID slot index for this immutable input. The slot
 -- list preserves strict missing/duplicate source failures at first use; the
 -- byte and verification arrays avoid rescanning or recopying source JSON per
 -- owner. This memo is local to the current admission call only.
 WITH docs AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT value,ordinality::int slot,value->>'documentId' document_id
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(documents) WITH ORDINALITY d(value,ordinality)),
 slots AS (
  SELECT document_id COLLATE pg_catalog."C" document_id,jsonb_agg(slot ORDER BY slot) slots
  FROM docs WHERE document_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY document_id COLLATE pg_catalog."C")
 SELECT coalesce((SELECT jsonb_object_agg(document_id,slots) FROM slots),'{}'::jsonb),
  coalesce(array_agg(convert_to(value->>'sourceText','UTF8') ORDER BY slot),'{}'::bytea[]),
  coalesce(array_agg(false ORDER BY slot),'{}'::boolean[])
 INTO source_slots,source_bytes_by_slot,source_verified FROM docs;
 -- Index original alias owners once; an alias target must not rescan all
 -- earlier operations for every owner/type/relationship lookup.
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_object_agg(o.value->>'alias',jsonb_build_object('operation',o.value->>'operation',
  'typeDefinitionPin',o.value->'typeDefinitionPin','relationshipDefinitionPin',o.value->'relationshipDefinitionPin',
  'operationIndex',o.ordinal-1)),'{}'::jsonb) INTO admission_aliases
 FROM jsonb_array_elements(input_operations) WITH ORDINALITY o(value,ordinal) WHERE o.value ? 'alias';
 -- Authorize the full original owner inventory without requiring live targets.
 person:=truss.runtime_person(false);
 -- CREATE source/owner meaning is constant for each exact definition pin
 -- during this read-only admission phase. Retain every original ordinal for
 -- alias-dependent operations; value/shape admission still checks every row.
 FOR admission IN
  SELECT * FROM (
   SELECT value operation,(ordinal-1)::int operation_index
   FROM jsonb_array_elements(input_operations) WITH ORDINALITY o(value,ordinal)
   WHERE (value->>'operation' IS NULL OR value->>'operation' NOT IN ('create_object','create_edge'))
    AND NOT (coalesce(value->>'operation'='update_object' AND value->'target'->>'state'='stored',false)
     AND NOT (value ? 'ownershipChange'))
   UNION ALL
   SELECT creates.operation,creates.operation_index FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (value->>'operation',value->>'typeDefinitionPin',value->>'relationshipDefinitionPin',
     CASE WHEN value->>'operation'='update_object' THEN (value->'target'->'identity')-'id' END)
     value operation,(ordinal-1)::int operation_index
    FROM jsonb_array_elements(input_operations) WITH ORDINALITY o(value,ordinal)
    WHERE value->>'operation' IN ('create_object','create_edge')
     OR value->>'operation'='update_object' AND value->'target'->>'state'='stored' AND NOT (value ? 'ownershipChange')
    ORDER BY value->>'operation',value->>'typeDefinitionPin',value->>'relationshipDefinitionPin',
     CASE WHEN value->>'operation'='update_object' THEN (value->'target'->'identity')-'id' END,ordinal) creates
  ) original_owners ORDER BY operation_index
 LOOP
  operation:=admission.operation;index:=admission.operation_index;
  SELECT * INTO STRICT selected FROM truss.runtime_owned_operation_owner_qualified(operation,admission_aliases,index,person);PERFORM truss.runtime_module_writer_qualified(selected.document_id,selected.module,person);
  source_slot_list:=source_slots->selected.document_id;
  IF source_slot_list IS NULL THEN
   SELECT * INTO STRICT archive FROM truss.schema_doc WHERE doc_id=selected.document_id ORDER BY rev DESC LIMIT 1;
   RAISE NO_DATA_FOUND;
  END IF;
  IF jsonb_array_length(source_slot_list)<>1 THEN
   SELECT * INTO STRICT archive FROM truss.schema_doc WHERE doc_id=selected.document_id ORDER BY rev DESC LIMIT 1;
   RAISE TOO_MANY_ROWS;
  END IF;
  source_slot:=(source_slot_list->>0)::int;
  IF source_verified[source_slot] IS DISTINCT FROM true THEN
   SELECT * INTO STRICT archive FROM truss.schema_doc WHERE doc_id=selected.document_id ORDER BY rev DESC LIMIT 1;
   IF source_bytes_by_slot[source_slot] IS DISTINCT FROM convert_to(archive.document,'UTF8') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'exact original source required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
   source_verified[source_slot]:=true;
  END IF;
  index:=index+1;
 END LOOP;
 -- Predicate owners can differ from all operation owners. Preserve exact
 -- original-source correspondence inside the database before evaluating them.
 IF input ? 'preconditions' THEN
  PERFORM truss.group_condition_key_metadata(original_input,original_documents,expected_release,expected_digest);
 END IF;
 -- Conditions observe the locked prestate before operation planning can fail.
 -- Receipt replay and complete owner/source admission above retain their order.
 IF input->'mutationProfile'=truss.runtime_owned_profile() THEN
  IF NOT pg_try_advisory_xact_lock(1953658227,1735549296) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'graph writer in flight' USING ERRCODE='55P03';END IF;
  LOCK TABLE truss.object IN ROW EXCLUSIVE MODE NOWAIT;
  LOCK TABLE truss.edge IN ROW EXCLUSIVE MODE NOWAIT;
 ELSE
  LOCK TABLE truss.object IN SHARE ROW EXCLUSIVE MODE NOWAIT;
  LOCK TABLE truss.edge IN SHARE ROW EXCLUSIVE MODE NOWAIT;
 END IF;
 PERFORM truss.runtime_evaluate_preconditions(input,original_condition_keys);
 -- Preserve precondition outcome precedence; a stale cache identity is checked
 -- only after the native group has completed the same current admission steps.
 IF app_prepared IS NOT NULL THEN
  SELECT * INTO STRICT installation FROM truss.runtime_current_installation();
  SELECT rev INTO STRICT head_revision FROM truss.schema_head WHERE id=1;
  SELECT r.registration_id INTO STRICT head_registration FROM truss.catalog_registration_request r WHERE r.revision=head_revision;
  IF app_prepared->>'profile' IS DISTINCT FROM 'truss-application-record-preparation/0.1'
   OR app_prepared->'basis' IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object('installationId',installation.installation_id::text,
    'releaseSha256',installation.release_sha256,'sourceEpoch',installation.source_epoch::text,
    'catalogRevision',head_revision,'registrationId',head_registration::text,'documentsSha256',encode(sha256(original_documents),'hex'))
   OR app_prepared->>'inputSha256' IS DISTINCT FROM encode(sha256(original_input),'hex')
   OR jsonb_typeof(app_prepared->'schemas') IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
   OR jsonb_typeof(app_prepared->'operations') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'prepared application basis changed' USING ERRCODE='55P03';END IF;
 END IF;
 INSERT INTO truss.runtime_object_attempt(writer_xid,actor_oid,input_bytes,documents_bytes,request_bytes,context)
 VALUES(writer,person,original_input,original_documents,original_request,
  context||jsonb_build_object('originalAssertedOrigin',input->'assertedOrigin')) RETURNING * INTO attempt;
 IF input->'mutationProfile'=truss.runtime_owned_profile() THEN
  IF app_prepared IS NULL THEN PERFORM truss.runtime_owned_capture(attempt.id);
  ELSE PERFORM truss.runtime_owned_capture_application(attempt.id,app_prepared);END IF;
 END IF;
 RETURN convert_to(jsonb_build_object('outcome','execute','attemptId',attempt.id::text)::text,'UTF8');
EXCEPTION WHEN SQLSTATE 'P1006' THEN
 GET STACKED DIAGNOSTICS failure_detail=PG_EXCEPTION_DETAIL;
 -- The function subtransaction rolls back guard setup and all other effects.
 RETURN convert_to(failure_detail,'UTF8');
END;
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.object_group_finish(attempt_id uuid)
 RETURNS bytea
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
 SET row_security TO 'off'
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
 SET bytea_output TO 'hex'
AS $function$
DECLARE input_operations jsonb;
 attempt truss.runtime_object_attempt%ROWTYPE;input jsonb;request jsonb;semantic jsonb;bytes bytea;receipt_bytes bytea;receipt truss.request_receipt%ROWTYPE;
 ns bytea;rk bytea;operation jsonb;selected record;index int:=0;owner record;current_actor oid;sealed record;
BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO STRICT attempt FROM truss.runtime_object_attempt WHERE id=attempt_id FOR UPDATE NOWAIT;
 IF attempt.writer_xid<>pg_current_xact_id() OR attempt.actor_oid<>truss.runtime_person(false) OR attempt.complete THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'current unfinished group required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
