 input:=convert_from(attempt.input_bytes,'UTF8')::jsonb;request:=convert_from(attempt.request_bytes,'UTF8')::jsonb;
 input_operations:=input->'operations';
 IF input->'mutationProfile'=truss.runtime_owned_profile() THEN
  IF attempt.results<>'[]'::jsonb OR attempt.aliases<>'[]'::jsonb THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'unassembled original owned attempt required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
  SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(p.result ORDER BY p.operation_index),'[]'::jsonb) results,
   coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('alias',p.plan->'operation'->>'alias','identity',p.result->'identity') ORDER BY p.operation_index)
    FILTER(WHERE (p.plan->'operation') ? 'alias'),'[]'::jsonb) aliases,
   array_agg(p.operation_index ORDER BY p.operation_index) ordinals,
   count(*) FILTER(WHERE p.result IS NULL) missing,bool_and(p.writer_xid=attempt.writer_xid) writer_matches
  INTO sealed FROM truss.runtime_owned_operation p WHERE p.attempt_id=attempt.id;
  IF sealed.missing<>0 OR sealed.writer_matches IS DISTINCT FROM true
   OR sealed.ordinals IS DISTINCT FROM ARRAY(SELECT generate_series(0,attempt.next_index-1)) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'complete ordered sealed owned results required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
  attempt.results:=sealed.results;attempt.aliases:=sealed.aliases;
 END IF;
 IF attempt.next_index<>jsonb_array_length(input_operations) OR jsonb_array_length(attempt.results)<>attempt.next_index THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'complete ordered results required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
 IF attempt.context ? 'creationTransitionProfile' THEN
  IF attempt.context->'creationTransitionProfile' IS DISTINCT FROM '{"identity":"truss-unified-create-transition","version":"0.1","sha256":"765d7def5e677dba5d3ed5cdc841b1aa43eb2f4a493f1d2603ff3698536a5396"}'::jsonb AND attempt.context->'creationTransitionProfile' IS DISTINCT FROM '{"identity":"truss-unified-create-transition","version":"0.2","sha256":"073782e2517f2a7e26c8d6479c6266ececf68963681ccfb6a380e9cd16f2e11b"}'::jsonb THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'known original creation storage profile required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
  IF EXISTS(
   SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(input_operations) WITH ORDINALITY o(operation,ordinal)
   LEFT JOIN truss.runtime_object_transition t ON t.attempt_id=attempt.id AND t.operation_index=o.ordinal-1
    AND t.before_object IS NULL AND t.object_id::text=attempt.results->(o.ordinal-1)::int->'identity'->>'id'
    AND t.type_id::text=attempt.results->(o.ordinal-1)::int->'identity'->>'typeId'
   WHERE o.operation->>'operation'='create_object' GROUP BY o.ordinal HAVING count(t.transition_id)<>1) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'one original transition for every completed create required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
 ELSIF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM truss.runtime_object_transition WHERE runtime_object_transition.attempt_id=attempt.id AND before_object IS NULL) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'historical attempts have no synthetic creation transitions' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
 IF input->'mutationProfile'=truss.runtime_owned_profile() THEN
  PERFORM truss.runtime_owned_graph_validate_attempt(attempt.id,true);
 ELSE PERFORM truss.runtime_graph_validate(true);END IF;
 IF input->'mutationProfile' IS DISTINCT FROM truss.runtime_owned_profile() THEN
  PERFORM truss.runtime_edge_authorize(attempt_id);
 END IF;
 -- Marker refresh above can fire triggers. Recheck mutable progress before
 -- reusing the already closed immutable owned result-slot census.
 IF input->'mutationProfile'=truss.runtime_owned_profile() AND NOT EXISTS(
  SELECT 1 FROM truss.runtime_object_attempt a WHERE a.id=attempt.id
   AND a.actor_oid=attempt.actor_oid AND a.writer_xid=attempt.writer_xid
   AND a.next_index=attempt.next_index AND NOT a.complete
   AND a.results='[]'::jsonb AND a.aliases='[]'::jsonb
   AND (SELECT count(*) FROM truss.runtime_owned_operation p
    WHERE p.attempt_id=a.id AND p.result IS NOT NULL)=a.next_index) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'original unfinished owned settlement progress required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
 -- Marker refresh and authorization above may execute write triggers. Issue
 -- identity only after them, for this read-only final-edge validation phase.
 -- Each edge still resolves live module policy/membership independently.
 current_actor:=truss.runtime_person(false);
 IF current_actor IS DISTINCT FROM attempt.actor_oid THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'original current finishing actor required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
 IF input->'mutationProfile' IS DISTINCT FROM truss.runtime_owned_profile() THEN
  FOR owner IN SELECT DISTINCT edge_id,rel_type_id FROM truss.runtime_edge_transition WHERE runtime_edge_transition.attempt_id=object_group_finish.attempt_id LOOP
   PERFORM truss.runtime_edge_validate(owner.edge_id,owner.rel_type_id);
  END LOOP;
 END IF;
 semantic:=jsonb_build_object('interfaceVersion','truss-group-result/0.1.0','executedCatalogRevision',(SELECT rev::text FROM truss.schema_head WHERE id=1),
  'layoutProfile',input->'layoutProfile','mutationProfile',input->'mutationProfile','results',attempt.results,'aliases',attempt.aliases);
 bytes:=convert_to(semantic::text,'UTF8');IF octet_length(bytes)>16777216 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'bounded complete results required' USING ERRCODE='54000';END IF;
 IF request<>'{"state":"none"}'::jsonb THEN
  ns:=convert_to(attempt.context->>'authorizedScopeIdentity','UTF8');rk:=convert_to(request->'identity'->>'requestId','UTF8');
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM truss.request_receipt WHERE namespace_sha256=sha256(ns) AND request_sha256=sha256(rk) AND namespace_identity_utf8=ns AND request_id_utf8=rk) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'exact request already settled' USING ERRCODE='P1001';END IF;
  IF (SELECT count(*) FROM truss.runtime_object_attempt a WHERE a.writer_xid=attempt.writer_xid AND NOT a.complete
   AND a.context->>'authorizedScopeIdentity'=attempt.context->>'authorizedScopeIdentity'
   AND convert_from(a.request_bytes,'UTF8')::jsonb->'identity'->>'requestId'=request->'identity'->>'requestId')<>1 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'one original request attempt required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
  receipt_bytes:=convert_to(jsonb_build_object('profile','truss-object-group-receipt/0.1','attemptId',attempt_id::text,
   'inputBase64',replace(encode(attempt.input_bytes,'base64'),chr(10),''),'semantic',semantic)::text,'UTF8');
  INSERT INTO truss.request_receipt(namespace_identity_utf8,request_id_utf8,original_writer_xid,original_writer_context_bytes,lifecycle_generation,payload_state,original_receipt_bytes)
  VALUES(ns,rk,attempt.writer_xid,convert_to(jsonb_build_object('profile','truss-object-group-writer/0.1','attemptId',attempt_id::text,
   'xid',attempt.writer_xid::text,'actorOid',attempt.actor_oid::text,'actor',session_user::text)::text,'UTF8'),0,'complete',receipt_bytes) RETURNING * INTO receipt;
  IF NOT FOUND OR receipt.storage_row_id IS NULL
   OR receipt.namespace_identity_utf8 IS DISTINCT FROM ns OR receipt.request_id_utf8 IS DISTINCT FROM rk
   OR receipt.original_writer_xid IS DISTINCT FROM attempt.writer_xid OR receipt.payload_state IS DISTINCT FROM 'complete'
   OR receipt.original_receipt_bytes IS DISTINCT FROM receipt_bytes THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'exact original request receipt required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
  UPDATE truss.request_receipt_route_guard SET generation=generation+1 WHERE namespace_sha256=sha256(ns) AND request_sha256=sha256(rk);
 END IF;
 UPDATE truss.runtime_object_attempt SET results=attempt.results,aliases=attempt.aliases,complete=true,receipt_id=receipt.storage_row_id,
  expected_receipt=CASE WHEN receipt.storage_row_id IS NOT NULL AND input->'mutationProfile' IS DISTINCT FROM truss.runtime_owned_profile() THEN to_jsonb(receipt) END,
  position_bytes=CASE WHEN receipt.storage_row_id IS NOT NULL THEN truss.runtime_receipt_position(attempt.context,receipt.storage_row_id,attempt.writer_xid) END WHERE id=attempt_id;
 current_actor:=truss.runtime_person(false);
 IF current_actor IS DISTINCT FROM attempt.actor_oid THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'original current finishing actor required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
 IF input->'mutationProfile' IS DISTINCT FROM truss.runtime_owned_profile() THEN
  FOR owner IN SELECT DISTINCT object_id,type_id FROM truss.runtime_object_transition WHERE runtime_object_transition.attempt_id=object_group_finish.attempt_id LOOP
   PERFORM truss.runtime_owned_row_validate_qualified(owner.object_id,owner.type_id,current_actor);
  END LOOP;
 END IF;
 IF input->'mutationProfile'=truss.runtime_owned_profile() THEN
  -- Group settlement rechecks the complete distinct owner/type set. Repeating
  -- the same policy/schema lookup for every operation adds no authority.
  PERFORM truss.runtime_owned_group_validate(attempt.id,true);
 ELSE
  FOR operation IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(input_operations) LOOP
   SELECT * INTO STRICT selected FROM truss.runtime_owned_operation_owner_qualified(operation,input_operations,index,current_actor);PERFORM truss.runtime_module_writer_qualified(selected.document_id,selected.module,current_actor);index:=index+1;
  END LOOP;
 END IF;
 RETURN convert_to(jsonb_build_object('outcome','success','disposition','applied','durability','pending','semantic',semantic,
  'receiptToken',CASE WHEN receipt.storage_row_id IS NOT NULL THEN truss.runtime_receipt_token(truss.runtime_receipt_position(attempt.context,receipt.storage_row_id,attempt.writer_xid)) END)::text,'UTF8');
END;
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.object_group_metadata(attempt_id uuid, operation_index integer)
 RETURNS bytea
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
 SET row_security TO 'off'
AS $function$
DECLARE metadata jsonb;encoded bytea;entry jsonb;
BEGIN
 metadata:=truss.runtime_object_metadata(attempt_id,operation_index);encoded:=convert_to(metadata::text,'UTF8');
 PERFORM truss.runtime_module_writer(metadata->>'documentId',metadata->>'moduleId');
 IF NOT metadata ? 'source' AND NOT truss.runtime_object_values_readable((metadata->>'typeId')::int) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'current buffered property/item reader required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
 FOR entry IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(jsonb_build_array(metadata->'oldSource',metadata->'oldTarget',metadata->'source',metadata->'target')) WHERE value<>'null'::jsonb LOOP
  IF NOT truss.runtime_can_read(entry->'owner'->>'documentId',entry->'owner'->>'moduleId') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'current endpoint metadata reader required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
 END LOOP;
 RETURN encoded;
END;
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.page_edges(selected_document text, selected_module text, selected_relationship text, anchor jsonb, direction text, page_limit integer, maximum_bytes integer, original_cursor bytea, expected_release text, expected_digest text)
 RETURNS bytea
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
 SET row_security TO 'off'
AS $function$
DECLARE relation truss.rel_def%ROWTYPE;selected truss.type_def%ROWTYPE;installation truss.catalog_runtime_installation%ROWTYPE;
 frozen record;anchor_object truss.object;anchor_root truss.object;anchor_root_definition truss.type_def;root_owner_buffer jsonb[]:=ARRAY[]::jsonb[];root_owners jsonb;edge_context jsonb;root_owner jsonb;
 context jsonb;continuation jsonb;cursor_value jsonb;candidate record;edge_value jsonb;lookahead jsonb;edge_buffer jsonb[]:=ARRAY[]::jsonb[];edges jsonb;edge_bytes bigint:=2;edge_item_bytes bigint;last_key text;last_id bigint;result bytea;revision int;
BEGIN
 PERFORM truss.runtime_person(false);
 IF page_limit IS NULL OR page_limit NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 1000 OR maximum_bytes IS NULL OR maximum_bytes NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 16777216 OR direction NOT IN ('outgoing','incoming') OR direction IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'bounded directed page required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT installation FROM truss.runtime_current_installation();
 IF installation.release_id IS DISTINCT FROM expected_release OR installation.release_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM expected_digest THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'selected edge page runtime required' USING ERRCODE='0A000';END IF;
 SELECT rev INTO STRICT revision FROM truss.schema_head WHERE id=1;
 IF NOT truss.runtime_can_read(selected_document,selected_module) THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 SELECT * INTO relation FROM truss.rel_def WHERE document_id=selected_document AND module=selected_module AND rel_id=selected_relationship AND retired_rev IS NULL;
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 IF relation.lifecycle NOT IN ('independent','owned') OR NOT relation.directed OR relation.composition OR relation.assoc_type_id IS NOT NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'selected directed scalar relationship required' USING ERRCODE='0A000';END IF;
 selected:=truss.runtime_condition_type(anchor);
 IF NOT truss.runtime_can_read(selected.document_id,selected.module) THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 SELECT o AS object,ro AS root,rt AS root_definition INTO frozen FROM truss.object o
 LEFT JOIN truss.object ro ON ro.id=o.root_id AND ro.type_id=o.root_type
 LEFT JOIN truss.type_def rt ON rt.type_id=ro.type_id AND rt.retired_rev IS NULL
 WHERE o.id=(anchor->>'id')::bigint AND o.type_id=selected.type_id;
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 anchor_object:=frozen.object;anchor_root:=frozen.root;anchor_root_definition:=frozen.root_definition;
 IF anchor_object.rev>revision THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'anchor catalog changed' USING ERRCODE='55P03';END IF;
 IF anchor_object.root_id IS NOT NULL OR anchor_object.root_type IS NOT NULL THEN
  IF anchor_object.root_id IS NULL OR anchor_object.root_type IS NULL OR anchor_root.id IS NULL OR anchor_root_definition.type_id IS NULL
   OR anchor_root.root_id IS NOT NULL OR anchor_root.root_type IS NOT NULL
   OR anchor_root.id=anchor_object.id AND anchor_root.type_id=anchor_object.type_id
   OR anchor_root_definition.kind<>'record' OR anchor_root_definition.provisional THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'current anchor aggregate root required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
  IF anchor_root.rev>revision OR anchor_root_definition.since_rev>revision THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'anchor root catalog changed' USING ERRCODE='55P03';END IF;
  IF NOT truss.runtime_can_read(anchor_root_definition.document_id,anchor_root_definition.module) THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
  root_owner_buffer:=array_append(root_owner_buffer,jsonb_build_object('documentId',anchor_root_definition.document_id,'moduleId',anchor_root_definition.module));
 END IF;
 context:=jsonb_build_object('profile','truss-python-edge-page/0.1','installationId',installation.installation_id::text,'releaseSha256',expected_digest,
  'catalogRevision',revision::text,'relationshipPin',truss.runtime_relationship_pin(relation.rel_type_id),'anchor',anchor,'direction',direction);
 IF original_cursor IS NOT NULL THEN
  IF octet_length(original_cursor) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 65536 OR (convert_from(original_cursor,'UTF8') IS JSON OBJECT WITH UNIQUE KEYS) IS NOT TRUE THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'bounded exact edge cursor required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
  cursor_value:=convert_from(original_cursor,'UTF8')::jsonb;
  IF cursor_value-ARRAY['afterId','afterKey'] IS DISTINCT FROM context THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'current edge cursor context required' USING ERRCODE='P1002';END IF;
  IF jsonb_typeof(cursor_value->'afterId') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string' OR cursor_value->>'afterId' !~ '^[1-9][0-9]{0,18}$'
   OR length(cursor_value->>'afterId')=19 AND (cursor_value->>'afterId') COLLATE "C">'9223372036854775807'
   OR jsonb_typeof(cursor_value->'afterKey') NOT IN ('string','null') OR NOT cursor_value ? 'afterKey' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'exact paired edge cursor required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
  last_id:=(cursor_value->>'afterId')::bigint;last_key:=cursor_value->>'afterKey';
 END IF;
 FOR candidate IN SELECT e.id,e.order_key,s.document_id source_document,s.module source_module,t.document_id target_document,t.module target_module FROM truss.edge e JOIN truss.type_def s ON s.type_id=e.source_type JOIN truss.type_def t ON t.type_id=e.target_type
  WHERE e.rel_type_id=relation.rel_type_id AND CASE direction WHEN 'outgoing' THEN e.source_id=(anchor->>'id')::bigint AND e.source_type=selected.type_id ELSE e.target_id=(anchor->>'id')::bigint AND e.target_type=selected.type_id END
   AND truss.runtime_can_read(s.document_id,s.module) AND truss.runtime_can_read(t.document_id,t.module)
   AND (original_cursor IS NULL OR last_key IS NULL AND e.order_key IS NULL AND e.id>last_id
    OR last_key IS NOT NULL AND (e.order_key IS NULL OR e.order_key COLLATE "C">last_key COLLATE "C" OR e.order_key=last_key AND e.id>last_id))
  ORDER BY e.order_key COLLATE "C" NULLS LAST,e.id LIMIT page_limit+1 LOOP
  edge_context:=truss.runtime_edge_read(selected_document,selected_module,selected_relationship,candidate.id,16777216,expected_release,expected_digest);
  edge_value:=edge_context->'edge';
  IF edge_value IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'edge page authority changed' USING ERRCODE='55P03';END IF;
  FOR root_owner IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(edge_context->'rootOwners') LOOP
   root_owner_buffer:=array_append(root_owner_buffer,root_owner);
  END LOOP;
  IF edge_value->'identity'->>'id' IS DISTINCT FROM candidate.id::text OR edge_value->'identity'->>'typeId' IS DISTINCT FROM relation.rel_type_id::text
   OR (CASE direction WHEN 'outgoing' THEN edge_value->'source' ELSE edge_value->'target' END) IS DISTINCT FROM anchor
   OR edge_value->'orderKey'->>'text' IS DISTINCT FROM candidate.order_key THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'edge page selection changed' USING ERRCODE='55P03';END IF;
  IF cardinality(edge_buffer)=page_limit THEN continuation:=context||jsonb_build_object('afterId',last_id::text,'afterKey',last_key);
   lookahead:=jsonb_build_object('sourceDocument',edge_value->'source'->'owner'->>'documentId','sourceModule',edge_value->'source'->'owner'->>'moduleId','targetDocument',edge_value->'target'->'owner'->>'documentId','targetModule',edge_value->'target'->'owner'->>'moduleId');EXIT;END IF;
  edge_item_bytes:=octet_length(edge_value::text);
  edge_bytes:=edge_bytes+edge_item_bytes+CASE WHEN cardinality(edge_buffer)>0 THEN 2 ELSE 0 END;
  IF edge_bytes>maximum_bytes THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'bounded complete edge page required' USING ERRCODE='54000';END IF;
  edge_buffer:=array_append(edge_buffer,edge_value);last_id:=candidate.id;last_key:=candidate.order_key;
 END LOOP;
 edges:=to_jsonb(edge_buffer);IF edges IS NULL THEN edges:='[]'::jsonb;END IF;
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(value ORDER BY value),'[]'::jsonb) INTO root_owners
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT value FROM unnest(root_owner_buffer) AS roots(value)) unique_roots;
 IF octet_length(root_owners::text)>16777216 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'bounded edge page authority context required' USING ERRCODE='54000';END IF;
 FOR edge_value IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(edges) LOOP
  IF NOT truss.runtime_can_read(edge_value->'source'->'owner'->>'documentId',edge_value->'source'->'owner'->>'moduleId') OR NOT truss.runtime_can_read(edge_value->'target'->'owner'->>'documentId',edge_value->'target'->'owner'->>'moduleId') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'current endpoint page reader required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
 END LOOP;
 IF lookahead IS NOT NULL AND (NOT truss.runtime_can_read(lookahead->>'sourceDocument',lookahead->>'sourceModule') OR NOT truss.runtime_can_read(lookahead->>'targetDocument',lookahead->>'targetModule')) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'lookahead page authority changed' USING ERRCODE='55P03';END IF;
 IF NOT truss.runtime_can_read(selected_document,selected_module) OR NOT truss.runtime_can_read(selected.document_id,selected.module) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'current relationship and anchor page reader required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
 FOR root_owner IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(root_owners) LOOP
  IF NOT truss.runtime_can_read(root_owner->>'documentId',root_owner->>'moduleId') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'current endpoint page root reader required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
 END LOOP;
 IF (SELECT rev FROM truss.schema_head WHERE id=1) IS DISTINCT FROM revision THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'edge page catalog changed' USING ERRCODE='55P03';END IF;
 result:=convert_to(jsonb_build_object('edges',edges,'catalogRevision',revision,'continuation',continuation)::text,'UTF8');
 IF octet_length(result)>maximum_bytes THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'bounded complete edge page required' USING ERRCODE='54000';END IF;
 RETURN result;
END;
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.page_import_load_audit(filters jsonb, maximum_entries integer, original_cursor bytea, expected_release text, expected_digest text)
 RETURNS bytea
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
 SET row_security TO 'off'
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
AS $function$
DECLARE actor oid;installation truss.catalog_runtime_installation%ROWTYPE;
 filter_sha text;cursor_value jsonb;frontier xid8;last_observed timestamptz;last_invocation uuid;
 candidate record;cursor_bytes bytea;owner jsonb;owners jsonb;entries jsonb;observed_chunks jsonb;
 source_row truss.runtime_import_load_chunk%ROWTYPE;visible_count int;expected_chunks int;state_value text;
 created_count int;skipped_count int;rejected_count int;observed_from timestamptz;observed_until timestamptz;
 release_check boolean;from_time timestamptz;until_time timestamptz;selected_owners jsonb;
BEGIN
 actor:=truss.runtime_person(false);
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM truss.runtime_import_audit_access a
   WHERE truss.runtime_audit_role_member(actor,a.auditor_oid)) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'current import audit enrollment required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
 IF filters IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(filters) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
  OR filters-ARRAY['invocationId','loadId','nativeActorOid','documentId','moduleId','observedAtFrom','observedAtUntil']<>'{}'::jsonb
  OR maximum_entries IS NULL OR maximum_entries NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 1024 THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'bounded import audit listing required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 IF filters ? 'invocationId' AND (jsonb_typeof(filters->'invocationId') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
  OR filters->>'invocationId' !~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$')
  OR filters ? 'loadId' AND (jsonb_typeof(filters->'loadId') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
   OR octet_length(filters->>'loadId') NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 4096)
  OR filters ? 'nativeActorOid' AND (jsonb_typeof(filters->'nativeActorOid') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
   OR filters->>'nativeActorOid' !~ '^[1-9][0-9]{0,9}$' OR (filters->>'nativeActorOid')::numeric>4294967295)
  OR (filters ? 'documentId') IS DISTINCT FROM (filters ? 'moduleId')
  OR filters ? 'documentId' AND (jsonb_typeof(filters->'documentId') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
   OR octet_length(filters->>'documentId') NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 4096
   OR jsonb_typeof(filters->'moduleId') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
   OR octet_length(filters->>'moduleId') NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 4096)
  OR filters ? 'observedAtFrom' AND (jsonb_typeof(filters->'observedAtFrom') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
   OR filters->>'observedAtFrom' !~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}(\.[0-9]{1,6})?(Z|[+-][0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2})$')
  OR filters ? 'observedAtUntil' AND (jsonb_typeof(filters->'observedAtUntil') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
   OR filters->>'observedAtUntil' !~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}(\.[0-9]{1,6})?(Z|[+-][0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2})$') THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'canonical import audit listing filters required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 IF filters ? 'observedAtFrom' OR filters ? 'observedAtUntil' THEN
  BEGIN
   from_time:=CASE WHEN filters ? 'observedAtFrom' THEN (filters->>'observedAtFrom')::timestamptz END;
   until_time:=CASE WHEN filters ? 'observedAtUntil' THEN (filters->>'observedAtUntil')::timestamptz END;
  EXCEPTION WHEN SQLSTATE '22007' OR SQLSTATE '22008' THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'canonical import audit time filters required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END;
  IF from_time IS NOT NULL AND until_time IS NOT NULL AND from_time>=until_time THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'ordered import audit observed-time range required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 END IF;
 IF filters ? 'documentId' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM truss.runtime_import_audit_access a
   WHERE a.document_id=filters->>'documentId' AND a.module=filters->>'moduleId'
    AND truss.runtime_audit_role_member(actor,a.auditor_oid)) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'qualified import audit module enrollment required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT installation FROM truss.runtime_current_installation();
 IF installation.release_id IS DISTINCT FROM expected_release OR installation.release_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM expected_digest
  OR pg_is_in_recovery() THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'current import audit release required' USING ERRCODE='0A000';END IF;
 filter_sha:=encode(sha256(convert_to(filters::text,'UTF8')),'hex');
 frontier:=pg_catalog.pg_snapshot_xmin(pg_catalog.pg_current_snapshot());
 IF original_cursor IS NOT NULL THEN
  IF octet_length(original_cursor) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 65536
   OR (convert_from(original_cursor,'UTF8') IS JSON OBJECT WITH UNIQUE KEYS) IS NOT TRUE THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'bounded exact import audit listing cursor required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
  cursor_value:=convert_from(original_cursor,'UTF8')::jsonb;
  IF cursor_value-ARRAY['profile','installationId','sourceEpoch','releaseId','releaseSha256','frontierXid',
       'filtersSha256','afterObservedAt','afterInvocationId']<>'{}'::jsonb
   OR cursor_value->>'profile' IS DISTINCT FROM 'truss-import-load-audit-cursor/0.2'
   OR cursor_value->>'installationId' IS DISTINCT FROM installation.installation_id::text
   OR cursor_value->>'sourceEpoch' IS DISTINCT FROM installation.source_epoch::text
   OR cursor_value->>'releaseId' IS DISTINCT FROM expected_release
   OR cursor_value->>'releaseSha256' IS DISTINCT FROM expected_digest
   OR cursor_value->>'filtersSha256' IS DISTINCT FROM filter_sha
   OR jsonb_typeof(cursor_value->'frontierXid') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
   OR cursor_value->>'frontierXid' !~ '^[1-9][0-9]{0,19}$'
   OR (cursor_value->>'frontierXid')::numeric>18446744073709551615
   OR jsonb_typeof(cursor_value->'afterObservedAt') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
   OR cursor_value->>'afterObservedAt' !~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}\.[0-9]{6}Z$'
   OR jsonb_typeof(cursor_value->'afterInvocationId') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
   OR cursor_value->>'afterInvocationId' !~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'current import audit listing cursor context required' USING ERRCODE='P1002';END IF;
  frontier:=(cursor_value->>'frontierXid')::xid8;
  BEGIN last_observed:=(cursor_value->>'afterObservedAt')::timestamptz;
  EXCEPTION WHEN SQLSTATE '22007' OR SQLSTATE '22008' THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'canonical import audit cursor time required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END;
  last_invocation:=(cursor_value->>'afterInvocationId')::uuid;
  IF cursor_value IS DISTINCT FROM convert_from(truss.runtime_import_load_audit_cursor(
    installation.installation_id,installation.source_epoch,expected_release,expected_digest,
    frontier,filter_sha,last_observed,last_invocation),'UTF8')::jsonb
   OR frontier>pg_catalog.pg_snapshot_xmin(pg_catalog.pg_current_snapshot()) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'exact frozen import audit listing cursor required' USING ERRCODE='P1002';END IF;
 ELSE
  last_observed:='infinity'::timestamptz;last_invocation:='ffffffff-ffff-ffff-ffff-ffffffffffff'::uuid;
 END IF;
 FOR candidate IN
  SELECT c.invocation_id,max(c.audit_observed_at) observed_until
   FROM truss.runtime_import_load_chunk c
   WHERE c.writer_xid<frontier
   GROUP BY c.invocation_id
   HAVING (original_cursor IS NULL OR (max(c.audit_observed_at),c.invocation_id)<(last_observed,last_invocation))
    AND (NOT filters ? 'documentId' OR bool_or(c.original_owners @> jsonb_build_array(
      jsonb_build_object('documentId',filters->>'documentId','moduleId',filters->>'moduleId'))))
    AND (from_time IS NULL OR max(c.audit_observed_at)>=from_time)
    AND (until_time IS NULL OR min(c.audit_observed_at)<until_time)
   ORDER BY max(c.audit_observed_at) DESC,c.invocation_id DESC
 LOOP
  SELECT * INTO STRICT source_row FROM truss.runtime_import_load_chunk c
   WHERE c.invocation_id=candidate.invocation_id AND c.writer_xid<frontier ORDER BY c.chunk_index LIMIT 1;
  -- Each invocation must retain one exact origin/input/owner/actor basis.
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM truss.runtime_import_load_chunk c WHERE c.invocation_id=candidate.invocation_id
    AND c.writer_xid<frontier AND (c.load_id IS DISTINCT FROM source_row.load_id
     OR c.original_asserted_origin IS DISTINCT FROM source_row.original_asserted_origin
     OR c.asserted_origin_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM source_row.asserted_origin_sha256
     OR c.input_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM source_row.input_sha256 OR c.input_count IS DISTINCT FROM source_row.input_count
     OR c.total_chunks IS DISTINCT FROM source_row.total_chunks OR c.original_owners IS DISTINCT FROM source_row.original_owners
     OR c.owner_inventory_complete IS DISTINCT FROM source_row.owner_inventory_complete
     OR c.native_actor IS DISTINCT FROM source_row.native_actor OR c.native_actor_name IS DISTINCT FROM source_row.native_actor_name)) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'inconsistent retained import invocation' USING ERRCODE='P1010';END IF;
  IF source_row.owner_inventory_complete IS NOT TRUE THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'complete original import owner inventory required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
  owners:=source_row.original_owners;
  IF jsonb_array_length(owners)=0 THEN PERFORM truss.runtime_person(true);END IF;
  IF NOT filters ? 'documentId' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(owners) owner(value) WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM truss.runtime_import_audit_access a WHERE a.document_id=owner.value->>'documentId' AND a.module=owner.value->>'moduleId' AND truss.runtime_audit_role_member(actor,a.auditor_oid))) THEN CONTINUE;END IF;
  FOR owner IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(owners) LOOP
   IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM truss.runtime_import_audit_access a WHERE a.document_id=owner->>'documentId'
     AND a.module=owner->>'moduleId' AND truss.runtime_audit_role_member(actor,a.auditor_oid)) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'complete original load audit membership required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
  END LOOP;
  IF filters ? 'invocationId' AND candidate.invocation_id::text IS DISTINCT FROM filters->>'invocationId' THEN CONTINUE;END IF;
  IF filters ? 'loadId' AND source_row.load_id IS DISTINCT FROM filters->>'loadId' THEN CONTINUE;END IF;
  IF filters ? 'nativeActorOid' AND source_row.native_actor::text IS DISTINCT FROM filters->>'nativeActorOid' THEN CONTINUE;END IF;
  SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(c.chunk_index::text ORDER BY c.chunk_index),'[]'::jsonb),count(*),min(c.audit_observed_at),max(c.audit_observed_at)
   INTO observed_chunks,visible_count,observed_from,observed_until
   FROM truss.runtime_import_load_chunk c WHERE c.invocation_id=candidate.invocation_id AND c.writer_xid<frontier;
  expected_chunks:=source_row.total_chunks;
  state_value:=CASE WHEN visible_count=expected_chunks AND
   (SELECT count(DISTINCT c.chunk_index)=expected_chunks FROM truss.runtime_import_load_chunk c
    WHERE c.invocation_id=candidate.invocation_id AND c.writer_xid<frontier) THEN 'complete' ELSE 'partial' END;
  SELECT count(*) FILTER(WHERE e.value->>'outcome'='created'),
   count(*) FILTER(WHERE e.value->>'outcome'='skipped'),
   count(*) FILTER(WHERE e.value->>'outcome'='rejected')
   INTO created_count,skipped_count,rejected_count
   FROM truss.runtime_import_load_chunk c CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(c.entries) e(value)
   WHERE c.invocation_id=candidate.invocation_id AND c.writer_xid<frontier;
  SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('chunkIndex',c.chunk_index::text,
     'observedAt',to_char(c.audit_observed_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"'),
     'createdCount',(SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_array_elements(c.entries) e(value) WHERE e.value->>'outcome'='created')::text,
     'skippedCount',(SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_array_elements(c.entries) e(value) WHERE e.value->>'outcome'='skipped')::text,
     'rejectedCount',(SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_array_elements(c.entries) e(value) WHERE e.value->>'outcome'='rejected')::text)
     ORDER BY c.chunk_index),'[]'::jsonb)
   INTO entries FROM truss.runtime_import_load_chunk c
   WHERE c.invocation_id=candidate.invocation_id AND c.writer_xid<frontier;
  IF jsonb_array_length(entries)>maximum_entries THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'whole import audit invocation exceeds page limit' USING ERRCODE='54000';END IF;
  cursor_bytes:=truss.runtime_import_load_audit_cursor(installation.installation_id,installation.source_epoch,
    expected_release,expected_digest,frontier,filter_sha,candidate.observed_until,candidate.invocation_id);
  -- Freshly recheck the complete owner union before release.
  IF jsonb_array_length(owners)=0 THEN PERFORM truss.runtime_person(true);END IF;
  FOR owner IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(owners) LOOP
   IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM truss.runtime_import_audit_access a WHERE a.document_id=owner->>'documentId'
     AND a.module=owner->>'moduleId' AND truss.runtime_audit_role_member(actor,a.auditor_oid)) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'load audit authority changed before listing release' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
  END LOOP;
  PERFORM truss.runtime_person(false);
  RETURN convert_to(jsonb_build_object('outcome','summary','invocationId',candidate.invocation_id::text,
   'loadId',source_row.load_id,'assertedOriginSha256',source_row.asserted_origin_sha256,
   'nativeActorOid',source_row.native_actor::text,'nativeActorName',source_row.native_actor_name,
   'inputSha256',source_row.input_sha256,'inputCount',source_row.input_count::text,
   'totalChunks',expected_chunks::text,'observedChunkCount',visible_count::text,'observedChunks',observed_chunks,
   'state',state_value,'observedAtFrom',to_char(observed_from AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"'),
   'observedAtUntil',to_char(observed_until AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"'),
   'createdCount',created_count::text,'skippedCount',skipped_count::text,'rejectedCount',rejected_count::text,
   'chunks',entries,'nextPageCursor',convert_from(cursor_bytes,'UTF8')::jsonb)::text,'UTF8');
 END LOOP;
 IF filters ? 'documentId' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM truss.runtime_import_audit_access a
   WHERE a.document_id=filters->>'documentId' AND a.module=filters->>'moduleId'
    AND truss.runtime_audit_role_member(actor,a.auditor_oid)) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'load audit module authority changed before empty-page release' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
 PERFORM truss.runtime_person(false);
 RETURN convert_to('{"outcome":"end","nextPageCursor":null}'::text,'UTF8');
END;
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.page_mutation_group_audit(filters jsonb, maximum_events integer, original_cursor bytea, expected_release text, expected_digest text)
 RETURNS bytea
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
 SET row_security TO 'off'
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
AS $function$
DECLARE actor oid;installation truss.catalog_runtime_installation%ROWTYPE;filter_sha text;
 cursor_value jsonb;frontier xid8;last_observed timestamptz;last_attempt uuid;candidate record;
 group_bytes bytea;group_value jsonb;cursor_bytes bytea;key_filter jsonb;release_check bytea;selected_key record;scope_owner jsonb;
BEGIN
 actor:=truss.runtime_person(false);
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM truss.runtime_import_audit_access a
   WHERE truss.runtime_audit_role_member(actor,a.auditor_oid)) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'current mutation audit enrollment required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
 IF filters IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(filters) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
  OR filters-ARRAY['attemptId','documentId','moduleId','entityId','entityType','entityKey','nativeActorOid',
    'assertedAction','observedAtFrom','observedAtUntil','includeData']<>'{}'::jsonb
  OR octet_length(convert_to(filters::text,'UTF8'))>65536
  OR maximum_events IS NULL OR maximum_events NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 4096 THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'bounded mutation-group audit listing required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 IF filters ? 'includeData' AND jsonb_typeof(filters->'includeData') IS DISTINCT FROM 'boolean'
  OR filters ? 'attemptId' AND (jsonb_typeof(filters->'attemptId') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
   OR filters->>'attemptId' !~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$')
  OR (filters ? 'documentId') IS DISTINCT FROM (filters ? 'moduleId')
  OR filters ? 'entityId' AND (filters ? 'entityType') IS NOT TRUE
  OR filters ? 'nativeActorOid' AND (jsonb_typeof(filters->'nativeActorOid') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
   OR filters->>'nativeActorOid' !~ '^[1-9][0-9]{0,9}$' OR (filters->>'nativeActorOid')::numeric>4294967295)
  OR filters ? 'entityId' AND (jsonb_typeof(filters->'entityId') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
   OR filters->>'entityId' !~ '^[1-9][0-9]{0,18}$')
  OR filters ? 'entityType' AND (jsonb_typeof(filters->'entityType') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
   OR filters->>'entityType' !~ '^[1-9][0-9]{0,9}$')
  OR filters ? 'entityKey' AND NOT (filters->'entityKey' ? 'recordId') AND (jsonb_typeof(filters->'entityKey') IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
   OR (filters->'entityKey')-ARRAY['documentId','moduleId','typeId','keyNumber','definitionPin','values']<>'{}'::jsonb
   OR jsonb_typeof(filters->'entityKey'->'documentId') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
   OR octet_length(filters->'entityKey'->>'documentId') NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 4096
   OR jsonb_typeof(filters->'entityKey'->'moduleId') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
   OR octet_length(filters->'entityKey'->>'moduleId') NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 4096
   OR jsonb_typeof(filters->'entityKey'->'typeId') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
   OR filters->'entityKey'->>'typeId' !~ '^[1-9][0-9]{0,9}$'
   OR (filters->'entityKey'->>'typeId')::numeric>2147483647
   OR jsonb_typeof(filters->'entityKey'->'keyNumber') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
   OR filters->'entityKey'->>'keyNumber' !~ '^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,4})$'
   OR (filters->'entityKey'->>'keyNumber')::numeric>32767
   OR jsonb_typeof(filters->'entityKey'->'definitionPin') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
   OR octet_length(filters->'entityKey'->>'definitionPin') NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 256
   OR jsonb_typeof(filters->'entityKey'->'values') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
   OR jsonb_array_length(filters->'entityKey'->'values') NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 128)
  OR filters ? 'documentId' AND (jsonb_typeof(filters->'documentId') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
   OR octet_length(filters->>'documentId') NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 4096)
  OR filters ? 'moduleId' AND (jsonb_typeof(filters->'moduleId') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
   OR octet_length(filters->>'moduleId') NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 4096)
  OR filters ? 'assertedAction' AND (jsonb_typeof(filters->'assertedAction') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
   OR octet_length(filters->>'assertedAction') NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 4096)
  OR filters ? 'observedAtFrom' AND (jsonb_typeof(filters->'observedAtFrom') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
   OR filters->>'observedAtFrom' !~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}(\.[0-9]{1,6})?(Z|[+-][0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2})$')
  OR filters ? 'observedAtUntil' AND (jsonb_typeof(filters->'observedAtUntil') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
   OR filters->>'observedAtUntil' !~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}(\.[0-9]{1,6})?(Z|[+-][0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2})$') THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'canonical bounded mutation audit filters required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 IF filters ? 'documentId' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM truss.runtime_import_audit_access a
   WHERE a.document_id=filters->>'documentId' AND a.module=filters->>'moduleId'
    AND truss.runtime_audit_role_member(actor,a.auditor_oid)) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'qualified mutation audit module enrollment required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
 IF filters ? 'assertedAction' AND octet_length(convert_to(filters->>'assertedAction','UTF8'))>4096 THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'bounded mutation audit action required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 IF filters ? 'observedAtFrom' AND filters ? 'observedAtUntil' THEN
  BEGIN
   IF (filters->>'observedAtFrom')::timestamptz >= (filters->>'observedAtUntil')::timestamptz THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'ordered observed-time range required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
  EXCEPTION WHEN SQLSTATE '22007' OR SQLSTATE '22008' THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'canonical mutation audit time range required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END;
 END IF;
 IF filters ? 'entityKey' AND filters->'entityKey' ? 'recordId' THEN
  key_filter:=filters->'entityKey';
  IF key_filter-ARRAY['documentId','moduleId','recordId','keyId','values']<>'{}'::jsonb
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM unnest(ARRAY['documentId','moduleId','recordId','keyId']) n(name)
    WHERE jsonb_typeof(key_filter->n.name) IS DISTINCT FROM 'string' OR octet_length(key_filter->>n.name) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 4096)
   OR jsonb_typeof(key_filter->'values') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
   OR key_filter->>'documentId' IS DISTINCT FROM filters->>'documentId' OR key_filter->>'moduleId' IS DISTINCT FROM filters->>'moduleId' THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'qualified named key reference required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
  IF truss.runtime_can_read(key_filter->>'documentId',key_filter->>'moduleId') IS NOT TRUE THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'separate key data readership required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
  SELECT t.type_id,k.key_num,d.definition_pin INTO selected_key
   FROM truss.type_def t JOIN truss.key_def k ON k.type_id=t.type_id
   JOIN truss.runtime_definition_source d ON d.rev=k.definition_rev AND d.ord=k.definition_doc_ord
    AND d.doc_id=k.definition_document_id AND d.module_id=t.module AND d.element_id=t.element AND d.kind='key' AND d.key_id=k.key_id
   WHERE t.document_id=key_filter->>'documentId' AND t.module=key_filter->>'moduleId'
    AND t.element=key_filter->>'recordId' AND t.retired_rev IS NULL AND k.key_id=key_filter->>'keyId' AND k.retired_rev IS NULL;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'current named key reference unavailable' USING ERRCODE='P1002';END IF;
  filters:=jsonb_set(filters,'{entityKey}',jsonb_build_object('documentId',key_filter->>'documentId','moduleId',key_filter->>'moduleId',
   'typeId',selected_key.type_id::text,'keyNumber',selected_key.key_num::text,'definitionPin',selected_key.definition_pin,'values',key_filter->'values'));
 END IF;
 IF filters ? 'entityKey' THEN
  key_filter:=filters->'entityKey';
  IF jsonb_typeof(key_filter) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
   OR key_filter-ARRAY['documentId','moduleId','typeId','keyNumber','definitionPin','values']<>'{}'::jsonb
   OR jsonb_typeof(key_filter->'documentId') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
   OR jsonb_typeof(key_filter->'moduleId') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
   OR jsonb_typeof(key_filter->'typeId') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string' OR key_filter->>'typeId' !~ '^[1-9][0-9]{0,9}$'
   OR length(key_filter->>'typeId')=10 AND key_filter->>'typeId' COLLATE "C">'2147483647'
   OR jsonb_typeof(key_filter->'keyNumber') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string' OR key_filter->>'keyNumber' !~ '^[1-9][0-9]{0,4}$'
   OR (key_filter->>'keyNumber')::int>32767
   OR jsonb_typeof(key_filter->'definitionPin') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string' OR key_filter->>'definitionPin' !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
   OR jsonb_typeof(key_filter->'values') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
   OR jsonb_array_length(key_filter->'values') NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 32 THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'exact archived entity-key filter required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
  IF key_filter->>'documentId' IS DISTINCT FROM filters->>'documentId'
   OR key_filter->>'moduleId' IS DISTINCT FROM filters->>'moduleId' THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'entity-key and module listing scopes must agree' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 END IF;
 IF octet_length(convert_to(filters::text,'UTF8'))>16384 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'mutation audit filters exceed limits' USING ERRCODE='54000';END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT installation FROM truss.runtime_current_installation();
 IF installation.release_id IS DISTINCT FROM expected_release OR installation.release_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM expected_digest
  OR pg_is_in_recovery() THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'current mutation audit release required' USING ERRCODE='0A000';END IF;
 filter_sha:=encode(sha256(convert_to(filters::text,'UTF8')),'hex');
 frontier:=pg_catalog.pg_snapshot_xmin(pg_catalog.pg_current_snapshot());
 IF filters ? 'documentId' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM truss.runtime_object_attempt a
   WHERE a.complete AND a.writer_xid<frontier AND a.audit_observed_at IS NULL
    AND (NOT filters ? 'documentId' OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM truss.runtime_owned_operation p WHERE p.attempt_id=a.id AND p.writer_xid=a.writer_xid
     AND jsonb_path_exists(p.plan,'$.** ? (@.documentId == $document && @.moduleId == $module)',
      jsonb_build_object('document',to_jsonb(filters->>'documentId'),'module',to_jsonb(filters->>'moduleId')))))) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'retained mutation group has no truthful observation time' USING ERRCODE='P1010';END IF;
 IF original_cursor IS NOT NULL THEN
  IF octet_length(original_cursor) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 65536
   OR (convert_from(original_cursor,'UTF8') IS JSON OBJECT WITH UNIQUE KEYS) IS NOT TRUE THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'bounded exact mutation audit cursor required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
  cursor_value:=convert_from(original_cursor,'UTF8')::jsonb;
  IF cursor_value-ARRAY['profile','installationId','sourceEpoch','releaseId','releaseSha256','frontierXid',
      'filtersSha256','afterObservedAt','afterAttemptId']<>'{}'::jsonb
   OR cursor_value->>'profile' IS DISTINCT FROM 'truss-mutation-group-audit-cursor/0.2'
   OR cursor_value->>'installationId' IS DISTINCT FROM installation.installation_id::text
   OR cursor_value->>'sourceEpoch' IS DISTINCT FROM installation.source_epoch::text
   OR cursor_value->>'releaseId' IS DISTINCT FROM expected_release
   OR cursor_value->>'releaseSha256' IS DISTINCT FROM expected_digest
   OR cursor_value->>'filtersSha256' IS DISTINCT FROM filter_sha
   OR jsonb_typeof(cursor_value->'frontierXid') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
   OR cursor_value->>'frontierXid' !~ '^[1-9][0-9]{0,19}$'
   OR (cursor_value->>'frontierXid')::numeric>18446744073709551615
   OR jsonb_typeof(cursor_value->'afterObservedAt') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
   OR cursor_value->>'afterObservedAt' !~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}\.[0-9]{6}Z$'
   OR jsonb_typeof(cursor_value->'afterAttemptId') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
   OR cursor_value->>'afterAttemptId' !~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'current mutation audit cursor context required' USING ERRCODE='P1002';END IF;
  frontier:=(cursor_value->>'frontierXid')::xid8;
  BEGIN last_observed:=(cursor_value->>'afterObservedAt')::timestamptz;
  EXCEPTION WHEN SQLSTATE '22007' OR SQLSTATE '22008' THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'canonical mutation audit cursor timestamp required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END;
  last_attempt:=(cursor_value->>'afterAttemptId')::uuid;
  IF cursor_value IS DISTINCT FROM convert_from(truss.runtime_mutation_audit_cursor(
    installation.installation_id,installation.source_epoch,expected_release,expected_digest,
    frontier,filter_sha,last_observed,last_attempt),'UTF8')::jsonb
   OR frontier>pg_catalog.pg_snapshot_xmin(pg_catalog.pg_current_snapshot()) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'exact frozen mutation audit cursor required' USING ERRCODE='P1002';END IF;
 ELSE
  last_observed:='infinity'::timestamptz;last_attempt:='ffffffff-ffff-ffff-ffff-ffffffffffff'::uuid;
 END IF;
 FOR candidate IN SELECT a.id,a.writer_xid,a.audit_observed_at FROM truss.runtime_object_attempt a
  WHERE a.complete AND a.audit_observed_at IS NOT NULL AND a.writer_xid<frontier
   AND a.audit_observed_at IS NOT NULL
   AND (NOT filters ? 'documentId' OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM truss.runtime_owned_operation p WHERE p.attempt_id=a.id AND p.writer_xid=a.writer_xid
    AND jsonb_path_exists(p.plan,'$.** ? (@.documentId == $document && @.moduleId == $module)',
     jsonb_build_object('document',to_jsonb(filters->>'documentId'),'module',to_jsonb(filters->>'moduleId')))))
   AND (original_cursor IS NULL OR (a.audit_observed_at,a.id)<(last_observed,last_attempt))
   AND (NOT filters ? 'attemptId' OR a.id=(filters->>'attemptId')::uuid)
   AND (NOT filters ? 'nativeActorOid' OR a.actor_oid=(filters->>'nativeActorOid')::oid)
  ORDER BY a.audit_observed_at DESC,a.id DESC LOOP
  -- Authorize and validate the complete original owner union before applying
  -- identity or business-key filters that inspect retained private values.
  BEGIN
   group_bytes:=truss.runtime_read_mutation_group_audit(candidate.id,maximum_events,expected_release,expected_digest,coalesce((filters->>'includeData')::boolean,false));
  EXCEPTION WHEN SQLSTATE 'P1403' THEN
   IF filters ? 'documentId' THEN RAISE;ELSE CONTINUE;END IF;
  END;
  group_value:=convert_from(group_bytes,'UTF8')::jsonb;
  IF filters ? 'documentId' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(group_value->'ownerScopes') scope(value)
    WHERE scope.value->>'documentId'=filters->>'documentId' AND scope.value->>'moduleId'=filters->>'moduleId') THEN CONTINUE;END IF;
  IF filters ? 'entityKey' THEN
   FOR scope_owner IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(group_value->'ownerScopes') LOOP
    IF truss.runtime_can_read(scope_owner->>'documentId',scope_owner->>'moduleId') IS NOT TRUE THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'complete retained key data readership required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
   END LOOP;
  END IF;
  IF truss.runtime_mutation_audit_attempt_matches(candidate.id,filters) IS NOT TRUE THEN CONTINUE;END IF;
  cursor_bytes:=truss.runtime_mutation_audit_cursor(installation.installation_id,
    installation.source_epoch,expected_release,expected_digest,frontier,filter_sha,
    candidate.audit_observed_at,candidate.id);
  -- The collector checks the complete historical owner union. Re-run it after
  -- cursor/projection work so revocation during page assembly cannot release
  -- a group on the strength of an earlier membership observation.
  release_check:=truss.runtime_read_mutation_group_audit(candidate.id,maximum_events,expected_release,expected_digest,coalesce((filters->>'includeData')::boolean,false));
  IF filters ? 'entityKey' THEN
   FOR scope_owner IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(group_value->'ownerScopes') LOOP
    IF truss.runtime_can_read(scope_owner->>'documentId',scope_owner->>'moduleId') IS NOT TRUE THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'retained key data readership changed' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
   END LOOP;
  END IF;
  PERFORM truss.runtime_person(false);
  RETURN convert_to((group_value||jsonb_build_object('nextPageCursor',convert_from(cursor_bytes,'UTF8')::jsonb))::text,'UTF8');
 END LOOP;
 IF filters ? 'documentId' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM truss.runtime_import_audit_access a
   WHERE a.document_id=filters->>'documentId' AND a.module=filters->>'moduleId'
    AND truss.runtime_audit_role_member(actor,a.auditor_oid)) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'mutation audit module authority changed before empty-page release' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
 PERFORM truss.runtime_person(false);
 RETURN convert_to('{"outcome":"end","nextPageCursor":null}','UTF8');
END;
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.page_objects(selected_document text, selected_module text, selected_record text, page_limit integer, maximum_bytes integer, original_cursor bytea, expected_release text, expected_digest text)
 RETURNS bytea
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
 SET row_security TO 'off'
AS $function$
DECLARE installation truss.catalog_runtime_installation%ROWTYPE;selected_type truss.type_def%ROWTYPE;
 captured_revision int;source_pin record;cursor_value jsonb;after_id bigint:=0;candidate record;
 objects jsonb:='[]';lookahead_root_owner jsonb;object_bytes bytea;object_value jsonb;continuation jsonb;result bytea;counted int:=0;last_id bigint;
BEGIN
 PERFORM truss.runtime_person(false);
 IF selected_document IS NULL OR selected_module IS NULL OR selected_record IS NULL
  OR octet_length(selected_document) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 4096 OR octet_length(selected_module) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 4096
  OR octet_length(selected_record) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 4096 OR page_limit IS NULL OR page_limit NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 1000
  OR maximum_bytes IS NULL OR maximum_bytes NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 16777216 THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'bounded page selection and limits required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT installation FROM truss.runtime_current_installation();
 IF installation.release_id IS DISTINCT FROM expected_release OR installation.release_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM expected_digest THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'selected object page runtime required' USING ERRCODE='0A000';END IF;
 IF current_setting('transaction_read_only')='on' THEN SELECT rev INTO STRICT captured_revision FROM truss.schema_head WHERE id=1;
 ELSE SELECT rev INTO STRICT captured_revision FROM truss.schema_head WHERE id=1 FOR SHARE NOWAIT;END IF;
 IF captured_revision<1 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'accepted page catalog required' USING ERRCODE='0A000';END IF;
 IF NOT truss.runtime_can_read(selected_document,selected_module) THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 SELECT * INTO selected_type FROM truss.type_def WHERE document_id=selected_document AND module=selected_module
  AND element=selected_record AND kind='record' AND NOT provisional AND retired_rev IS NULL AND since_rev<=captured_revision;
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 IF NOT truss.runtime_object_values_readable(selected_type.type_id) THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT source_pin FROM truss.runtime_owned_definition_metadata('type',selected_type.type_id);
 IF original_cursor IS NOT NULL THEN
  IF octet_length(original_cursor) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 65536 OR (convert_from(original_cursor,'UTF8') IS JSON OBJECT WITH UNIQUE KEYS) IS NOT TRUE THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'bounded original page cursor required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
  cursor_value:=convert_from(original_cursor,'UTF8')::jsonb;
  IF (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(cursor_value))<>11 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_each(cursor_value) e WHERE jsonb_typeof(e.value)<>'string')
   OR cursor_value-ARRAY['profile','installationId','sourceEpoch','releaseSha256','documentId','moduleId','recordId','typeId','definitionPin','catalogRevision','afterId']<>'{}'::jsonb
   OR cursor_value->>'documentId' IS DISTINCT FROM selected_document OR cursor_value->>'moduleId' IS DISTINCT FROM selected_module OR cursor_value->>'recordId' IS DISTINCT FROM selected_record
   OR jsonb_typeof(cursor_value->'afterId') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string' OR cursor_value->>'afterId' !~ '^[1-9][0-9]{0,18}$'
   OR (length(cursor_value->>'afterId')=19 AND (cursor_value->>'afterId') COLLATE "C">'9223372036854775807' COLLATE "C") THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'exact page cursor selection required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
  IF cursor_value->>'profile' IS DISTINCT FROM 'truss-python-object-page/0.1'
   OR cursor_value->>'installationId' IS DISTINCT FROM installation.installation_id::text
   OR cursor_value->>'sourceEpoch' IS DISTINCT FROM installation.source_epoch::text
   OR cursor_value->>'releaseSha256' IS DISTINCT FROM installation.release_sha256
   OR cursor_value->>'typeId' IS DISTINCT FROM selected_type.type_id::text OR cursor_value->>'definitionPin' IS DISTINCT FROM source_pin.definition_pin
   OR cursor_value->>'catalogRevision' IS DISTINCT FROM captured_revision::text THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'current page cursor context required' USING ERRCODE='P1002';END IF;
  after_id:=(cursor_value->>'afterId')::bigint;
 END IF;
 FOR candidate IN SELECT id FROM truss.object WHERE type_id=selected_type.type_id AND id>after_id ORDER BY id LIMIT page_limit+1 LOOP
  counted:=counted+1;
  IF counted>page_limit THEN
   object_bytes:=truss.get_object(selected_document,selected_module,selected_record,candidate.id,16777216,expected_release,expected_digest);
   IF object_bytes IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'page lookahead no longer admitted' USING ERRCODE='55P03';END IF;
   object_value:=convert_from(object_bytes,'UTF8')::jsonb;
   IF object_value->>'catalogRevision' IS DISTINCT FROM captured_revision::text THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'catalog changed during page lookahead' USING ERRCODE='55P03';END IF;
   IF object_value->>'profile'='truss-python-logical-object/0.1' THEN lookahead_root_owner:=object_value->'root'->'owner';END IF;
   continuation:=jsonb_build_object('profile','truss-python-object-page/0.1','installationId',installation.installation_id::text,
    'sourceEpoch',installation.source_epoch::text,'releaseSha256',installation.release_sha256,'documentId',selected_document,
    'moduleId',selected_module,'recordId',selected_record,'typeId',selected_type.type_id::text,'definitionPin',source_pin.definition_pin,
    'catalogRevision',captured_revision::text,'afterId',last_id::text);
   IF octet_length(continuation::text)>65536 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'page cursor byte limit exceeded' USING ERRCODE='54000';END IF;
   EXIT;
  END IF;
  object_bytes:=truss.get_object(selected_document,selected_module,selected_record,candidate.id,maximum_bytes,expected_release,expected_digest);
  IF object_bytes IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'page observation no longer admitted' USING ERRCODE='55P03';END IF;
  object_value:=convert_from(object_bytes,'UTF8')::jsonb;
  IF object_value->>'catalogRevision' IS DISTINCT FROM captured_revision::text THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'catalog changed during page observation' USING ERRCODE='55P03';END IF;
  objects:=objects||jsonb_build_array(object_value);last_id:=candidate.id;
  IF octet_length(objects::text)>maximum_bytes THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'complete page byte limit exceeded' USING ERRCODE='54000';END IF;
 END LOOP;
 PERFORM truss.runtime_person(false);
 IF NOT truss.runtime_can_read(selected_document,selected_module) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'current page reader required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
 IF (SELECT rev FROM truss.schema_head WHERE id=1) IS DISTINCT FROM captured_revision THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'catalog changed during page observation' USING ERRCODE='55P03';END IF;
 result:=convert_to(jsonb_build_object('profile','truss-python-object-page/0.1','catalogRevision',captured_revision,'objects',objects,'continuation',continuation)::text,'UTF8');
 IF octet_length(result)>maximum_bytes THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'complete page byte limit exceeded' USING ERRCODE='54000';END IF;
 IF NOT truss.runtime_object_values_readable(selected_type.type_id) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'current buffered page interpretation reader required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
 FOR object_value IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(objects) LOOP
  IF object_value->>'profile'='truss-python-logical-object/0.1' AND NOT truss.runtime_can_read(
   object_value->'root'->'owner'->>'documentId',object_value->'root'->'owner'->>'moduleId') THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'current buffered aggregate root reader required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
 END LOOP;
 IF lookahead_root_owner IS NOT NULL AND NOT truss.runtime_can_read(lookahead_root_owner->>'documentId',lookahead_root_owner->>'moduleId') THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'current lookahead aggregate root reader required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
 RETURN result;
END;
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.person_runtime_status(expected_release text, expected_digest text, expected_layout jsonb)
 RETURNS bytea
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
 SET row_security TO 'off'
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
AS $function$
DECLARE actor oid;installation truss.catalog_runtime_installation%ROWTYPE;revision int;catalog_state text;
 selected_document text;selected_module text;
BEGIN
 actor:=truss.runtime_person(false);
 SELECT * INTO STRICT installation FROM truss.runtime_current_installation();
 IF installation.release_id IS DISTINCT FROM expected_release
  OR installation.release_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM expected_digest
  OR installation.layout_profile IS DISTINCT FROM expected_layout THEN
  RETURN convert_to('{"outcome":"status","installation":"incompatible","catalog":"unknown"}','UTF8');
 END IF;
 SELECT rev INTO STRICT revision FROM truss.schema_head WHERE id=1;
 IF revision=0 THEN catalog_state:='empty';
 ELSE
  SELECT m.document_id,m.module INTO selected_document,selected_module FROM truss.module_access m
   WHERE truss.runtime_can_read(m.document_id,m.module)
    OR truss.runtime_audit_role_member(actor,pg_catalog.to_regrole(m.writer_role))
    OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM truss.runtime_import_audit_access a WHERE a.document_id=m.document_id
     AND a.module=m.module AND truss.runtime_audit_role_member(actor,a.auditor_oid))
   ORDER BY m.document_id,m.module LIMIT 1;
  IF selected_document IS NULL OR selected_module IS NULL THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'current enrolled module reader required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
  IF NOT (truss.runtime_can_read(selected_document,selected_module)
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM truss.module_access m WHERE m.document_id=selected_document AND m.module=selected_module
    AND truss.runtime_audit_role_member(actor,pg_catalog.to_regrole(m.writer_role)))
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM truss.runtime_import_audit_access a WHERE a.document_id=selected_document
    AND a.module=selected_module AND truss.runtime_audit_role_member(actor,a.auditor_oid))) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'current enrolled module reader required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
  catalog_state:='accepted';
 END IF;
 IF truss.runtime_person(false) IS DISTINCT FROM actor THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'current status person required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
 RETURN convert_to(jsonb_build_object('outcome','status','installation','compatible',
  'catalog',catalog_state)::text,'UTF8');
END;
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.preview_group_conditions(original_input bytea, original_documents bytea, expected_release text, expected_digest text)
 RETURNS bytea
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
 SET row_security TO 'off'
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
AS $function$
DECLARE input jsonb;documents jsonb;truth jsonb;actor oid;current_revision int;
 current_installation truss.catalog_runtime_installation%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
 actor:=truss.runtime_person(false);
 IF original_input IS NULL OR octet_length(original_input)<1
  OR original_documents IS NULL OR octet_length(original_documents)<1 THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'bounded original condition preview required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 IF octet_length(original_input)>1048576 OR octet_length(original_documents)>4194304 THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'condition preview source exceeds limits' USING ERRCODE='54000';END IF;
 IF (convert_from(original_input,'UTF8') IS JSON OBJECT WITH UNIQUE KEYS) IS NOT TRUE
  OR (convert_from(original_documents,'UTF8') IS JSON ARRAY WITH UNIQUE KEYS) IS NOT TRUE THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'unique original condition preview JSON required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 input:=convert_from(original_input,'UTF8')::jsonb;documents:=convert_from(original_documents,'UTF8')::jsonb;
 IF jsonb_typeof(documents) IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' OR jsonb_array_length(documents)<1 THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'original condition documents required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 IF jsonb_array_length(documents)>512 THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'original condition documents exceed limits' USING ERRCODE='54000';END IF;
 IF EXISTS(
  SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(documents) d
   WHERE jsonb_typeof(d.value) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
    OR d.value-ARRAY['documentId','sourceText']<>'{}'::jsonb
    OR jsonb_typeof(d.value->'documentId') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
    OR octet_length(d.value->>'documentId') NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 4096
    OR jsonb_typeof(d.value->'sourceText') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string')
  OR jsonb_array_length(documents)<>(SELECT count(DISTINCT d.value->>'documentId') FROM jsonb_array_elements(documents) d) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'complete unique original preview documents required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 -- The helper is one STABLE SQL statement: every metadata/source/data read and
 -- the reported snapshot token therefore share exactly one MVCC basis.
 SELECT truss.runtime_preview_truth_snapshot(input,documents,expected_release,expected_digest) INTO STRICT truth;
 PERFORM truss.runtime_preview_recheck_authority(truth->'inventory',actor);
 SELECT * INTO STRICT current_installation FROM truss.catalog_runtime_installation WHERE singleton;
 SELECT rev INTO STRICT current_revision FROM truss.schema_head WHERE id=1;
 IF current_installation.release_id IS DISTINCT FROM truth->>'releaseId'
  OR current_installation.release_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM truth->>'releaseSha256'
  OR current_installation.source_epoch::text IS DISTINCT FROM truth->>'sourceEpoch'
  OR current_revision::text IS DISTINCT FROM truth->>'catalogRevision' THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'observed preview basis changed before release' USING ERRCODE='55P03';END IF;
 IF truss.runtime_person(false) IS DISTINCT FROM actor THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'current preview person required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
 RETURN convert_to(jsonb_build_object('outcome','observed','conditions',truth->'conditions',
  'basis',jsonb_build_object('catalogRevision',truth->'catalogRevision','snapshot',truth->'snapshot',
   'sourceEpoch',truth->'sourceEpoch','releaseId',truth->'releaseId','releaseSha256',truth->'releaseSha256',
   'layoutProfile',truth->'layoutProfile'))::text,'UTF8');
END;
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.process_import_chunk(original_input bytea, original_documents bytea, invocation_id uuid, chunk_index integer, expected_release text, expected_digest text)
 RETURNS bytea
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
 SET row_security TO 'off'
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
AS $function$
DECLARE input jsonb;documents jsonb;context jsonb;group_context jsonb;source_map jsonb;selected record;record jsonb;metadata jsonb;
 payload_bytes bytea;payload jsonb;operation jsonb;group_input jsonb;applied jsonb;created jsonb;state text;code text;
 outcomes jsonb[]:='{}';original_records jsonb[]:='{}';counted int;chunk_size int;total_chunks int;budget_rows int;input_digest text;
 origin jsonb;selected_outcome jsonb;result jsonb;source_at text;
 batch_operations jsonb:='[]';batch_sources jsonb:='[]';batch_records jsonb[]:='{}';batch_outcomes jsonb[]:='{}';batch_done boolean:=false;batch_index int:=0;
BEGIN
 context:=convert_from(truss.batched_import_context(expected_release,expected_digest),'UTF8')::jsonb;
 IF original_input IS NULL OR octet_length(original_input)>8388608 OR original_documents IS NULL OR octet_length(original_documents)>4194304 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'bounded original import required' USING ERRCODE='54000';END IF;
 IF (convert_from(original_input,'UTF8') IS JSON OBJECT WITH UNIQUE KEYS) IS NOT TRUE OR (convert_from(original_documents,'UTF8') IS JSON ARRAY WITH UNIQUE KEYS) IS NOT TRUE THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'unique original import required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 input:=convert_from(original_input,'UTF8')::jsonb;documents:=convert_from(original_documents,'UTF8')::jsonb;
 IF input-ARRAY['interfaceVersion','layoutProfile','importProfile','valueProfile','catalog','loadId','assertedOrigin','records','chunkSize']<>'{}'::jsonb
  OR input->>'interfaceVersion' IS DISTINCT FROM 'truss-batched-import-input/0.1.0'
  OR input->'layoutProfile' IS DISTINCT FROM context->'layoutProfile' OR input->'importProfile' IS DISTINCT FROM context->'importProfile'
  OR input->'valueProfile' IS DISTINCT FROM context->'valueProfile' OR input->'catalog' IS DISTINCT FROM context->'catalog'
  OR jsonb_typeof(input->'records') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' OR jsonb_array_length(input->'records')>1024
  OR jsonb_typeof(input->'chunkSize') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string' OR input->>'chunkSize' !~ '^[1-9][0-9]{0,2}$'
  OR (input->>'chunkSize')::int>128 OR jsonb_typeof(input->'loadId') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string' OR octet_length(input->>'loadId') NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 4096
  OR jsonb_typeof(input->'assertedOrigin') IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' OR input->'assertedOrigin'->>'kind' IS DISTINCT FROM 'map'
  OR jsonb_typeof(input->'assertedOrigin'->'entries') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(input->'assertedOrigin'->'entries') e WHERE e.value->>'key'='x-load-id' OR e.value->'value'->>'kind' NOT IN ('null','string'))
  OR (SELECT count(*)<>count(DISTINCT e.value->>'key') FROM jsonb_array_elements(input->'assertedOrigin'->'entries') e)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'selected original chunk profile required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 IF (input->'assertedOrigin')-ARRAY['kind','entries']<>'{}'::jsonb
  OR jsonb_array_length(input->'assertedOrigin'->'entries')>1024
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(input->'assertedOrigin'->'entries') e WHERE
   jsonb_typeof(e.value) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' OR e.value-ARRAY['key','value']<>'{}'::jsonb
   OR jsonb_typeof(e.value->'key') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string' OR jsonb_typeof(e.value->'value') IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
   OR (e.value->'value')-ARRAY['kind','text']<>'{}'::jsonb
   OR (e.value->'value'->>'kind' IN ('null','string')) IS NOT TRUE
   OR e.value->'value'->>'kind'='null' AND e.value->'value' ? 'text'
   OR e.value->'value'->>'kind'='string' AND jsonb_typeof(e.value->'value'->'text') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string') THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'closed original asserted origin required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 origin:=jsonb_set(input->'assertedOrigin','{entries}',(input->'assertedOrigin'->'entries')||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('key','x-load-id','value',jsonb_build_object('kind','string','text',input->>'loadId'))));
 IF octet_length((input->'assertedOrigin')::text)>1048576 OR octet_length(origin::text)>1048576 THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'bounded original asserted origin required' USING ERRCODE='54000';END IF;
 chunk_size:=(input->>'chunkSize')::int;counted:=jsonb_array_length(input->'records');total_chunks:=greatest(1,(counted+chunk_size-1)/chunk_size);
 IF invocation_id IS NULL OR chunk_index IS NULL OR chunk_index<0 OR chunk_index>=total_chunks THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'derived original chunk required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 IF jsonb_array_length(documents)>512 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(documents) d WHERE d.value-ARRAY['documentId','sourceText']<>'{}'::jsonb OR jsonb_typeof(d.value->'sourceText') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string')
  OR (SELECT count(*)<>count(DISTINCT d.value->>'documentId') FROM jsonb_array_elements(documents) d) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'complete unique original documents required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_object_agg(d.value->>'documentId',d.value->>'sourceText'),'{}') INTO source_map FROM jsonb_array_elements(documents) d;
 -- Byte/hash admission precedes identity routing, including skipped records.
 -- Payload interpretation remains after the native live/reserved-identity skip.
 FOR record IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(input->'records') LOOP
  IF jsonb_typeof(record) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' OR record-ARRAY['kind','identity','payload','payloadProfile']<>'{}'::jsonb
   OR (record->>'kind' IN ('object','edge')) IS NOT TRUE OR record->'payloadProfile' IS DISTINCT FROM context->'importPayloadProfile'
   OR jsonb_typeof(record->'payload') IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' OR (record->'payload')-ARRAY['identity','bytesBase64','sha256']<>'{}'::jsonb THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'closed original import record required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
  payload_bytes:=decode(record->'payload'->>'bytesBase64','base64');
  IF record->'payload'->>'identity' IS DISTINCT FROM record->'payload'->>'sha256' OR payload_bytes IS NULL OR octet_length(payload_bytes) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 1048576 OR encode(sha256(payload_bytes),'hex') IS DISTINCT FROM record->'payload'->>'sha256' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'original payload byte integrity required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 END LOOP;
 -- Only finished transactions below every active snapshot are eligible; cleanup
 -- is bounded independently of this call's admitted work.
 DELETE FROM truss.runtime_import_budget WHERE writer_xid IN
  (SELECT writer_xid FROM truss.runtime_import_budget WHERE writer_xid<pg_snapshot_xmin(pg_current_snapshot()) ORDER BY writer_xid LIMIT 128);
 INSERT INTO truss.runtime_import_budget VALUES(pg_current_xact_id(),least(chunk_size,greatest(0,counted-chunk_index*chunk_size)),octet_length(original_input)+octet_length(original_documents))
 ON CONFLICT(writer_xid) DO UPDATE SET records=truss.runtime_import_budget.records+EXCLUDED.records,submitted_bytes=truss.runtime_import_budget.submitted_bytes+EXCLUDED.submitted_bytes
 WHERE truss.runtime_import_budget.records+EXCLUDED.records<=4096 AND truss.runtime_import_budget.submitted_bytes+EXCLUDED.submitted_bytes<=268435456;
 GET DIAGNOSTICS budget_rows=ROW_COUNT;IF budget_rows<>1 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'cumulative import work budget exceeded' USING ERRCODE='54000';END IF;
 group_context:=convert_from(truss.group_context(expected_release,expected_digest),'UTF8')::jsonb;
 -- Independent new rootless objects can share the existing set-based group
 -- writer. A contained eligibility/constraint failure falls through to the
 -- original per-record semantics; stale admission, resource, cancellation and
 -- transaction-retry failures are never retried here.
 IF least(chunk_size,greatest(0,counted-chunk_index*chunk_size))>1 THEN
  BEGIN
   FOR selected IN SELECT value AS record,(ordinality-1)::int AS input_index FROM jsonb_array_elements(input->'records') WITH ORDINALITY
    ORDER BY (value->>'kind'='edge'),ordinality OFFSET chunk_index*chunk_size LIMIT chunk_size LOOP
    record:=selected.record;
    IF record->>'kind' IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'independent object run required' USING ERRCODE='TRB01';END IF;
    metadata:=convert_from(truss.import_object_identity(convert_to((record->'identity')::text,'UTF8'),convert_to(source_map->>(record->'identity'->'type'->'owner'->>'documentId'),'UTF8'),NULL,expected_release,expected_digest),'UTF8')::jsonb;
    IF metadata->>'state'='skipped' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'per-record skip precedence required' USING ERRCODE='TRB01';END IF;
    operation:=truss.runtime_import_operation(record,metadata);
    batch_operations:=batch_operations||jsonb_build_array(operation);
    batch_records:=array_append(batch_records,jsonb_build_object('inputIndex',selected.input_index::text,'record',record));
    batch_sources:=batch_sources||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('operationIndex',batch_index,
     'originalRecordBase64',replace(encode(convert_to(record::text,'UTF8'),'base64'),E'\n','')));
    batch_index:=batch_index+1;
   END LOOP;
   group_input:=jsonb_build_object('interfaceVersion','truss-group-input/0.1.0','layoutProfile',group_context->'layoutProfile','mutationProfile',group_context->'mutationProfile','valueProfile',group_context->'valueProfile','catalog',jsonb_build_object('selection','current'),'preconditions','[]'::jsonb,'operations',batch_operations,'assertedOrigin',origin);
   IF octet_length(group_input::text)>4194304 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'per-record envelope required' USING ERRCODE='TRB01';END IF;
   applied:=convert_from(truss.apply_group(convert_to(group_input::text,'UTF8'),original_documents,convert_to('{"state":"none"}','UTF8'),expected_release,expected_digest),'UTF8')::jsonb;
   IF applied->>'outcome'<>'success' THEN
    state:=CASE WHEN applied->>'outcome'='failed' THEN coalesce(applied->>'nativeState','22023') WHEN applied->>'reason'='resource' THEN '54000' WHEN applied->>'reason'='observation' THEN '55P03' ELSE '0A000' END;
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'independent import group refused' USING ERRCODE=state;
   END IF;
   PERFORM truss.runtime_owned_import_record_sources((applied->>'attemptId')::uuid,batch_sources,input->>'loadId');
   FOR batch_index IN 0..array_length(batch_records,1)-1 LOOP
    created:=applied->'semantic'->'results'->batch_index;
    batch_outcomes:=array_append(batch_outcomes,jsonb_build_object('inputIndex',batch_records[batch_index+1]->>'inputIndex',
     'outcome','created','identity',created->'identity','version',created->>'version','groupAttemptId',applied->>'attemptId'));
   END LOOP;
   original_records:=batch_records;outcomes:=batch_outcomes;batch_done:=true;
  EXCEPTION WHEN SQLSTATE 'TRB01' OR SQLSTATE '22023' OR SQLSTATE '23505' OR SQLSTATE 'P1403' OR SQLSTATE '0A000' OR SQLSTATE 'P1004' OR SQLSTATE 'P1005' OR SQLSTATE 'P1405' THEN
   -- This entire block's database effects have rolled back. Nothing from the
   -- rejected group may enter the original-record/outcome/provenance report.
   batch_done:=false;
  END;
 END IF;
 IF NOT batch_done THEN
 FOR selected IN SELECT value AS record,(ordinality-1)::int AS input_index FROM jsonb_array_elements(input->'records') WITH ORDINALITY
  ORDER BY (value->>'kind'='edge'),ordinality OFFSET chunk_index*chunk_size LIMIT chunk_size LOOP
  record:=selected.record;original_records:=array_append(original_records,jsonb_build_object('inputIndex',selected.input_index::text,'record',record));
  code:=NULL;
  BEGIN
   IF record->'payloadProfile' IS DISTINCT FROM context->'importPayloadProfile' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'selected payload profile required' USING ERRCODE='0A000';END IF;
   IF record->>'kind'='object' THEN
    metadata:=convert_from(truss.import_object_identity(convert_to((record->'identity')::text,'UTF8'),convert_to(source_map->>(record->'identity'->'type'->'owner'->>'documentId'),'UTF8'),NULL,expected_release,expected_digest),'UTF8')::jsonb;
   ELSIF record->>'kind'='edge' THEN metadata:=convert_from(truss.import_edge_identity(convert_to((record->'identity')::text,'UTF8'),expected_release,expected_digest),'UTF8')::jsonb;
   ELSE RAISE EXCEPTION 'object or edge import required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
   IF metadata->>'state'='skipped' THEN
    selected_outcome:=jsonb_build_object('inputIndex',selected.input_index::text,'outcome','skipped','reason',metadata->>'reason');
    IF metadata ? 'identity' THEN selected_outcome:=selected_outcome||jsonb_build_object('identity',metadata->'identity');END IF;
   ELSE
    code:='invalid_payload';
    operation:=truss.runtime_import_operation(record,metadata);
    group_input:=jsonb_build_object('interfaceVersion','truss-group-input/0.1.0','layoutProfile',group_context->'layoutProfile','mutationProfile',group_context->'mutationProfile','valueProfile',group_context->'valueProfile','catalog',jsonb_build_object('selection','current'),'preconditions','[]'::jsonb,'operations',jsonb_build_array(operation),'assertedOrigin',origin);
    code:=NULL;
    applied:=convert_from(truss.apply_group(convert_to(group_input::text,'UTF8'),original_documents,convert_to('{"state":"none"}','UTF8'),expected_release,expected_digest),'UTF8')::jsonb;
    IF applied->>'outcome'<>'success' THEN
     state:=CASE WHEN applied->>'outcome'='failed' THEN applied->>'nativeState' WHEN applied->>'reason'='resource' THEN '54000' WHEN applied->>'reason'='observation' THEN '55P03' ELSE '0A000' END;
     IF state IS NULL THEN state:='22023';END IF;RAISE EXCEPTION 'import record refused' USING ERRCODE=state;
    END IF;
    created:=applied->'semantic'->'results'->0;
    PERFORM truss.import_record_source((applied->>'attemptId')::uuid,convert_to(record::text,'UTF8'),input->>'loadId');
    selected_outcome:=jsonb_build_object('inputIndex',selected.input_index::text,'outcome','created','identity',created->'identity','version',created->>'version','groupAttemptId',applied->>'attemptId');
   END IF;
  EXCEPTION WHEN SQLSTATE '22023' OR SQLSTATE '23505' OR SQLSTATE 'P1403' OR SQLSTATE '0A000' OR SQLSTATE 'P1004' OR SQLSTATE 'P1005' OR SQLSTATE 'P1405' THEN
   GET STACKED DIAGNOSTICS state=RETURNED_SQLSTATE;
   code:=coalesce(code,CASE state WHEN '22023' THEN 'invalid' WHEN '23505' THEN 'conflict' WHEN 'P1403' THEN 'unauthorized' WHEN '0A000' THEN 'unsupported_profile' WHEN 'P1004' THEN 'missing_endpoint' ELSE 'dependencies' END);
   selected_outcome:=jsonb_build_object('inputIndex',selected.input_index::text,'outcome','rejected','code',code);
  END;
  outcomes:=array_append(outcomes,selected_outcome);
 END LOOP;
 END IF;
