 FOR selected IN SELECT r.value AS original,o.value AS result FROM unnest(original_records) r(value) JOIN unnest(outcomes) o(value) ON r.value->>'inputIndex'=o.value->>'inputIndex' LOOP
  IF selected.result->>'outcome' IN ('created','skipped') THEN PERFORM truss.import_report_record_authority(convert_to(jsonb_build_object('originalIdentity',selected.original->'record'->'identity','outcomeIdentity',selected.result->'identity')::text,'UTF8'),selected.original->'record'->>'kind',expected_release,expected_digest);END IF;
 END LOOP;
 IF convert_from(truss.batched_import_context(expected_release,expected_digest),'UTF8')::jsonb IS DISTINCT FROM context THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'original import context changed' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
 input_digest:=encode(sha256(convert_to('truss-batched-import-input/0.1.0'||chr(10),'UTF8')||original_input),'hex');
 PERFORM truss.runtime_record_import_load(invocation_id,chunk_index,total_chunks,input->>'loadId',input->'assertedOrigin',input_digest,counted,input->'records',to_jsonb(original_records),to_jsonb(outcomes),expected_release,expected_digest);
 result:=jsonb_build_object('context',context,'outcomes',to_jsonb(outcomes),'hostTransactionId','truss-pending-transaction:'||(context->>'sourceEpoch')||':'||pg_current_xact_id()::text);
 IF octet_length(result::text)>8388608 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'bounded complete import report required' USING ERRCODE='54000';END IF;
 RETURN convert_to(result::text,'UTF8');
END;
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.query_abi()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$ SELECT '{"identity":"truss-postgresql-logical-query","version":"1.2","sha256":"8266c19d6f1bc4e816d5981cd594b224f09bafd4975e1c851610fa94d1f75f96"}'::jsonb; $function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.query_binding_if_changed(selected_documents jsonb, maximum_scan_rows integer, maximum_result_rows integer, maximum_bytes integer, expected_release text, expected_digest text, validator text)
 RETURNS bytea
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
 SET row_security TO 'off'
AS $function$
DECLARE installation truss.catalog_runtime_installation%ROWTYPE;captured_revision int;actor oid;selected_document_id text;
 compiled record;dependency jsonb;pins jsonb:='[]';readers jsonb:='[]';current_validator text;bundle bytea;result bytea;
BEGIN
 actor:=truss.runtime_person(false);
 SELECT * INTO STRICT installation FROM truss.runtime_current_installation();
 IF installation.release_id IS DISTINCT FROM expected_release OR installation.release_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM expected_digest THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'selected query release required' USING ERRCODE='0A000';END IF;
 IF maximum_scan_rows IS NULL OR maximum_scan_rows NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 10000 OR maximum_result_rows IS NULL OR maximum_result_rows NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 10000 OR maximum_bytes IS NULL OR maximum_bytes NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 16777216
 OR jsonb_typeof(selected_documents) IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' OR jsonb_array_length(selected_documents) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 32
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(selected_documents) v WHERE jsonb_typeof(v.value)<>'string')
 OR (SELECT count(DISTINCT v.value) FROM jsonb_array_elements(selected_documents) v)<>jsonb_array_length(selected_documents)
 OR validator IS NOT NULL AND validator !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'bounded original query validator request required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 SELECT rev INTO STRICT captured_revision FROM truss.schema_head WHERE id=1;
 FOR selected_document_id IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(selected_documents) LOOP
  SELECT metadata->'pin' AS pin,metadata->'readers' AS readers INTO compiled
   FROM truss.runtime_document_schema WHERE rev=captured_revision AND doc_id=selected_document_id;
  IF NOT FOUND OR compiled.pin IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(compiled.readers) IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'current original query schema required' USING ERRCODE='0A000';END IF;
  pins:=pins||jsonb_build_array(compiled.pin);readers:=readers||compiled.readers;
 END LOOP;
 FOR dependency IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(readers) LOOP
  IF NOT truss.runtime_can_read_qualified(dependency->>'documentId',dependency->>'moduleId',actor) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'complete current query reader required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
 END LOOP;
 current_validator:=encode(sha256(convert_to(jsonb_build_object(
  'installation',installation.installation_id::text,'release',expected_release,'digest',expected_digest,
  'revision',captured_revision,'documents',pins,'person',actor::text,'sessionUser',session_user,
  'maximumScanRows',maximum_scan_rows,'maximumResultRows',maximum_result_rows,'maximumBytes',maximum_bytes)::text,'UTF8')),'hex');
 IF validator IS NOT NULL AND validator=current_validator THEN
  result:=convert_to(jsonb_build_object('outcome','unchanged','validator',current_validator)::text,'UTF8');
 ELSE
  bundle:=truss.query_binding(selected_documents,maximum_scan_rows,maximum_result_rows,maximum_bytes,expected_release,expected_digest);
  result:=convert_to(jsonb_build_object('outcome','snapshot','validator',current_validator,
   'bundle',convert_from(bundle,'UTF8')::jsonb)::text,'UTF8');
 END IF;
 -- Do not publish a warm hint after a role/dependency change during observation.
 IF truss.runtime_person(false) IS DISTINCT FROM actor OR captured_revision IS DISTINCT FROM (SELECT rev FROM truss.schema_head WHERE id=1) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'query basis changed during observation' USING ERRCODE='55P03';END IF;
 FOR dependency IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(readers) LOOP
  IF NOT truss.runtime_can_read_qualified(dependency->>'documentId',dependency->>'moduleId',actor) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'complete current query reader required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
 END LOOP;
 IF octet_length(result)>maximum_bytes THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'conditional query binding byte limit' USING ERRCODE='54000';END IF;
 RETURN result;
END;
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.query_edges(binding jsonb, selected_relationship integer)
 RETURNS TABLE(id bigint, source_id bigint, target_id bigint)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
 SET row_security TO 'off'
AS $function$
DECLARE relation truss.rel_def%ROWTYPE;edge_row truss.edge%ROWTYPE;source_object truss.object%ROWTYPE;target_object truss.object%ROWTYPE;row_count int:=0;byte_count bigint:=0;root_identity jsonb;roots jsonb:='{}';root_entry jsonb;
BEGIN
 PERFORM truss.query_scope(binding);
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(binding->'relationships') r WHERE (r.value->>'relationshipTypeId')::int=selected_relationship) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'selected query relationship required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT relation FROM truss.rel_def r WHERE r.rel_type_id=selected_relationship AND r.retired_rev IS NULL;
 FOR edge_row IN SELECT * FROM truss.edge e WHERE e.rel_type_id=selected_relationship ORDER BY e.id LIMIT (binding->>'maximumScanRows')::int+1 LOOP
  row_count:=row_count+1;byte_count:=byte_count+octet_length(edge_row.props::text);
  IF row_count>(binding->>'maximumScanRows')::int OR byte_count>(binding->>'maximumBytes')::int THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'bounded query edge source required' USING ERRCODE='54000';END IF;
  SELECT * INTO source_object FROM truss.object o WHERE o.id=edge_row.source_id AND o.type_id=edge_row.source_type;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'query source endpoint missing' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
  SELECT * INTO target_object FROM truss.object o WHERE o.id=edge_row.target_id AND o.type_id=edge_row.target_type;
  IF NOT FOUND OR edge_row.ver<=0 OR edge_row.rev>(binding->>'catalogRevision')::int OR source_object.ver<=0 OR target_object.ver<=0
   OR source_object.rev>(binding->>'catalogRevision')::int OR target_object.rev>(binding->>'catalogRevision')::int
   OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM truss.rel_endpoint e WHERE e.rel_type_id=selected_relationship AND e.source_type=edge_row.source_type AND e.target_type=edge_row.target_type) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'complete independent query endpoints required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
  FOR root_identity IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(jsonb_build_array(
   truss.query_object_root(binding,source_object),truss.query_object_root(binding,target_object))) WHERE value<>'null'::jsonb LOOP
   roots:=roots||jsonb_build_object((root_identity->>'typeId')||':'||(root_identity->>'id'),root_identity);
  END LOOP;
  IF byte_count+(CASE WHEN roots='{}'::jsonb THEN 0 ELSE octet_length(roots::text) END)>(binding->>'maximumBytes')::int THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'bounded query root witnesses required' USING ERRCODE='54000';END IF;
  id:=edge_row.id;source_id:=edge_row.source_id;target_id:=edge_row.target_id;RETURN NEXT;
 END LOOP;
 FOR root_entry IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_each(roots) LOOP
  IF NOT truss.runtime_can_read(root_entry->'owner'->>'documentId',root_entry->'owner'->>'moduleId') THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'current buffered query aggregate root reader required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
 END LOOP;
 -- Buffer the complete validated edge bag before correlation and key predicates.
 PERFORM truss.query_scope(binding);
END;
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.query_export_page_objects(binding jsonb, selected_type integer, selected_key text)
 RETURNS TABLE(id bigint, props jsonb)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
 SET row_security TO 'off'
AS $function$
DECLARE key_definition truss.key_def%ROWTYPE;component truss.prop_def%ROWTYPE;row record;counted int:=0;
BEGIN
 PERFORM truss.query_scope(binding);
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(binding->'records') r WHERE (r.value->>'typeId')::int=selected_type) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'selected query record required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
 SELECT * INTO key_definition FROM truss.key_def k WHERE k.type_id=selected_type AND k.key_id=selected_key AND k.retired_rev IS NULL;
 IF NOT FOUND OR cardinality(key_definition.prop_ids) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 1024 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'bounded authored page key required' USING ERRCODE='0A000';END IF;
 FOR component IN SELECT p.* FROM unnest(key_definition.prop_ids) WITH ORDINALITY k(prop_id,n) JOIN truss.prop_def p ON p.prop_id=k.prop_id AND p.type_id=selected_type ORDER BY k.n LOOP
  counted:=counted+1;
  IF component.retired_rev IS NOT NULL OR component.scalar_type NOT IN ('string','boolean','integer','decimal') OR component.nullability<>'required' OR component.cardinality<>'one' OR component.home<>'json' OR NOT ((component.scalar_type IN ('string','boolean') AND coalesce(component.facets,'{}')='{}'::jsonb OR component.scalar_type='integer' AND (coalesce(component.facets,'{}')='{}'::jsonb OR component.facets='{"integerWidth":{"bits":64,"signed":true}}'::jsonb) OR component.scalar_type='decimal' AND truss.valid_decimal_facets(component.facets)) IS TRUE) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'required exact page key components required' USING ERRCODE='0A000';END IF;
 END LOOP;
 IF counted<>cardinality(key_definition.prop_ids) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'complete page key required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
 FOR row IN SELECT q.* FROM truss.query_export_objects(binding,selected_type) q LOOP
  id:=row.id;props:=row.props;RETURN NEXT;
 END LOOP;
 -- The preceding SRF validates the complete export source in this snapshot.
 -- Validated typed tuple equality matches emitted C-text/bool/numeric ROW.
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT (SELECT jsonb_agg(CASE property.scalar_type WHEN 'boolean' THEN o.props->property.prop_id::text->'value' WHEN 'integer' THEN to_jsonb((o.props->property.prop_id::text->>'text')::numeric) WHEN 'decimal' THEN to_jsonb((o.props->property.prop_id::text->>'text')::numeric) ELSE to_jsonb(o.props->property.prop_id::text->>'text') END ORDER BY p.n)
  FROM unnest(key_definition.prop_ids) WITH ORDINALITY p(prop_id,n) JOIN truss.prop_def property ON property.prop_id=p.prop_id AND property.type_id=selected_type) AS key_values
  FROM truss.object o WHERE o.type_id=selected_type) source GROUP BY source.key_values HAVING count(*)>1) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'unique authored page key required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
 PERFORM truss.query_scope(binding);
END;
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.query_object_attribution(binding jsonb, selected_type integer, selected_id bigint)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
 SET row_security TO 'off'
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
AS $function$
DECLARE object_row truss.object%ROWTYPE;owner truss.type_def%ROWTYPE;
 registration truss.catalog_registration_request%ROWTYPE;rebound truss.runtime_catalog_rebind_transition%ROWTYPE;
 writer xid8;asserted jsonb;history_profile text;
 attempt truss.runtime_object_attempt%ROWTYPE;selected_transition_id bigint;transition_attempt_id uuid;transition_operation_index int;transition_writer_xid xid8;transition_before_object jsonb;transition_after_object jsonb;transition_journal jsonb;
 physical truss.journal%ROWTYPE;item jsonb;event jsonb;original bytea;actor text;
 created_actor text;updated_actor text;selected_version bigint;events int;used_bytes bigint:=0;
 creation truss.runtime_create_group%ROWTYPE;member jsonb;journals jsonb;expected_actor text;after_image jsonb;
 source_row truss.record_source%ROWTYPE;source_ledger truss.runtime_import_source%ROWTYPE;
 import_record jsonb;import_payload bytea;payload_value jsonb;expected_source jsonb;source_entry jsonb;
 root_identity jsonb;historical_image jsonb;historical_ownership jsonb;owned_mutation boolean;atomic_creation boolean;creation_attempt uuid;operation jsonb;result jsonb;input_header jsonb;event_group jsonb;semantic_events jsonb;event_refs jsonb;legacy_events jsonb[];legacy_event_refs jsonb[];epoch text;
BEGIN
 PERFORM truss.query_scope(binding);
 SELECT source_epoch::text INTO STRICT epoch FROM truss.catalog_runtime_installation;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(binding->'records') r WHERE (r.value->>'typeId')::int=selected_type)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'selected entity metadata scope required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT owner FROM truss.type_def WHERE type_id=selected_type AND retired_rev IS NULL;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT object_row FROM truss.object WHERE id=selected_id AND type_id=selected_type;
 root_identity:=truss.query_object_root(binding,object_row);
 FOR selected_version IN SELECT DISTINCT v FROM unnest(ARRAY[1::bigint,object_row.ver::bigint]) v LOOP
  expected_actor:=NULL;registration.registration_id:=NULL;result:=NULL;transition_journal:=NULL;journals:=NULL;owned_mutation:=false;atomic_creation:=false;
  IF selected_version=1 THEN
   -- Modern creations have an indexed, immutable transition coordinate.
   SELECT a.* INTO attempt FROM truss.runtime_object_transition t
    JOIN truss.runtime_object_attempt a ON a.id=t.attempt_id
    WHERE t.object_id=selected_id AND t.type_id=selected_type AND t.before_object IS NULL AND a.complete;
   IF NOT FOUND THEN
   SELECT a.* INTO STRICT attempt FROM truss.runtime_object_attempt a WHERE a.complete
    AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(a.results) r
     WHERE r.value->>'operation'='create_object' AND r.value->'identity'->>'id'=selected_id::text
      AND r.value->'identity'->>'typeId'=selected_type::text);
   END IF;
   IF attempt.context->'creationTransitionProfile'='{"identity":"truss-unified-create-transition","version":"0.2","sha256":"073782e2517f2a7e26c8d6479c6266ececf68963681ccfb6a380e9cd16f2e11b"}'::jsonb THEN
    SELECT t.transition_id,t.attempt_id,t.operation_index,t.writer_xid,t.before_object,t.after_object
     INTO STRICT selected_transition_id,transition_attempt_id,transition_operation_index,transition_writer_xid,transition_before_object,transition_after_object
     FROM truss.runtime_object_transition t
     WHERE t.attempt_id=attempt.id AND t.object_id=selected_id AND t.type_id=selected_type AND t.before_object IS NULL;
    IF attempt.context->'mutationProfile'=truss.runtime_owned_profile() THEN
     SELECT p.plan->'operation',p.result,p.plan->>'actorName' INTO STRICT operation,result,expected_actor FROM truss.runtime_owned_operation p
      WHERE p.attempt_id=attempt.id AND p.operation_index=transition_operation_index AND p.writer_xid=attempt.writer_xid;
    ELSE
    operation:=convert_from(attempt.input_bytes,'UTF8')::jsonb->'operations'->transition_operation_index;
    result:=attempt.results->transition_operation_index;
    SELECT t.journal INTO STRICT transition_journal FROM truss.runtime_object_transition t WHERE t.transition_id=selected_transition_id;
    END IF;
    IF transition_writer_xid IS DISTINCT FROM attempt.writer_xid OR attempt.next_index<=transition_operation_index
     OR attempt.result_count<>attempt.next_index
     OR operation->>'operation' IS DISTINCT FROM 'create_object' OR result->>'operation' IS DISTINCT FROM 'create_object'
     OR result->>'outcome' IS DISTINCT FROM 'created' OR result->>'version' IS DISTINCT FROM '1'
     OR result->'identity'->>'id' IS DISTINCT FROM selected_id::text OR result->'identity'->>'typeId' IS DISTINCT FROM selected_type::text
     OR result->'identity'->>'definitionPin' IS DISTINCT FROM operation->>'typeDefinitionPin'
     OR transition_after_object->>'id' IS DISTINCT FROM selected_id::text
     OR transition_after_object->>'type_id' IS DISTINCT FROM selected_type::text
     OR transition_after_object->>'ver' IS DISTINCT FROM '1' THEN
     RAISE EXCEPTION 'completed atomic creation attribution required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
    creation_attempt:=attempt.id;journals:=transition_journal;after_image:=transition_after_object;atomic_creation:=true;
    owned_mutation:=attempt.context->'mutationProfile'=truss.runtime_owned_profile();
    IF owned_mutation AND nullif(expected_actor,'') IS NULL
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'original creation actor required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
   ELSIF attempt.context->'creationTransitionProfile' IS NULL OR attempt.context->'creationTransitionProfile'=
    '{"identity":"truss-unified-create-transition","version":"0.1","sha256":"765d7def5e677dba5d3ed5cdc841b1aa43eb2f4a493f1d2603ff3698536a5396"}'::jsonb THEN
   SELECT g.* INTO STRICT creation FROM truss.runtime_create_group g
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(g.expected_members) m
    WHERE m.value->'object'->>'id'=selected_id::text AND m.value->'object'->>'type_id'=selected_type::text;
   SELECT m.value INTO STRICT member FROM jsonb_array_elements(creation.expected_members) m
    WHERE m.value->'object'->>'id'=selected_id::text AND m.value->'object'->>'type_id'=selected_type::text;
   SELECT a.* INTO STRICT attempt FROM truss.runtime_object_attempt a
    WHERE a.complete AND a.writer_xid=creation.writer_xid AND a.actor_oid=creation.actor_oid
    AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(a.results) r
      WHERE r.value->>'operation'='create_object' AND r.value->'identity'->>'id'=selected_id::text
       AND r.value->'identity'->>'typeId'=selected_type::text);
   creation_attempt:=attempt.id;
   journals:=jsonb_build_array(member->'journal');after_image:=member->'object';expected_actor:=creation.actor_name;
   ELSE RAISE EXCEPTION 'known original creation attribution profile required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
   input_header:=CASE WHEN attempt.context ? 'originalAssertedOrigin'
    THEN jsonb_build_object('assertedOrigin',attempt.context->'originalAssertedOrigin','mutationProfile',attempt.context->'mutationProfile')
    ELSE convert_from(attempt.input_bytes,'UTF8')::jsonb END;
   writer:=attempt.writer_xid;asserted:=input_header->'assertedOrigin';history_profile:=CASE WHEN input_header->'mutationProfile'=truss.runtime_owned_profile() THEN 'truss-native-owned-create/0.1' ELSE 'truss-native-scalar-create/0.2' END;
  ELSE
   SELECT * INTO rebound FROM truss.runtime_catalog_rebind_transition t WHERE t.object_id=selected_id AND t.type_id=selected_type AND (t.after_object->>'ver')::bigint=selected_version;
   IF FOUND THEN
    SELECT * INTO STRICT registration FROM truss.catalog_registration_request r WHERE r.registration_id=rebound.registration_id;
    IF registration.writer_xid IS DISTINCT FROM rebound.writer_xid OR registration.actor_oid IS DISTINCT FROM rebound.actor_oid OR registration.revision IS DISTINCT FROM rebound.revision THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'original catalog attribution source required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
    PERFORM truss.catalog_rebind_transition_reader(rebound);
    journals:=rebound.journal;after_image:=rebound.after_object;expected_actor:=registration.actor_name;
    writer:=registration.writer_xid;asserted:=convert_from(registration.origin_bytes,'UTF8')::jsonb;history_profile:=truss.catalog_rebind_profile(rebound.journal);
   ELSE
   SELECT t.transition_id,t.attempt_id,t.operation_index,t.writer_xid,t.before_object,t.after_object
    INTO STRICT selected_transition_id,transition_attempt_id,transition_operation_index,transition_writer_xid,transition_before_object,transition_after_object
    FROM truss.runtime_object_transition t
    WHERE t.object_id=selected_id AND t.type_id=selected_type AND (t.after_object->>'ver')::bigint=selected_version;
   SELECT * INTO STRICT attempt FROM truss.runtime_object_attempt WHERE id=transition_attempt_id;
   IF NOT attempt.complete OR attempt.writer_xid IS DISTINCT FROM transition_writer_xid
    OR attempt.next_index<=transition_operation_index OR attempt.result_count<>attempt.next_index
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'complete original attribution attempt required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
   input_header:=CASE WHEN attempt.context ? 'originalAssertedOrigin'
    THEN jsonb_build_object('assertedOrigin',attempt.context->'originalAssertedOrigin','mutationProfile',attempt.context->'mutationProfile')
    ELSE convert_from(attempt.input_bytes,'UTF8')::jsonb END;
   owned_mutation:=input_header->'mutationProfile'=truss.runtime_owned_profile();
   IF owned_mutation THEN
    SELECT p.plan->'operation',p.result,p.plan->>'actorName' INTO STRICT operation,result,expected_actor FROM truss.runtime_owned_operation p
     WHERE p.attempt_id=attempt.id AND p.operation_index=transition_operation_index AND p.writer_xid=attempt.writer_xid;
   ELSE
    operation:=input_header->'operations'->transition_operation_index;result:=attempt.results->transition_operation_index;
    IF operation IS NULL THEN operation:=convert_from(attempt.input_bytes,'UTF8')::jsonb->'operations'->transition_operation_index;END IF;
   END IF;
   IF owned_mutation THEN
    IF operation->>'operation' IS DISTINCT FROM 'update_object' OR result->>'operation' IS DISTINCT FROM 'update_object'
     OR result->>'outcome' IS DISTINCT FROM 'changed'
     OR transition_after_object->>'id' IS DISTINCT FROM selected_id::text
     OR transition_after_object->>'type_id' IS DISTINCT FROM selected_type::text
     OR transition_after_object->>'ver' IS DISTINCT FROM selected_version::text OR nullif(expected_actor,'') IS NULL
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'original owned update attribution required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
   ELSIF operation->>'operation' IS DISTINCT FROM 'update_object' OR result->>'operation' IS DISTINCT FROM 'update_object'
    OR result->>'outcome' IS DISTINCT FROM 'changed' OR result->>'version' IS DISTINCT FROM selected_version::text
    OR result->'identity'->>'id' IS DISTINCT FROM selected_id::text OR result->'identity'->>'typeId' IS DISTINCT FROM selected_type::text
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'original changed attribution result required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
   IF NOT owned_mutation THEN SELECT t.journal INTO STRICT transition_journal FROM truss.runtime_object_transition t WHERE t.transition_id=selected_transition_id;END IF;
   journals:=transition_journal;after_image:=transition_after_object;
   writer:=attempt.writer_xid;asserted:=input_header->'assertedOrigin';history_profile:=CASE WHEN owned_mutation THEN 'truss-native-owned-mutation/0.1' ELSE 'truss-native-scalar-mutation/0.1' END;
   END IF;
  END IF;
  IF selected_version=object_row.ver AND (after_image->>'id' IS DISTINCT FROM object_row.id::text
   OR after_image->>'type_id' IS DISTINCT FROM object_row.type_id::text OR after_image->>'ver' IS DISTINCT FROM object_row.ver::text)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'current entity attribution identity differs' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
  -- Original attribution can depend on roots that no longer own this object.
  -- Their original identities must be covered by final selected-scope checks.
  FOR historical_image IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(jsonb_build_array(after_image,
   CASE WHEN owned_mutation THEN transition_before_object ELSE NULL END)) WHERE value<>'null'::jsonb LOOP
   historical_ownership:=truss.runtime_object_ownership_at(historical_image);
   IF historical_ownership->>'state'='owned' THEN
    IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(binding->'documents') d JOIN truss.schema_doc archive
     ON archive.doc_id=d.value->>'documentId' AND archive.doc_revision=d.value->>'revision' AND archive.content_sha256=d.value->>'sha256'
     WHERE archive.doc_id=historical_ownership->'root'->'owner'->>'documentId' AND archive.rev<=(binding->>'catalogRevision')::int
      AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(archive.document::jsonb->'modules') m
       WHERE m.value->>'id'=historical_ownership->'root'->'owner'->>'moduleId')) THEN
     RAISE EXCEPTION 'historical attribution root document must be selected for query' USING ERRCODE='0A000';END IF;
    PERFORM truss.runtime_history_ownership(jsonb_build_object('identity',jsonb_build_object('id',selected_id::text,'typeId',selected_type::text),
     'catalogRevision',historical_image->>'rev','ownership',historical_ownership));
   END IF;
  END LOOP;
  actor:=NULL;events:=0;event_group:=NULL;semantic_events:='[]';event_refs:='[]';legacy_events:='{}';legacy_event_refs:='{}';
  IF owned_mutation OR registration.registration_id IS NOT NULL THEN
   actor:=expected_actor;
   IF nullif(actor,'') IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'immutable attribution actor required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
   IF selected_version=1 THEN created_actor:=actor;END IF;
   IF selected_version=object_row.ver THEN updated_actor:=actor;END IF;
  ELSE
  FOR item IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(journals) LOOP
   events:=events+1;used_bytes:=used_bytes+octet_length(item::text);
   IF events>128 OR used_bytes>(binding->>'maximumBytes')::bigint THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'bounded attribution evidence required' USING ERRCODE='54000';END IF;
   SELECT * INTO STRICT physical FROM truss.journal WHERE xid=(item->>'xid')::xid8 AND seq=(item->>'seq')::bigint;
   IF physical IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_populate_record(NULL::truss.journal,item) OR physical.entity_kind<>'o' OR physical.entity_id<>selected_id
    OR physical.entity_type<>selected_type OR physical.ver<>selected_version OR physical.xid<>writer
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'original attribution journal correspondence required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
   original:=decode(physical.new_value->>'bytesBase64','base64');
   IF physical.new_value IS DISTINCT FROM truss.runtime_exact_wrapper('event',original)
    OR (convert_from(original,'UTF8') IS JSON OBJECT WITH UNIQUE KEYS) IS NOT TRUE
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'original attribution event required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
   event:=convert_from(original,'UTF8')::jsonb;
   IF event->>'interfaceVersion' IS DISTINCT FROM 'truss-history-event/0.2.0-proposal'
    OR event->>'sourceEpoch' IS DISTINCT FROM epoch
    OR event->>'historyProfile' IS DISTINCT FROM history_profile
    OR physical.op IS DISTINCT FROM (CASE event->>'operation' WHEN 'property' THEN 'update' ELSE event->>'operation' END)
    OR physical.prop_id IS DISTINCT FROM (event->>'propertyId')::int
    OR event->'origin'->'asserted' IS DISTINCT FROM asserted
    OR event->>'xid' IS DISTINCT FROM physical.xid::text OR event->>'seq' IS DISTINCT FROM physical.seq::text
    OR event->>'eventVersion' IS DISTINCT FROM selected_version::text OR event->>'eventCatalogRevision' IS DISTINCT FROM physical.rev::text
    OR event->'identity'->>'id' IS DISTINCT FROM selected_id::text OR event->'identity'->>'typeId' IS DISTINCT FROM selected_type::text
    OR event->'identity'->'owner' IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object('documentId',owner.document_id,'moduleId',owner.module)
    OR physical.origin IS DISTINCT FROM truss.runtime_exact_wrapper('origin',convert_to((event->'origin')::text,'UTF8'))
    OR nullif(event->'origin'->>'databaseRole','') IS NULL
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'original attribution identity and origin required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
   IF actor IS NOT NULL AND actor IS DISTINCT FROM event->'origin'->>'databaseRole'
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'one actor per attribution version required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
   IF event_group IS NULL THEN event_group:=event->'mutationGroup';
   ELSIF event_group IS DISTINCT FROM event->'mutationGroup' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'one original attribution group required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
   legacy_events[cardinality(legacy_events)+1]:=event-'mutationGroup';
   legacy_event_refs[cardinality(legacy_event_refs)+1]:=jsonb_build_object('sourceEpoch',epoch,'historyProfile',event->>'historyProfile','xid',physical.xid::text,'seq',physical.seq::text);
   actor:=event->'origin'->>'databaseRole';
   IF expected_actor IS NOT NULL AND actor IS DISTINCT FROM expected_actor
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'original creation actor correspondence required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
   IF selected_version=1 AND event->>'operation'<>'create'
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'original creation attribution required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
  END LOOP;
  SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(v ORDER BY n),'[]'::jsonb) INTO semantic_events FROM unnest(legacy_events) WITH ORDINALITY e(v,n);
  SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(v ORDER BY n),'[]'::jsonb) INTO event_refs FROM unnest(legacy_event_refs) WITH ORDINALITY e(v,n);
  IF event_group IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object('profile','truss-history-group/0.1.0','eventCount',events::text,'orderedEventDigest',encode(sha256(convert_to(semantic_events::text,'UTF8')),'hex'))
   OR selected_version>1 AND result->'events' IS DISTINCT FROM event_refs
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'complete original attribution event group required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
  IF events=0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'missing attribution events' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
  IF selected_version=1 THEN created_actor:=actor;END IF;
  IF selected_version=object_row.ver THEN updated_actor:=actor;END IF;
  END IF;
 END LOOP;
 SELECT * INTO source_row FROM truss.record_source WHERE entity_kind='o' AND entity_id=selected_id;
 SELECT * INTO source_ledger FROM truss.runtime_import_source WHERE entity_kind='o' AND entity_id=selected_id;
 IF (source_row.entity_id IS NULL) IS DISTINCT FROM (source_ledger.entity_id IS NULL)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'original import source linkage required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
 IF source_ledger.entity_id IS NOT NULL THEN
  SELECT * INTO STRICT attempt FROM truss.runtime_object_attempt WHERE id=source_ledger.group_attempt_id;
  IF attempt.context->'mutationProfile'=truss.runtime_owned_profile() THEN
   -- Modern source rows were admitted with the atomic group. Resolve their
   -- indexed result without decoding the entire group or replaying its payload.
   SELECT p.result INTO STRICT result FROM truss.runtime_owned_operation p
    WHERE p.attempt_id=attempt.id AND p.operation_index=source_ledger.operation_index
     AND p.writer_xid=source_ledger.writer_xid;
  ELSE result:=attempt.results->source_ledger.operation_index;END IF;
  IF attempt.id IS DISTINCT FROM creation_attempt OR NOT attempt.complete OR attempt.writer_xid IS DISTINCT FROM source_ledger.writer_xid
   OR source_ledger.operation_index<0 OR source_ledger.operation_index>=attempt.next_index
   OR result->>'outcome' IS DISTINCT FROM 'created'
   OR result->'identity'->>'id' IS DISTINCT FROM selected_id::text
   OR result->'identity'->>'typeId' IS DISTINCT FROM selected_type::text
   OR result->'identity'->'owner' IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object('documentId',owner.document_id,'moduleId',owner.module)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'original import creation linkage required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
  -- Keep the historical scalar-import qualification separate. Modern trusted
  -- imports read their immutable source facts directly, including owned roots.
  IF attempt.context->'mutationProfile' IS DISTINCT FROM truss.runtime_owned_profile() THEN
  IF attempt.next_index<>1 OR source_ledger.operation_index<>0 THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'legacy singleton import creation required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
  import_record:=convert_from(source_ledger.original_record,'UTF8')::jsonb;
  import_payload:=decode(import_record->'payload'->>'bytesBase64','base64');
  IF encode(sha256(import_payload),'hex') IS DISTINCT FROM import_record->'payload'->>'sha256'
   OR (convert_from(import_payload,'UTF8') IS JSON OBJECT WITH UNIQUE KEYS) IS NOT TRUE
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'original import payload required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
  payload_value:=convert_from(import_payload,'UTF8')::jsonb;expected_source:='{}'::jsonb;
  input_header:=convert_from(attempt.input_bytes,'UTF8')::jsonb;
  operation:=input_header->'operations'->source_ledger.operation_index;
  IF import_record->>'kind' IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' OR payload_value->>'kind' IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
   OR operation->>'operation' IS DISTINCT FROM 'create_object'
   OR operation->>'typeDefinitionPin' IS DISTINCT FROM import_record->'identity'->'type'->>'definitionPin'
   OR operation->'values' IS DISTINCT FROM payload_value->'values' OR operation->'ownership' IS DISTINCT FROM payload_value->'ownership'
   OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(input_header->'assertedOrigin'->'entries') e
    WHERE e.value->>'key'='x-load-id' AND e.value->'value'=jsonb_build_object('kind','string','text',source_row.load_id))
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'original import payload and creation correspondence required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
  IF payload_value->'source' IS NOT NULL THEN
   SELECT coalesce(jsonb_object_agg(source_entry->>'key',CASE source_entry->'value'->>'kind'
     WHEN 'string' THEN source_entry->'value'->'text' WHEN 'null' THEN 'null'::jsonb
     WHEN 'boolean' THEN source_entry->'value'->'value' ELSE source_entry->'value' END ORDER BY ordinal),'{}'::jsonb)
    INTO expected_source FROM jsonb_array_elements(payload_value->'source'->'entries') WITH ORDINALITY s(source_entry,ordinal);
  END IF;
  IF source_row.source IS DISTINCT FROM expected_source THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'original import source facts required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
  END IF;
 END IF;
 PERFORM truss.query_scope(binding);
 IF root_identity IS NOT NULL AND NOT truss.runtime_can_read(root_identity->'owner'->>'documentId',root_identity->'owner'->>'moduleId') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'current attribution aggregate root reader required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('_version',object_row.ver::text,'_created_by',created_actor,'_updated_by',updated_actor,
  '_original_author',source_row.source->'author','_original_at',source_row.source->'at');
END;
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.query_object_load_id(binding jsonb, selected_type integer, selected_id bigint)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
 SET row_security TO 'off'
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
AS $function$
DECLARE selected_load text;current_object truss.object%ROWTYPE;root_identity jsonb;
BEGIN
 -- Prove the complete original creation/current attribution, immutable import
 -- ledger, payload and load-origin correspondence in this statement snapshot.
 PERFORM truss.query_object_attribution(binding,selected_type,selected_id);
 SELECT load_id INTO selected_load FROM truss.record_source
  WHERE entity_kind='o' AND entity_id=selected_id;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT current_object FROM truss.object WHERE id=selected_id AND type_id=selected_type;
 root_identity:=truss.query_object_root(binding,current_object);
 PERFORM truss.query_scope(binding);
 IF root_identity IS NOT NULL AND NOT truss.runtime_can_read(root_identity->'owner'->>'documentId',root_identity->'owner'->>'moduleId') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'current metadata aggregate root reader required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
 -- A proved ordinary creation has JSON null, never a SQL NULL result carrier.
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('_load_id',selected_load);
END;
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.query_object_root(binding jsonb, object_row truss.object)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE root_row truss.object;root_type truss.type_def;pin record;captured_revision int:=(binding->>'catalogRevision')::int;
BEGIN
 IF object_row.ver<=0 OR object_row.rev>captured_revision THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'current query object required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
 IF object_row.root_id IS NULL AND object_row.root_type IS NULL THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 IF object_row.root_id IS NULL OR object_row.root_type IS NULL OR object_row.root_id<=0
  OR object_row.root_id=object_row.id AND object_row.root_type=object_row.type_id THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'complete query aggregate root required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT root_row FROM truss.object WHERE id=object_row.root_id AND type_id=object_row.root_type;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT root_type FROM truss.type_def WHERE type_id=root_row.type_id AND retired_rev IS NULL AND NOT provisional AND kind='record';
 IF root_row.root_id IS NOT NULL OR root_row.root_type IS NOT NULL OR root_row.ver<=0 THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'rootless query aggregate root required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
 IF root_row.rev>captured_revision OR root_type.since_rev>captured_revision THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'catalog changed during query root observation' USING ERRCODE='55P03';END IF;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(binding->'documents') d JOIN truss.schema_doc archive
  ON archive.doc_id=d.value->>'documentId' AND archive.doc_revision=d.value->>'revision' AND archive.content_sha256=d.value->>'sha256'
  WHERE archive.doc_id=root_type.document_id AND archive.rev<=captured_revision
   AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(archive.document::jsonb->'modules') m WHERE m.value->>'id'=root_type.module)) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'aggregate root document must be selected for query' USING ERRCODE='0A000';END IF;
 IF NOT truss.runtime_can_read(root_type.document_id,root_type.module) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'current query aggregate root reader required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT pin FROM truss.runtime_owned_definition_metadata('type',root_row.type_id,NULL,captured_revision);
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('id',root_row.id::text,'typeId',root_row.type_id::text,'definitionPin',pin.definition_pin,
  'owner',jsonb_build_object('documentId',root_type.document_id,'moduleId',root_type.module));
END;
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.query_object_times(binding jsonb, selected_type integer, selected_id bigint)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
 SET row_security TO 'off'
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
AS $function$
DECLARE current_object truss.object%ROWTYPE;root_identity jsonb;
BEGIN
 -- Establish original creation/current-version attribution and exact current image
 -- in this statement snapshot, including the caller's pending writes.
 PERFORM truss.query_object_attribution(binding,selected_type,selected_id);
 SELECT * INTO STRICT current_object FROM truss.object WHERE id=selected_id AND type_id=selected_type;
 IF NOT isfinite(current_object.created_at) OR NOT isfinite(current_object.updated_at)
  OR current_object.created_at<'0001-01-01 00:00:00+00'::timestamptz
  OR current_object.created_at>='10000-01-01 00:00:00+00'::timestamptz
  OR current_object.updated_at<'0001-01-01 00:00:00+00'::timestamptz
  OR current_object.updated_at>='10000-01-01 00:00:00+00'::timestamptz
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'finite supported object timestamps required' USING ERRCODE='0A000';END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT current_object FROM truss.object WHERE id=selected_id AND type_id=selected_type;
 root_identity:=truss.query_object_root(binding,current_object);
 PERFORM truss.query_scope(binding);
 IF root_identity IS NOT NULL AND NOT truss.runtime_can_read(root_identity->'owner'->>'documentId',root_identity->'owner'->>'moduleId') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'current metadata aggregate root reader required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object(
  '_created_at',to_char(current_object.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"'),
  '_updated_at',to_char(current_object.updated_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"'));
END;
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.query_objects(binding jsonb, selected_type integer)
 RETURNS TABLE(id bigint, props jsonb)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
 SET row_security TO 'off'
AS $function$
DECLARE owner truss.type_def%ROWTYPE;object_row truss.object%ROWTYPE;selected_row record;numeric_properties jsonb;numeric_valid boolean;
 row_count int:=0;byte_count bigint:=0;root_identity jsonb;roots jsonb:='{}';root_entry jsonb;
BEGIN
 PERFORM truss.query_scope(binding);
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(binding->'records') r WHERE (r.value->>'typeId')::int=selected_type) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'selected query record required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT owner FROM truss.type_def t WHERE t.type_id=selected_type AND t.retired_rev IS NULL;
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('propertyId',p.prop_id::text,'scalarType',p.scalar_type) ORDER BY p.prop_id),'[]'::jsonb)
 INTO numeric_properties FROM truss.prop_def p WHERE p.type_id=selected_type AND p.retired_rev IS NULL AND p.scalar_type IN ('integer','decimal');
 FOR selected_row IN
  SELECT o AS object_row,NOT EXISTS(
   SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(numeric_properties) f
   CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT o.props->(f.value->>'propertyId') AS cell) selected_cell
   WHERE selected_cell.cell IS NOT NULL AND selected_cell.cell<>'{"kind":"null"}'::jsonb
    AND truss.query_numeric_value(selected_cell.cell->>'text',f.value->>'scalarType') IS NOT TRUE
  ) AS numeric_valid
  FROM truss.object o WHERE o.type_id=selected_type ORDER BY o.id LIMIT (binding->>'maximumScanRows')::int+1 LOOP
  object_row:=selected_row.object_row;numeric_valid:=selected_row.numeric_valid;
  row_count:=row_count+1;byte_count:=byte_count+octet_length(object_row.props::text);
  IF row_count>(binding->>'maximumScanRows')::int OR byte_count>(binding->>'maximumBytes')::int THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'bounded query source required' USING ERRCODE='54000';END IF;
  root_identity:=truss.query_object_root(binding,object_row);
  IF root_identity IS NOT NULL THEN roots:=roots||jsonb_build_object((root_identity->>'typeId')||':'||(root_identity->>'id'),root_identity);END IF;
  IF byte_count+(CASE WHEN roots='{}'::jsonb THEN 0 ELSE octet_length(roots::text) END)>(binding->>'maximumBytes')::int THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'bounded query root witnesses required' USING ERRCODE='54000';END IF;
  IF object_row.ver<=0 OR object_row.rev> (binding->>'catalogRevision')::int THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'complete scalar source required' USING ERRCODE='0A000';END IF;
  IF NOT numeric_valid THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'exact native numeric domain unavailable' USING ERRCODE='22003';END IF;
  id:=object_row.id;props:=object_row.props;RETURN NEXT;
 END LOOP;
 FOR root_entry IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_each(roots) LOOP
  IF NOT truss.runtime_can_read(root_entry->'owner'->>'documentId',root_entry->'owner'->>'moduleId') THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'current buffered query aggregate root reader required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
 END LOOP;
 -- PL/pgSQL buffers this complete validated source before caller predicates run.
 PERFORM truss.query_scope(binding);
END;
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.query_page_objects(binding jsonb, selected_type integer, selected_key text)
 RETURNS TABLE(id bigint, props jsonb)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
 SET row_security TO 'off'
AS $function$
DECLARE key_definition truss.key_def%ROWTYPE;component truss.prop_def%ROWTYPE;row record;counted int:=0;
BEGIN
 PERFORM truss.query_scope(binding);
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(binding->'records') r WHERE (r.value->>'typeId')::int=selected_type) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'selected query record required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
 SELECT * INTO key_definition FROM truss.key_def k WHERE k.type_id=selected_type AND k.key_id=selected_key AND k.retired_rev IS NULL;
 IF NOT FOUND OR cardinality(key_definition.prop_ids) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 1024 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'bounded authored page key required' USING ERRCODE='0A000';END IF;
 FOR component IN SELECT p.* FROM unnest(key_definition.prop_ids) WITH ORDINALITY k(prop_id,n) JOIN truss.prop_def p ON p.prop_id=k.prop_id AND p.type_id=selected_type ORDER BY k.n LOOP
  counted:=counted+1;
  IF component.retired_rev IS NOT NULL OR component.scalar_type NOT IN ('string','boolean','integer','decimal') OR component.nullability<>'required' OR component.cardinality<>'one' OR component.home<>'json' OR NOT ((component.scalar_type IN ('string','boolean') AND coalesce(component.facets,'{}')='{}'::jsonb OR component.scalar_type='integer' AND (coalesce(component.facets,'{}')='{}'::jsonb OR component.facets='{"integerWidth":{"bits":64,"signed":true}}'::jsonb) OR component.scalar_type='decimal' AND truss.valid_decimal_facets(component.facets)) IS TRUE) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'required exact page key components required' USING ERRCODE='0A000';END IF;
 END LOOP;
 IF counted<>cardinality(key_definition.prop_ids) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'complete page key required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
 FOR row IN SELECT q.* FROM truss.query_objects(binding,selected_type) q LOOP
  id:=row.id;props:=row.props;RETURN NEXT;
 END LOOP;
 -- The preceding SRF validates and bounds the complete source in this snapshot.
 -- Validated typed tuple equality matches emitted C-text/bool/numeric ROW.
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT (SELECT jsonb_agg(CASE property.scalar_type WHEN 'boolean' THEN o.props->property.prop_id::text->'value' WHEN 'integer' THEN to_jsonb((o.props->property.prop_id::text->>'text')::numeric) WHEN 'decimal' THEN to_jsonb((o.props->property.prop_id::text->>'text')::numeric) ELSE to_jsonb(o.props->property.prop_id::text->>'text') END ORDER BY p.n)
  FROM unnest(key_definition.prop_ids) WITH ORDINALITY p(prop_id,n) JOIN truss.prop_def property ON property.prop_id=p.prop_id AND property.type_id=selected_type) AS key_values
  FROM truss.object o WHERE o.type_id=selected_type) source GROUP BY source.key_values HAVING count(*)>1) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'unique authored page key required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
 PERFORM truss.query_scope(binding);
END;
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.query_scope(binding jsonb)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
 SET row_security TO 'off'
AS $function$
DECLARE installation truss.catalog_runtime_installation%ROWTYPE;selected_document jsonb;selected_record jsonb;selected_field jsonb;source truss.schema_doc%ROWTYPE;owner truss.type_def%ROWTYPE;property truss.prop_def%ROWTYPE;module jsonb;selected_relation jsonb;relation truss.rel_def%ROWTYPE;selected_key jsonb;key_definition truss.key_def%ROWTYPE;current_actor oid;compiled jsonb;
BEGIN
 current_actor:=truss.runtime_person(false);
 SELECT * INTO STRICT installation FROM truss.runtime_current_installation();
 IF jsonb_typeof(binding) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' OR binding->>'interfaceVersion' IS DISTINCT FROM 'truss-runtime-binding/0.5'
 OR binding->'queryAbi' IS DISTINCT FROM truss.query_abi()
 OR binding-ARRAY['interfaceVersion','queryAbi','schema','installationId','releaseId','releaseSha256','catalogRevision','documents','records','relationships','maximumScanRows','maximumResultRows','maximumBytes']<>'{}'::jsonb
 OR binding->>'schema' IS DISTINCT FROM 'truss' OR binding->>'installationId' IS DISTINCT FROM installation.installation_id::text
 OR binding->>'releaseId' IS DISTINCT FROM installation.release_id OR binding->>'releaseSha256' IS DISTINCT FROM installation.release_sha256
 OR installation.release_id<>'truss-catalog-runtime/0.74-candidate' OR (binding->>'catalogRevision')::int IS DISTINCT FROM (SELECT rev FROM truss.schema_head WHERE id=1)
 OR binding->>'maximumResultRows' IS NULL OR (binding->>'maximumResultRows')::int NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 10000 OR binding->>'maximumScanRows' IS NULL OR binding->>'maximumBytes' IS NULL OR (binding->>'maximumScanRows')::int NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 10000 OR (binding->>'maximumBytes')::int NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 16777216
 OR octet_length(binding::text)>4194304 OR jsonb_typeof(binding->'documents') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' OR jsonb_array_length(binding->'documents') NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 32
 OR jsonb_typeof(binding->'relationships') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' OR jsonb_array_length(binding->'relationships')>1024
 OR jsonb_typeof(binding->'records') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' OR jsonb_array_length(binding->'records') NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 1024 THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'selected query context required' USING ERRCODE='0A000';END IF;
 IF jsonb_array_length(binding->'documents')=1 THEN
  SELECT metadata INTO compiled FROM truss.runtime_document_schema
   WHERE rev=(binding->>'catalogRevision')::int AND doc_id=binding->'documents'->0->>'documentId';
  IF compiled->'pin'=binding->'documents'->0 AND compiled->'records'=binding->'records'
   AND compiled->'relationships'=binding->'relationships' AND compiled->'closed'='true'::jsonb AND compiled->'itemsValid'='true'::jsonb THEN
   FOR selected_document IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(compiled->'readers') LOOP
    IF NOT truss.runtime_can_read_qualified(selected_document->>'documentId',selected_document->>'moduleId',current_actor) THEN
     RAISE EXCEPTION 'complete selected_document reader required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
   END LOOP;
   RETURN;
  END IF;
 END IF;
 FOR selected_document IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(binding->'documents') LOOP
  SELECT * INTO source FROM truss.schema_doc d WHERE d.doc_id=selected_document->>'documentId' AND d.rev<= (binding->>'catalogRevision')::int ORDER BY d.rev DESC LIMIT 1;
  IF NOT FOUND OR source.doc_revision IS DISTINCT FROM selected_document->>'revision' OR source.content_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM selected_document->>'sha256' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'original query source changed' USING ERRCODE='55P03';END IF;
  -- Full original source bytes are supplied only under complete selected_document scope.
  FOR module IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(source.document::jsonb->'modules') LOOP
   IF NOT truss.runtime_can_read(source.doc_id,module->>'id') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'complete selected_document reader required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
  END LOOP;
 END LOOP;
 FOR selected_record IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(binding->'records') LOOP
  SELECT * INTO owner FROM truss.type_def t WHERE t.type_id=(selected_record->>'typeId')::int AND t.retired_rev IS NULL AND NOT t.provisional AND t.kind='record';
  IF NOT FOUND OR owner.document_id IS DISTINCT FROM selected_record->'identity'->>'documentId' OR owner.module IS DISTINCT FROM selected_record->'identity'->>'module' OR owner.element IS DISTINCT FROM selected_record->'identity'->>'element'
   OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(binding->'documents') d WHERE d.value->>'documentId'=owner.document_id AND d.value->>'revision'=selected_record->'identity'->>'revision')
   OR NOT truss.runtime_can_read(owner.document_id,owner.module) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'accepted authorized query record required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
  IF jsonb_typeof(selected_record->'fields') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' OR jsonb_array_length(selected_record->'fields')<>(SELECT count(*) FROM truss.prop_def p WHERE p.type_id=owner.type_id AND p.retired_rev IS NULL)
   OR (SELECT count(DISTINCT f.value->>'propertyId') FROM jsonb_array_elements(selected_record->'fields') f)<>jsonb_array_length(selected_record->'fields') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'complete property mapping required' USING ERRCODE='0A000';END IF;
  IF truss.runtime_object_values_readable(owner.type_id) IS NOT TRUE THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'current query interpretation reader required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
  FOR selected_field IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(selected_record->'fields') LOOP
   SELECT * INTO property FROM truss.prop_def p WHERE p.type_id=owner.type_id AND p.prop_id=(selected_field->>'propertyId')::int AND p.retired_rev IS NULL;
   IF NOT FOUND OR property.element IS DISTINCT FROM selected_field->'identity'->>'element' OR property.declaration_module IS DISTINCT FROM selected_field->'identity'->>'module'
    OR selected_field->'identity'->>'documentId' IS DISTINCT FROM owner.document_id OR selected_field->'identity'->>'revision' IS DISTINCT FROM selected_record->'identity'->>'revision'
    OR NOT truss.runtime_can_read(owner.document_id,property.declaration_module) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'accepted authorized property mapping required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
  END LOOP;
  IF jsonb_typeof(selected_record->'keys') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' OR jsonb_array_length(selected_record->'keys')<>(SELECT count(*) FROM truss.key_def k WHERE k.type_id=owner.type_id AND k.retired_rev IS NULL)
   OR (SELECT count(DISTINCT k.value->>'keyId') FROM jsonb_array_elements(selected_record->'keys') k)<>jsonb_array_length(selected_record->'keys') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'complete current key mapping required' USING ERRCODE='0A000';END IF;
  FOR selected_key IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(selected_record->'keys') LOOP
   SELECT * INTO key_definition FROM truss.key_def k WHERE k.type_id=owner.type_id AND k.key_id=selected_key->>'keyId' AND k.retired_rev IS NULL;
   IF NOT FOUND OR selected_key->'propertyIds' IS DISTINCT FROM (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(p.prop_id::text ORDER BY p.n),'[]') FROM unnest(key_definition.prop_ids) WITH ORDINALITY p(prop_id,n)) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'exact ordered native key mapping required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
  END LOOP;
 END LOOP;
 FOR selected_relation IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(binding->'relationships') LOOP
  SELECT * INTO relation FROM truss.rel_def r WHERE r.rel_type_id=(selected_relation->>'relationshipTypeId')::int AND r.retired_rev IS NULL;
  IF NOT FOUND OR relation.document_id IS DISTINCT FROM selected_relation->'identity'->>'documentId' OR relation.module IS DISTINCT FROM selected_relation->'identity'->>'module'
   OR relation.rel_id IS DISTINCT FROM selected_relation->'identity'->>'relationship' OR relation.lifecycle NOT IN ('independent','owned') OR NOT relation.directed OR relation.composition OR relation.assoc_type_id IS NOT NULL
   OR NOT truss.runtime_can_read(relation.document_id,relation.module)
   OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(binding->'documents') d WHERE d.value->>'documentId'=relation.document_id AND d.value->>'revision'=selected_relation->'identity'->>'revision')
   OR (SELECT count(*) FROM truss.rel_endpoint e WHERE e.rel_type_id=relation.rel_type_id)<>1
   OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM truss.rel_endpoint e WHERE e.rel_type_id=relation.rel_type_id AND e.source_type=(selected_relation->>'sourceTypeId')::int AND e.target_type=(selected_relation->>'targetTypeId')::int)
   OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(binding->'records') r WHERE r.value->>'typeId'=selected_relation->>'sourceTypeId')
   OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(binding->'records') r WHERE r.value->>'typeId'=selected_relation->>'targetTypeId') THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'accepted authorized relationship mapping required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
 END LOOP;
END;
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.read_import_load_chunk(selected_invocation uuid, selected_chunk integer, page_limit integer, expected_release text, expected_digest text)
 RETURNS bytea
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
 SET row_security TO 'off'
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
AS $function$
DECLARE actor oid;installation truss.catalog_runtime_installation%ROWTYPE;selected truss.runtime_import_load_chunk%ROWTYPE;
 item jsonb;owner jsonb;chunks jsonb;state_value text;all_count int;
 created_count int;skipped_count int;rejected_count int;load_created int;load_skipped int;load_rejected int;
BEGIN
 actor:=truss.runtime_person(false);
 IF selected_invocation IS NULL OR selected_chunk IS NULL OR selected_chunk<0 OR page_limit IS NULL OR page_limit NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 128 THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'bounded import audit page required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT installation FROM truss.runtime_current_installation();
 IF installation.release_id IS DISTINCT FROM expected_release OR installation.release_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM expected_digest THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'current import audit release required' USING ERRCODE='0A000';END IF;
 SELECT * INTO selected FROM truss.runtime_import_load_chunk c WHERE c.invocation_id=selected_invocation
  AND c.chunk_index=selected_chunk AND c.writer_xid<>pg_current_xact_id();
 -- Hide whether an unqualified invocation/chunk identifier exists.
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'qualified import audit scope unavailable' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
 IF selected.owner_inventory_complete IS NOT TRUE THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'complete original load owner inventory required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
 IF jsonb_array_length(selected.original_owners)=0 THEN
  -- An admitted empty load has no module scope from which to derive an audit
  -- role, so only an enrolled installation registrar may inspect its metadata.
  PERFORM truss.runtime_person(true);
 END IF;
 FOR owner IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(selected.original_owners) LOOP
  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM truss.runtime_import_audit_access a WHERE a.document_id=owner->>'documentId'
    AND a.module=owner->>'moduleId' AND truss.runtime_audit_role_member(actor,a.auditor_oid)) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'complete original load audit membership required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
 END LOOP;
 SELECT count(*),coalesce(jsonb_agg(chunk_index::text ORDER BY chunk_index),'[]'::jsonb) INTO all_count,chunks
  FROM truss.runtime_import_load_chunk WHERE invocation_id=selected_invocation AND writer_xid<>pg_current_xact_id();
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(selected.entries) e GROUP BY e.value->>'inputIndex' HAVING count(*)>1) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'duplicate original load index refused' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
 IF jsonb_array_length(selected.entries)>page_limit THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'whole load chunk exceeds page limit' USING ERRCODE='54000';END IF;
 state_value:=CASE WHEN all_count=selected.total_chunks AND
  (SELECT count(DISTINCT chunk_index)=selected.total_chunks FROM truss.runtime_import_load_chunk
    WHERE invocation_id=selected_invocation AND writer_xid<>pg_current_xact_id()) THEN 'complete' ELSE 'partial' END;
 SELECT count(*) FILTER(WHERE e.value->>'outcome'='created'),
  count(*) FILTER(WHERE e.value->>'outcome'='skipped'),
  count(*) FILTER(WHERE e.value->>'outcome'='rejected')
  INTO created_count,skipped_count,rejected_count FROM jsonb_array_elements(selected.entries) e(value);
 IF state_value='complete' THEN
  SELECT count(*) FILTER(WHERE e.value->>'outcome'='created'),
   count(*) FILTER(WHERE e.value->>'outcome'='skipped'),
   count(*) FILTER(WHERE e.value->>'outcome'='rejected')
   INTO load_created,load_skipped,load_rejected
   FROM truss.runtime_import_load_chunk c CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(c.entries) e(value)
   WHERE c.invocation_id=selected_invocation AND c.writer_xid<>pg_current_xact_id();
 END IF;
 -- Freshly check the full authority union immediately before disclosure.
 FOR owner IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(selected.original_owners) LOOP
  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM truss.runtime_import_audit_access a WHERE a.document_id=owner->>'documentId'
   AND a.module=owner->>'moduleId' AND truss.runtime_audit_role_member(actor,a.auditor_oid)) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'load audit authority changed before release' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
 END LOOP;
 IF jsonb_array_length(selected.original_owners)=0 THEN
  -- Repeat the registrar-only empty-scope admission at the disclosure edge;
  -- the earlier check may have preceded a same-transaction role revocation.
  PERFORM truss.runtime_person(true);
 END IF;
 PERFORM truss.runtime_person(false);
 RETURN convert_to(jsonb_build_object('outcome','page','invocationId',selected.invocation_id::text,
  'loadId',selected.load_id,'assertedOriginSha256',selected.asserted_origin_sha256,'nativeActor',selected.native_actor::text,'nativeActorName',selected.native_actor_name,
  'observedAt',to_char(selected.audit_observed_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"'),'createdCount',created_count::text,
  'skippedCount',skipped_count::text,'rejectedCount',rejected_count::text,
  'loadCreatedCount',CASE WHEN state_value='complete' THEN load_created::text ELSE NULL END,
  'loadSkippedCount',CASE WHEN state_value='complete' THEN load_skipped::text ELSE NULL END,
  'loadRejectedCount',CASE WHEN state_value='complete' THEN load_rejected::text ELSE NULL END,
  'inputSha256',selected.input_sha256,'inputCount',selected.input_count::text,
  'totalChunks',selected.total_chunks::text,'observedChunks',chunks,'state',state_value,
  'entries',selected.entries,'nextChunk',CASE WHEN selected.chunk_index+1<selected.total_chunks
    THEN (selected.chunk_index+1)::text ELSE NULL END)::text,'UTF8');
END;
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.read_mutation_group_audit(selected_attempt uuid, maximum_events integer, expected_release text, expected_digest text)
 RETURNS bytea
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 SELECT truss.runtime_read_mutation_group_audit(selected_attempt,maximum_events,expected_release,expected_digest,false) $function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.reader_catalog(maximum_count integer, maximum_bytes integer, expected_release text, expected_digest text)
 RETURNS bytea
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
 SET row_security TO 'off'
AS $function$
DECLARE installation truss.catalog_runtime_installation%ROWTYPE;captured_revision int;modules jsonb:='[]';owner record;module jsonb;encoded bytea;definition_count int:=0;dependency record;
BEGIN
 PERFORM truss.runtime_person(false);
 IF maximum_count IS NULL OR maximum_count NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 65536 OR maximum_bytes IS NULL OR maximum_bytes NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 16777216 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'bounded catalog limits required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT installation FROM truss.runtime_current_installation();
 IF installation.release_id IS DISTINCT FROM expected_release OR installation.release_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM expected_digest THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'selected runtime required' USING ERRCODE='0A000';END IF;
 IF current_setting('transaction_read_only')='on' THEN
 SELECT rev INTO STRICT captured_revision FROM truss.schema_head WHERE id=1;
 ELSE
 SELECT rev INTO STRICT captured_revision FROM truss.schema_head WHERE id=1 FOR SHARE NOWAIT;
 END IF;
 IF captured_revision<1 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'accepted catalog required' USING ERRCODE='0A000';END IF;
 FOR owner IN SELECT d.doc_id,d.rev AS source_catalog_revision,d.doc_revision,d.content_sha256,m.value->>'id' AS module_id
  FROM truss.schema_doc d CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(d.document::jsonb->'modules') m(value)
  WHERE d.rev<=captured_revision AND d.rev=(SELECT max(latest.rev) FROM truss.schema_doc latest WHERE latest.doc_id=d.doc_id AND latest.rev<=captured_revision) ORDER BY d.doc_id COLLATE "C",m.value->>'id' COLLATE "C" LOOP
  IF NOT truss.runtime_can_read(owner.doc_id,owner.module_id) THEN CONTINUE;END IF;
  module:=jsonb_build_object('documentId',owner.doc_id,'moduleId',owner.module_id,'documentRevision',owner.doc_revision,'documentSha256',owner.content_sha256,'sourceCatalogRevision',owner.source_catalog_revision,
   'types',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('typeId',t.type_id,'recordId',t.element,'kind',t.kind,'provisional',t.provisional) ORDER BY t.type_id),'[]') FROM truss.type_def t WHERE t.document_id=owner.doc_id AND t.module=owner.module_id AND t.retired_rev IS NULL),
   'properties',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('propertyId',p.prop_id,'typeId',p.type_id,'fieldId',p.element,'name',p.name,'scalarType',p.scalar_type,'nullability',p.nullability,'cardinality',p.cardinality,'itemDefinition',p.item-'declaration') ORDER BY p.prop_id),'[]') FROM truss.prop_def p JOIN truss.type_def t USING(type_id) WHERE t.document_id=owner.doc_id AND t.module=owner.module_id AND t.retired_rev IS NULL AND p.retired_rev IS NULL AND truss.runtime_can_read(t.document_id,p.declaration_module) AND (p.cardinality NOT IN ('array','map') OR truss.runtime_item_chain_readable(p.item))),
   'keys',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('typeId',k.type_id,'keyId',k.key_id,'keyNumber',k.key_num,'propertyIds',k.prop_ids,'primary',k.is_primary) ORDER BY k.type_id,k.key_num),'[]') FROM truss.key_def k JOIN truss.type_def t USING(type_id) WHERE t.document_id=owner.doc_id AND t.module=owner.module_id AND t.retired_rev IS NULL AND k.retired_rev IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM truss.prop_def p WHERE p.prop_id=ANY(k.prop_ids) AND NOT truss.runtime_can_read(t.document_id,p.declaration_module))),
   'relationships',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('relationshipId',r.rel_type_id,'authoredId',r.rel_id,'name',r.name,'sourceMin',r.source_min,'sourceMax',r.source_max,'targetMin',r.target_min,'targetMax',r.target_max,'directed',r.directed,
      'endpoints',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('sourceType',e.source_type,'targetType',e.target_type) ORDER BY e.source_type,e.target_type) FROM truss.rel_endpoint e WHERE e.rel_type_id=r.rel_type_id)) ORDER BY r.rel_type_id),'[]') FROM truss.rel_def r
    WHERE r.document_id=owner.doc_id AND r.module=owner.module_id AND r.retired_rev IS NULL
    AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM truss.rel_endpoint e JOIN truss.type_def s ON s.type_id=e.source_type JOIN truss.type_def t ON t.type_id=e.target_type WHERE e.rel_type_id=r.rel_type_id AND (NOT truss.runtime_can_read(s.document_id,s.module) OR NOT truss.runtime_can_read(t.document_id,t.module)))
    AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM truss.rel_endpoint e JOIN truss.key_def k ON k.type_id=e.target_type AND k.key_id=r.target_key JOIN truss.type_def t ON t.type_id=k.type_id JOIN truss.prop_def p ON p.prop_id=ANY(k.prop_ids) WHERE e.rel_type_id=r.rel_type_id AND NOT truss.runtime_can_read(t.document_id,p.declaration_module))
    AND (r.assoc_type_id IS NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM truss.type_def a WHERE a.type_id=r.assoc_type_id AND truss.runtime_can_read(a.document_id,a.module)))));
  definition_count:=definition_count+1+jsonb_array_length(module->'types')+jsonb_array_length(module->'properties')+jsonb_array_length(module->'keys')+jsonb_array_length(module->'relationships');
  IF definition_count>maximum_count THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'catalog count limit' USING ERRCODE='54000';END IF;
  modules:=modules||jsonb_build_array(module);
  IF octet_length(modules::text)>maximum_bytes THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'catalog byte limit' USING ERRCODE='54000';END IF;
 END LOOP;
 -- Membership may have changed while the projection was assembled.
 FOR module IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(modules) LOOP
  IF NOT truss.runtime_can_read(module->>'documentId',module->>'moduleId') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'current reader required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
 END LOOP;
 -- Recheck every dependency actually used in the buffered projection, even if
 -- that owner was revoked before its own module was visited and emitted.
 FOR dependency IN
  SELECT DISTINCT document_id,module_id FROM (
   SELECT t.document_id,p.declaration_module AS module_id
    FROM jsonb_array_elements(modules) m CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(m.value->'properties') f
    JOIN truss.prop_def p ON p.prop_id=(f.value->>'propertyId')::int JOIN truss.type_def t USING(type_id)
   UNION
   SELECT node.value->>'documentId',node.value->'reference'->>'module'
    FROM jsonb_array_elements(modules) m CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(m.value->'properties') f
    JOIN truss.prop_def p ON p.prop_id=(f.value->>'propertyId')::int
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(jsonb_build_array(p.item)||coalesce(p.item->'descendants','[]'::jsonb)) node
    WHERE p.cardinality IN ('array','map')
   UNION
   SELECT t.document_id,p.declaration_module
    FROM jsonb_array_elements(modules) m CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(m.value->'keys') k

    CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(k.value->'propertyIds') f JOIN truss.prop_def p ON p.prop_id=f.value::int

    FROM jsonb_array_elements(modules) m CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(m.value->'relationships') r
    JOIN truss.rel_endpoint e ON e.rel_type_id=(r.value->>'relationshipId')::int
    JOIN truss.type_def t ON t.type_id IN(e.source_type,e.target_type)

   SELECT t.document_id,t.module
    FROM jsonb_array_elements(modules) m CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(m.value->'relationships') r
    JOIN truss.rel_def d ON d.rel_type_id=(r.value->>'relationshipId')::int JOIN truss.type_def t ON t.type_id=d.assoc_type_id
   UNION
   SELECT t.document_id,p.declaration_module
    FROM jsonb_array_elements(modules) m CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(m.value->'relationships') r
    JOIN truss.rel_def d ON d.rel_type_id=(r.value->>'relationshipId')::int JOIN truss.rel_endpoint e ON e.rel_type_id=d.rel_type_id
    JOIN truss.key_def k ON k.type_id=e.target_type AND k.key_id=d.target_key

  IF NOT truss.runtime_can_read(dependency.document_id,dependency.module_id) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'current dependency reader required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;

 IF (SELECT rev FROM truss.schema_head WHERE id=1) IS DISTINCT FROM captured_revision THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'catalog changed during reader observation' USING ERRCODE='55P03';END IF;
 RETURN encoded;
END;
