CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.runtime_condition_inventory(input jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE conditions jsonb:=coalesce(input->'preconditions','[]');condition jsonb;selected truss.type_def%ROWTYPE;other truss.type_def%ROWTYPE;
 last_target jsonb;last_target_type truss.type_def%ROWTYPE;last_target_valid boolean:=false;
 relation truss.rel_def%ROWTYPE;property truss.prop_def%ROWTYPE;key_row truss.key_def%ROWTYPE;component record;owner record;
 inventory jsonb;inventory_entries jsonb[]:='{}';entry jsonb;objects jsonb;scopes jsonb;scope_entries jsonb[];scope_entry jsonb;identity jsonb;bound text;index int:=0;
BEGIN
 IF jsonb_typeof(conditions) IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'condition array required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 IF jsonb_array_length(conditions)>(CASE WHEN input->'mutationProfile'=truss.runtime_owned_profile() THEN 3072 ELSE 128 END) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'condition count exceeds selected profile' USING ERRCODE='54000';END IF;
 IF jsonb_array_length(conditions)<>(SELECT count(DISTINCT value->>'id') FROM jsonb_array_elements(conditions)) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'unique condition IDs required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 FOR condition IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(conditions) LOOP
  IF jsonb_typeof(condition->'id') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string' OR octet_length(condition->>'id') NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 1024
   OR jsonb_typeof(condition->'reason') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string' OR octet_length(condition->>'reason')>4096 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'caller condition ID/reason required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
  objects:='[]';scope_entries:='{}';entry:=jsonb_build_object('index',index,'condition',condition);
  IF condition->>'condition' IN ('object_exists','property_equals') THEN
   IF condition-(CASE condition->>'condition' WHEN 'object_exists' THEN ARRAY['condition','id','reason','target'] ELSE ARRAY['condition','id','reason','target','name','value'] END)<>'{}'::jsonb THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'closed object condition required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
   -- Repeated exact targets share immutable type metadata within this one
   -- inventory pass. Full identity equality retains the ID/owner/pin checks;
   -- authority is still checked for every condition below.
   IF last_target_valid AND last_target IS NOT DISTINCT FROM condition->'target' THEN selected:=last_target_type;
   ELSE
    selected:=truss.runtime_condition_type(condition->'target');last_target:=condition->'target';last_target_type:=selected;last_target_valid:=true;
   END IF;
   objects:=jsonb_build_array(condition->'target');
   scope_entries[cardinality(scope_entries)+1]:=jsonb_build_object('documentId',selected.document_id,'moduleId',selected.module);
   IF condition->>'condition'='property_equals' THEN
    IF jsonb_typeof(condition->'name') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string' OR octet_length(condition->>'name') NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 4096 OR truss.valid_flat_cell(condition->'value') IS NOT TRUE THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'exact scalar property equality required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
    SELECT * INTO property FROM truss.prop_def p WHERE p.type_id=selected.type_id AND p.name=condition->>'name' AND p.retired_rev IS NULL;
    IF FOUND THEN entry:=entry||jsonb_build_object('propertyId',property.prop_id::text);
     scope_entries[cardinality(scope_entries)+1]:=jsonb_build_object('documentId',selected.document_id,'moduleId',property.declaration_module);
     IF property.cardinality IN ('array','map') THEN
      FOR scope_entry IN SELECT jsonb_build_object('documentId',node.value->>'documentId','moduleId',node.value->'reference'->>'module')
       FROM jsonb_array_elements(jsonb_build_array(property.item)||coalesce(property.item->'descendants','[]'::jsonb)) WITH ORDINALITY node(value,ordinality)
       ORDER BY node.ordinality LOOP
       scope_entries[cardinality(scope_entries)+1]:=scope_entry;
      END LOOP;
     END IF;
    END IF;
   END IF;
  ELSIF condition->>'condition'='key_absent' THEN
   IF condition-ARRAY['condition','id','reason','typeDefinitionPin','keyId','values']<>'{}'::jsonb OR jsonb_typeof(condition->'values') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
    OR jsonb_array_length(condition->'values') NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 1024 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'closed key condition required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
   WITH pinned AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT rev,ord,doc_id,module_id,element_id FROM truss.runtime_definition_source
    WHERE definition_pin=condition->>'typeDefinitionPin' AND kind='element' AND key_id='')
   SELECT t.* INTO selected FROM pinned p JOIN truss.type_def t
    ON t.definition_rev=p.rev AND t.definition_doc_ord=p.ord AND t.definition_document_id=p.doc_id
     AND t.module=p.module_id AND t.element=p.element_id
    WHERE NOT t.provisional AND t.retired_rev IS NULL;
   IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'known predicate type required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
   SELECT * INTO key_row FROM truss.key_def WHERE type_id=selected.type_id AND key_id=condition->>'keyId' AND retired_rev IS NULL;
   IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'known predicate key required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
   IF cardinality(key_row.prop_ids)<>jsonb_array_length(condition->'values') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(condition->'values') v WHERE v.value->>'kind' NOT IN ('string','integer','decimal','boolean','binary') OR truss.valid_scalar_cell(v.value,NULL,false) IS NOT TRUE) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'complete exact key values required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
   scope_entries[cardinality(scope_entries)+1]:=jsonb_build_object('documentId',selected.document_id,'moduleId',selected.module);
   FOR component IN SELECT p.*,i.ord AS component_ordinal FROM unnest(key_row.prop_ids) WITH ORDINALITY i(prop_id,ord) JOIN truss.prop_def p ON p.prop_id=i.prop_id AND p.type_id=selected.type_id ORDER BY i.ord LOOP
    IF component.scalar_type NOT IN ('string','integer','decimal','boolean','binary') OR component.nullability IS DISTINCT FROM 'required' OR component.retired_rev IS NOT NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'supported string key required' USING ERRCODE='0A000';END IF;
    IF truss.valid_scalar_property(condition->'values'->(component.component_ordinal::int-1),component.scalar_type,false,component.facets) IS NOT TRUE THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'exact declared condition key cell required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
    scope_entries[cardinality(scope_entries)+1]:=jsonb_build_object('documentId',selected.document_id,'moduleId',component.declaration_module);
   END LOOP;
   entry:=entry||jsonb_build_object('typeId',selected.type_id::text,'documentId',selected.document_id,'moduleId',selected.module,'recordId',selected.element,'keyId',key_row.key_id,'keyNumber',key_row.key_num::text,'values',condition->'values');
  ELSIF condition->>'condition' IN ('relationship_absent','relationship_count') THEN
   -- Select the exact source pin before joining native coordinates. Evaluating
   -- the pin function for every unrelated relationship made bounded condition
   -- batches grow with the complete catalog instead of their selected pins.
   WITH pinned AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT rev,ord,doc_id,module_id,element_id FROM truss.runtime_definition_source
    WHERE definition_pin=condition->>'relationshipDefinitionPin' AND kind='relationship' AND key_id='')
   SELECT r.* INTO relation FROM pinned p JOIN truss.rel_def r
    ON r.definition_rev=p.rev AND r.definition_doc_ord=p.ord AND r.definition_document_id=p.doc_id
     AND r.module=p.module_id AND r.rel_id=p.element_id
    WHERE r.retired_rev IS NULL;
   IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'known predicate relationship required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
   scope_entries[cardinality(scope_entries)+1]:=jsonb_build_object('documentId',relation.document_id,'moduleId',relation.module);
   FOR owner IN SELECT DISTINCT t.document_id,t.module FROM truss.rel_endpoint e JOIN truss.type_def t ON t.type_id=e.source_type OR t.type_id=e.target_type WHERE e.rel_type_id=relation.rel_type_id LOOP
    scope_entries[cardinality(scope_entries)+1]:=jsonb_build_object('documentId',owner.document_id,'moduleId',owner.module);
   END LOOP;
   entry:=entry||jsonb_build_object('relationshipId',relation.rel_type_id::text);
   IF condition->>'condition'='relationship_absent' THEN
    IF condition-ARRAY['condition','id','reason','relationshipDefinitionPin','source','target']<>'{}'::jsonb THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'closed relationship condition required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
    selected:=truss.runtime_condition_type(condition->'source');other:=truss.runtime_condition_type(condition->'target');
    IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM truss.rel_endpoint WHERE rel_type_id=relation.rel_type_id AND source_type=selected.type_id AND target_type=other.type_id) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'admitted relationship endpoint types required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
    objects:=jsonb_build_array(condition->'source',condition->'target');
   ELSE
    IF condition-ARRAY['condition','id','reason','relationshipDefinitionPin','anchor','direction','minimum','maximum']<>'{}'::jsonb OR coalesce(condition->>'direction','') NOT IN ('outgoing','incoming') OR jsonb_typeof(condition->'minimum') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string' OR (condition ? 'maximum' AND jsonb_typeof(condition->'maximum') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'closed relationship count required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
    selected:=truss.runtime_condition_type(condition->'anchor');objects:=jsonb_build_array(condition->'anchor');
    IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM truss.rel_endpoint WHERE rel_type_id=relation.rel_type_id AND (condition->>'direction'='outgoing' AND source_type=selected.type_id OR condition->>'direction'='incoming' AND target_type=selected.type_id)) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'admitted count anchor required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
    FOREACH bound IN ARRAY ARRAY[condition->>'minimum',CASE WHEN condition ? 'maximum' THEN condition->>'maximum' ELSE '9223372036854775807' END] LOOP
     IF bound IS NULL OR bound !~ '^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,18})$' OR length(bound)=19 AND bound COLLATE "C">'9223372036854775807' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'exact bounded counts required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
    END LOOP;
    IF condition ? 'maximum' AND (condition->>'minimum')::bigint>(condition->>'maximum')::bigint THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'ordered count bounds required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
   END IF;
  ELSE RAISE EXCEPTION 'known condition required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
  SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(value ORDER BY ord),'[]'::jsonb) INTO scopes FROM unnest(scope_entries) WITH ORDINALITY s(value,ord);
  FOR owner IN SELECT DISTINCT value->>'documentId' AS document_id,value->>'moduleId' AS module_id FROM jsonb_array_elements(scopes) LOOP
   IF NOT truss.runtime_can_read(owner.document_id,owner.module_id) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'current predicate owner read authority required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
  END LOOP;
  inventory_entries[cardinality(inventory_entries)+1]:=entry||jsonb_build_object('objects',objects,'scopes',scopes);index:=index+1;
 END LOOP;
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(value ORDER BY ord),'[]'::jsonb) INTO inventory FROM unnest(inventory_entries) WITH ORDINALITY i(value,ord);
 RETURN inventory;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.runtime_edge_authorize(selected_attempt uuid)

 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'

 FOR context,revision IN SELECT DISTINCT i.value,t.endpoint_ownership->>'captureCatalogRevision' FROM truss.runtime_edge_transition t
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(jsonb_build_array(t.endpoint_ownership->'before'->'source',t.endpoint_ownership->'before'->'target',
   t.endpoint_ownership->'after'->'source',t.endpoint_ownership->'after'->'target')) i
  WHERE t.attempt_id=selected_attempt AND i.value<>'null'::jsonb LOOP
  IF NOT truss.runtime_can_read_qualified(context->'identity'->'owner'->>'documentId',context->'identity'->'owner'->>'moduleId',current_actor) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'original endpoint context reader required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
  PERFORM truss.runtime_history_ownership_qualified(jsonb_build_object('identity',context->'identity','catalogRevision',revision,'ownership',context->'ownership'),current_actor);
 END LOOP;
 FOR entry IN SELECT DISTINCT i.value FROM truss.runtime_edge_transition t
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(jsonb_build_array(t.old_source,t.old_target,t.source_identity,t.target_identity)) i
  WHERE t.attempt_id=selected_attempt AND i.value<>'null'::jsonb LOOP
  IF NOT truss.runtime_can_read_qualified(entry->'owner'->>'documentId',entry->'owner'->>'moduleId',current_actor) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'original endpoint reader required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
 END LOOP;
END;
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.runtime_edge_effect(attempt_id uuid, operation_index integer, metadata jsonb, effect_operation text, advance boolean, qualified_actor oid DEFAULT NULL::oid, prepared_input jsonb DEFAULT NULL::jsonb, source_bytes bytea DEFAULT NULL::bytea)
 RETURNS bytea
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
 SET bytea_output TO 'hex'
AS $function$
DECLARE attempt truss.runtime_object_attempt%ROWTYPE;operation jsonb;input jsonb;row_image truss.edge%ROWTYPE;
 identity jsonb;before_image jsonb;after_image jsonb;before_record jsonb;after_record jsonb;result jsonb;event jsonb;
 installation truss.catalog_runtime_installation%ROWTYPE;journal truss.journal%ROWTYPE;event_refs jsonb;revision int;version bigint;entry jsonb;ownership_context jsonb;selected_history text;current_actor oid;changed_rows bigint;
BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO STRICT attempt FROM truss.runtime_object_attempt WHERE id=attempt_id;
 current_actor:=coalesce(qualified_actor,truss.runtime_person(false));
 IF attempt.writer_xid IS DISTINCT FROM pg_current_xact_id() OR attempt.actor_oid IS DISTINCT FROM current_actor
  OR attempt.complete OR attempt.next_index IS DISTINCT FROM operation_index THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'current original edge effect progress required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
 IF attempt.context->'mutationProfile'=truss.runtime_owned_profile() THEN
  SELECT p.plan->'operation' INTO STRICT operation FROM truss.runtime_owned_operation p
   WHERE p.attempt_id=attempt.id AND p.operation_index=runtime_edge_effect.operation_index;
  input:=jsonb_build_object('mutationProfile',attempt.context->'mutationProfile','assertedOrigin',attempt.context->'originalAssertedOrigin');
 ELSE
  input:=coalesce(prepared_input,convert_from(attempt.input_bytes,'UTF8')::jsonb);operation:=input->'operations'->operation_index;
 END IF;
 IF effect_operation IS NULL OR effect_operation NOT IN ('create_edge','update_edge','delete_edge') OR advance IS NULL THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'explicit native edge effect required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
 IF input->'mutationProfile'=truss.runtime_owned_profile() THEN
  IF advance THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'owned parent alone advances original progress' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
 ELSE
  IF NOT advance OR effect_operation IS DISTINCT FROM operation->>'operation' OR metadata ? 'ownedReference' THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'original independent edge operation required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
 END IF;
 selected_history:=CASE WHEN input->'mutationProfile'=truss.runtime_owned_profile() THEN 'truss-native-owned-edge-mutation/0.1' ELSE 'truss-native-edge-mutation/0.1' END;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT installation FROM truss.runtime_current_installation();SELECT rev INTO STRICT revision FROM truss.schema_head WHERE id=1;
 before_image:=nullif(metadata->'prior','null'::jsonb);identity:=metadata->'identity';
 ownership_context:=jsonb_build_object('profile','truss-edge-endpoint-ownership/0.1','captureCatalogRevision',revision::text,
  'before',CASE WHEN before_image IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE jsonb_build_object('source',truss.runtime_endpoint_ownership(metadata->'oldSource',revision),'target',truss.runtime_endpoint_ownership(metadata->'oldTarget',revision)) END,
  'after',NULL);
 IF effect_operation='create_edge' THEN
  row_image.id:=nextval('truss.id_seq');row_image.rel_type_id:=(metadata->>'typeId')::int;row_image.props:='{}';
  row_image.ver:=1;row_image.created_at:=clock_timestamp();
  identity:=jsonb_build_object('id',row_image.id::text,'typeId',row_image.rel_type_id::text,'definitionPin',operation->>'relationshipDefinitionPin',
   'owner',jsonb_build_object('documentId',metadata->>'documentId','moduleId',metadata->>'moduleId'));
 ELSE row_image:=jsonb_populate_record(NULL::truss.edge,before_image);END IF;
 IF effect_operation='update_edge' AND row_image.source_id::text=metadata->'source'->>'id'
  AND row_image.source_type::text=metadata->'source'->>'typeId' AND row_image.target_id::text=metadata->'target'->>'id'
  AND row_image.target_type::text=metadata->'target'->>'typeId' AND coalesce(row_image.retained,'{}')=metadata->'retained'
  AND row_image.order_key IS NOT DISTINCT FROM metadata->'orderKey'->>'text' THEN
  result:=jsonb_build_object('outcome','unchanged','operation','update_edge','identity',identity,'version',row_image.ver::text,'events','[]'::jsonb);
  ownership_context:=jsonb_set(ownership_context,'{after}',CASE WHEN effect_operation='delete_edge' THEN 'null'::jsonb ELSE jsonb_build_object('source',truss.runtime_endpoint_ownership(metadata->'source',revision),'target',truss.runtime_endpoint_ownership(metadata->'target',revision)) END);
  INSERT INTO truss.runtime_edge_transition(attempt_id,operation_index,writer_xid,edge_id,rel_type_id,before_edge,after_edge,journal,old_source,old_target,source_identity,target_identity,endpoint_ownership)
   VALUES(attempt_id,operation_index,attempt.writer_xid,row_image.id,row_image.rel_type_id,before_image,before_image,'[]'::jsonb,metadata->'oldSource',metadata->'oldTarget',metadata->'source',metadata->'target',ownership_context);
 ELSE
  IF before_image IS NOT NULL THEN
   IF row_image.ver=9223372036854775807 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'edge version exhausted' USING ERRCODE='54000';END IF;
   before_record:=truss.runtime_edge_history(before_image,identity,metadata->'oldSource',metadata->'oldTarget');row_image.ver:=row_image.ver+1;
  END IF;
  version:=row_image.ver;row_image.rev:=revision;row_image.updated_at:=clock_timestamp();
  IF before_image IS NOT NULL AND (effect_operation='delete_edge' OR metadata->'source' IS DISTINCT FROM metadata->'oldSource' OR metadata->'target' IS DISTINCT FROM metadata->'oldTarget') THEN
   INSERT INTO truss.key_tombstone(entity_kind,type_id,key_num,k,entity_id,ver) VALUES('e',row_image.rel_type_id,0,truss.runtime_edge_business_key(row_image.rel_type_id,metadata->'oldSource',metadata->'oldTarget'),row_image.id,version) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
  END IF;
  row_image.source_id:=(metadata->'source'->>'id')::bigint;row_image.source_type:=(metadata->'source'->>'typeId')::int;
  row_image.target_id:=(metadata->'target'->>'id')::bigint;row_image.target_type:=(metadata->'target'->>'typeId')::int;
  row_image.retained:=nullif(metadata->'retained','{}'::jsonb);row_image.order_key:=metadata->'orderKey'->>'text';
  IF effect_operation='delete_edge' THEN
   DELETE FROM truss.edge WHERE id=row_image.id AND rel_type_id=row_image.rel_type_id AND ver=(before_image->>'ver')::bigint;
   GET DIAGNOSTICS changed_rows=ROW_COUNT;
   IF changed_rows<>1 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'original edge version required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
   event:=jsonb_build_object('operation','delete','before',before_record);
  ELSE
   after_image:=to_jsonb(row_image);after_record:=truss.runtime_edge_history(after_image,identity,metadata->'source',metadata->'target');
   IF before_image IS NULL THEN
    INSERT INTO truss.edge SELECT (row_image).*;
    GET DIAGNOSTICS changed_rows=ROW_COUNT;
    IF changed_rows<>1 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'one original edge creation required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
    event:=jsonb_build_object('operation','create','after',after_record);
   ELSE
    UPDATE truss.edge SET source_id=row_image.source_id,source_type=row_image.source_type,target_id=row_image.target_id,target_type=row_image.target_type,
     retained=row_image.retained,order_key=row_image.order_key,rev=row_image.rev,ver=row_image.ver,updated_at=row_image.updated_at WHERE id=row_image.id AND rel_type_id=row_image.rel_type_id AND ver=(before_image->>'ver')::bigint;
    GET DIAGNOSTICS changed_rows=ROW_COUNT;
    IF changed_rows<>1 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'original edge version required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
    event:=jsonb_build_object('operation','metadata','before',before_record,'after',after_record);
   END IF;
  END IF;
  event:=event||jsonb_build_object('interfaceVersion','truss-history-event/0.2.0-proposal','sourceEpoch',installation.source_epoch::text,
   'historyProfile',selected_history,'xid',attempt.writer_xid::text,'seq',nextval('truss.journal_seq')::text,
   'identity',identity,'eventVersion',version::text,'eventCatalogRevision',revision::text,
   'origin',jsonb_build_object('asserted',input->'assertedOrigin','databaseRole',session_user::text));
  event:=event||jsonb_build_object('mutationGroup',jsonb_build_object('profile','truss-history-group/0.1.0','eventCount','1',
   'orderedEventDigest',encode(sha256(convert_to(jsonb_build_array(event)::text,'UTF8')),'hex')));
  journal.seq:=(event->>'seq')::bigint;journal.at:=clock_timestamp();journal.xid:=attempt.writer_xid;journal.entity_kind:='e';journal.entity_id:=row_image.id;
  journal.entity_type:=row_image.rel_type_id;journal.ver:=version;journal.op:=event->>'operation';journal.prop_id:=NULL;journal.old_value:=NULL;
  journal.new_value:=truss.runtime_exact_wrapper('event',convert_to(event::text,'UTF8'));journal.rev:=revision;
  journal.origin:=truss.runtime_exact_wrapper('origin',convert_to((event->'origin')::text,'UTF8'));
  INSERT INTO truss.journal SELECT (journal).*;
  ownership_context:=jsonb_set(ownership_context,'{after}',CASE WHEN effect_operation='delete_edge' THEN 'null'::jsonb ELSE jsonb_build_object('source',truss.runtime_endpoint_ownership(metadata->'source',revision),'target',truss.runtime_endpoint_ownership(metadata->'target',revision)) END);
  INSERT INTO truss.runtime_edge_transition(attempt_id,operation_index,writer_xid,edge_id,rel_type_id,before_edge,after_edge,journal,old_source,old_target,source_identity,target_identity,endpoint_ownership)
   VALUES(attempt_id,operation_index,attempt.writer_xid,row_image.id,row_image.rel_type_id,before_image,after_image,jsonb_build_array(to_jsonb(journal)),
    metadata->'oldSource',metadata->'oldTarget',metadata->'source',metadata->'target',ownership_context);
  event_refs:=jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('sourceEpoch',installation.source_epoch::text,'historyProfile',selected_history,'xid',attempt.writer_xid::text,'seq',journal.seq::text));
  IF effect_operation='create_edge' THEN result:=jsonb_build_object('outcome','created','operation','create_edge','identity',identity,'version',version::text,'events',event_refs);
   IF operation ? 'alias' THEN result:=result||jsonb_build_object('alias',operation->>'alias');END IF;
  ELSIF effect_operation='update_edge' THEN result:=jsonb_build_object('outcome','changed','operation','update_edge','identity',identity,'version',version::text,'events',event_refs);
  ELSE result:=jsonb_build_object('outcome','deleted','operation','delete_edge','identity',identity,'deletionVersion',version::text,
   'deleted',jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('identity',identity,'deletionVersion',version::text)),'events',event_refs);END IF;
 END IF;
 -- The legacy route settles itself; owned groups settle distinct authority once.
 IF advance THEN
 current_actor:=truss.runtime_person(false);
 PERFORM truss.runtime_module_writer_qualified(metadata->>'documentId',metadata->>'moduleId',current_actor);
 FOR entry IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(jsonb_build_array(metadata->'oldSource',metadata->'oldTarget',metadata->'source',metadata->'target')) WHERE value<>'null'::jsonb LOOP
  IF NOT truss.runtime_can_read_qualified(entry->'owner'->>'documentId',entry->'owner'->>'moduleId',current_actor) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'endpoint reader required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
 END LOOP;
 END IF;
 IF advance THEN
 UPDATE truss.runtime_object_attempt SET next_index=next_index+1,results=results||jsonb_build_array(result),
  aliases=aliases||CASE WHEN effect_operation='create_edge' AND operation ? 'alias' THEN jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('alias',operation->>'alias','identity',identity)) ELSE '[]'::jsonb END WHERE id=attempt_id;
 END IF;
 RETURN convert_to(result::text,'UTF8');
END;
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.runtime_edge_endpoint(reference jsonb, attempt_id uuid, operation_index integer)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE attempt truss.runtime_object_attempt%ROWTYPE;operations jsonb;identity jsonb;selected truss.type_def%ROWTYPE;object_row truss.object%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO STRICT attempt FROM truss.runtime_object_attempt WHERE id=attempt_id;
 operations:=convert_from(attempt.input_bytes,'UTF8')::jsonb->'operations';
 IF reference->>'state'='stored' AND reference-ARRAY['state','identity']='{}'::jsonb THEN identity:=reference->'identity';
 ELSIF reference->>'state'='alias' AND reference-ARRAY['state','alias']='{}'::jsonb THEN
  IF (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_array_elements(operations) WITH ORDINALITY o(value,ord)
   WHERE ord<=operation_index AND value->>'operation'='create_object' AND value->>'alias'=reference->>'alias')<>1 THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'prior object endpoint alias required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
  SELECT value->'identity' INTO STRICT identity FROM jsonb_array_elements(attempt.aliases) WHERE value->>'alias'=reference->>'alias';
 ELSE RAISE EXCEPTION 'qualified object endpoint required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 IF jsonb_typeof(identity->'typeId') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string' OR jsonb_typeof(identity->'definitionPin') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string' THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'exact object endpoint identity required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 selected:=truss.runtime_condition_type(identity);IF NOT truss.runtime_can_read(selected.document_id,selected.module) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'endpoint reader required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
 SELECT * INTO object_row FROM truss.object WHERE id=(identity->>'id')::bigint AND type_id=selected.type_id FOR UPDATE NOWAIT;
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'endpoint absent' USING ERRCODE='P1004';END IF;
 IF object_row.root_id IS NOT NULL THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'rootless endpoint required' USING ERRCODE='0A000';END IF;
 RETURN identity;
END;
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.runtime_edge_read(selected_document text, selected_module text, selected_relationship text, selected_id bigint, maximum_bytes integer, expected_release text, expected_digest text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
 SET row_security TO 'off'
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
AS $function$
DECLARE relation truss.rel_def%ROWTYPE;edge_row truss.edge%ROWTYPE;installation truss.catalog_runtime_installation%ROWTYPE;
 source_identity jsonb;target_identity jsonb;endpoint truss.type_def%ROWTYPE;frozen record;entry jsonb;obj jsonb;root_row jsonb;root_def jsonb;root_owners jsonb:='[]';pin record;identity jsonb;result bytea;captured_revision int;
BEGIN
 PERFORM truss.runtime_person(false);
 IF selected_id IS NULL OR selected_id<1 OR maximum_bytes IS NULL OR maximum_bytes NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 16777216 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'bounded edge selection required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT installation FROM truss.runtime_current_installation();
 IF installation.release_id IS DISTINCT FROM expected_release OR installation.release_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM expected_digest THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'selected edge runtime required' USING ERRCODE='0A000';END IF;
 SELECT rev INTO STRICT captured_revision FROM truss.schema_head WHERE id=1;
 IF NOT truss.runtime_can_read(selected_document,selected_module) THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 SELECT * INTO relation FROM truss.rel_def WHERE document_id=selected_document AND module=selected_module AND rel_id=selected_relationship AND retired_rev IS NULL;
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 -- Freeze the edge, endpoint rows and their aggregate roots in one statement snapshot.
 SELECT e AS edge,s AS source,t AS target,st AS source_definition,tt AS target_definition,
  sr AS source_root,tr AS target_root,srt AS source_root_definition,trt AS target_root_definition
 INTO frozen FROM truss.edge e
 JOIN truss.object s ON s.id=e.source_id AND s.type_id=e.source_type
 JOIN truss.object t ON t.id=e.target_id AND t.type_id=e.target_type
 JOIN truss.type_def st ON st.type_id=s.type_id AND st.retired_rev IS NULL
 JOIN truss.type_def tt ON tt.type_id=t.type_id AND tt.retired_rev IS NULL
 LEFT JOIN truss.object sr ON sr.id=s.root_id AND sr.type_id=s.root_type
 LEFT JOIN truss.object tr ON tr.id=t.root_id AND tr.type_id=t.root_type
 LEFT JOIN truss.type_def srt ON srt.type_id=sr.type_id AND srt.retired_rev IS NULL
 LEFT JOIN truss.type_def trt ON trt.type_id=tr.type_id AND trt.retired_rev IS NULL
 WHERE e.id=selected_id AND e.rel_type_id=relation.rel_type_id;
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 edge_row:=frozen.edge;
 IF relation.lifecycle NOT IN ('independent','owned') OR NOT relation.directed OR relation.composition OR relation.assoc_type_id IS NOT NULL OR edge_row.props<>'{}'::jsonb THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'selected directed scalar edge required' USING ERRCODE='0A000';END IF;
 FOR entry IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(jsonb_build_array(
  jsonb_build_object('object',to_jsonb(frozen.source),'definition',to_jsonb(frozen.source_definition),'root',to_jsonb(frozen.source_root),'rootDefinition',to_jsonb(frozen.source_root_definition)),
  jsonb_build_object('object',to_jsonb(frozen.target),'definition',to_jsonb(frozen.target_definition),'root',to_jsonb(frozen.target_root),'rootDefinition',to_jsonb(frozen.target_root_definition)))) LOOP
  obj:=entry->'object';endpoint:=jsonb_populate_record(NULL::truss.type_def,entry->'definition');
  IF endpoint.kind<>'record' OR endpoint.provisional OR (obj->>'rev')::int>captured_revision OR endpoint.since_rev>captured_revision THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'current endpoint catalog required' USING ERRCODE='55P03';END IF;
  IF NOT truss.runtime_can_read(endpoint.document_id,endpoint.module) THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
  IF obj->>'root_id' IS NOT NULL OR obj->>'root_type' IS NOT NULL THEN
   root_row:=entry->'root';root_def:=entry->'rootDefinition';
   IF obj->>'root_id' IS NULL OR obj->>'root_type' IS NULL OR root_row->>'id' IS NULL OR root_def->>'type_id' IS NULL
    OR root_row->>'root_id' IS NOT NULL OR root_row->>'root_type' IS NOT NULL
    OR root_row->>'id'=obj->>'id' AND root_row->>'type_id'=obj->>'type_id'
    OR root_def->>'kind'<>'record' OR (root_def->>'provisional')::boolean THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'current endpoint aggregate root required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
   IF (root_row->>'rev')::int>captured_revision OR (root_def->>'since_rev')::int>captured_revision THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'endpoint root catalog changed' USING ERRCODE='55P03';END IF;
   IF NOT truss.runtime_can_read(root_def->>'document_id',root_def->>'module') THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
   root_owners:=root_owners||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('documentId',root_def->>'document_id','moduleId',root_def->>'module'));
  END IF;
 END LOOP;
 endpoint:=frozen.source_definition;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT pin FROM truss.runtime_owned_definition_metadata('type',endpoint.type_id);
 source_identity:=jsonb_build_object('id',edge_row.source_id::text,'typeId',endpoint.type_id::text,'definitionPin',pin.definition_pin,'owner',jsonb_build_object('documentId',endpoint.document_id,'moduleId',endpoint.module));
 endpoint:=frozen.target_definition;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT pin FROM truss.runtime_owned_definition_metadata('type',endpoint.type_id);
 target_identity:=jsonb_build_object('id',edge_row.target_id::text,'typeId',endpoint.type_id::text,'definitionPin',pin.definition_pin,'owner',jsonb_build_object('documentId',endpoint.document_id,'moduleId',endpoint.module));
 identity:=jsonb_build_object('id',edge_row.id::text,'typeId',relation.rel_type_id::text,'definitionPin',truss.runtime_relationship_pin(relation.rel_type_id),'owner',jsonb_build_object('documentId',relation.document_id,'moduleId',relation.module));
 result:=convert_to((truss.runtime_edge_history(to_jsonb(edge_row),identity,source_identity,target_identity,captured_revision)||jsonb_build_object('executedCatalogRevision',captured_revision::text))::text,'UTF8');
 IF octet_length(result)>maximum_bytes THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'bounded complete edge required' USING ERRCODE='54000';END IF;
 IF NOT truss.runtime_can_read(relation.document_id,relation.module) OR NOT truss.runtime_can_read(source_identity->'owner'->>'documentId',source_identity->'owner'->>'moduleId')
  OR NOT truss.runtime_can_read(target_identity->'owner'->>'documentId',target_identity->'owner'->>'moduleId') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'current edge reader required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
 IF (SELECT rev FROM truss.schema_head WHERE id=1) IS DISTINCT FROM captured_revision THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'edge catalog changed' USING ERRCODE='55P03';END IF;
 FOR entry IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(root_owners) LOOP
  IF NOT truss.runtime_can_read(entry->>'documentId',entry->>'moduleId') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'current endpoint root reader required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
 END LOOP;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('edge',convert_from(result,'UTF8')::jsonb,'rootOwners',root_owners);
END;
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.runtime_endpoint_ownership(identity jsonb, captured_revision integer)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE endpoint truss.object%ROWTYPE;root_object truss.object%ROWTYPE;endpoint_type truss.type_def%ROWTYPE;root_type truss.type_def%ROWTYPE;pin record;ownership jsonb;
BEGIN
 IF captured_revision<1 OR (SELECT rev FROM truss.schema_head WHERE id=1) IS DISTINCT FROM captured_revision THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'current ownership observation revision required' USING ERRCODE='55P03';END IF;
 IF identity-ARRAY['id','typeId','definitionPin','owner']<>'{}'::jsonb OR jsonb_typeof(identity->'owner') IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'exact endpoint identity required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT endpoint_type FROM truss.type_def WHERE type_id=(identity->>'typeId')::int AND kind='record' AND NOT provisional AND retired_rev IS NULL;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT pin FROM truss.runtime_owned_definition_metadata('type',endpoint_type.type_id,NULL,captured_revision);
 IF identity->>'definitionPin' IS DISTINCT FROM pin.definition_pin OR identity->'owner' IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object('documentId',endpoint_type.document_id,'moduleId',endpoint_type.module) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'original endpoint definition correspondence required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 IF NOT truss.runtime_can_read(endpoint_type.document_id,endpoint_type.module) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'endpoint reader required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT endpoint FROM truss.object WHERE id=(identity->>'id')::bigint AND type_id=endpoint_type.type_id;
 IF (endpoint.root_id IS NULL) IS DISTINCT FROM (endpoint.root_type IS NULL) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'complete root pair required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
 ownership:='{"state":"rootless"}';
 IF endpoint.root_id IS NOT NULL THEN
  SELECT * INTO STRICT root_type FROM truss.type_def WHERE type_id=endpoint.root_type AND kind='record' AND NOT provisional AND retired_rev IS NULL;
  IF NOT truss.runtime_can_read(root_type.document_id,root_type.module) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'aggregate root reader required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
  SELECT * INTO STRICT root_object FROM truss.object WHERE id=endpoint.root_id AND type_id=endpoint.root_type;
  IF root_object.root_id IS NOT NULL OR root_object.root_type IS NOT NULL OR root_object.id=endpoint.id AND root_object.type_id=endpoint.type_id THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'live rootless aggregate root required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
  SELECT * INTO STRICT pin FROM truss.runtime_owned_definition_metadata('type',root_type.type_id,NULL,captured_revision);
  ownership:=jsonb_build_object('state','owned','root',jsonb_build_object('id',root_object.id::text,'typeId',root_type.type_id::text,'definitionPin',pin.definition_pin,
    'owner',jsonb_build_object('documentId',root_type.document_id,'moduleId',root_type.module)));
 END IF;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('identity',identity,'ownership',ownership);
END;
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.runtime_feed_authorize(selected_consumer text, expected_release text, expected_digest text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE person oid;consumer truss.runtime_feed_consumer%ROWTYPE;installation truss.catalog_runtime_installation%ROWTYPE;owner record;
BEGIN
 person:=truss.runtime_person(false);
 SELECT * INTO STRICT installation FROM truss.runtime_current_installation();
 IF installation.release_id IS DISTINCT FROM expected_release OR installation.release_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM expected_digest
 OR pg_is_in_recovery() THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'selected authority feed profile required' USING ERRCODE='0A000';END IF;
 SELECT * INTO consumer FROM truss.runtime_feed_consumer WHERE consumer_id=selected_consumer;
 IF NOT FOUND OR NOT EXISTS(WITH RECURSIVE memberships(role_oid) AS (
  SELECT person UNION SELECT m.roleid FROM pg_auth_members m JOIN memberships p ON m.member=p.role_oid)
  SELECT 1 FROM memberships WHERE role_oid=consumer.reader_oid) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'authorized feed consumer required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
 -- This is a complete database feed, not a role-filtered change stream.
 -- Every module in every disclosed historical document must be readable.
 FOR owner IN SELECT DISTINCT d.doc_id,m.value->>'id' AS module_id FROM truss.schema_doc d
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(d.document::jsonb->'modules') m LOOP
  IF NOT truss.runtime_can_read(owner.doc_id,owner.module_id) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'complete source authority required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
 END LOOP;
END;
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.runtime_graph_validate_object_qualified(selected_id bigint, selected_type integer, refresh_markers boolean, qualified_actor oid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
 SET plan_cache_mode TO 'force_generic_plan'
AS $function$
DECLARE phase int;relation truss.rel_def%ROWTYPE;owner record;outgoing bigint;incoming bigint;expected jsonb;actual jsonb;
BEGIN
  PERFORM 1 FROM truss.object WHERE id=selected_id AND type_id=selected_type FOR UPDATE NOWAIT;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RETURN;END IF;
  FOR phase IN 1..2 LOOP
   FOR owner IN
    WITH selected_relations AS MATERIALIZED (
     SELECT DISTINCT rel_type_id FROM truss.rel_endpoint WHERE source_type=selected_type OR target_type=selected_type),
    active_relations AS MATERIALIZED (
     SELECT r.rel_type_id,r.document_id,r.module FROM selected_relations s JOIN truss.rel_def r USING(rel_type_id)
     WHERE r.retired_rev IS NULL),
    dependencies AS (
     SELECT document_id,module AS module_id FROM active_relations
     UNION ALL SELECT t.document_id,t.module FROM active_relations r
      JOIN truss.rel_endpoint e USING(rel_type_id) JOIN truss.type_def t ON t.type_id IN(e.source_type,e.target_type))
    SELECT DISTINCT document_id,module_id FROM dependencies
   LOOP
    IF NOT truss.runtime_can_read_qualified(owner.document_id,owner.module_id,qualified_actor) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'complete relationship and endpoint count reader required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
   END LOOP;
   IF phase=1 THEN
  FOR relation IN SELECT r.* FROM (
   SELECT DISTINCT rel_type_id FROM truss.rel_endpoint WHERE source_type=selected_type OR target_type=selected_type
  ) selected JOIN truss.rel_def r USING(rel_type_id) WHERE r.retired_rev IS NULL ORDER BY r.rel_type_id LOOP
   -- A threshold verdict needs only minimum witnesses or maximum + 1 rows.
   outgoing:=NULL;incoming:=NULL;
   IF (relation.target_min>0 OR relation.target_max IS NOT NULL)
    AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM truss.rel_endpoint WHERE rel_type_id=relation.rel_type_id AND source_type=selected_type) THEN
    SELECT count(*) INTO outgoing FROM (
     SELECT 1 FROM truss.edge WHERE rel_type_id=relation.rel_type_id AND source_id=selected_id AND source_type=selected_type
     LIMIT CASE WHEN relation.target_max IS NULL THEN relation.target_min::bigint ELSE relation.target_max::bigint+1 END
    ) matching_edges;
    IF outgoing<relation.target_min OR relation.target_max IS NOT NULL AND outgoing>relation.target_max THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'outgoing multiplicity failed' USING ERRCODE='P1405',DETAIL=jsonb_build_object('rule',CASE WHEN outgoing<relation.target_min THEN 'relationship.target_min' ELSE 'relationship.target_max' END,
     'entity',jsonb_build_object('kind','object','id',selected_id::text,'typeId',selected_type::text),
     'relationship',jsonb_build_object('documentId',relation.document_id,'moduleId',relation.module,'relationshipId',relation.rel_id))::text;END IF;
   END IF;
   IF (relation.source_min>0 OR relation.source_max IS NOT NULL)
    AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM truss.rel_endpoint WHERE rel_type_id=relation.rel_type_id AND target_type=selected_type) THEN
    SELECT count(*) INTO incoming FROM (
     SELECT 1 FROM truss.edge WHERE rel_type_id=relation.rel_type_id AND target_id=selected_id AND target_type=selected_type
     LIMIT CASE WHEN relation.source_max IS NULL THEN relation.source_min::bigint ELSE relation.source_max::bigint+1 END
    ) matching_edges;
    IF incoming<relation.source_min OR relation.source_max IS NOT NULL AND incoming>relation.source_max THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'incoming multiplicity failed' USING ERRCODE='P1405',DETAIL=jsonb_build_object('rule',CASE WHEN incoming<relation.source_min THEN 'relationship.source_min' ELSE 'relationship.source_max' END,
     'entity',jsonb_build_object('kind','object','id',selected_id::text,'typeId',selected_type::text),
     'relationship',jsonb_build_object('documentId',relation.document_id,'moduleId',relation.module,'relationshipId',relation.rel_id))::text;END IF;
   END IF;
   SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(v ORDER BY v->>'side'),'[]'::jsonb) INTO expected FROM (
    SELECT jsonb_build_object('rel_type_id',relation.rel_type_id,'side','s','endpoint_id',selected_id,'edge_id',id) v FROM truss.edge
     WHERE relation.target_max=1 AND rel_type_id=relation.rel_type_id AND source_id=selected_id AND source_type=selected_type
    UNION ALL SELECT jsonb_build_object('rel_type_id',relation.rel_type_id,'side','t','endpoint_id',selected_id,'edge_id',id) FROM truss.edge
     WHERE relation.source_max=1 AND rel_type_id=relation.rel_type_id AND target_id=selected_id AND target_type=selected_type) markers;
   IF refresh_markers THEN
    DELETE FROM truss.edge_limit WHERE rel_type_id=relation.rel_type_id AND endpoint_id=selected_id;
    INSERT INTO truss.edge_limit SELECT (jsonb_populate_record(NULL::truss.edge_limit,value)).* FROM jsonb_array_elements(expected);
   END IF;
   SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(m) ORDER BY m.side),'[]'::jsonb) INTO actual FROM truss.edge_limit m WHERE m.rel_type_id=relation.rel_type_id AND m.endpoint_id=selected_id;
   IF actual IS DISTINCT FROM expected THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'exact final multiplicity markers required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
  END LOOP;
   END IF;
  END LOOP;
END;
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.runtime_history_entity(selection jsonb, expected_release text, expected_digest text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE installation truss.catalog_runtime_installation%ROWTYPE;selected_type int;
BEGIN
 PERFORM truss.runtime_person(false);
 SELECT * INTO STRICT installation FROM truss.runtime_current_installation();
 IF installation.release_id IS DISTINCT FROM expected_release OR installation.release_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM expected_digest
 OR pg_is_in_recovery() THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'selected retained authority history required' USING ERRCODE='0A000';END IF;
 IF selection-ARRAY['kind','documentId','moduleId','definitionId','id']<>'{}'::jsonb
 OR (selection->>'kind' IN ('object','edge')) IS NOT TRUE
 OR jsonb_typeof(selection->'id') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string' OR selection->>'id' !~ '^[1-9][0-9]{0,18}$'
 OR length(selection->>'id')=19 AND (selection->>'id') COLLATE "C">'9223372036854775807'
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_each(selection) WHERE key='documentId' AND jsonb_typeof(value)='string' AND octet_length(value#>>'{}') BETWEEN 1 AND 4096)
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_each(selection) WHERE key='moduleId' AND jsonb_typeof(value)='string' AND octet_length(value#>>'{}') BETWEEN 1 AND 4096)
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_each(selection) WHERE key='definitionId' AND jsonb_typeof(value)='string' AND octet_length(value#>>'{}') BETWEEN 1 AND 4096) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'bounded qualified history entity required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 IF NOT truss.runtime_can_read(selection->>'documentId',selection->>'moduleId') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'current history owner reader required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
 IF selection->>'kind'='object' THEN
  SELECT type_id INTO selected_type FROM truss.type_def WHERE document_id=selection->>'documentId' AND module=selection->>'moduleId' AND element=selection->>'definitionId'
   AND kind='record' AND NOT provisional AND retired_rev IS NULL;
 ELSE
  SELECT rel_type_id INTO selected_type FROM truss.rel_def WHERE document_id=selection->>'documentId' AND module=selection->>'moduleId' AND rel_id=selection->>'definitionId' AND retired_rev IS NULL;
 END IF;
 IF selected_type IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'retained entity definition unavailable' USING ERRCODE='P1010';END IF;
 RETURN selection||jsonb_build_object('typeId',selected_type::text,'installationId',installation.installation_id::text,
  'sourceEpoch',installation.source_epoch::text,'releaseSha256',installation.release_sha256);
END;
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.runtime_history_group_qualified(entity jsonb, writer xid8, version bigint, maximum_events integer, maximum_bytes integer, qualified_actor oid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
 SET bytea_output TO 'hex'
AS $function$
DECLARE physical truss.journal%ROWTYPE;original bytea;event jsonb;items jsonb:='[]';semantic jsonb:='[]';group_pin jsonb;
 count_events int:=0;size int:=0;expected_pin text;
 schema_metadata jsonb;property_pins jsonb;property_access jsonb;property_context jsonb;property_pin text;event_property_pin text;reader jsonb;property_type_pin text;
 property_revision int;property_type int;
 item_buffer jsonb[]:='{}';semantic_buffer jsonb[]:='{}';edge_context jsonb;endpoint_context jsonb;edge_readers_checked boolean:=false;
BEGIN
 FOR physical IN SELECT * FROM truss.journal j WHERE j.entity_kind=(CASE entity->>'kind' WHEN 'object' THEN 'o' ELSE 'e' END)::char(1)
  AND j.entity_id=(entity->>'id')::bigint AND j.entity_type=(entity->>'typeId')::int AND j.xid=writer AND j.ver=version ORDER BY j.seq LIMIT maximum_events+1 LOOP
  count_events:=count_events+1;
  IF count_events>maximum_events THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'whole history group exceeds event limit' USING ERRCODE='54000';END IF;
  size:=size+octet_length(physical.new_value::text)+octet_length(physical.origin::text);
  IF size>maximum_bytes THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'whole history group exceeds byte limit' USING ERRCODE='54000';END IF;
  original:=decode(physical.new_value->>'bytesBase64','base64');
  IF physical.new_value IS DISTINCT FROM truss.runtime_exact_wrapper('event',original)
  OR (convert_from(original,'UTF8') IS JSON OBJECT WITH UNIQUE KEYS) IS NOT TRUE THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'original exact history wrapper required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
  event:=convert_from(original,'UTF8')::jsonb;
  IF event->>'interfaceVersion' IS DISTINCT FROM 'truss-history-event/0.2.0-proposal'
  OR (event->>'historyProfile' IN ('truss-native-scalar-create/0.2','truss-native-owned-create/0.1','truss-native-scalar-mutation/0.1','truss-native-owned-mutation/0.1','truss-native-edge-mutation/0.1','truss-native-owned-edge-mutation/0.1','truss-native-catalog-rebind/0.1','truss-native-catalog-rebind/0.2','truss-native-catalog-rebind/0.3','truss-native-catalog-rebind/0.4')) IS NOT TRUE
  OR event->>'sourceEpoch' IS DISTINCT FROM entity->>'sourceEpoch' OR event->>'xid' IS DISTINCT FROM physical.xid::text
  OR event->>'seq' IS DISTINCT FROM physical.seq::text OR event->>'eventVersion' IS DISTINCT FROM physical.ver::text
  OR event->>'eventCatalogRevision' IS DISTINCT FROM physical.rev::text
  OR event->'identity'->>'id' IS DISTINCT FROM entity->>'id' OR event->'identity'->>'typeId' IS DISTINCT FROM entity->>'typeId'
  OR event->'identity'->'owner' IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object('documentId',entity->>'documentId','moduleId',entity->>'moduleId')
  OR physical.op IS DISTINCT FROM (CASE event->>'operation' WHEN 'property' THEN 'update' ELSE event->>'operation' END)
  OR physical.prop_id IS DISTINCT FROM (event->>'propertyId')::int
  OR physical.origin IS DISTINCT FROM truss.runtime_exact_wrapper('origin',convert_to((event->'origin')::text,'UTF8')) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'physical and semantic history correspondence required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
  -- The canonical producer already settled the transition. Only the original
  -- edge endpoint/root policy is additional to the public history images.
  IF event->>'historyProfile'='truss-native-owned-edge-mutation/0.1' AND NOT edge_readers_checked THEN
   SELECT t.endpoint_ownership INTO STRICT edge_context FROM truss.runtime_edge_transition t
    WHERE t.edge_id=physical.entity_id AND t.rel_type_id=physical.entity_type AND t.writer_xid=writer
     AND CASE WHEN t.after_edge IS NULL THEN (t.before_edge->>'ver')::bigint+1 ELSE (t.after_edge->>'ver')::bigint END=version;
   FOR endpoint_context IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(jsonb_build_array(
    edge_context->'before'->'source',edge_context->'before'->'target',edge_context->'after'->'source',edge_context->'after'->'target'))
    WHERE value<>'null'::jsonb LOOP
    IF NOT truss.runtime_can_read_qualified(endpoint_context->'identity'->'owner'->>'documentId',endpoint_context->'identity'->'owner'->>'moduleId',qualified_actor) THEN
     RAISE EXCEPTION 'current original endpoint reader required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
    PERFORM truss.runtime_history_ownership_qualified(jsonb_build_object('identity',endpoint_context->'identity',
     'catalogRevision',edge_context->>'captureCatalogRevision','ownership',endpoint_context->'ownership'),qualified_actor);
   END LOOP;
   edge_readers_checked:=true;
  END IF;
  IF entity->>'kind'='object' THEN
   IF property_pins IS NULL OR property_revision IS DISTINCT FROM physical.rev OR property_type IS DISTINCT FROM physical.entity_type THEN
    -- One detoast per revision/type; permissions below remain live per reader.
    SELECT s.metadata||'{}'::jsonb INTO STRICT schema_metadata FROM truss.runtime_type_schema s
     WHERE s.rev=physical.rev AND s.type_id=physical.entity_type;
    property_type_pin:=schema_metadata->>'typePin';property_pins:=schema_metadata->'propertyPins';property_access:=schema_metadata->'propertyAccess';
    schema_metadata:=NULL;
    property_revision:=physical.rev;property_type:=physical.entity_type;
   END IF;
   expected_pin:=property_type_pin;
  ELSE expected_pin:=truss.runtime_relationship_pin(physical.entity_type,physical.rev);END IF;
  IF expected_pin IS NULL OR event->'identity'->>'definitionPin' IS DISTINCT FROM expected_pin THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'original event interpretation required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
  IF event->>'operation' IN ('property','rebind') THEN
   IF event->>'operation'='rebind' AND
    (event->>'historyProfile' IN ('truss-native-catalog-rebind/0.1','truss-native-catalog-rebind/0.2','truss-native-catalog-rebind/0.3','truss-native-catalog-rebind/0.4')) IS NOT TRUE THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'original catalog rebind profile required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
   IF property_pins IS NULL OR property_revision IS DISTINCT FROM physical.rev OR property_type IS DISTINCT FROM physical.entity_type THEN
    SELECT s.metadata||'{}'::jsonb INTO STRICT schema_metadata FROM truss.runtime_type_schema s
     WHERE s.rev=physical.rev AND s.type_id=physical.entity_type;
    property_pins:=schema_metadata->'propertyPins';property_access:=schema_metadata->'propertyAccess';schema_metadata:=NULL;
    property_revision:=physical.rev;property_type:=physical.entity_type;
   END IF;
   event_property_pin:=CASE WHEN event->>'operation'='rebind' THEN event->>'afterDefinitionPin' ELSE event->>'definitionPin' END;
   property_pin:=property_pins->>physical.prop_id::text;property_context:=property_access->physical.prop_id::text;
   IF property_pin IS DISTINCT FROM event_property_pin OR property_context IS NULL
    OR (property_context->>'itemsValid')::boolean IS NOT TRUE OR jsonb_typeof(property_context->'readers') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'original property interpretation required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
   FOR reader IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(property_context->'readers') LOOP
    IF NOT truss.runtime_can_read_qualified(reader->>'documentId',reader->>'moduleId',qualified_actor) THEN
     RAISE EXCEPTION 'current historical property/item reader required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
   END LOOP;
  ELSIF event->>'operation'='create' THEN PERFORM truss.runtime_history_image_qualified(event->'after',entity,version,qualified_actor);
  ELSIF event->>'operation'='metadata' THEN
   PERFORM truss.runtime_history_image_qualified(event->'before',entity,version-1,qualified_actor);PERFORM truss.runtime_history_image_qualified(event->'after',entity,version,qualified_actor);
  ELSIF event->>'operation'='delete' THEN PERFORM truss.runtime_history_image_qualified(event->'before',entity,version-1,qualified_actor);
  ELSE RAISE EXCEPTION 'supported retained event required' USING ERRCODE='0A000';END IF;
  IF group_pin IS NULL THEN group_pin:=event->'mutationGroup';
  ELSIF group_pin IS DISTINCT FROM event->'mutationGroup' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'one complete mutation group required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
  semantic_buffer:=array_append(semantic_buffer,event-'mutationGroup');
  item_buffer:=array_append(item_buffer,jsonb_build_object('contentBase64',replace(encode(original,'base64'),chr(10),''),'sha256',encode(sha256(original),'hex'),
   'writerXid',physical.xid::text,'seq',physical.seq::text,'version',physical.ver::text));
 END LOOP;
 semantic:=to_jsonb(semantic_buffer);items:=to_jsonb(item_buffer);
 IF count_events=0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'retained history unavailable' USING ERRCODE='P1010';END IF;
 IF group_pin IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object('profile','truss-history-group/0.1.0','eventCount',count_events::text,'orderedEventDigest',encode(sha256(convert_to(semantic::text,'UTF8')),'hex')) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'complete original history group digest required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
 RETURN items;
END;
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.runtime_history_image_qualified(image jsonb, entity jsonb, expected_version bigint, qualified_actor oid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE revision int;pin text;member jsonb;endpoint jsonb;endpoint_pin record;
 schema_metadata jsonb;property_pins jsonb;property_access jsonb;property_context jsonb;property_pin text;property_id int;reader jsonb;
BEGIN
 IF image->>'interfaceVersion' IS DISTINCT FROM 'truss-history-record/0.1.0' OR image->>'kind' IS DISTINCT FROM entity->>'kind'
 OR image->'identity'->>'id' IS DISTINCT FROM entity->>'id' OR image->'identity'->>'typeId' IS DISTINCT FROM entity->>'typeId'
 OR image->'identity'->'owner' IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object('documentId',entity->>'documentId','moduleId',entity->>'moduleId')
 OR image->>'recordVersion' IS DISTINCT FROM expected_version::text THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'original complete history image required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
 revision:=(image->>'catalogRevision')::int;
 IF entity->>'kind'='object' THEN
  -- Force one detoast, then retain only flat property maps for this image.
  SELECT s.metadata||'{}'::jsonb INTO STRICT schema_metadata FROM truss.runtime_type_schema s
   WHERE s.rev=revision AND s.type_id=(entity->>'typeId')::int;
  pin:=schema_metadata->>'typePin';property_pins:=schema_metadata->'propertyPins';property_access:=schema_metadata->'propertyAccess';
  schema_metadata:=NULL;
 ELSE pin:=truss.runtime_relationship_pin((entity->>'typeId')::int,revision);END IF;
 IF pin IS NULL OR image->'identity'->>'definitionPin' IS DISTINCT FROM pin THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'original image interpretation required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
 FOR member IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(image->'properties') LOOP
  property_id:=(member->>'propertyId')::int;
  IF property_pins IS NULL THEN
   -- Project flat local maps once; repeated helper calls would detoast the
   -- complete stored type metadata again for every property in this image.
   SELECT s.metadata||'{}'::jsonb INTO STRICT schema_metadata FROM truss.runtime_type_schema s
    WHERE s.rev=revision AND s.type_id=(entity->>'typeId')::int;
   property_pins:=schema_metadata->'propertyPins';property_access:=schema_metadata->'propertyAccess';schema_metadata:=NULL;
  END IF;
  property_pin:=property_pins->>property_id::text;property_context:=property_access->property_id::text;
  IF property_pin IS DISTINCT FROM member->>'definitionPin' OR property_context IS NULL
   OR (property_context->>'itemsValid')::boolean IS NOT TRUE OR jsonb_typeof(property_context->'readers') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'original property interpretation required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
  FOR reader IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(property_context->'readers') LOOP
   IF NOT truss.runtime_can_read_qualified(reader->>'documentId',reader->>'moduleId',qualified_actor) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'current historical property/item reader required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
  END LOOP;
 END LOOP;
 IF entity->>'kind'='object' THEN PERFORM truss.runtime_history_ownership_qualified(image,qualified_actor);END IF;
 IF entity->>'kind'='edge' THEN
  FOR endpoint IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(jsonb_build_array(image->'source',image->'target')) LOOP
   SELECT * INTO STRICT endpoint_pin FROM truss.runtime_owned_definition_metadata('type',(endpoint->>'typeId')::int,NULL,revision);
   IF endpoint->>'definitionPin' IS DISTINCT FROM endpoint_pin.definition_pin OR endpoint->'owner' IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object('documentId',endpoint_pin.document_id,'moduleId',endpoint_pin.module_id) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'original endpoint interpretation required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
   IF NOT truss.runtime_can_read_qualified(endpoint_pin.document_id,endpoint_pin.module_id,qualified_actor) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'current historical endpoint reader required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
  END LOOP;
 END IF;
END;
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.runtime_history_ownership_qualified(image jsonb, qualified_actor oid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE ownership jsonb:=image->'ownership';root jsonb;pin record;revision int;
BEGIN
 IF ownership='{"state":"rootless"}'::jsonb THEN RETURN;END IF;
 IF ownership->>'state' IS DISTINCT FROM 'owned' OR ownership-ARRAY['state','root']<>'{}'::jsonb
  OR jsonb_typeof(ownership->'root') IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'original explicit ownership selection required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
 root:=ownership->'root';revision:=(image->>'catalogRevision')::int;
 IF root-ARRAY['id','typeId','definitionPin','owner']<>'{}'::jsonb
  OR jsonb_typeof(root->'id') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string' OR root->>'id' !~ '^[1-9][0-9]{0,18}$'
  OR length(root->>'id')=19 AND (root->>'id') COLLATE "C">'9223372036854775807'
  OR jsonb_typeof(root->'typeId') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string' OR root->>'typeId' !~ '^[1-9][0-9]{0,9}$'
  OR (root->>'typeId')::bigint>2147483647
  OR root->>'id'=image->'identity'->>'id' AND root->>'typeId'=image->'identity'->>'typeId'
  OR revision IS NULL OR revision<1 THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'exact historical aggregate root required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT pin FROM truss.runtime_owned_definition_metadata('type',(root->>'typeId')::int,NULL,revision);
 IF root->>'definitionPin' IS DISTINCT FROM pin.definition_pin
  OR root->'owner' IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object('documentId',pin.document_id,'moduleId',pin.module_id) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'original aggregate root interpretation required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
 IF NOT truss.runtime_can_read_qualified(pin.document_id,pin.module_id,qualified_actor) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'current historical root reader required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
END;
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.runtime_history_property_qualified(selected_type integer, property_id integer, revision integer, definition_pin text, qualified_actor oid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE access jsonb;pin text;reader jsonb;
BEGIN
 SELECT s.metadata->'propertyPins'->>property_id::text,s.metadata->'propertyAccess'->property_id::text
  INTO STRICT pin,access FROM truss.runtime_type_schema s WHERE s.rev=revision AND s.type_id=selected_type;
 IF pin IS DISTINCT FROM definition_pin OR access IS NULL OR (access->>'itemsValid')::boolean IS NOT TRUE
  OR jsonb_typeof(access->'readers') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'original property interpretation required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
 FOR reader IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(access->'readers') LOOP
  IF NOT truss.runtime_can_read_qualified(reader->>'documentId',reader->>'moduleId',qualified_actor) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'current historical property/item reader required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
 END LOOP;
END;
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.runtime_module_writer_qualified(selected_document text, selected_module text, qualified_actor oid)
 RETURNS oid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE person oid;policy truss.module_access%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
 person:=qualified_actor;
 SELECT * INTO policy FROM truss.module_access WHERE document_id=selected_document AND module=selected_module FOR SHARE NOWAIT;
 IF NOT FOUND OR NOT EXISTS(WITH RECURSIVE memberships(role_oid) AS (
  SELECT person UNION SELECT m.roleid FROM pg_auth_members m JOIN memberships p ON m.member=p.role_oid)
  SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles r JOIN memberships m ON m.role_oid=r.oid WHERE r.rolname::text=policy.writer_role) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'current qualified module writer required' USING ERRCODE='P1403'; END IF;
 RETURN person;
END;
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.runtime_object_commit_check()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
 SET row_security TO 'off'
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
 SET bytea_output TO 'hex'
AS $function$
DECLARE attempt truss.runtime_object_attempt%ROWTYPE;actual jsonb;expected jsonb;endpoint record;selected_edge bigint;selected_relation int;journal_kind text;journal_id bigint;journal_type int;current_actor oid;journal_problem boolean;expected_count bigint;distinct_expected bigint;actual_count bigint;owned_resource_kind text;owned_resource_type int;owner_document text;owner_module text;
BEGIN
 -- One fresh actor per constraint-trigger event. Resource authorization stays
 -- live below; this identity is never retained across events or commands.
 -- A completed native attempt owns its exact transition callback. Its mandatory
 -- attempt constraint performs the single current-authority/effect settlement;
 -- legacy and catalog-owned transitions retain their row validator.
 IF TG_TABLE_NAME IN ('runtime_object_transition','runtime_edge_transition') THEN
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM truss.runtime_object_attempt a WHERE a.id=NEW.attempt_id
    AND a.writer_xid=pg_current_xact_id() AND a.complete
    AND a.context->'mutationProfile'=truss.runtime_owned_profile()) THEN
   IF TG_TABLE_NAME='runtime_object_transition' THEN
    owned_resource_kind:='object';owned_resource_type:=NEW.type_id;
   ELSE
    owned_resource_kind:='edge';owned_resource_type:=NEW.rel_type_id;
   END IF;
  END IF;
 END IF;
 -- For an entity INSERT/UPDATE, tie the queued row image to the owned transition
 -- header. A later same-owner legacy/rebind write has a different version or
 -- catalog revision and must keep the ordinary row/graph/journal checks.
 IF TG_TABLE_NAME='object' AND TG_OP IN ('INSERT','UPDATE') THEN
  IF EXISTS(
   SELECT 1 FROM truss.runtime_object_transition t JOIN truss.runtime_object_attempt a ON a.id=t.attempt_id
   WHERE t.writer_xid=pg_current_xact_id() AND t.object_id=NEW.id AND t.type_id=NEW.type_id
    AND t.after_object->>'id'=NEW.id::text AND t.after_object->>'type_id'=NEW.type_id::text
    AND t.after_object->>'ver'=NEW.ver::text AND t.after_object->>'rev'=NEW.rev::text
    AND t.after_object->'root_id'=coalesce(to_jsonb(NEW.root_id),'null'::jsonb)
    AND t.after_object->'root_type'=coalesce(to_jsonb(NEW.root_type),'null'::jsonb)
    AND a.writer_xid=pg_current_xact_id() AND a.complete
    AND a.context->'mutationProfile'=truss.runtime_owned_profile()) THEN
   owned_resource_kind:='object';owned_resource_type:=NEW.type_id;
  END IF;
 END IF;
 -- Deleted objects are attributed to the owned deletion's before header.
 IF TG_TABLE_NAME='object' AND TG_OP='DELETE' THEN
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM truss.runtime_object_transition t JOIN truss.runtime_object_attempt a ON a.id=t.attempt_id
   WHERE t.writer_xid=pg_current_xact_id() AND t.object_id=OLD.id AND t.type_id=OLD.type_id
    AND t.after_object IS NULL AND t.before_object->>'ver'=OLD.ver::text AND t.before_object->>'rev'=OLD.rev::text
    AND t.before_object->'root_id'=coalesce(to_jsonb(OLD.root_id),'null'::jsonb)
    AND t.before_object->'root_type'=coalesce(to_jsonb(OLD.root_type),'null'::jsonb)
    AND a.writer_xid=pg_current_xact_id() AND a.complete AND a.context->'mutationProfile'=truss.runtime_owned_profile()) THEN
   owned_resource_kind:='object';owned_resource_type:=OLD.type_id;
  END IF;
 END IF;
 -- Match each queued edge header to its completed owned effect. Later legacy
 -- writes have a different header and retain their legacy validator.
 IF TG_TABLE_NAME='edge' THEN
  IF TG_OP='DELETE' THEN
   IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM truss.runtime_edge_transition t JOIN truss.runtime_object_attempt a ON a.id=t.attempt_id
    WHERE t.writer_xid=pg_current_xact_id() AND t.edge_id=OLD.id AND t.rel_type_id=OLD.rel_type_id
     AND t.after_edge IS NULL AND t.before_edge->>'ver'=OLD.ver::text AND t.before_edge->>'rev'=OLD.rev::text
     AND t.before_edge->>'source_id'=OLD.source_id::text AND t.before_edge->>'target_id'=OLD.target_id::text
     AND t.before_edge->>'source_type'=OLD.source_type::text AND t.before_edge->>'target_type'=OLD.target_type::text
     AND a.writer_xid=pg_current_xact_id() AND a.complete AND a.context->'mutationProfile'=truss.runtime_owned_profile()) THEN
    owned_resource_kind:='edge';owned_resource_type:=OLD.rel_type_id;
   END IF;
  ELSE
   IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM truss.runtime_edge_transition t JOIN truss.runtime_object_attempt a ON a.id=t.attempt_id
    WHERE t.writer_xid=pg_current_xact_id() AND t.edge_id=NEW.id AND t.rel_type_id=NEW.rel_type_id
     AND t.after_edge->>'ver'=NEW.ver::text AND t.after_edge->>'rev'=NEW.rev::text
     AND t.after_edge->>'source_id'=NEW.source_id::text AND t.after_edge->>'target_id'=NEW.target_id::text
     AND t.after_edge->>'source_type'=NEW.source_type::text AND t.after_edge->>'target_type'=NEW.target_type::text
     AND a.writer_xid=pg_current_xact_id() AND a.complete AND a.context->'mutationProfile'=truss.runtime_owned_profile()) THEN
    owned_resource_kind:='edge';owned_resource_type:=NEW.rel_type_id;
   END IF;
  END IF;
 END IF;
 -- A completed owned callback still rechecks current caller identity and writer
 -- authority for the row's exact owning module before taking its cheap path.
 IF owned_resource_type IS NOT NULL THEN
  -- The completed attempt already passed full actor qualification. Refresh
  -- only direct session safety flags and the exact module-writer membership;
  -- do not rescan installation privileges and every catalog table per row.
  SELECT r.oid INTO current_actor FROM pg_roles r
   WHERE r.rolname=session_user AND current_setting('role')='none' AND r.rolcanlogin
    AND NOT r.rolsuper AND NOT r.rolcreaterole AND NOT r.rolcreatedb AND NOT r.rolreplication AND NOT r.rolbypassrls;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'current qualified module writer required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
  IF owned_resource_kind='object' THEN
   SELECT document_id,module INTO STRICT owner_document,owner_module FROM truss.type_def WHERE type_id=owned_resource_type;
  ELSE
   SELECT document_id,module INTO STRICT owner_document,owner_module FROM truss.rel_def WHERE rel_type_id=owned_resource_type;
  END IF;
  PERFORM truss.runtime_module_writer_qualified(owner_document,owner_module,current_actor);
  RETURN NULL;
 END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname=session_user AND rolsuper) THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 -- A completed owned attempt requalifies actor and dependencies once in its
 -- mandatory settlement. Issue current identity here only for the legacy paths.
 IF TG_TABLE_NAME IN ('object','runtime_object_transition','runtime_catalog_rebind_transition','runtime_catalog_key_backfill','edge','runtime_edge_transition') THEN
  current_actor:=truss.runtime_person(false);END IF;
 IF TG_TABLE_NAME='runtime_object_attempt' THEN
  SELECT * INTO STRICT attempt FROM truss.runtime_object_attempt WHERE id=NEW.id;
  IF NOT attempt.complete OR attempt.writer_xid<>pg_current_xact_id() OR attempt.actor_oid<>truss.runtime_person(false)
   OR attempt.next_index<>jsonb_array_length(convert_from(attempt.input_bytes,'UTF8')::jsonb->'operations')
   OR jsonb_array_length(attempt.results)<>attempt.next_index THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'complete current mutation attempt required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
  IF convert_from(attempt.input_bytes,'UTF8')::jsonb->'mutationProfile'=truss.runtime_owned_profile() THEN PERFORM truss.runtime_owned_group_validate(attempt.id,false);END IF;
  IF attempt.receipt_id IS NOT NULL THEN
   SELECT * INTO STRICT endpoint FROM truss.request_receipt r WHERE storage_row_id=attempt.receipt_id;
   IF attempt.expected_receipt IS NOT NULL THEN
    IF to_jsonb(endpoint) IS DISTINCT FROM attempt.expected_receipt THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'exact original group receipt required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
   ELSIF convert_from(attempt.input_bytes,'UTF8')::jsonb->'mutationProfile'=truss.runtime_owned_profile() THEN
    IF endpoint.storage_row_id IS DISTINCT FROM attempt.receipt_id OR endpoint.namespace_identity_utf8 IS DISTINCT FROM convert_to(attempt.context->>'authorizedScopeIdentity','UTF8')
     OR endpoint.request_id_utf8 IS DISTINCT FROM convert_to(convert_from(attempt.request_bytes,'UTF8')::jsonb->'identity'->>'requestId','UTF8')
     OR endpoint.original_writer_xid IS DISTINCT FROM attempt.writer_xid OR endpoint.lifecycle_generation<>0
     OR endpoint.payload_state IS DISTINCT FROM 'complete' OR endpoint.original_receipt_bytes IS NULL
     OR endpoint.expired_identity_bytes IS NOT NULL OR endpoint.expiry_writer_xid IS NOT NULL OR endpoint.expiry_writer_context_bytes IS NOT NULL THEN
     RAISE EXCEPTION 'exact original group receipt header required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
   ELSE RAISE EXCEPTION 'original receipt binding required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
   IF attempt.position_bytes IS DISTINCT FROM truss.runtime_receipt_position(attempt.context,attempt.receipt_id,attempt.writer_xid) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'exact original receipt position required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
  END IF;
 ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME='object' THEN
  IF TG_OP='DELETE' THEN PERFORM truss.runtime_owned_row_validate_qualified(OLD.id,OLD.type_id,current_actor);ELSE PERFORM truss.runtime_owned_row_validate_qualified(NEW.id,NEW.type_id,current_actor);END IF;
 ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME IN ('runtime_object_transition','runtime_catalog_rebind_transition','runtime_catalog_key_backfill') THEN PERFORM truss.runtime_owned_row_validate_qualified(NEW.object_id,NEW.type_id,current_actor);
 ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME='edge' THEN
  IF TG_OP='DELETE' THEN PERFORM truss.runtime_owned_edge_validate_in_input_qualified(OLD.id,OLD.rel_type_id,NULL,NULL,NULL,current_actor);ELSE PERFORM truss.runtime_owned_edge_validate_in_input_qualified(NEW.id,NEW.rel_type_id,NULL,NULL,NULL,current_actor);END IF;
 ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME='runtime_edge_transition' THEN PERFORM truss.runtime_owned_edge_validate_in_input_qualified(NEW.edge_id,NEW.rel_type_id,NULL,NULL,NULL,current_actor);
 ELSE RAISE EXCEPTION 'registered mutation commit event required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
 -- Attempt and catalog settlement still validate the complete affected graph.
 -- Row events recheck every endpoint they can change, avoiding a complete
 -- transaction scan for each row. No validation cache survives later writes.
 IF TG_TABLE_NAME='runtime_object_attempt' THEN
  IF attempt.context->'mutationProfile'=truss.runtime_owned_profile() THEN
   PERFORM truss.runtime_owned_graph_validate_attempt(attempt.id,false);
   RETURN NULL;
  ELSE PERFORM truss.runtime_graph_validate(false);END IF;
 ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME='object' THEN
  -- Values/version/timestamps cannot change topology or multiplicity. Every
  -- actual edge/ownership/catalog change still queues its own structural check.
  IF TG_OP='DELETE' THEN PERFORM truss.runtime_graph_validate_object_qualified(OLD.id,OLD.type_id,false,current_actor);
  ELSIF TG_OP<>'UPDATE' OR ROW(OLD.id,OLD.type_id,OLD.root_id,OLD.root_type,OLD.rev)
    IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(NEW.id,NEW.type_id,NEW.root_id,NEW.root_type,NEW.rev) THEN
   PERFORM truss.runtime_graph_validate_object_qualified(NEW.id,NEW.type_id,false,current_actor);END IF;
 ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME='runtime_object_transition' THEN
  IF (NEW.before_object-ARRAY['props','retained','ver','created_at','updated_at'])
    IS DISTINCT FROM (NEW.after_object-ARRAY['props','retained','ver','created_at','updated_at']) THEN
   PERFORM truss.runtime_graph_validate_object_qualified(NEW.object_id,NEW.type_id,false,current_actor);END IF;
 ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME IN ('runtime_catalog_rebind_transition','runtime_catalog_key_backfill') THEN
  PERFORM truss.runtime_graph_validate_object_qualified(NEW.object_id,NEW.type_id,false,current_actor);
 ELSE
  -- Include old and new endpoints of every transition for this edge in this
  -- transaction, including retargets and deletion. Final-edge endpoints alone
  -- would miss a formerly connected object's minimum multiplicity.
  IF TG_TABLE_NAME='runtime_edge_transition' THEN selected_edge:=NEW.edge_id;selected_relation:=NEW.rel_type_id;
  ELSIF TG_OP='DELETE' THEN selected_edge:=OLD.id;selected_relation:=OLD.rel_type_id;
  ELSE selected_edge:=NEW.id;selected_relation:=NEW.rel_type_id;END IF;
  FOR endpoint IN SELECT DISTINCT (i.value->>'id')::bigint id,(i.value->>'typeId')::int type_id
   FROM truss.runtime_edge_transition t
   CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(jsonb_build_array(t.old_source,t.old_target,t.source_identity,t.target_identity)) i
   WHERE t.writer_xid=pg_current_xact_id() AND i.value<>'null'::jsonb
    AND t.edge_id=selected_edge
    AND t.rel_type_id=selected_relation
  LOOP
   PERFORM truss.runtime_graph_validate_object_qualified(endpoint.id,endpoint.type_id,false,current_actor);
  END LOOP;
 END IF;
 -- Ordinary entity events compare the complete journal for their typed owner.
 -- Mandatory attempt, catalog and legacy settlement keep transaction closure.
 IF TG_TABLE_NAME='object' THEN
  journal_kind:='o';
  IF TG_OP='DELETE' THEN journal_id:=OLD.id;journal_type:=OLD.type_id;
  ELSE journal_id:=NEW.id;journal_type:=NEW.type_id;END IF;
 ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME='runtime_object_transition' THEN
  journal_kind:='o';journal_id:=NEW.object_id;journal_type:=NEW.type_id;
 ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME='edge' THEN
  journal_kind:='e';
  IF TG_OP='DELETE' THEN journal_id:=OLD.id;journal_type:=OLD.rel_type_id;
  ELSE journal_id:=NEW.id;journal_type:=NEW.rel_type_id;END IF;
 ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME='runtime_edge_transition' THEN
  journal_kind:='e';journal_id:=NEW.edge_id;journal_type:=NEW.rel_type_id;
 END IF;
 -- Match each claim to its indexed physical row without aggregating event
 -- payloads. Keep entity and transaction statements separate so generic plans
 -- retain the entity index instead of scanning the whole xid for every object.
 IF journal_kind IS NOT NULL THEN
  WITH expected(value) AS MATERIALIZED (
   SELECT g.expected_members->m.operation_index->'journal'
   FROM truss.runtime_create_member m JOIN truss.runtime_create_group g USING(group_id)
   WHERE g.writer_xid=pg_current_xact_id() AND journal_kind='o' AND m.object_id=journal_id AND m.type_id=journal_type
   UNION ALL SELECT j.value FROM truss.runtime_object_transition t CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(t.journal) j
   WHERE t.writer_xid=pg_current_xact_id() AND journal_kind='o' AND t.object_id=journal_id AND t.type_id=journal_type
   UNION ALL SELECT j.value FROM truss.runtime_catalog_rebind_transition t CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(t.journal) j
   WHERE t.writer_xid=pg_current_xact_id() AND journal_kind='o' AND t.object_id=journal_id AND t.type_id=journal_type
   UNION ALL SELECT j.value FROM truss.runtime_edge_transition t CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(t.journal) j
   WHERE t.writer_xid=pg_current_xact_id() AND journal_kind='e' AND t.edge_id=journal_id AND t.rel_type_id=journal_type)
  SELECT count(*),count(DISTINCT ROW((e.value->>'at')::timestamptz,(e.value->>'seq')::bigint)),
   coalesce(bool_or((p.physical).seq IS NULL OR CASE WHEN e.value ? 'referenceProfile'
    THEN e.value IS DISTINCT FROM truss.runtime_owned_journal_reference(p.physical)
    ELSE e.value IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(p.physical) END),false)
  INTO expected_count,distinct_expected,journal_problem
  FROM expected e LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
   SELECT j physical FROM truss.journal j WHERE j.at=(e.value->>'at')::timestamptz AND j.seq=(e.value->>'seq')::bigint
    AND j.xid=pg_current_xact_id() AND j.entity_kind=journal_kind AND j.entity_id=journal_id AND j.entity_type=journal_type OFFSET 0) p ON true;
  SELECT count(*) INTO actual_count FROM truss.journal j WHERE j.xid=pg_current_xact_id() AND j.entity_kind=journal_kind AND j.entity_id=journal_id AND j.entity_type=journal_type;
 ELSE
  WITH expected(value) AS MATERIALIZED (
   SELECT g.expected_members->m.operation_index->'journal'
   FROM truss.runtime_create_member m JOIN truss.runtime_create_group g USING(group_id)
   WHERE g.writer_xid=pg_current_xact_id()
   UNION ALL SELECT j.value FROM truss.runtime_object_transition t CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(t.journal) j
   WHERE t.writer_xid=pg_current_xact_id()
   UNION ALL SELECT j.value FROM truss.runtime_catalog_rebind_transition t CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(t.journal) j
   WHERE t.writer_xid=pg_current_xact_id()
   UNION ALL SELECT j.value FROM truss.runtime_edge_transition t CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(t.journal) j
   WHERE t.writer_xid=pg_current_xact_id())
  SELECT count(*),count(DISTINCT ROW((e.value->>'at')::timestamptz,(e.value->>'seq')::bigint)),
   coalesce(bool_or((p.physical).seq IS NULL OR CASE WHEN e.value ? 'referenceProfile'
    THEN e.value IS DISTINCT FROM truss.runtime_owned_journal_reference(p.physical)
    ELSE e.value IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(p.physical) END),false)
