    WHERE p.type_id=selected_type.type_id AND p.retired_rev IS NULL AND node.value ? 'reference' LOOP
    IF owner_entry->>'documentId' IS NULL OR owner_entry->>'moduleId' IS NULL THEN
     RAISE EXCEPTION 'complete item owner required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
    IF NOT owners @> jsonb_build_array(owner_entry) THEN owners:=owners||jsonb_build_array(owner_entry);END IF;
   END LOOP;
   SELECT s.metadata INTO type_metadata FROM truss.runtime_type_schema s
    WHERE s.rev=(SELECT rev FROM truss.schema_head WHERE id=1) AND s.type_id=selected_type.type_id;
   IF NOT FOUND OR jsonb_typeof(type_metadata->'propertyAccess') IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'complete original object property scope required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
   FOR owner_entry IN SELECT reader.value FROM jsonb_each(type_metadata->'propertyAccess') property
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(property.value->'readers') reader(value) LOOP
    IF jsonb_typeof(owner_entry) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' OR owner_entry-ARRAY['documentId','moduleId']<>'{}'::jsonb THEN
     RAISE EXCEPTION 'complete original object reader required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
    IF NOT owners @> jsonb_build_array(owner_entry) THEN owners:=owners||jsonb_build_array(owner_entry);END IF;
   END LOOP;
  ELSE
   FOR ordinal IN 1..2 LOOP
    IF ordinal=1 THEN owner_entry:=identity_value->'source'->'owner';
    ELSE owner_entry:=identity_value->'target'->'owner';END IF;
    IF jsonb_typeof(owner_entry) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' OR owner_entry-ARRAY['documentId','moduleId']<>'{}'::jsonb
     OR jsonb_typeof(owner_entry->'documentId') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string' OR jsonb_typeof(owner_entry->'moduleId') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string' THEN
     RAISE EXCEPTION 'complete edge endpoint owner required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
    IF ordinal=1 AND (jsonb_typeof(identity_value->'source'->'typeId') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
      OR identity_value->'source'->>'typeId' !~ '^[1-9][0-9]{0,9}$'
      OR length(identity_value->'source'->>'typeId')=10
       AND identity_value->'source'->>'typeId' COLLATE pg_catalog."C">'2147483647')
     OR ordinal=2 AND (jsonb_typeof(identity_value->'target'->'typeId') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
      OR identity_value->'target'->>'typeId' !~ '^[1-9][0-9]{0,9}$'
      OR length(identity_value->'target'->>'typeId')=10
       AND identity_value->'target'->>'typeId' COLLATE pg_catalog."C">'2147483647') THEN
     RAISE EXCEPTION 'bounded original edge endpoint type id required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
    IF ordinal=1 THEN SELECT t.* INTO selected_type FROM truss.type_def t JOIN truss.runtime_definition_source d
      ON d.rev=t.definition_rev AND d.ord=t.definition_doc_ord AND d.doc_id=t.definition_document_id AND d.module_id=t.module AND d.element_id=t.element
       AND d.kind='element' AND d.key_id='' WHERE t.type_id=(identity_value->'source'->>'typeId')::int
       AND t.kind='record' AND NOT t.provisional AND t.retired_rev IS NULL AND d.definition_pin=identity_value->'source'->>'definitionPin';
    ELSE SELECT t.* INTO selected_type FROM truss.type_def t JOIN truss.runtime_definition_source d
      ON d.rev=t.definition_rev AND d.ord=t.definition_doc_ord AND d.doc_id=t.definition_document_id AND d.module_id=t.module AND d.element_id=t.element
       AND d.kind='element' AND d.key_id='' WHERE t.type_id=(identity_value->'target'->>'typeId')::int
       AND t.kind='record' AND NOT t.provisional AND t.retired_rev IS NULL AND d.definition_pin=identity_value->'target'->>'definitionPin';END IF;
    IF NOT FOUND OR owner_entry IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object('documentId',selected_type.document_id,'moduleId',selected_type.module) THEN
     RAISE EXCEPTION 'exact original edge endpoint owner required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
    IF NOT owners @> jsonb_build_array(owner_entry) THEN owners:=owners||jsonb_build_array(owner_entry);END IF;
    FOR owner_entry IN SELECT DISTINCT jsonb_build_object('documentId',selected_type.document_id,'moduleId',p.declaration_module)
     FROM truss.prop_def p WHERE p.type_id=selected_type.type_id AND p.retired_rev IS NULL LOOP
     IF NOT owners @> jsonb_build_array(owner_entry) THEN owners:=owners||jsonb_build_array(owner_entry);END IF;
    END LOOP;
    SELECT s.metadata INTO type_metadata FROM truss.runtime_type_schema s
     WHERE s.rev=(SELECT rev FROM truss.schema_head WHERE id=1) AND s.type_id=selected_type.type_id;
    IF NOT FOUND OR jsonb_typeof(type_metadata->'propertyAccess') IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' THEN
     RAISE EXCEPTION 'complete original endpoint property scope required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
    FOR owner_entry IN SELECT reader.value FROM jsonb_each(type_metadata->'propertyAccess') property
     CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(property.value->'readers') reader(value) LOOP
     IF jsonb_typeof(owner_entry) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' OR owner_entry-ARRAY['documentId','moduleId']<>'{}'::jsonb THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'complete original endpoint reader required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
     IF NOT owners @> jsonb_build_array(owner_entry) THEN owners:=owners||jsonb_build_array(owner_entry);END IF;
    END LOOP;
   END LOOP;
   SELECT r.* INTO selected_relation
    FROM truss.runtime_definition_source d JOIN truss.rel_def r
     ON r.definition_rev=d.rev AND r.definition_doc_ord=d.ord AND r.definition_document_id=d.doc_id
      AND r.module=d.module_id AND r.rel_id=d.element_id
    WHERE d.definition_pin=identity_value->>'relationshipDefinitionPin' AND d.kind='relationship'
     AND r.retired_rev IS NULL;
   IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'complete original relationship owner required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
   owner_entry:=jsonb_build_object('documentId',selected_relation.document_id,'moduleId',selected_relation.module);
   IF NOT owners @> jsonb_build_array(owner_entry) THEN owners:=owners||jsonb_build_array(owner_entry);END IF;
   -- An unattributed relationship has no association Record/property schema.
   -- Retain its real declaration owner; never fabricate an association type.
   IF selected_relation.assoc_type_id IS NOT NULL THEN
   SELECT * INTO selected_type FROM truss.type_def WHERE type_id=selected_relation.assoc_type_id AND retired_rev IS NULL;
   IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'complete original association type required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
   owner_entry:=jsonb_build_object('documentId',selected_type.document_id,'moduleId',selected_type.module);
   IF NOT owners @> jsonb_build_array(owner_entry) THEN owners:=owners||jsonb_build_array(owner_entry);END IF;
   FOR owner_entry IN SELECT DISTINCT jsonb_build_object('documentId',selected_type.document_id,'moduleId',p.declaration_module)
    FROM truss.prop_def p WHERE p.type_id=selected_type.type_id AND p.retired_rev IS NULL LOOP
    IF NOT owners @> jsonb_build_array(owner_entry) THEN owners:=owners||jsonb_build_array(owner_entry);END IF;
   END LOOP;
   SELECT s.metadata INTO type_metadata FROM truss.runtime_type_schema s
    WHERE s.rev=(SELECT rev FROM truss.schema_head WHERE id=1) AND s.type_id=selected_type.type_id;
   IF NOT FOUND OR jsonb_typeof(type_metadata->'propertyAccess') IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'complete original association property scope required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
   FOR owner_entry IN SELECT reader.value FROM jsonb_each(type_metadata->'propertyAccess') property
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(property.value->'readers') reader(value) LOOP
    IF jsonb_typeof(owner_entry) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' OR owner_entry-ARRAY['documentId','moduleId']<>'{}'::jsonb THEN
     RAISE EXCEPTION 'complete original association reader required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
    IF NOT owners @> jsonb_build_array(owner_entry) THEN owners:=owners||jsonb_build_array(owner_entry);END IF;
   END LOOP;
   END IF;
  END IF;
  EXCEPTION WHEN SQLSTATE '22023' OR SQLSTATE '22P02' THEN
   owner_inventory_complete:=false;
  END;
 END LOOP;
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(value ORDER BY value->>'documentId',value->>'moduleId'),'[]'::jsonb) INTO owners
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(owners)) unique_owner;
 IF jsonb_array_length(owners)>4096 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'load owner scope resource limit' USING ERRCODE='54000';END IF;

 FOR record_entry,outcome_entry IN SELECT r.value,o.value FROM jsonb_array_elements(chunk_records) WITH ORDINALITY r(value,ord)
  JOIN jsonb_array_elements(chunk_outcomes) WITH ORDINALITY o(value,ord) USING(ord) LOOP
  IF jsonb_typeof(record_entry) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' OR record_entry-ARRAY['inputIndex','record']<>'{}'::jsonb
   OR jsonb_typeof(record_entry->'inputIndex') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string' OR jsonb_typeof(record_entry->'record') IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
   OR jsonb_typeof(outcome_entry) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' OR outcome_entry-ARRAY['inputIndex','outcome','groupAttemptId','identity','version','reason','code','path']<>'{}'::jsonb
   OR outcome_entry->>'inputIndex' IS DISTINCT FROM record_entry->>'inputIndex'
   OR outcome_entry->>'outcome' NOT IN ('created','skipped','rejected') THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'exact chunk record and outcome pair required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
  index_value:=record_entry->>'inputIndex';
  IF index_value !~ '^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,3})$' OR index_value::int>1023 OR index_value::int>=original_count THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'canonical original load index required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
  record_value:=record_entry->'record';kind_value:=record_value->>'kind';identity_value:=record_value->'identity';
  payload_digest:=record_value->'payload'->>'sha256';payload_profile:=record_value->'payloadProfile';
  IF kind_value NOT IN ('object','edge') OR jsonb_typeof(identity_value) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
   OR jsonb_typeof(record_value->'payload') IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
   OR jsonb_typeof(payload_profile) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
   OR payload_digest IS NULL OR payload_digest !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
   OR payload_profile-ARRAY['identity','version','sha256']<>'{}'::jsonb
   OR jsonb_typeof(payload_profile->'identity') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string' OR jsonb_typeof(payload_profile->'version') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
   OR jsonb_typeof(payload_profile->'sha256') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string' THEN
   owner_inventory_complete:=false;kind_value:='unknown';payload_digest:='';payload_profile:='{}'::jsonb;
   identity_value:=jsonb_build_object('kind','unknown');
  END IF;
  group_attempt:=NULL;
  IF outcome_entry->>'outcome'='created' THEN
   IF jsonb_typeof(outcome_entry->'groupAttemptId') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'created import attempt reference required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
   group_attempt:=(outcome_entry->>'groupAttemptId')::uuid;
   IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM truss.runtime_object_attempt a WHERE a.id=group_attempt AND a.complete)
    OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM truss.runtime_import_source s WHERE s.group_attempt_id=group_attempt) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'created native source ledger reference required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
  ELSIF outcome_entry ? 'groupAttemptId' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'only created outcomes have attempt reference' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
  IF kind_value='object' THEN
   projected_identity:=jsonb_build_object('kind','object','typeId',identity_value->'type'->>'typeId',
    'definitionPin',identity_value->'type'->>'definitionPin','owner',identity_value->'type'->'owner',
    'keyNumber',identity_value->>'keyNumber','keyDefinitionPin',identity_value->>'keyDefinitionPin');
  ELSIF kind_value='edge' THEN
   projected_identity:=jsonb_build_object('kind','edge','relationshipDefinitionPin',identity_value->>'relationshipDefinitionPin',
    'source',jsonb_build_object('id',identity_value->'source'->>'id','typeId',identity_value->'source'->>'typeId',
     'definitionPin',identity_value->'source'->>'definitionPin','owner',identity_value->'source'->'owner'),
    'target',jsonb_build_object('id',identity_value->'target'->>'id','typeId',identity_value->'target'->>'typeId',
     'definitionPin',identity_value->'target'->>'definitionPin','owner',identity_value->'target'->'owner'));
  ELSE
   projected_identity:=jsonb_build_object('kind','unknown');
  END IF;
  all_entries:=all_entries||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
   'inputIndex',index_value,'outcome',outcome_entry->>'outcome','recordKind',kind_value,
   'identity',projected_identity,'payloadProfile',payload_profile,'payloadSha256',payload_digest,
   'groupAttemptId',group_attempt));
 END LOOP;
 count_entries:=jsonb_array_length(all_entries);
 IF count_entries<>jsonb_array_length(chunk_records) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'complete chunk audit report required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 SELECT * INTO prior FROM truss.runtime_import_load_chunk WHERE invocation_id=runtime_record_import_load.invocation
  ORDER BY chunk_index LIMIT 1;
  IF FOUND AND (prior.load_id IS DISTINCT FROM selected_load_id OR prior.original_asserted_origin IS DISTINCT FROM origin_value
  OR prior.asserted_origin_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM origin_sha
  OR prior.input_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM input_sha OR prior.input_count IS DISTINCT FROM original_count
  OR prior.total_chunks IS DISTINCT FROM total_no OR prior.native_actor IS DISTINCT FROM actor
  OR prior.native_actor_name IS DISTINCT FROM actor_name
  OR prior.original_owners IS DISTINCT FROM owners OR prior.owner_inventory_complete IS DISTINCT FROM owner_inventory_complete) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'conflicting original load invocation' USING ERRCODE='23505';END IF;
 SELECT * INTO prior FROM truss.runtime_import_load_chunk WHERE invocation_id=runtime_record_import_load.invocation
  AND chunk_index=chunk_no;
 IF FOUND THEN
  IF prior.total_chunks IS DISTINCT FROM total_no OR prior.load_id IS DISTINCT FROM selected_load_id
   OR prior.original_asserted_origin IS DISTINCT FROM origin_value
   OR prior.asserted_origin_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM origin_sha OR prior.input_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM input_sha
   OR prior.input_count IS DISTINCT FROM original_count OR prior.original_owners IS DISTINCT FROM owners
   OR prior.owner_inventory_complete IS DISTINCT FROM owner_inventory_complete
   OR prior.entries IS DISTINCT FROM all_entries OR prior.native_actor IS DISTINCT FROM actor
   OR prior.native_actor_name IS DISTINCT FROM actor_name THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'conflicting repeated import load chunk' USING ERRCODE='23505';END IF;
 ELSE
  INSERT INTO truss.runtime_import_load_chunk(invocation_id,chunk_index,total_chunks,load_id,original_asserted_origin,asserted_origin_sha256,input_sha256,
   input_count,original_owners,owner_inventory_complete,entries,native_actor,native_actor_name,writer_xid)
  VALUES(invocation,chunk_no,total_no,selected_load_id,origin_value,origin_sha,input_sha,original_count,owners,owner_inventory_complete,all_entries,actor,actor_name,pg_current_xact_id());
 END IF;
 PERFORM truss.runtime_person(false);
 RETURN convert_to(jsonb_build_object('outcome','recorded','chunkIndex',chunk_no::text)::text,'UTF8');
END;
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.runtime_retained_operation_owner(selected_attempt uuid, operation_index integer)
 RETURNS TABLE(document_id text, module text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE attempt truss.runtime_object_attempt%ROWTYPE;operation jsonb;result jsonb;identity jsonb;owner_document text;owner_module text;revision int;readers jsonb;dependency jsonb;current_actor oid;
BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO STRICT attempt FROM truss.runtime_object_attempt WHERE id=selected_attempt;
 IF NOT attempt.complete OR operation_index<0 OR operation_index>=attempt.next_index
  OR jsonb_array_length(attempt.results)<>attempt.next_index THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'complete retained operation required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
 operation:=convert_from(attempt.input_bytes,'UTF8')::jsonb->'operations'->operation_index;
 result:=attempt.results->operation_index;identity:=result->'identity';
 IF result->>'operation' IS DISTINCT FROM operation->>'operation' OR jsonb_typeof(identity->'typeId') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'retained operation identity required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
 IF operation->>'operation' IN ('create_object','update_object','delete_object') THEN
  SELECT t.document_id,t.module INTO STRICT owner_document,owner_module FROM truss.type_def t WHERE t.type_id=(identity->>'typeId')::int AND t.kind='record';
  IF attempt.expected_receipt IS NOT NULL THEN
   revision:=((convert_from(decode(substr(attempt.expected_receipt->>'original_receipt_bytes',3),'hex'),'UTF8')::jsonb)->'semantic'->>'executedCatalogRevision')::int;
  ELSIF attempt.context->'mutationProfile'=truss.runtime_owned_profile() AND operation->>'operation'<>'create_object' THEN
   SELECT (p.plan->>'catalogRevision')::int INTO STRICT revision FROM truss.runtime_owned_operation p
    WHERE p.attempt_id=attempt.id AND p.operation_index=runtime_retained_operation_owner.operation_index;
  END IF;
  IF attempt.expected_receipt IS NULL AND operation->>'operation'='create_object' THEN
   IF attempt.context->'creationTransitionProfile'='{"identity":"truss-unified-create-transition","version":"0.2","sha256":"073782e2517f2a7e26c8d6479c6266ececf68963681ccfb6a380e9cd16f2e11b"}'::jsonb THEN
    SELECT (t.after_object->>'rev')::int INTO STRICT revision FROM truss.runtime_object_transition t
     WHERE t.attempt_id=attempt.id AND t.operation_index=runtime_retained_operation_owner.operation_index AND t.before_object IS NULL;
   ELSE
   SELECT (g.expected_members->m.operation_index->'object'->>'rev')::int INTO STRICT revision FROM truss.runtime_create_member m JOIN truss.runtime_create_group g ON g.group_id=m.group_id WHERE m.object_id=(identity->>'id')::bigint AND m.type_id=(identity->>'typeId')::int AND g.writer_xid=attempt.writer_xid;
   END IF;
  END IF;
  IF revision IS NULL OR revision<1 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'positive original executed revision required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
  SELECT s.value_readers INTO STRICT readers FROM truss.runtime_type_schema s
   WHERE s.rev=revision AND s.type_id=(identity->>'typeId')::int;
  current_actor:=truss.runtime_person(false);
  FOR dependency IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(readers) LOOP
   IF NOT truss.runtime_can_read_qualified(dependency->>'documentId',dependency->>'moduleId',current_actor) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'current retained property/item reader required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
  END LOOP;
 ELSIF operation->>'operation' IN ('create_edge','update_edge','delete_edge') THEN
  SELECT r.document_id,r.module INTO STRICT owner_document,owner_module FROM truss.rel_def r WHERE r.rel_type_id=(identity->>'typeId')::int;
 ELSE RAISE EXCEPTION 'retained operation category required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
 IF identity->'owner' IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object('documentId',owner_document,'moduleId',owner_module) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'retained owner correspondence required' USING ERRCODE='55000';END IF;
 RETURN QUERY SELECT owner_document,owner_module;
END;
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.validate_batched_import_report(original_input bytea, original_outcomes bytea, original_context bytea, expected_release text, expected_digest text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
 SET row_security TO 'off'
AS $function$
DECLARE input jsonb;outcomes jsonb;context jsonb;item jsonb;record jsonb;
BEGIN
 IF octet_length(original_input)>8388608 OR octet_length(original_outcomes)>8388608 OR octet_length(original_context)>1048576 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'bounded original report required' USING ERRCODE='54000';END IF;
 input:=convert_from(original_input,'UTF8')::jsonb;outcomes:=convert_from(original_outcomes,'UTF8')::jsonb;context:=convert_from(original_context,'UTF8')::jsonb;
 IF convert_from(truss.batched_import_context(expected_release,expected_digest),'UTF8')::jsonb IS DISTINCT FROM context THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'original report context required' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
 FOR item IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(outcomes) LOOP
  IF item->>'outcome' IN ('created','skipped') THEN
   record:=input->'records'->(item->>'inputIndex')::int;
   PERFORM truss.import_report_record_authority(convert_to(jsonb_build_object('originalIdentity',record->'identity','outcomeIdentity',item->'identity')::text,'UTF8'),record->>'kind',expected_release,expected_digest);
  END IF;
 END LOOP;
 IF convert_from(truss.batched_import_context(expected_release,expected_digest),'UTF8')::jsonb IS DISTINCT FROM context THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'original report authority changed' USING ERRCODE='P1403';END IF;
 RETURN true;
END;
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION truss.writer_schema_basis(original_input bytea, original_documents bytea, expected_release text, expected_digest text)
 RETURNS bytea
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
 SET row_security TO 'off'
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
 SET bytea_output TO 'hex'
AS $function$
DECLARE input jsonb;documents jsonb;ops jsonb;operation jsonb;actor oid;installation truss.catalog_runtime_installation%ROWTYPE;
 selected_revision int;registration uuid;required_types int[];records jsonb;declaration_count bigint;result_bytes bytea;
BEGIN
 IF original_input IS NULL OR octet_length(original_input) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 1048576
  OR original_documents IS NULL OR octet_length(original_documents) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 4194304
  OR (convert_from(original_input,'UTF8') IS JSON OBJECT WITH UNIQUE KEYS) IS NOT TRUE
  OR (convert_from(original_documents,'UTF8') IS JSON ARRAY WITH UNIQUE KEYS) IS NOT TRUE THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 input:=convert_from(original_input,'UTF8')::jsonb;documents:=convert_from(original_documents,'UTF8')::jsonb;ops:=input->'operations';
 IF input->>'interfaceVersion'<>'truss-group-input/0.1.0' OR input->'catalog'<>'{"selection":"current"}'::jsonb
  OR input->'mutationProfile' IS DISTINCT FROM truss.runtime_owned_profile()
  OR jsonb_typeof(ops)<>'array' OR jsonb_array_length(ops) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 1024 THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT installation FROM truss.runtime_current_installation();
 IF installation.release_id IS DISTINCT FROM expected_release OR installation.release_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM expected_digest THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 SELECT rev INTO STRICT selected_revision FROM truss.schema_head WHERE id=1 FOR SHARE NOWAIT;
 SELECT reg.registration_id INTO STRICT registration FROM truss.catalog_registration_request reg WHERE reg.revision=selected_revision;
 actor:=truss.runtime_person(false);
 FOR operation IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(ops) LOOP
  IF operation->>'operation' IS NULL OR operation->>'operation' NOT IN ('create_object','update_object') OR operation ? 'ownershipChange' THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
  IF operation->>'operation'='create_object' AND (operation->'ownership' IS DISTINCT FROM '{"state":"rootless"}'::jsonb
   OR jsonb_typeof(operation->'typeDefinitionPin') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string') THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
  IF operation->>'operation'='update_object' AND (operation->'target'->>'state' IS NULL OR operation->'target'->>'state' NOT IN ('stored','alias')
   OR operation->'target'->>'state'='stored' AND jsonb_typeof(operation->'target'->'identity') IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
   OR operation->'target'->>'state'='alias' AND jsonb_typeof(operation->'target'->'alias') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string') THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 END LOOP;
 -- Resolve one representative per exact type pin / stored type identity. The
 -- native helper still owns identity rules, while duplicate operations avoid
 -- repeating source-pin derivation during cold cache construction.
 WITH indexed AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT value operation,(ordinality-1)::int operation_index
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(ops) WITH ORDINALITY o(value,ordinality)
 ), keyed AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT indexed.operation AS op_json,indexed.operation_index,
   CASE WHEN indexed.operation->>'operation'='create_object' THEN indexed.operation->>'typeDefinitionPin'
    WHEN indexed.operation->'target'->>'state'='stored' THEN indexed.operation->'target'->'identity'->>'definitionPin'
    ELSE (SELECT c.operation->>'typeDefinitionPin' FROM indexed c
     WHERE c.operation->>'operation'='create_object' AND c.operation->>'alias'=indexed.operation->'target'->>'alias'
      AND c.operation_index<indexed.operation_index ORDER BY c.operation_index LIMIT 1) END definition_pin,
   CASE WHEN indexed.operation->'target'->>'state'='stored' THEN indexed.operation->'target'->'identity'->>'typeId' END stored_type
  FROM indexed
 ), representatives AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON(definition_pin,stored_type) op_json,operation_index
  FROM keyed WHERE definition_pin IS NOT NULL ORDER BY definition_pin,stored_type,operation_index
 )
 SELECT coalesce(array_agg(DISTINCT q.type_id) FILTER(WHERE q.type_id IS NOT NULL),'{}'::int[]) INTO required_types
 FROM (SELECT (truss.runtime_owned_operation_type_qualified(r.op_json,ops,r.operation_index,actor)).type_id AS type_id
  FROM representatives r) q;
 IF cardinality(required_types)=0 THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM truss.type_def t JOIN unnest(required_types) r(type_id) USING(type_id)
  WHERE NOT EXISTS(WITH RECURSIVE memberships(role_oid) AS (
    SELECT actor UNION SELECT m.roleid FROM pg_auth_members m JOIN memberships p ON m.member=p.role_oid)
   SELECT 1 FROM truss.module_access ma JOIN pg_roles r ON r.rolname::text=ma.writer_role
    JOIN memberships m ON m.role_oid=r.oid WHERE ma.document_id=t.document_id AND ma.module=t.module)) THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 -- The supplied source set must be an exact current snapshot. This query is
 -- set-based across documents, including documents unrelated to the selected
 -- operations, so a cold application cache has one stable revision boundary.
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(documents) d
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT sd.document FROM truss.schema_doc sd WHERE sd.doc_id=d.value->>'documentId' ORDER BY sd.rev DESC LIMIT 1) a ON true
  WHERE jsonb_typeof(d.value)<>'object' OR jsonb_typeof(d.value->'sourceText')<>'string'
   OR a.document IS NULL OR convert_to(d.value->>'sourceText','UTF8') IS DISTINCT FROM convert_to(a.document,'UTF8')) THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 WITH RECURSIVE memberships(role_oid) AS (
  SELECT actor UNION SELECT m.roleid FROM pg_auth_members m JOIN memberships p ON m.member=p.role_oid
 ), candidates AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT t.type_id,t.document_id,t.module,compiled.metadata->>'typePin' definition_pin
  FROM truss.type_def t JOIN truss.runtime_type_schema compiled ON compiled.rev=selected_revision AND compiled.type_id=t.type_id
  WHERE t.kind='record' AND NOT t.provisional AND t.retired_rev IS NULL
   AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(documents) d WHERE d.value->>'documentId'=t.document_id)
   AND truss.runtime_object_values_readable_qualified(t.type_id,actor)
   AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM truss.module_access ma JOIN pg_roles r ON r.rolname::text=ma.writer_role
    JOIN memberships m ON m.role_oid=r.oid WHERE ma.document_id=t.document_id AND ma.module=t.module)
 ), properties AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT p.type_id,jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',p.name,'prop_id',p.prop_id,'home',p.home,
   'cardinality',p.cardinality,'nullability',p.nullability,'scalar_type',p.scalar_type,
   'facets',p.facets,'item',p.item) ORDER BY p.prop_id) rows
  FROM truss.prop_def p JOIN candidates c USING(type_id) WHERE p.retired_rev IS NULL GROUP BY p.type_id
 )
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('typeId',c.type_id::text,'definitionPin',c.definition_pin,
  'properties',coalesce(p.rows,'[]'::jsonb)) ORDER BY c.type_id),'[]'::jsonb)
 INTO records FROM candidates c LEFT JOIN properties p USING(type_id);
 SELECT coalesce(sum(jsonb_array_length(r.value->'properties')),0) INTO declaration_count
 FROM jsonb_array_elements(records) r;
 IF declaration_count>65536 THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM unnest(required_types) required(type_id)
  WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(records) r WHERE r.value->>'typeId'=required.type_id::text)) THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 IF (SELECT rev FROM truss.schema_head WHERE id=1) IS DISTINCT FROM selected_revision THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 result_bytes:=convert_to(jsonb_build_object('basis',jsonb_build_object('installationId',installation.installation_id::text,
  'releaseSha256',installation.release_sha256,'sourceEpoch',installation.source_epoch::text,'catalogRevision',selected_revision,'registrationId',registration::text,
  'documentsSha256',encode(sha256(original_documents),'hex')),'records',records)::text,'UTF8');
 IF octet_length(result_bytes)>16777216 THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 RETURN result_bytes;
EXCEPTION WHEN SQLSTATE '22023' OR SQLSTATE 'P1403' OR SQLSTATE '0A000' OR SQLSTATE '54000' OR SQLSTATE '55P03' OR SQLSTATE 'P0002' THEN
 RETURN NULL;
END;
